source: <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Really?! You mean it? Wow, thank you!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Heh heh... Well, thank you! I think you did a really good

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, obrigado, acho que você fez um bom
trabalho com isso, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Wait, are you sure? You better not be joking, ’cause I

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>É melhor não brincar, porque vou
me mudar, sabe?

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I dunno, it seems a little tight... <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,4)>I don’t think any more
Pokémon could fit in this house...
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Não sei, parece um pouco apertado<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,4)>... não acho que
mais Pokémon caberia nesta casa...

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh wow, this must be treasure, right?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Today must be our lucky day! Maybe we’ll find something
good next time too!
translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Hoje deve ser nosso dia de
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>sorte, talvez encontremos algo bom na próxima
vez também.

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, what’s that you’ve got there? It’s so sparkly and pretty!
translation: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei, o que você tem aí? É tão brilhante e bonito!

source:
<$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? For me? Aw, you shouldn’t have!
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>I know—you can have this! It’s my way of saying thank you!
translation:
<$emotion(1,39)><$voicel(1,9)>Para mim, não deveria ter, eu sei
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>, você pode ter isso, é minha maneira de agradecer.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>I appreciate the thought, but I really don’t need anything
like that right now...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>I’m sure there’s another Pokémon out there who’d really
like it, though!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu aprecio o pensamento, mas eu realmente não preciso de
nada assim agora... Tenho
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>certeza que há outro Pokémon lá fora que realmente
gostaria, no entanto!

source:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>I’m super sorry, but I don’t know what I’d do with that...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>I appreciate the thought, though!
translation:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Sinto muito, mas não sei o que faria com isso..
.<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)> mas agradeço o pensamento!

translation: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>É aqui que eu já vivo, não é?

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you think maybe you could fix it up for
me, <$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Aww, I was so sure we’d win this time... You’re really good
at hide-and-sneak, <$cdef(27)>!

translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu tinha tanta certeza que ganharíamos desta vez... você é muito
bom em esconder e <$cdef(27)>espirrar
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>, e aqui está o seu prêmio... é algo um pouco especial desta vez!

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Do you want to play another round?

<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aww, OK... Well, let’s play together again some other
time, then!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... This doesn’t really feel like THE place,
you know?

translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Isso não parece o lugar, sabe? Talvez
eu não vá
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>me mudar depois de tudo...

source:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>OK! I’ll get right on it! <$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>It’ll take me a little while, so come
back later to pick it up.
translation:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Certo, vou acertar, vou<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)> demorar um pouco, então volte
mais tarde para pegá-lo.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m working on it right now. I need a little bit more time,
I think...
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Estou trabalhando nisso agora, preciso de um pouco mais de tempo
, acho...

source:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,5)>There’s actually something else I need to do... I’m
really sorry!
translation:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,5)>Na verdade, há algo mais que preciso fazer...
Sinto muito!

<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Well...I guess standing around worrying isn’t gonna help

<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem... acho que ficar em pé se
preocupando <$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>não vai ajudar em nada.

<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Eu vou fazer disso minha nova casa, você
<$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,1)> foi quem fez esse lugar, certo? É tão legal que você

<$cdef(27)>?

I’m looking forward to life in my new home!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I’m really not sure why... Me? I love talking!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Às vezes parece que meus amigos ficam <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>entediados
me ouvindo falar... Eu
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>realmente não tenho certeza por que... eu?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>You know how sometimes you can see the moon even
when the sun’s still going down?

too early?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Sabe quando dá para ver a lua mesmo
antes de o sol terminar de se pôr?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Será que é porque ela acordou cedo
demais sem querer?

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)> cadentes, não é? Eu me
pergunto<$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> se a lua vai cair assim.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>I wonder what’s actually hidden there. Maybe it’s some

está enterrado... eu
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>me pergunto o que está realmente escondido lá
. Talvez seja algum tipo<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)> de tesouro incrível!

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>I tripped and fell the other day... I almost started crying,
but then <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>a nearby Pokémon came over to help me!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>That made me so happy... <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope I can help in the same
way if I ever see a Pokémon in need!

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu tropecei e caí outro dia... eu quase comecei a chorar, mas
então um <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Pokémon próximo veio me ajudar! Isso me

to

<$cdef(27)>, eu posso

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Heehee! I knew it! You’re so good at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>ing. ♪

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>É você, hehee, <$cdef(27)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>eu sabia, você é tão bom em <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Ooh... It looks like maybe we don’t have enough, y’know,
space to play hide-and-sneak, huh?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Uhhh... What should we do?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Parece que talvez não tenhamos espaço
suficiente para brincar de
esconde<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>-esconde, não é?

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Uhhh... I don’t think I can live here. I’m real sorry...

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>That’s really nice, but I’m pretty full now... Oh! <$voicel(1,8)>You should
eat it instead, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Isso é muito bom, mas estou bem cheio agora<$voicel(1,8)>... você
deveria comer isso, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Ooooooh! So this is my new home? Yay, new home!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Yippee! OK, here comes a question. Ummm...
<$voicel(1,5)>Who do you think is heavier, me or <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Aí vem uma pergunta, quem você
acha<$voicel(1,5)> que é mais pesado, eu ou<$cdef(27)>?

source: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa, I’m so happy... What’ll you trade me?
translation: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Estou tão feliz... o que você vai me trocar?

source: <$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, OK... Well, let me know if you need something!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>You wanna call it off? OK, got it...

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Hee hee! Thanks so much...
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, it looks like I don’t have anything left... Uh, come
back another time, OK?
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Obrigado, parece
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>que não tenho mais nada... volte outra
hora, certo?

source:
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! I’m off to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> now...
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee... I can’t wait to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>!
translation:
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>Estou indo para o <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> agora... hee
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>hee... eu não posso esperar para <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>!

source:
<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>... I’m sorry but, um... I think I’m out of
stuff to trade...
translation:
<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>Sinto muito, mas... acho que estou sem trabalho
para negociar...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... I wonder if I can eat this.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... Eu me pergunto se eu posso comer isso.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Ooooooh! You made food for me? Thank you so much!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Hi, good morning! It really IS a nice morning, isn’t it?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>The sun’s nice and warm, and now I get to chat with you
a little bit too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oi, bom dia, é uma boa manhã, não é? O sol é bom
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>e quente, e agora eu posso conversar com você
um pouco também!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>The clouds up in the sky look so light and fluffy... They
look delicious, don’t they?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>I wish I could grab one and just gobble it up...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>The sun gets all red in the evening...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>You know, I bet that color means it’s all spicy and
delicious. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>I wanna lick it...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>O sol fica todo vermelho à noite
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>... eu aposto que a cor significa que
é picante<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)> e delicioso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>The moon looks like it’s about the same size as the
sun, right?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>So uh... Why is it that the sun’s so much brighter?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>A lua parece ter mais ou menos o mesmo tamanho
do sol, né?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Então... por que o sol brilha tanto mais?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I know I space out and get lost sometimes, <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>but I’ve
never panicked!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>See, I remember the scent of my home—all I need to do
is follow it and I know I’ll be just fine.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Sei que me espaço e me perco<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)> às
vezes, mas
nunca<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)> entrei em pânico, só preciso segui
-lo e sei que ficarei bem.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I found a bunch of delicious-looking berries scattered all
over the ground the other day.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>I miiight’ve grabbed one and eaten it...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>But now that I think about it, maybe someone was saving
them for a snack? <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Sorry about that, if they were yours...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Encontrei um monte de frutas deliciosas
espalhadas por todo o chão no
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>outro dia. Eu agarrei uma e
comi<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>... mas agora que penso nisso, talvez
alguém estivesse<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)> guardando-as para um lanche?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I think it’s best to eat slowly. <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>That way I get to
enjoy delicious food for even longer!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Acho que é melhor comer devagar, <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>assim posso desfrutar
de comida deliciosa por mais tempo!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, I guess that’s it for today. Well, I had a really
good time!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)>When should I do this again?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Acho que é por hoje, me diverti muito,
quando
devo<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)> fazer isso de novo?

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Sounds like <$cdef(27)> is at the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)>.
Maybe
I’ll go
say hi.

<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>When I look at the sun from underwater, it’s all squiggly
and pretty, y’know?
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>But then when I stick my face above the surface, it’s way
too bright! I just wanna see it up close, is all...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, heya! I know you’ve been watering stuff here and
there lately.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>You’re really working hard, aren’t you,
<$cdef(27)>.
Maybe I
should
do
something too...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Ah, oi! Sei que você tem regado as coisas por aqui
ultimamente.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Você está se esforçando muito, né,
<$cdef(27)>?
Talvez eu
também
devesse
fazer alguma coisa...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hey, I just found this. Uh, you can have it!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>I was just hanging out with <$cdef(27)>—they’re
really nice!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>They were so patient and <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>a great listener too.
Just like you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>Eu estava saindo com eles, <$cdef(27)>eles são
muito legais,
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>eles eram tão pacientes e<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)> um ótimo ouvinte
também, assim como você, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oooh, hi! You know
<$cdef(27)>
you
gave
me before?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>I just wanted to say, really great! <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m so glad I asked
for ! Thanks again, <$cdef(27)>!
candidate_translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Ah, oi! Sabe aquele presente
<$cdef(27)>
que
você me deu
antes?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>Só queria dizer que foi incrível! <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)>Que bom que pedi
! Obrigado de novo, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, wowww! You really can make anything you want, can’t
you, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Oooh, I know! I bet you could make one of those houses
the humans used to live in.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’d just love to, you know, chill out in one of
those someday...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, wow! Você realmente pode fazer o que quiser, não pode
,? Oooh<$cdef(27)>,
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>eu sei! Eu aposto que você poderia fazer uma daquelas casas
em que os humanos costumavam
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)> viver. Eu adoraria, você sabe, relaxar em um
daqueles algum dia...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh wow, when’d the sky get dark? It must be later than
I expected...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I guess I should go to bed soon. How about you,
<$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Quando o céu escureceu, deve ser mais tarde do
que eu esperava
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>, acho que devo ir para a cama em breve
<$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Everyone keeps telling me morning walks are the best,
but I dunno...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I think I like the atmosphere at night better. <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)>Besides, I’m
always so sleepy in the morning... *yawn*
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Todo mundo me diz que as caminhadas
matinais são
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>as melhores, mas eu não sei... acho<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)> que
gosto mais da atmosfera à noite.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>So you can transform, right, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,6)>Maybe one of these days you can transform into a flying
Pokémon and we can go explore the sky together.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, but I should warn you... I’m a lot faster than you might
think, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>so it might be hard for you to keep up.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Talvez um dia desses você <$cdef(27)>
possa<$voicel(1,6)> se transformar em um Pokémon voador e possamos
explorar o céu juntos. Oh, mas eu deveria avisá
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>-lo... Eu sou muito mais rápido do que você imagina,
então <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>pode ser difícil para você acompanhar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>It’s so nice that nobody here’s afraid of me, even though
I’m poisonous.
<$voicel(1,6)>They happily gobble up <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>the snacks I share with them
and everything! ♪
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>É tão bom que ninguém aqui tem medo de mim, mesmo
sabendo que sou venenoso.
<$voicel(1,6)>Todo mundo come feliz <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>os lanchinhos que eu divido
e tudo mais! ♪

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>You know, I’m pretty proud of how squishy I am.
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Oh, but you seem pretty soft and smooshy too,
<$cdef(27)>...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I wonder which one of us is squishier. Maybe we can find
out by squashing each other?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Sabe, estou muito orgulhoso de como sou fofinho.
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Oh, mas você parece muito suave e macio também
, <$cdef(27)>... Eu
me<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)> pergunto qual de nós é mais fofinho. Talvez possamos descobrir
esmagando uns aos outros?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>My body’s nice and hard, don’t you think? <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>I can get hit by
little rocks and stuff and it doesn’t hurt at all!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Oh, but please don’t go throwing rocks at me on
purpose, OK?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Meu corpo é bom e duro, não acha? Posso <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>ser atingido por
pequenas pedras e coisas assim e não dói nada!
Oh<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>, mas por favor, não atire pedras em mim de
propósito, OK?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>You know, the other day I was just spacing out for a little
bit when a really strong wind kicked up...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>I got caught up and blown around a bit!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I guess tiny Pokémon like me gotta be more alert when
the wind’s strong...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Outro dia eu estava apenas espaçando por um pouco quando
um vento muito forte começou... eu fui
pego<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)> e explodido um pouco! Eu acho que
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Pokémon minúsculo como eu deve estar mais alerta quando
o vento é forte...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I think I toss and turn a lot in my sleep. The other day,
<$voicel(1,6)>I tossed and turned my way clean out of my home <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>and
right into the middle of the pathway.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>I think I ended up blocking it up for a good while...
How embarrassing.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Acho que me deitei e virei muito no meu sono, outro
dia<$voicel(1,6)>, joguei e virei meu caminho limpo para fora<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)> da
minha casa e direto para o meio do
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>caminho, acho que acabei bloqueando por um bom tempo
, que embaraçoso.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>When I’m just floating in the river, the current tends to
carry me downstream...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>You know, I wonder where I’d end up if I just let it carry
me along? How far does it even go?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>We should just go with the flow together sometime,
<$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Quando estou flutuando no rio, a corrente tende a me
levar para baixo...
Sabe<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>, eu me pergunto onde eu iria acabar se eu deixasse
isso me levar? Até onde isso vai?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Devemos simplesmente ir com o fluxo juntos algum
dia, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Every now and then, when I’m taking a nap, <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>a hungry
bug Pokémon’ll start gnawing on me!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>I gotta be more careful about that...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>De vez em quando, quando eu estou <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>tirando uma
soneca, um Pokémon de inseto
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>faminto vai começar a roer em mim!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>I get a tingly sensation <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>when I’m near a machine <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>that
uses electricity.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Tenho uma sensação de frio <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>quando estou perto de uma máquina<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>
que usa eletricidade.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You know how some folks like scary stories?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>I don’t, uh...understand that, to be honest.
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,47)>I mean, they’re SCARY!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sabe como alguns gostam de histórias de terror?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Eu não... entendo isso, para falar a verdade.
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,47)>Elas dão MEDO!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Say, <$cdef(27)>, you’re looking for a
human, right?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>Are you going to, uh...drop your transformation once you
find them?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>’Cause otherwise there would be two identical humans!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Not that there’s anything wrong with that though, I guess!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Diga, <$cdef(27)>, você está procurando um
humano, certo
?<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)> Você vai... deixar sua transformação quando encontrá
-los? Porque
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>, caso contrário, haveria dois seres humanos

,<$voicel(1,7)> tipo, o vento pode estar soprando muito forte para cima ou para
baixo ou para trás ou para frente<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>... É realmente meio difícil, cara

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Sabe como alguns Pokémon ficam todos relaxados

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>cara. Quero dizer... E se eu escorregasse e caísse no
oceano<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,23)>, certo? Eu simplesmente me desprendia e enferrujava
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,803)>! Ei, só pensando nisso me deixa ansioso!

<$cdef(27)>

<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Sunsets reflecting off the water’s surface are nice, but

capaz de comer muito mais
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)> do que eu posso agora, sim<$pkcry;0(1,1)>?

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s up, pal? Need me to cut some logs for ya?

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>You know who rules at finding cool stuff? Me! If you ever
wanna hunt for treasure, let me know!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>When you’re looking for a Pokémon, come find me first.

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Algo sobre ver o pôr do sol sempre me faz querer

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,666)>You seem like the type that gets hyped when it’s night...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Whoa, hey! I was JUST thinkin’ about how much I wanted

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>When I feel like crying, I just let out all of my tears—and

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando eu sinto vontade de chorar, eu apenas solto todas as minhas lágrimas -

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I don’t use my powers during hide-and-seek. After all,

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>Little dry around here, huh? Makes you wish for a

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>Faz você desejar um pouco mais

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>. I won’t stop till it’s done.

in

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>A área ao redor da minha casa está se unindo, só precisa

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, wanna go look for treasure together?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Aposto que encontraremos algo legal se

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Think you could tidy up the parts of the path that’re kinda

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,47)>Desculpe, <$cdef(27)>, mas ainda não consigo.

?<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,48)> Desculpe por isso, mas agradeço.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Don’t think I can make it past here. Can you sort this out
somehow, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Não acho que posso passar por aqui, pode resolver isso
de alguma forma, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>I heard you got a friend named <$motion(1,805)><$cdef(27)>
living
around
these
parts.
That true?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Since we’re here, I’d like to go say hi to them.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Ouvi dizer que tem um amigo<$motion(1,805)><$cdef(27)>
chamado
vivendo
por
aqui,

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>estamos aqui, gostaria de dizer oi a eles.

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Got it. I’ll head home for now.

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>Hey, thanks for always being so nice. Spending time with
you makes me happy.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>I got you something. It’s not much, but I hope you’ll

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>Obrigado por sempre ser tão legal, passar tempo com
você me faz feliz, eu
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>te trouxe algo, não é muito, mas espero que você vá
aguentar.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>You know, I’m really glad we’re friends. Looking forward to
fun future hangs together.
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>Estou muito feliz por sermos amigos, e por estarmos ansiosos
para nos divertirmos juntos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! Glad we found some treasure.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,50)>This was fun. Let me know if you do it again, yeah?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>Que bom que encontramos um tesouro
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,50)>, isso foi divertido, me avise se fizer de novo, certo?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You heading over there? Guess this is where we part ways.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Acho que é aqui que nos separamos.

on a path like that.

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>É muito difícil e difícil de seguir, não consigo chegar lá em

somewhere like that.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>É uma casa bonita, eu podia me ver vivendo
em um lugar assim.

source:

real hard on it, <$cdef(27)>.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, parece um lugar muito legal, você claramente
trabalhou duro nisso, <$cdef(27)>.

source:

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Esta casa parece meio cheia, acho
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>que vou passar essa... prefiro não ficar mais
apertada.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Nice work. I think we can call that search a success.

find more cool stuff.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Bom trabalho, acho que podemos chamar essa busca de
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,50)>sucesso, vamos caçar tesouros juntos de novo, vamos encontrar
coisas mais legais.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>For me? Thanks, I appreciate it. <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,8)>Here, you can have this
as a thank-you.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Obrigado, eu agradeço, pode<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,8)> ter isso como um

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)> isso, mas há provavelmente alguém por aqui
que gostaria.

even use this...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>But I appreciate the thought. You keep it for now.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Honestamente, não sei se saberia usar isso
, mas agradeço
o<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)> pensamento, você o mantém por enquanto.

different house.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)>É aqui que eu moro agora, prefiro me mudar
para outra casa.

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Se alguém sabe como ajudar, tem que ser

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Nunca pensei que alguém pudesse derrubar o Equipe Turbo... você

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Não se preocupe, sei que está ocupado, espero que possamos

.. mas não

<$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, it might actually be kinda fun, looking for a new

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sabe, pode ser divertido, procurar um novo lar

<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, I like the look of this place. Did you make this for

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow... Thank you. From now on, this is my new home.

<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu gosto da aparência deste lugar, você fez isso para mim

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>obrigado, a partir de agora, esta é a minha nova casa.

, mas

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Ok, prepare-se... quem
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)>diria que é mais alto, <$cdef(27)>ou eu?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>Sabia que ia acertar, provavelmente foi muito fácil
para você, não é?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Whoops, wrong answer. Off your game today?

De agora em diante, esta vai ser minha nova casa.

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>but I appreciate the thought.

others—it’s one way to put my knowledge to good use.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, posso ajudá-lo com alguma coisa? Eu gosto muito de ajudar os
outros, é uma maneira de colocar meu conhecimento em bom uso.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>I’m in the mood for some pleasant conversation today.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>Estou com vontade de uma conversa agradável hoje.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, are you out for a walk?
Excellent
idea.
Walking
always
clears
my head.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>It’s always good to keep an eye on your surroundings when
you’re out walking. You’d be surprised by the useful
things you can find.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>É sempre bom ficar de olho no seu entorno quando você está
andando. Você ficaria surpreso com as coisas úteis que
você pode encontrar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I suppose I don’t mind doing something active with you
from time to time, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Suponho que não me importo de fazer algo ativo com
você de vez em quando, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>You always look so busy with one thing or another.
Remember—it’s essential to take a break now and then.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Você está sempre se ocupando com alguma coisa.
Lembre-se: é essencial fazer uma pausa de vez em quando.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>Time seems to pass so quickly when I’m lost in thought.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>O tempo parece passar tão rápido quando estou perdido em pensamentos.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>I sometimes wonder what topics you discuss with your
other friends, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>Às vezes me pergunto que assuntos você discute com
seus outros amigos, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>What do you suppose was the cause of the humans’
disappearance?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Qual você acha que foi a causa do desaparecimento
dos humanos?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,50)>Please feel free to ask me anything. I enjoy chatting with
you, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,50)>Por favor, sinta-se livre para me perguntar qualquer
coisa<$cdef(27)>.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>...Hm? Ah. I seem to have fallen asleep.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,16)>*yawn* Good morning... Please wait a moment...
I must allow my brain to fully wake up.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,16)>Bom dia, por favor, espere um momento, eu devo
permitir que meu cérebro acorde completamente.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Unknown areas can be frightening...yet more than that,
they’re thrilling!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Áreas desconhecidas podem ser assustadoras... mas mais do que
isso, são emocionantes!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Once I’ve got my bearings, I may just go on a little
excursion. That’s bound to be fun.
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando eu tiver meus rumos, posso
fazer uma pequena excursão.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>You seem quite knowledgeable about the area. I’m glad
to have someone like you around.
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Você parece bem conhecedor da área, estou feliz por
ter alguém como você por perto.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I’d like to partake next time everyone’s
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing... It seems quite interesting.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmm... gostaria de participar da próxima vez que todos
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> estiverem... parece bem interessante.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>I’ve completed all the necessary preparations and am
ready to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>. Heh heh, I’m itching to start!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Eu completei todos os preparativos
necessários e estou pronto para <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m quite pleased by the influx of Pokémon. I suppose
we all have you to thank, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Estou muito satisfeito com o influxo de Pokémon. Acho
que todos nós temos que agradecer, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Regarding my home...I think there’s significant room
for improvement.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Em relação à minha casa... acho que há um espaço significativo
para melhorias.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Living in my home has become much more pleasant thanks
to your efforts, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Viver em minha casa tornou-se muito mais agradável
graças aos seus esforços, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>My current home is most agreeable—such a genuinely
comfortable space! I commend you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Minha casa atual é muito agradável, um
espaço realmente confortável<$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>. How kind of you to come
talk
with me.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, que gentil de sua parte em vir
falar
comigo.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hoje é um dia esplêndido, <$cdef(27)>
porque eu
encontrei
você!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Traveling is such a joy, as we’re able to make so
many new discoveries. Let’s go again sometime.
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Viajar é uma alegria, já que podemos
fazer tantas descobertas novas.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>If I come across anything you might like,
<$cdef(27)>,
I’ll
be
sure
to
put
it
in
the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1460)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Se eu encontrar algo que você possa
<$cdef(27)>gostar
,
vou
ter
certeza
de

colocá-
lo
no<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1460)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I have confidence in my ability to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> things. Do you
have any projects for me?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Tenho confiança na minha<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> capacidade
de fazer coisas.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>The manipulation of fire comes easily to me. Don’t
hesitate to call on me any time.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Controlar o fogo é muito fácil para mim. Pode
me chamar sempre que precisar.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Do you need any help with watering? I’ll happily aid you.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>I’m rather knowledgeable about vegetables and other
plants, if I do say so myself. Let me know if you’re
hoping to grow something.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Sou bastante conhecedor de vegetais e outras
plantas, se eu disser isso, me avise se você está
esperando crescer algo.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Sinta-se livre para usar qualquer coisa<$cdef(27)>
que encontrar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Let’s meet at the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> sometime. I can teach
you what a joy it is to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Vamos nos encontrar no <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)>, posso te ensinar
que é uma alegria para <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>There are always new things to discover in the scenery
around here... I never tire of it.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Sempre há coisas novas para descobrir no cenário
por aqui... nunca me canso disso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>Now what in the world could this be?
...Do you have any idea, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>Agora, o que poderia ser isso?
... Você tem alguma idéia, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>This bears a rather striking resemblance to myself, doesn’t
it? I wonder what motivated that design.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>Isso tem uma semelhança bastante
impressionante comigo mesmo, não é?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>*munch* This deserves...to be enjoyed...slowly... *gulp*
I wouldn’t want to waste it.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Isso merece ser desfrutado... devagar... e
não quero desperdiçá-lo.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,41)>Th-this is... Ahem! Well, it will take a bit of courage to
gulp it down, at any rate.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,41)>Bem, vai ser preciso um pouco de coragem para engolir
, de qualquer forma.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Bem feito, <$cdef(27)>, vejo que você está
tão
ativo

como sempre.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>H-how best to ration my energy during a game of tag?
*pant* *wheeze* I haven’t had a free moment to consider...
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Qual a melhor forma de racionar minha energia durante um jogo
de tag? *pant *wheeze* Não tive um momento livre para considerar...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)> has been providing me with
some
new perspectives.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Now then, it’s gotten quite late. Shall we head to our
homes to get some sleep?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Agora, então, já é tarde, vamos dormir
em nossas casas?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>It’s nearly time for bed. Don’t forget to get some rest
yourself!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>É quase hora de dormir, não se esqueça de
descansar!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ah. It’s morning. That marks the end of my activities for
the time being.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>É manhã, isso marca o fim das minhas atividades
por enquanto.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)>I’m not terribly fond of bright light. I think I’ll turn in
shortly.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)>Não gosto muito de luz brilhante, acho que vou me entregar
em breve.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Landing takes far more concentration than just flying
in the sky.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Aterrar requer muito mais concentração do que
voar no céu.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Everyone tends to avoid me on hot days. <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>The sun makes
my body radiate far too much heat, you see...

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>My poison exists as a means of protection. I won’t go
scattering it around indiscriminately.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Meu veneno existe como meio de proteção, não
vou espalhar indiscriminadamente.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>I’m quite confident in the sturdiness of my body. Even the
boulders around here don’t compare.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Estou confiante na robustez do meu corpo, nem as
pedras por aqui se comparam.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>I wonder if I’ll grow any larger in the future or if I’ve
reached the extent of my growth. An intriguing question.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>Eu me pergunto se vou crescer mais no futuro ou
se eu já atingi a extensão do meu crescimento.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>The difference in energy that you and I require for a single
day... <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>I’d say it’s about eight berries’ worth.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,55)>A diferença de energia que você e eu precisamos por um único
dia...<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)> eu diria que vale cerca de oito frutas.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder what it feels like to swim in the sea. I won’t be
trying it myself, naturally, but I do wonder.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I always find water provides a fun distraction whenever I
feel the need to let loose and enjoy myself.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Sempre acho que a água é uma distração divertida quando
sinto a necessidade de me soltar e me divertir.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>I’m quite fortunate, you know—I can absorb nutrients not
only from food but from sunlight as well.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Eu sou muito afortunado, sabe... Eu posso absorver nutrientes
não só da comida, mas da luz solar também.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,64)>Electricity is quite beautiful, whether it takes on a blue
or yellow appearance. I wonder which is its true color.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,64)>A eletricidade é muito bonita, quer
tenha uma aparência azul ou amarela.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Today seems like an excellent day for some meditation.
I’ll take deep breaths and calm my mind...
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>It’s good to relax from time to time.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hoje parece um excelente dia para um pouco de meditação
. Vou respirar fundo e acalmar minha mente
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>... é bom relaxar de vez em quando.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m apparently quite intimidating to those first meeting
me, so I put a lot of effort into being friendly.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Aparentemente, estou intimidando aqueles que me conheceram
, então me esforcei muito para ser amigável.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>It seems the Pokémon population has grown again. Have
you already met the latest newcomer?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Parece que a população de
Pokémon cresceu de novo.

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>O sol está<$cdef(27)> muito brilhante

hoje,
não é?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ah yes, the rain is here. I could smell it coming earlier.
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>... I do wish this rain would stop.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Judging by the state of the sky, I’d say it’s going to
rain today.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>A julgar pelo estado do céu, eu diria que vai
chover hoje.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Speaking with <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth is really quite fun. They
bring up ideas I’d never even thought of.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Falar com o <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth é muito divertido, eles
trazem ideias que eu nunca tinha pensado.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Leave it to me. I’ll get this all nicely cleared away.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Do you know what’s most important when cooking? The
answer is...precision.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Sabe o que é mais importante
quando cozinhar?

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Yes? Is there something you’d like to speak with me about?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>There are so many fascinating things around us.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Há tantas coisas fascinantes ao nosso redor.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Any outing is enjoyable when it’s with
you, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Qualquer passeio é agradável quando
está com você, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>This is so pleasant. I could happily stay all day here in
our house.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Eu poderia ficar o dia todo aqui em nossa
casa.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Have you also witnessed the massive shadow of something
unknown flying through the sky?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>It appears in the vicinity from time to time. Keep a close
eye on your surroundings.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Você também testemunhou a sombra de algo desconhecido
voando pelo céu, que
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>aparece nas proximidades de vez em quando, e fica de
olho nos seus arredores.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>The more intimidating a Pokémon appears, the kinder they
may, in fact, turn out to be.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>As for myself... Well, who’s to say?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Quanto mais intimidante um Pokémon aparece
, mais gentil eles
podem<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>, de fato, acabar sendo.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Others often assume having a frightening face would make
me miss out on certain opportunities, but in fact,
sometimes it’s an advantage.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Like when others step out of my way to let me pass,
for example.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Costumam achar que minha aparência assustadora me faz
perder oportunidades. Mas, na verdade,
às vezes ela é uma vantagem.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Por exemplo, quando saem da minha frente
para me deixar passar.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>I’m currently in need of <$cdef(27)>
.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I don’t suppose you could share?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu estou precisando de você,<$cdef(27)>
não

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>If you happen to know anyone familiar with this area,
may I ask you for an introduction?

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Parece que você veio de muito longe, hm, se

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,4)>Others have often praised me for my fine coat. Some are

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,4)>Costumam elogiar muito minha bela pelagem. Alguns

source:

this <$cdef(27)>.
translation:

nisso<$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I have a talent for finding treasures, you know.
Come and see me if you’d like to go on a hunt.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Tenho talento para encontrar tesouros,
venha me ver se quiser ir em uma caçada.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>If you need to get rid of any garbage, I’m happy to take
care of it and <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(17)> it for you.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Se precisa se livrar de qualquer lixo, estou feliz
em cuidar dele e <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(17)> para você.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I know how to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)>, if you ever need it. Just give

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Sei como <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)>, se precisar, me dê um
grito e eu vou me dar bem!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>If you need help locating someone, let me know and I’ll
happily assist.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Se precisar de ajuda para localizar alguém, me avise e eu
ajudarei com prazer.

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Good morning. What do you think today has in store for
us, <$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>O que acha que hoje tem reservado

a

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Has it gotten darker out? Please don’t tire yourself

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Por favor, não se canse de trabalhar
até tarde.

source:

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ Whenever I run into you, it always

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>Sempre que eu esbarro em você, isso sempre

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Hello there! Did you come all this way to see me? You’re
such a sweetheart, <$cdef(27)>.

source: <$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,7)>Is there something I can do to assist you?

<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>You came to see me? Thank you. It brings me joy to know
there are those who care about me.
translation:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>Obrigada, me traz alegria saber que há aqueles
que se importam comigo.

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Every time I see that human transformation of yours, I can’t
help but feel truly impressed.
translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Toda vez que vejo a transformação humana de vocês, não posso deixar
de me sentir realmente impressionado.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, how funny. I had a feeling we’d run into each other
today, <$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, que engraçado. Eu tive a sensação de que nos
encontraríamos hoje, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Your ability to make just about anything is impressive.
You must be incredibly skilled!
translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Sua habilidade de fazer qualquer
coisa é impressionante.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>This area seems to be flourishing lately. I suppose it’s all

translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Esta área parece estar florescendo ultimamente. Acho que é tudo
graças a você.

source: <$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps I’ll pop by a friend’s place today...
translation: <$emotion(1,55)><$voicel(1,7)>Talvez eu vá passar por um lugar de amigo hoje...

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>I always enjoy the time we spend together. What shall we
do today? ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu sempre gosto do tempo que passamos
juntos.

<$comeff(1,16)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Zzz... Naturally...I am the strongest...the prettiest... Zzz...
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>...Oh? <$cdef(27)>? Am I...awake?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>, estou<$cdef(27)> acordado?

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Que tipo de edifício será esse, eu me pergunto. Estou animado para

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Sempre que olho ao redor, vejo todos os tipos
de Pokémon agora.

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>Is there any way to make my home slightly more...homey?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Se precisar de ajuda para regar plantas ou culturas, ficarei

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Preciso de um momento para recuperar o fôlego, mas

<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>É hora de ir para a cama, não se esqueça de

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)>Oh! I-I wasn’t sleeping. Just resting my eyes.

until morning.
translation:
<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Ao contrário dos outros, eu normalmente não vou dormir

source:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Flying isn’t always as elegant as it looks. At times, it can be

pode ser uma luta.

source:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Every now and again, my poison causes berries to go bad.
It spoils my mood as well.

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Being small does have its perks, you know. For instance,
I can easily squeeze through tight spaces!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Ser pequeno tem suas vantagens, por exemplo, eu posso
facilmente espremer espaços apertados!

source:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>I worry others may feel intimidated by my size, so I try to
smile often in hope of putting them at ease.
translation:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu me preocupo que outros possam se sentir intimidados pelo meu tamanho, então eu
tento sorrir muitas vezes na esperança de colocá-los à vontade.

source:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>You’re not too hot, are you? I imagine the heat I give off
must make my surroundings quite warm.
translation:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Imagino que o calor que eu emiti deve fazer
meu ambiente muito quente.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Isn’t it interesting how ocean water differs from
regular water?
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Não é interessante como a água do oceano difere
da água normal?

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I enjoy sunny days just as much as rainy days, which is why
I’m in a good mood every day! ♪
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu gosto de dias ensolarados tanto quanto dias chuvosos, e é por isso
que estou de bom humor todos os dias!

source:

translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>De alguma forma, tenho uma boa ideia do que você está planejando
fazer a seguir.

source:
<$emotion(1,17)><$voicel(1,3)>I’ve never liked the heat. Being drenched in sweat is
a foul feeling.
translation:
<$emotion(1,17)><$voicel(1,3)>Nunca gostei do calor, ficar encharcado de suor é uma
sensação ruim.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I often feel others are frightened of me, but surely it’s a
misunderstanding... <$voicel(1,8)>Don’t you think?

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Muitas vezes sinto que os outros têm medo de mim, mas
certamente é um mal-entendido<$voicel(1,8)>... não acha?

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>There seem to be more Pokémon in the area now.
I’m excited to speak with them. ♪

com meu maior sorriso.

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Don’t you love it when a rainbow appears after the rain
stops? They look so beautiful and colorful.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s a shame they vanish so quickly...but I suppose that
fleeting beauty is another part of their charm.
translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Não gosta quando um arco-íris aparece depois que a chuva
pára? Eles parecem tão bonitos e coloridos. É
uma<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)> pena que eles desapareçam tão rapidamente... mas eu suponho
que a beleza fugaz é outra parte do seu charme.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Watching the sunset makes me want to spend the evening
in restful solitude, but...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>perhaps doing something active
would be enjoyable as well?
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ver o pôr do sol me faz querer passar a noite em
uma solidão tranquila, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>mas... talvez fazer algo ativo
também seria agradável?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Look up at the sky, <$cdef(27)>.
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>Do you see it? If you connect these stars here <$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>with those
ones there in a sort of zig-zag pattern...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ It’s shaped like you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Olhe para o céu, <$cdef(27)>, você vê
?<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)> Se você conectar essas estrelas aqui com <$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>aquelas
lá em uma espécie de padrão zigue-zague.
.<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>. Tem a forma de você!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>I get the feeling this place has become more habitable
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>All the things you’ve made are so delightful—I’ve become
quite fond of them all. <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Thank you so much. ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Sinto que este lugar se tornou mais habitável
graças a você, <$cdef(27)>. Todas
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>as coisas que você fez são tão deliciosas. Eu me
afeiçoei a todos eles<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>. Muito obrigado.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>I’m unsure when it happened, but at some point I stopped
getting upset over little things, like taking a tumble.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Nowadays I only feel like crying while watching a beautiful
sunset <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>or eating something unpleasant!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Não sei quando aconteceu, mas em algum momento parei de
ficar chateado com pequenas coisas, como tomar um banho.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hoje em dia só sinto vontade de chorar enquanto vejo um belo
pôr do <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>sol ou comer algo desagradável!

source:
<$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m impressed by how much effort you put into taking care
of us all, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I want to get you something as thanks, so I’ve been trying
to think of the perfect present.
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,9)>Just wait—I’m sure you’ll be delighted by it. ♪

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Finished with <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>s for the day, are we?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Well, I’m looking forward to being back in business soon.
And I hope you are too!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Encerramos o trabalho de <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)> por hoje, então?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Bem, espero que voltemos a trabalhar em breve.
E que você também esteja com vontade!

<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,1)>Hm... <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)>Probably not, I imagine.

up
a
storm,
haven’t you?

sweetheart you are!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>Nossa, <$cdef(27)>, você tem regado
tudo
por
aqui,
hein?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,4)>Fez isso por nós, foi? Eu sabia! Que
gentileza a sua!

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I found this a little earlier. Why don’t you take it?
translation: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Encontrei isto há pouco. Por que não fica com você?

source:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,6)>I had a little chat with <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>They’re such a sweetheart, don’t you think? ♪

<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,6)>Eu tive uma pequena <$cdef(27)>conversa
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)> com eles, eles são tão queridos, não acha?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I adore the <$cdef(27)>
you
gave
me, <$cdef(27)>.

você me

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>There’s something so...appealing about human houses.
Don’t you agree?
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps you might build me a house like that someday,
hm, <$cdef(27)>? <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>...Only joking, of course.
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Há algo tão... atraente sobre casas humanas. Você
não concorda? Talvez
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)> você possa me construir uma casa como essa algum
dia, hm, <$cdef(27)>?... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Apenas brincando, é claro.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Everyone gets sleepy at different times, and in my case...
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>that time is right now.
<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,4)>*yawn* Good night, little one.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Todo mundo fica sonolento em momentos diferentes
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>, e no meu caso.
.<$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,4)>. esse momento é agora.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>I often sleep during the day, but please don’t hesitate to
wake me up if you need me.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Day or night, I’m always happy to help you.
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu durmo muitas vezes durante o dia, mas por
favor, não hesite
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>em me acordar se precisar de mim.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>The time I spend in the sky is very important to me.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I can be alone there, which is quite relaxing.
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>O tempo que passo no céu é muito importante para mim,
posso<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)> ficar sozinha lá, o que é bastante relaxante.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Every morning when I wake up, I check the condition of
my skin.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I worry that I will excrete poison in my sleep...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>No issues today, though. <$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I’ve occasionally been mistaken for a child due to my size.
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,667)><$voicel(1,3)>Honestly, how rude... I may be small, but I am still an adult.
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu ocasionalmente me confundi com uma criança devido ao meu tamanho.
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,667)><$voicel(1,3)>Honestamente, quão rude... eu posso ser pequeno, mas eu ainda sou um adulto.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s quite tricky playing hide-and-seek, given my stature.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>I have limited options when it comes to hiding spots.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>É muito complicado jogar de esconde
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>-esconde, dada a minha estatura.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s best if you try not to startle me, little one.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>If a stray flame popped off and started a fire, it would
cause quite a bit of trouble!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>É melhor não me assustar, pequeno, se uma chama
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>perdida se acendesse e começasse um incêndio, isso
causaria um pouco de problemas!

source:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m quite fond of rainy days.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s like going for a swim without getting in the water! ♪
translation:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Gosto muito de dias
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>chuvosos, é como nadar sem entrar na água!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>You know, I’m often told I give off a nice, floral aroma.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Isn’t that odd? I’m not putting in an effort to do so...
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Sabe, sempre dizem que exalo um perfume floral agradável.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Não é curioso? Eu nem faço esforço para isso...

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Your future... Well, I suppose it depends on what you do
next, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>But you needn’t fret—whatever the future brings, you will
face it <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>with plenty of Pokémon by your side. ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Seu futuro... Bem, eu suponho que depende do que você faz a
seguir, mas<$cdef(27)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>você não precisa se preocupar, seja o que for que o futuro traga,
você vai <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>enfrentá-lo com muitos Pokémon ao seu lado.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Lately we’ve not had any unbearably hot days.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>But if the scorching heat returns, I’ll happily cool you
down with one of my chilly moves!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Ultimamente, não tivemos dias insuportavelmente quentes.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas, se o calor voltar, terei prazer em refrescar você
com um dos meus golpes de gelo!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I hear some of the other Pokémon think I’m scary...

“bewitchingly dark and mysterious.”
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Ouvi dizer que alguns Pokémon me acham assustador...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,3)>Pessoalmente, eu preferia ser considerado
“sombrio e misterioso, de um jeito fascinante”.

aquelas coisas que eles usavam... roupas, certo?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,5)>Pensando bem, os humanos também se transformavam
todos os dias com essas “roupas”, não é?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>You’ve made some very interesting things, little one.

posso ficar maior!

.<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)> eu amo tanto os dois, que nunca poderia escolher

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sempre que preciso tirar algo do caminho, uso meu

bodies? It gets awfully hot standing near them to chat,

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>This is a pretty cool place. I think I’m gonna live here!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Hopefully I’ll see ya around and we can chat, yeah?
translation:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>Ei, ei, quem é você,
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)> esse é um lugar legal, acho que vou morar
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>aqui, espero te ver e conversar, certo?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... This is just a hunch, but I’m guessin’ you’re not from
around here, are ya?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>If you know someone who knows this place better than
anyone, send ’em my way!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Hum... É só um palpite, mas você não parece ser
daqui, né?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Se conhecer alguém que entenda bem desta região,
mande conversar comigo!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>... I can’t stop starin’ at my hammer! It’s

so
cool, y’know?

<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>I just love to relax and float around aimlessly, y’know?
Really helps me forget about any bad stuff goin’ on.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,8)>Check out this coat of mine, bud! Pretty awesome, huh.
<$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>If you ever wanna pet it, gimme a shout! You can see
for yourself just how awesome it feels!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,8)>Olha só esse casaco meu, cara, ótimo, se
<$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>quiser acariciá-lo, me dê um grito, pode ver
por si mesmo o quão incrível é!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Another day of workin’ hard and bein’ awesome!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Can’t wait to show everyone what I’ve got—I just wanna
grow up already!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Mal posso esperar para mostrar
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)> a todos o que tenho - eu só quero
crescer já!

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>It was a real challenge to make that
<$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>When you’re as good as me, choppin’ logs is easier
than breathin’!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Quando você é tão bom quanto eu, cortar troncos é mais fácil

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I just can’t stop treasure huntin’, ya know? Sometimes you
find the most AMAZING stuff. How could I stop?!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Não consigo parar de caçar tesouros, às vezes
você acha as coisas mais incríveis.

and stuff, y’know.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu sou muito bom em esmagar frutas e coisas
assim, sabe.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know in the evening when the sky kinda looks like it’s on

makes me wanna go for a little run. Ya feel me?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Não sei o que é, mas algo sobre a noite me faz
querer ir para uma pequena corrida.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Pokémon who train their bodies to get stronger are real

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Pokémon que treinam seus corpos para ficar

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)>Everything’s fresh and exciting in a new place. Looks like I

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)>Tudo é novo e excitante em um lugar novo. Parece que
não vou ficar entediado tão cedo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Hey, heyyy! You seem to know this place pretty well!
I’m countin’ on ya to help me settle in, bud!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Ei, ei, você parece conhecer bem esse lugar, estou contando
com você para me ajudar a me instalar, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>I’m thinkin’ I could really enjoy this place! Looking forward
to just wanderin’ around!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Estou pensando que eu poderia realmente
aproveitar este lugar!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,32)>O que estão fazendo ali? Será que vão <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> alguma coisa?

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,5)>Looks like our population’s growin’ here! I get to meet so
many different Pokémon—it’s pretty great!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,5)>Parece que nossa população está crescendo aqui! Eu posso
conhecer tantos Pokémon diferentes - é muito bom!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,60)>Going to a new place is a nice change of pace! We should

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Não suporto ver uma fogueira sem luz, vou pegar todos eles
de novo para você!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>U-uau. Por que o céu está tão claro?! Ugh. É por isso que

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>If I just spread my wings and fly, I can go anywhere!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Se eu abrir as asas e voar, posso

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>My poison’s the real deal—real dangerous, that is!

,<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)> é perigoso, mas este lugar é muito

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>There are a lot of Pokémon smaller than me, but I’ve never
thought of ’em as weak.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Everyone’s got their own strengths, y’know?
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Há muitos Pokémon menores que eu, mas nunca
achei que fossem fracos.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Watch yourself, <$cdef(27)>! If ya touch me,

gonna

, só

clear water.
translation:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Tudo que preciso para sobreviver na vida são frutas saborosas e água limpa
e agradável.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>I’ve got, like, an electric field around me, OK?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>If ya stick close by, you might just feel your body relax and

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Se ficar por perto, pode
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>sentir seu corpo relaxar e toda a sua
fadiga derreter!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, heyyy! I could sense that you were gonna come talk

give ya that, <$cdef(27)>!

darei isso, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Looks like there are more Pokémon around here now, huh?

se eu fosse cair nele, é um sentimento muito estranho!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Like the AWESOME battle I had with a buddy, or the

AMAZING treasure...

awesomeness hoje, cara,
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>como a batalha maravilhosa que tive com um amigo, ou
o treinamento intenso que fiz uma vez, ou a vez que
encontrei um tesouro
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>incrível, Gah, eu nem sei por onde começar!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>me concentrando muito agora - fazendo alguma

Ugh. Maybe I’m runnin’ outta steam for the day, after all...

the sun’s out, <$cdef(27)>?
