translation:
<$voicel(2,3)>Está vendo aquele muro de pedra ali?
<$voicel(2,5)>Estou tão curioso sobre o que está do outro lado!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>If we could smash that wall, I bet we could see what’s
on the other side...
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>Do you think you could do that,
<$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Se pudéssemos quebrar essa parede, aposto que poderíamos ver o
que está do outro lado...
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>Você acha que poderia fazer
isso, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait, really?! You can use <$cdef(27)><$sklname;0(4)>?!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Awww... I guess not after all, huh?
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Você pode usar?<$cdef(27)><$sklname;0(4)>!
..<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)>................
..................
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Acho que não depois de tudo, hein?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,12)>You know, I bet we could smash right through that wall if
one of us could <$cdef(27)>use the move <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>...
<$voicel(2,4)>But I guess that’s not happening, huh?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,12)>Você sabe, eu aposto que poderíamos esmagar através da parede se
um de nós pudesse <$cdef(27)>usar o movimento<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>...
<$voicel(2,4)>Mas eu acho que isso não está acontecendo, hein?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>So you found a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2793)>, huh? That’s great!
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>...Not that I have any idea what that thing does.
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>But I got a feeling you’ll have no problem figuring out how
to use it.
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>In any case, knowing what was up there’s a huge weight
off my mind. Thanks, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Então você encontrou um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2793)>, hein?
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>Não que eu tenha ideia do que essa coisa faz.
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Mas tenho a sensação de que não terá problema em descobrir
como usá-lo.
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>De qualquer forma, saber o que estava lá em cima é um grande
peso fora da minha mente<$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,9)>You know...a long time ago, <$voicel(2,6)>I actually met a Pokémon
who was really good at <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,9)>Sabe... há muito tempo <$voicel(2,6)>atrás, conheci um Pokémon
que era muito bom em<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>They were always training with a <$cdef(27)>punching bag...
<$voicel(2,8)>They looked so cool—even when they were just taking a
break on a <$cdef(27)>bench!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>Eles estavam sempre treinando com um <$cdef(27)>saco de pancadas...
<$voicel(2,8)>Eles pareciam tão legais, mesmo quando eles estavam apenas fazendo
uma pausa em um <$cdef(27)>banco!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,18)>I really shoulda learned <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> from them when
I had the chance...
<$voicel(2,4)>Then again, I guess my arms are too short for that kind
of thing.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,18)>Eu realmente deveria ter <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>aprendido com eles
quando tive a chance...
<$voicel(2,4)>Então, novamente, acho que meus braços são muito curtos para esse
tipo de coisa.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>If you ever learn <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>, <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>let’s go check out the
other side of that wall together!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Se você aprender<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)><$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>, vamos ver o
outro lado da parede juntos!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)>The Pokémon who was good at <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> would
always train with a <$cdef(27)>punching bag... <$voicel(2,8)><$comcan(2)><$motion(2,803)>And then they’d rest
on a <$cdef(27)>bench when they got tired!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)>O Pokémon que era bom sempre<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> treinava
com um <$cdef(27)>saco de pancadas... e então<$voicel(2,8)><$comcan(2)><$motion(2,803)> eles descansavam em
um <$cdef(27)>banco quando ficavam cansados!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Wha—? You were able to learn <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>?! Wow,
you’re amazing, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Then let’s go see what’s on <$cdef(27)>the other side of that wall</color>!
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Então vamos ver o que está<$cdef(27)> do outro lado da parede</color>!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>I wonder what’s on the other side of that wall. What
do you think’s over there?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Eu me pergunto o que tem do outro
lado da parede.

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,15)>Wowww, look at THAT! It’s a big, huge beach!
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,15)>Uaaaau, olhe isso! É uma praia grande, enorme!

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)>Ahhh, it feels so nice here! I’m glad we made it!
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)>Ahhh, é tão bom aqui! Estou feliz que conseguimos!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, look—there’s a cave over there!
<$voicel(2,6)>It looks way too scary though... I think I’ll stay here.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, olha, tem uma caverna ali!
<$voicel(2,6)>Mas parece muito assustador... acho que vou ficar aqui.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,13)>Actually, <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth said <$cdef(27)>caves could have
rare mushrooms growing in them...
<$voicel(2,6)>I’m still not goin’ anywhere NEAR that cave though...
It’s way too spooky!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,13)>Na verdade, o <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth disse <$cdef(27)>que cavernas podem
ter cogumelos raros crescendo neles...
<$voicel(2,6)>Ainda não vou a lugar nenhum perto daquela caverna...
mas é muito assustador!
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>De qualquer forma, obrigado por me trazer aqui, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>See, I spotted this path between the cliffs, and
I’m really curious about where it leads to...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Veja, eu vi esse caminho entre as falésias, e estou
realmente curioso sobre onde isso leva a...

source:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>And I was wondering if you wanted to go check it out with
me, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(2,4)>I mean... It’s not like I’m SCARED or anything, OK? I just
thought I’d ask!
translation:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu queria saber se você quer ir dar uma olhada
comigo, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(2,4)>Quer dizer... Não estou com MEDO nem nada, tá? Só
achei que não custava perguntar!

source: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Yaaay! I knew I could count on you!
translation: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu sabia que podia contar com você!

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Let’s see where this path’ll take us! Uh...you can lead the
way, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Vamos ver para onde esse caminho vai nos
levar<$cdef(27)>!

source: <$voicel(4,5)>Check out this rock pile. <wait(0.5)>You thinking what I’m thinking?

Wanna hit rocks above you? Just <$cdef(27)>look up and <$motion(4,814)><$voicel(4,7)>POW!
Buried rocks giving you trouble? <$cdef(27)>Look down and <$motion(4,815)>BAM!
And the rocks in the middle? They get the ol’ <$motion(4,814)><$voicel(4,10)>BA-DA-DA!
translation:
Quer atingir pedras acima de você? É só <$cdef(27)>olhar para cima e <$motion(4,814)><$voicel(4,7)>PÁ!
Pedras enterradas dando trabalho? <$cdef(27)>Olhe para baixo e <$motion(4,815)>BUM!
E as pedras no meio do caminho? Nessas, mande um <$motion(4,814)><$voicel(4,10)>PÁ-PÁ-PÁ!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)>Try smashing up all the rocks, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>You’ve got what it takes to be a <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> champion!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)>Tente esmagar todas as pedras, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Você tem o que é preciso para ser <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>um campeão!

source:
Point the camera upward using <$keyicon(190)> when you want to
smash blocks above you, or point it downward to smash
blocks in the ground!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,9)>Real nice work there, <$cdef(27)>. I knew
you
had
it
in ya.
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Guess that officially makes you a <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> champ.
Welcome to the club!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Keep putting those <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)> skills to work, just like
you practiced here!
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,9)>Bom trabalho, <$cdef(27)>, eu sabia que
você
tinha
em
você.
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Acho que isso oficialmente <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>faz de
você um campeão.
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Continue colocando essas <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>habilidades para trabalhar, assim
como você praticou aqui!

source:
The area around you gets cluttered when you break lots of
blocks with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>, doesn’t it?
When that happens, you can<$cdef(27)> hold <$keyicon(153)> to <$cdef(27)>inhale all that
clutter and clean everything up!
translation:
A área ao seu redor fica bagunçada quando você quebra
muitos <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>blocos, não é?
Quando isso acontecer, você<$cdef(27)> pode <$keyicon(153)>segurar para <$cdef(27)>inalar
toda essa desordem e limpar tudo!

source: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! I’ve got a question for ya.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)>Do you know how to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1290)></color>?

<$voicel(4,7)><$voicel(4,7)>You need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1482)> to make them. You can get logs
by clearing any old tree you find around here, but
<$voicel(4,4)><$emotion(4,31)>I don’t know any moves that make the cut...
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$voicel(4,7)>Você precisa de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1482)> para fazê-los. Você pode obter troncos
limpando qualquer árvore velha que você encontrar por aqui,
mas<$voicel(4,4)><$emotion(4,31)> eu não sei nenhum movimento que faça o corte...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>There’s a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Scyther with big ol’ blade arms,
and <$voicel(4,9)>I bet they’d be able to cut down any kind of tree,
no problem!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>Há um Pokémon chamado Scyther<$cdef(27)> com grandes braços de lâmina, e eu
aposto <$voicel(4,9)>que eles seriam capazes de cortar qualquer tipo de árvore, não
há problema!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,13)>I haven’t seen any <$cdef(27)>Scyther around here yet, but I think
they enjoy tall grass, just like me.
<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,14)>But they really can’t handle the heat. <$voicel(4,9)>I used to see them
chilling in tall grass in the shade, like under trees.
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,13)>Eu não vi nenhum <$cdef(27)>Scyther por aqui ainda, mas acho que eles
gostam de grama alta, assim como eu.
<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,14)>Mas eles realmente não aguentam o calor<$voicel(4,9)>, eu os via esfriando
na grama alta na sombra, como debaixo das árvores.

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$facial(4,4)>If you ever meet a <$cdef(27)>Scyther that can teach you how to cut
down trees, <$voicel(4,9)>please make me a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$facial(4,4)>Se alguma vez encontrar<$cdef(27)> um Citera que possa ensiná-lo a
cortar árvores<$voicel(4,9)>, por favor, me faça um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>You can get <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1482)> for making stuff by cutting down
trees like <$cdef(27)>Scyther can.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Você pode pegar <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1482)> para fazer coisas cortando árvores
como <$cdef(27)>Scyther pode.

source:
<$voicel(4,9)>I used to see <$cdef(27)>Scyther chilling out in tall grass next to trees.
They like the shade!
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)>Eu costumava<$cdef(27)> ver Scyther esfriando em grama alta ao
lado de árvores.

source:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>WHOA! You seriously made me a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>?
Awesome! Thanks a bunch!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Can you put it somewhere for me? Anywhere is fine—I just
gotta see it!
translation:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Você realmente me fez um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>
incrível, muito obrigado.
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Qualquer lugar é bom, só preciso
vê-lo.

source:
<$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Whoa, a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>! You made one for me? Thanks
a bunch!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>You should make lots more furniture and decorate the area
around here. You can put stuff wherever you want!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Y’know, I bet tons of other Pokémon probably like
that too!
translation:
<$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>, você fez um para
mim.
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Você deve fazer muito mais móveis e decorar a área por
aqui. Você pode colocar as coisas onde quiser!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Você sabe, eu aposto toneladas de outros Pokémon provavelmente
assim também!

translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Mas eu aposto<$cdef(27)> que Scyther poderia cortar até mesmo a árvore mais grossa

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>If <$cdef(27)>Scyther ever teaches you how to cut down trees,
<$voicel(4,7)>please make me a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1290)>!

translation: Você ainda tem mais coisas para fazer nesta cidade.

This gate cannot open because of an obstruction on the
other side.
translation:
*bzzzt!*
Este portão não pode abrir por causa de uma obstrução do

source:
It seems you can create a habitat by placing a <$cdef(27)>punching
bag and a <$cdef(27)>bench next to each other!
You may find a <$cdef(27)>punching bag and a <$cdef(27)>bench nearby if you
look around!

Parece que você pode criar um habitat colocando um <$cdef(27)>saco de
pancadas e um <$cdef(27)>banco ao lado um do outro!
Você pode encontrar um <$cdef(27)>saco de pancadas e um <$cdef(27)>banco por perto se você
olhar ao redor!

source:
As you raise the<$cdef(27)> environment level, you’ll be able to buy
lots and lots of different items from the <$cdef(27)>shop!
translation:
Ao elevar o <$cdef(27)>nível ambiental, você poderá comprar
muitos e muitos itens diferentes da <$cdef(27)>loja!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>At first, I was super excited when we started getting rain
around here, but you know what I realized?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,1)>If my tail gets wet in the rain, then...<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,23)>I’m gonna catch a cold!
translation:

translation: <$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)>Aqui está o seu presente,<$comeff(4,6)> como prometido.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I think you’d better spend a little more time getting used
to THIS place before you set off for somewhere else.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Acho melhor passar um pouco mais de tempo se acostumando
com esse lugar antes de partir para outro lugar.

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Oooh, oooh, <$cdef(27)>, você sabe como jogar

corda
<$cdef(27)>de salto?

source:
<$comeff(3,14)><$voicel(3,5)>So, um, to play <$cdef(27)>jump rope, I spin my vines ’round and
’round.
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)>And then everybody jumps up and down and tries not to
trip on ’em! <$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motionoff(3,804)><$voicel(3,10)>It’s really fun!
translation:
<$comeff(3,14)><$voicel(3,5)>Então, para jogar <$cdef(27)>corda de salto, eu giro minhas videiras ao redor e
ao redor.
E<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,7)> então todo mundo pula para cima e para baixo e
tenta não <$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motionoff(3,804)><$voicel(3,10)>tropeçar neles!

source: <$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,7)>If you ever wanna play <$cdef(27)>jump rope</color>, just tell me!
translation: <$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,7)>Se quiser brincar de <$cdef(27)>pular corda</color>, me diga!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>I think you should put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1440)> on your
newly built house.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>That’ll make it easier for everyone to know where you live!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>Acho que deveria colocar o <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1440)> na sua casa
recém-construída.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Isso tornará mais fácil para todos saberem onde você mora!

source:
Designate <$cdef(27)>the house you <$cdef(27)><$spwicon(1)>built as your very own by
placing the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1440)> on top of it!

At the current <$cdef(27)>environment level, you should be able to
buy a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(326)>!
Access the <$cdef(27)>shop and check it out!
translation:
No nível atual<$cdef(27)> do ambiente, você deve ser capaz de
comprar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(326)>!
Acesse a <$cdef(27)>loja e confira!

source:
As you raise the<$cdef(27)> environment level, you’ll be able to buy
lots and lots of different items from the <$cdef(27)>shop!
translation:
Ao elevar o <$cdef(27)>nível ambiental, você poderá comprar
muitos e muitos itens diferentes da <$cdef(27)>loja!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Preparations for rebuilding the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center are sure to
be a lot of work.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>There’s no need to rush. You can continue granting
Pokémon’s requests as you have been, <$voicel(1,6)>making them new
homes, <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>and just taking it easy doing whatever you like!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>I’m sure some of the preparations will come together as
you’re doing all that, so you can come back to rebuilding
the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center whenever you’re ready!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Os preparativos para reconstruir o <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon certamente serão
muito trabalhosos.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Você pode continuar concedendo os pedidos de
Pokémon como tem sido, tornando-os<$voicel(1,6)> novas casas,
e apenas<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)> tendo a facilidade de fazer o que quiser!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>Tenho certeza de que alguns dos preparativos se unirão enquanto
você está fazendo tudo isso, então você pode voltar a reconstruir
o <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon sempre que estiver pronto!

source: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s hear what the <$cdef(27)>professor</color> has to say about celebrating!
translation: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Vamos ouvir o que o<$cdef(27)> professor</color> tem a dizer sobre celebrar!

source: You can hear a voice from beyond the stone.
translation: Você pode ouvir uma voz além da pedra.

source:
<$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)>Oh! Hey, bud! I’m real glad you found me! <$voicel(4,8)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>Sorry for the
sudden request, but, uh...think you could help me out?
translation:
<$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)>Ei, amigo, estou muito feliz que você me encontrou<$voicel(4,8)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>, desculpe
pelo pedido repentino, mas... acho que você poderia me ajudar?

source:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>This is kinda embarrassing, but I, uh...got myself stuck
in here...
<$voicel(4,1)><$facial(4,9)>Normally, I could bore straight through a cave like this
no prob and be outta here in a flash!
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,7)>But I guess I overslept and my muscles still haven’t woken
up or somethin’, cause the walls and floor here are
wicked hard! <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,663)>I was about to give up, if I’m bein’ honest.
translation:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>É meio vergonhoso, mas eu... acabei ficando preso
aqui...
<$voicel(4,1)><$facial(4,9)>Normalmente, eu atravessaria uma caverna destas cavando
e sairia daqui num instante!
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,7)>Mas devo ter dormido demais e meus músculos ainda não
acordaram, porque estas paredes e este chão estão
duros demais! <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,663)>Para falar a verdade, eu já estava quase desistindo.

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>But look at you, bud—you made it here! That means you
can smash through the walls and floor of this cave, yeah?
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Mas olhe para você, amigo, você chegou aqui, isso significa
que você pode quebrar as paredes e o chão desta caverna, sim?

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,1)>Think you could <$cdef(27)>bust up that wall there in front of you to
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>help me get outta here?
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,1)>Acha que poderia<$cdef(27)> quebrar aquela parede na sua frente para
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>me ajudar a sair daqui?

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>I got myself stuck in here... <$cdef(27)>Could ya bust up that wall
there in front of you?
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,38)>Just give it a “WHAM! THWACK!” and smash it up!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>Eu fiquei preso aqui... você<$cdef(27)> poderia abrir aquela
parede na sua frente?
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,38)>Basta dar um "WHAM! THWACK!" e esmagá-lo!

source: <$voicel(4,1)><$emotion(4,47)>Dang! I thought for sure you could do it...
translation: <$voicel(4,1)><$emotion(4,47)>Eu pensei que você poderia fazer isso...

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,661)><$comeff(4,14)>I always heard that you should try usin’ your head when
your muscles don’t work, <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,17)>but I’m not so good at that...
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,661)><$comeff(4,14)>Eu sempre ouvi que você deveria nos tentar quando seus
músculos não funcionam, <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,17)>mas eu não sou tão bom nisso...

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)>Hey, I know! You got any really smart friends?
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Could ya maybe <$cdef(27)>ask them how <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>to bust through the walls
around here?
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,49)>I’ll be patiently waitin’ here! I’m countin’ on ya, bud!
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)>Ei, eu sei, você tem amigos muito inteligentes?
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Poderia perguntar<$cdef(27)> a eles <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>como atravessar as paredes
por aqui?
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,49)>Estarei esperando pacientemente aqui, estou contando com você, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Heh. Good one, bud. That was kinda funny. But if a
headbutt could do the trick, I’d already be out!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, I got an idea! You know any really smart Pokémon?
<$voicel(4,5)>Could ya maybe <$cdef(27)>ask them how <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>to bust through the walls
around here?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>I’ll be patiently waitin’ here! I’m countin’ on ya, bud!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Essa foi engraçada, mas se Headbutt
resolvesse, eu já estaria livre!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, eu tenho uma ideia, você conhece algum Pokémon realmente inteligente?
<$voicel(4,5)>Poderia perguntar<$cdef(27)> a eles <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>como atravessar as paredes
por aqui?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Estarei esperando pacientemente aqui, estou contando com você, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>You find a way to bust through the walls around here yet?
I’m countin’ on ya, bud!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Você encontra uma maneira de atravessar as
paredes por aqui?

source: <$voicel(1,5)>I can’t stop wondering what’s beyond that wall of stone.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)>Não consigo parar de me perguntar o que está além dessa parede de pedra.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)>I don’t believe that wall was there back when I was a
young little thing...
<$voicel(1,5)>But, whether it existed then or not, so much time has
passed that I don’t remember at all what lies beyond it.
<$voicel(1,7)>Seeing what you’re capable of now, I daresay you
could break through that wall for me.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)>Eu não acredito que aquela parede estava lá
quando eu era jovem...
<$voicel(1,5)>Mas, se existiu ou não, tanto tempo se passou
que eu não me lembro de nada do que está além dele.
<$voicel(1,7)>Vendo o que você é capaz agora, eu ouso dizer que
você poderia romper essa parede para mim.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>If it’s not too much trouble, could you please <$cdef(27)>take me to
the other side of that wall?
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Se não é muito problema, poderia me <$cdef(27)>levar para
o outro lado da parede?

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Hm? Did you have a question for me?
<$voicel(1,5)>My apologies, but I’d really like to see the other side of
that wall first.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,10)>I’m just too preoccupied with that to think about
anything else!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Você tem uma pergunta para mim?
<$voicel(1,5)>Minhas desculpas, mas eu gostaria de ver o outro lado da
parede primeiro.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,10)>Estou muito preocupado com isso para pensar em qualquer
outra coisa!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,5)>Would you please <$cdef(27)>break through that wall and take me to
the other side?
<$voicel(1,5)>It seems like you may have some sort of question for
me, but you can ask me afterwards.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,5)>Pode romper <$cdef(27)>a parede e me levar para o
outro lado?
<$voicel(1,5)>Parece que você pode ter algum tipo de pergunta para mim
, mas você pode me perguntar depois.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Oho! Well, would you look at that! So this is what awaited
us on the other side—the vast sea itself!
<$voicel(1,5)>Now that I see it again, I DO have some faint memories of
gazing out over this sea as a child!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Então é isso que nos esperava do outro
lado, o vasto mar em si!
<$voicel(1,5)>Agora que eu vejo de novo, eu tenho algumas lembranças fracas
de olhar para este mar quando criança!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>Wh-what could this be?
<$voicel(1,3)>It’s covered in sand...but it certainly looks like a
human-made building of some kind!
<$voicel(1,1)>I don’t think this used to be here in the old days, either...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>O que poderia ser isso?
<$voicel(1,3)>Está coberto de areia... mas certamente parece um edifício
feito pelo homem de algum tipo!
<$voicel(1,1)>Eu não acho que isso costumava estar aqui nos velhos tempos, também...
<$voicel(1,5)>O que é aquele idiota de boxe?

source:
... *crackle* ...
Ahhh, testing, testing, one two three...
Hello, good morning. Or maybe good evening!
Is this really recording? Ah, whatever. I’ll give it a go.
translation:
Ahhh, testes
, testes, um, dois, três...
Olá, bom dia, ou talvez boa noite.
Isso é realmente gravação? Ah, seja o que for. Eu vou dar uma chance.

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)><$facial(1,13)>Ohhh, the box spoke! Is this another PC?

Excuse me! You there! Welcome to our hideout. You look
like a real hero! And, you know, a real nice guy!
But...wait. Whoever hears this might not be a guy...
Uh, forget that last part!
You’re, uh—I mean, you have honest-looking eyes!
I’m certain you have a pure and worthy heart.
translation:
Bem-vindo ao nosso esconderijo, parece um
herói de verdade, e um cara muito legal.
Mas... espere, quem ouvir isso pode não ser um cara...
esqueça essa última parte!
Quer dizer, você tem olhos honestos, tenho
certeza que tem um coração puro e digno.

source:
And believe you me, all of us have pure and worthy hearts
too! After all, we’re a business that uses Pokémon—
Err, I mean, we’re an organization that works hard to
improve the environment for the sake of all Pokémon.
And we’re fun! And independent!
translation:
E acredite em mim, todos nós temos corações puros e dignos
também! Afinal, somos um negócio que usa Pokémon
Quero dizer, somos uma organização que trabalha duro para
melhorar o meio ambiente para o bem de todos os Pokémon.
E nós somos divertidos e independentes!

source:
Ah! That look in your eyes tells me that you want to join,
right? Well, I can tell you’ve got a lot of potential!
But if you really want to become one of us, you have to
overcome a difficult trial. We call it the <$cdef(27)>Team Initiation
<$cdef(27)>Challenge! Let’s get you started right away with Part One.
translation:
Esse olhar nos seus olhos me diz
que você quer se juntar, certo?
Mas se você realmente quer se tornar um de nós, você tem que
superar um julgamento difícil. Chamamos isso de<$cdef(27)> Desafio de Iniciação
<$cdef(27)> em Equipe! Vamos começar você imediatamente com a Parte Um.

source:
Your first task is to gather <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> and put them
in this delivery hatch!
Don’t worry—WE’RE not going to eat them! They’re for
the Pokémon, of course!
translation:
Sua primeira tarefa é reunir <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> e colocá-los nesta
escotilha de entrega!
Não se preocupe, nós não vamos comê-los! Eles são
para os Pokémon, é claro!

source:
And one more thing! As you work your way through the
<$cdef(27)>Team Initiation Challenge, you’ll get some quality gifts!
We’ll be waiting with bated breath, so get to it!
translation:
E mais uma coisa! Como você trabalha o seu caminho através do
<$cdef(27)>Desafio de Iniciação de Equipe, você vai ter alguns presentes de qualidade
! Estaremos esperando com fôlego batido, então chegar a ele!

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Hmm. Seems it’s finally done talking.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>I couldn’t make heads or tails of what it was saying, but it
sounded like a human voice...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,7)>and they seemed like they
might need help.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>I’m still really curious about this building. It might even
give us some clues about what happened to the humans.
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Parece que finalmente acabou de falar.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>Eu não conseguia entender o que estava dizendo, mas
parecia uma voz humana..<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,7)>. e eles pareciam
precisar de ajuda.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Ainda estou realmente curioso sobre este edifício, pode até nos
dar algumas pistas sobre o que aconteceu com os humanos.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>But there’s no use just standing here thinking about it.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Do you mind stopping by from time to time to check on
this building, though, <$cdef(27)>? Just
once
in a
while
would
be fine!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Mas não adianta ficar aqui pensando nisso.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Você se importaria de parar de vez em quando para
verificar este prédio, no<$cdef(27)> entanto
, só
de vez
em
quando
seria bom!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)>Oh, I nearly forgot! You had something you wanted to ask
me about—didn’t you, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)>Tinha algo que queria me
perguntar, não é, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,13)>What’s that you say? An <$cdef(27)>Onix is stuck in a cave?! <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)>Dear me,
I certainly hope we can do something to help...
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,13)>O que você diz? Um <$cdef(27)>Onix está preso em uma caverna?! Querido<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)>, eu
certamente espero que possamos fazer algo para ajudar...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>First things first, let’s head back and discuss this with
the others!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Primeiro, vamos voltar e discutir isso com
os outros!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>It seems an <$cdef(27)>Onix is trapped in a cave.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>And the walls of said cave are so hard, even
<$cdef(27)>
can’t
break
through them.
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Does anyone have any great brainstorms about what we
can do to help?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Parece que um <$cdef(27)>Onix está preso em uma caverna.
E<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)> as paredes da caverna são tão duras, que
<$cdef(27)>
nem
conseguem
atravessá-las.
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Alguém tem alguma grande discussão sobre o que podemos
fazer para ajudar?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>If we’re dealing with super-solid ground, we could try
spraying it with some water? <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Maybe that’d make it all
squishy and soft!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Se estivermos lidando com solo super-sólido
, poderíamos tentar <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>pulverizá-lo com um
pouco de água?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... If the walls are so hard that even a tough’un like
<$cdef(27)>Onix can’t deal with them...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,17)>I imagine it will take more than a little water to soften
them up.<$motion(1,654)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)>Se as paredes são tão duras que nem um durão como
<$cdef(27)>Onix pode lidar com elas...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,17)>Imagino que será preciso mais do que um pouco de água para
amaciá-los.<$motion(1,654)>

source: <$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Then why don’t we just wait for it to rain?
translation: <$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Então por que não esperamos que chova?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)>I suppose you all wouldn’t know, but it doesn’t really rain
around these parts.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)>Suponho que não saberiam, mas não chove muito
nessas partes.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>I couldn’t tell you why, but the last time I saw any rain fall
was when I was just a sprout—<$voicel(1,6)>back when there were still
humans around here.<$comcan(1)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,652)><$facial(1,9)>I haven’t seen so much as a drop since.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>Eu não podia te dizer por que, mas a última vez que vi qualquer queda de
chuva foi quando eu era apenas um broto<$voicel(1,6)> - de volta quando ainda havia
seres humanos por aqui.<$comcan(1)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,652)><$facial(1,9)>Eu não vi uma gota desde então.

source: <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Whoa, for real? <wait(0.8)>Well, that’s fine by me. No rain, no pain!
translation: <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Bem, isso é <wait(0.8)>bom para mim. Sem chuva, sem dor!

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,13)>Hold on! What do you mean, no rain?! We NEED rain!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>I’m sure a little rain would not only help <$cdef(27)>Onix—it might
cheer up the other Pokémon here as well!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Tenho certeza que um pouco de chuva não só ajudaria <$cdef(27)>Onix,
como também animaria os outros Pokémon aqui!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Easier said than done, I’m afraid! Let’s see... How CAN we
get it to rain?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>É mais fácil falar do que fazer, temo que vejamos... como podemos
fazer chover?

source: <$facial(1,1)><$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>Wow, there’s stuff even YOU don’t know, <$cdef(27)>Professor</color>?
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmmmmm... Rain. What does rain bring to mind...
translation: <$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>O que a chuva me traz à mente?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)><$facial(1,4)>Oho! I think I’ve got it! We need a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Yes, if we had a certain Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke helping
us, we might be able to make it rain!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Do you think you could find a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke and bring
them here?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,839)>If I recall correctly, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke like sleeping in <$cdef(27)>tall grass
near the sea!<$motion(1,656)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Sim, se tivéssemos um Pokémon chamado <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke nos
ajudando, poderíamos fazer chover!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Você acha que poderia encontrar um <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke e trazê
-los aqui?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,839)>Se eu me lembrar corretamente, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke como dormir <$cdef(27)>em grama alta
perto do mar!<$motion(1,656)>

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you recall that sand-covered building we found beyond
the rock wall you broke for me?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>If there’s any tall grass around there, I’m certain a
<$cdef(27)>Slowpoke would like it.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Lembra daquele prédio coberto de areia que encontramos além da parede
de pedra que você quebrou para mim?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Se houver alguma grama alta por aí, tenho certeza que
um <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke gostaria.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Do you think you could find a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke and <$cdef(27)>bring
them here?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Você acha que poderia encontrar um <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke <$cdef(27)>e trazê
-los aqui?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>If I recall correctly, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke like sleeping in <$cdef(27)>tall grass
near the sea!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>Se eu me lembrar corretamente, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke como dormir <$cdef(27)>em grama alta
perto do mar!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Huh. So I have the power to make it rain?
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Então eu tenho o poder de fazer chover?

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,807)>Oh, but hold on... The ground’s really bumpy around
here, right? It’s hard to walk...
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,47)>I think I’m gonna get all, y’know, tired out before we even
make it to the <$cdef(27)>professor.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,807)>Oh, mas espere... o chão está muito
esburacado por aqui, certo?
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,47)>Acho que vou me cansar antes de chegarmos
ao <$cdef(27)>professor.

source:
If you place steps where the terrain is different heights,
Pokémon will be able to walk more easily!
translation:
Se você colocar passos onde o terreno é de alturas diferentes,
Pokémon será capaz de andar mais facilmente!

source:
Also, Pokémon can walk much farther on moistened paths
than on dried-up ground!
translation:
Além disso, Pokémon pode andar muito mais longe em caminhos umedecidos
do que em terrenos secos!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)>If you could, y’know, <$voicel(4,7)>clear off the path and make it easier
to walk on, that’d be great.
’Cause...uh...’cause... Oh! Right! ’Cause I wanna get to
the <$cdef(27)>professor!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)>Se você pudesse, você <$voicel(4,7)>sabe, limpar o caminho e torná-lo mais
fácil de andar, isso seria ótimo.
Porque... ahn... porque... Oh! Certo! Porque eu quero chegar
ao <$cdef(27)>professor!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>Huh? Oh, is the path all, uh, cleared out?

<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>Hey there. Is that thing you were gonna do sorted? Like,
clearing a path or something?
translation:
<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>Ei, aquela coisa que você ia fazer, arrumando
um caminho ou algo assim?

source: <$voicel(4,10)><$motion(4,801)><$comeff(4,9)>Oh, OK! I guess I’d better go check it out, then...
translation: <$voicel(4,10)><$motion(4,801)><$comeff(4,9)>Acho que é melhor eu ir conferir, então...

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,3)>Oooh, OK. I guess I’d better head back then. Let me know
when the path is, y’know, all clear, I guess?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,3)>Acho que é melhor eu voltar, me avise quando o
caminho estiver, sabe, tudo limpo, eu acho?

source: <$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$comeff(4,9)>Oh, OK! I guess I’d better go check it out, then...
translation: <$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$comeff(4,9)>Acho que é melhor eu ir conferir, então...

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,3)>Oooh, OK. Let me know when you’re done!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,3)>Sure thing, I’m not rushing anywhere! Just let me know
when you’re done with...uh, what you said you’d do.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,3)>Claro, não estou me apressando em lugar nenhum, apenas
me avise quando terminar... o que você disse que faria.

source: <$voicel(4,1)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,14)>*pant pant* I think... I think I need a break...
translation: <$voicel(4,1)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,14)>Pant Pant Eu acho... eu acho que eu preciso de uma pausa...

source:
If you place steps where the terrain is different heights,
Pokémon will be able to walk more easily.
translation:
Se você colocar passos onde o terreno é de alturas diferentes,
Pokémon será capaz de andar mais facilmente.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,802)><$comeff(4,7)>Oh no! There’s like, uh, stuff in the way. I dunno if I
can make it through like this...
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,802)><$comeff(4,7)>Tem coisas no caminho, não sei se
consigo passar assim...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>Oho, it’s a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>! Thank you for coming!
<$voicel(1,7)>Now then, as for why I’ve asked you here.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)>Agora, então, por que eu te pedi aqui.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)>It’s because of an old human legend—that <$cdef(27)>rain falls when
a Slowpoke yawns! <$voicel(1,6)>At least, that’s what I’ve heard!<$motion(1,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)>É por causa de uma velha lenda humana, que a<$cdef(27)> chuva cai quando
um Slowpoke boceja<$voicel(1,6)>! Pelo menos, isso é o que eu ouvi!<$motion(1,652)>

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>To cut to the chase, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke—could you please
yawn for us?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Para ir direto ao assunto, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke, poderia
bocejar por nós?
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(4,4)>Eu não estou realmente com sono agora.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,13)>Oh, uh... Right!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>But do you suppose you could just...try for us, please?
<$voicel(1,6)>It would be such a huge help!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,13)>Oh, ahn... certo!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>Mas você acha que poderia... tentar
<$voicel(1,6)>por nós, por favor?

source: <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)>Awww, I shoulda figured it wouldn’t work...
translation: <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)>Ahhh, eu deveria ter imaginado que não funcionaria...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>No, no! It’s just because that yawn was only <$cdef(27)><akubi;0> <qty;0(point,points)></color>!
candidate_translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Não, não! É que aquele bocejo valeu só <$cdef(27)><akubi;0> <qty;0(ponto,pontos)></color>!
<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)><$cdef(27)><akubi;0> <qty;0(ponto,pontos)></color>? Do que está falando?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,48)>That just now wasn’t a serious yawn at all! It was a mere
<$cdef(27)>-point yawn!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,662)><$comeff(1,5)>For it to actually start raining, we need <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke to give
us a <$cdef(27)>full 100-point yawn! ...Probably!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,48)>Isso agora não era um bocejo sério, era um bocejo
<$cdef(27)> simples!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,662)><$comeff(1,5)>Para começar a chover, precisamos do<$cdef(27)> Slowpoke para
nos <$cdef(27)>dar um bocejo de 100 pontos!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>So how are we gonna get a <$cdef(27)>full 100-point</color> yawn, then?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Então, como vamos conseguir um<$cdef(27)> bocejo de 100 </color>pontos, então?

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Hmmm... Well, maybe if it was more <$cdef(27)>humid around here...
Then I’d be extra comfy, and then I’d get real sleepy!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Bem, talvez se fosse mais úmido por <$cdef(27)>aqui... então eu ficaria
mais confortável, e então eu ficaria realmente sonolento!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>The air’s so dry around here, right? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Like, it’s missing
some proper <$cdef(27)>humidity... You know?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>O ar está tão seco por aqui, né? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Parece que está
faltando uma boa dose de <$cdef(27)>umidade... Sabe?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Right, then! Let’s all work together to <$voicel(1,8)>raise the <$cdef(27)>humidity
around this place!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>And then we’ll make it rain!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Vamos todos trabalhar juntos para <$voicel(1,8)>aumentar a <$cdef(27)>umidade ao
redor deste lugar!
E<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)> então vamos fazer chover!

source:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$cdef(27)>, why don’t you start by spraying
some
water
around
the area?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>That ought to help <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke yawn better!
translation:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$cdef(27)>, por que você não começa pulverizando um
pouco
de água
ao redor
da área?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Isso deve ajudar <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke bocejar melhor!

source:

the area?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>That ought to help <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke yawn better!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Por que não começa pulverizando um pouco mais de água ao redor
da área?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Isso deve ajudar <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke bocejar melhor!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Oho! You sprayed that water, did you?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>So, how’s <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke’s yawn coming along?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Você borrifou essa água, não é?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Então, como vai o bocejo do <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,8)>After you’ve given the other Pokémon’s ideas a whirl, you
might find that the humidity has risen.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,3)>Try asking <$cdef(27)><$cname(37)> to <$cdef(27)>yawn to check the current
yawn points!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>A mere <$cdef(27)>-point yawn... It seems we haven’t

translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Parece<$cdef(27)> que ainda não aumentamos

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hmmm, I’d give that yawn about <$cdef(27)> points.

translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hmm, eu daria aquele bocejo sobre<$cdef(27)> pontos,

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Oho! I’d say that was a solid <$cdef(27)>-point yawn!
We’ve got some fairly decent humidity!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Eu diria que foi um bocejo de<$cdef(27)> ponto sólido
, temos um pouco de umidade decente.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,4)>My word! That yawn was worth at least <$cdef(27)> points!
Come on—we’re almost there!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,4)>Minha palavra, aquele bocejo valeu pelo <$cdef(27)>menos
pontos, vamos, estamos quase lá.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>I must say, if <$cdef(27)>Onix can’t break through those cave
walls, they must be exceedingly hard!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Devo dizer que, se <$cdef(27)>Onix não pode romper as paredes da
caverna, eles devem ser extremamente difíceis!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,2)>Helloooooo, everybody! Could you gather around here for

translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,2)>Podem se reunir por aqui por um momento

plantas e árvores saudáveis houver!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>So, um, you know how I was talking about the place where
I lived before? There was a really big, really pretty forest
near there, <$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,807)>and that area was always SUPER humid!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>Então, você sabe como eu estava falando sobre o lugar onde
eu morava antes? Havia uma floresta muito grande, muito bonita
perto de lá<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,807)>, e essa área era sempre SUPER úmida!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$facial(3,4)>So I was hoping you could water the dried-up trees around
here and make ’em all healthy again!
<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)>I bet that’d make the place even more humid!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$facial(3,4)>Então eu esperava que você pudesse regar as árvores secas
por aqui e torná-las saudáveis de novo!
<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)>Aposto que isso tornaria o lugar ainda mais úmido!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motionoff(3,804)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>If you see any dried-up trees, could you please
water them?
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,20)>Oh, wait a second! I just remembered something!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motionoff(3,804)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Se vir árvores secas, pode
regá-las?
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,20)>Oh, espere um segundo, acabei de me lembrar de algo!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)>There were lots and lots of dried-up trees on the beach
over that way!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)>Havia muitas árvores secas na praia
por ali!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Oooh, the trees around here look so much healthier now!
Did YOU do that? <$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,6)>Thank you!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Oooh, as árvores por aqui parecem muito mais saudáveis
agora! Você fez isso?<$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,6)> Obrigado!

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,666)>By the way, didja know that you can also plant new trees
from seeds? <$voicel(3,8)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>Here—try it out!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,666)>A propósito, você sabia que também pode plantar novas
árvores a <$voicel(3,8)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>partir de sementes?

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>The seeds can really take a long time to grow after you
plant them, though.
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>But I can help—um, just a little—when you’re growing trees
’n’ flowers ’n’ stuff!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>As sementes podem levar muito tempo para crescer
depois de plantá-las.
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Mas eu posso ajudar, só um pouco, quando você está cultivando
árvores e flores e coisas!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>I see a lot more healthy trees around here than before.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Vejo muito mais árvores saudáveis por aqui do que antes.

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Thanks to them, the air feels a bit more humid too!
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Graças a eles, o ar parece um pouco mais úmido também!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>It seems that having more healthy flowers around increases
the humidity as well!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Parece que ter flores mais saudáveis ao redor aumenta
a umidade também!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Growing various other plants might be a good idea too.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Cultivar várias outras plantas também pode ser uma boa ideia.

source:
<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,21)>If there are any plants you want to grow faster, then come
and get me!
translation:
<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,21)>Se há alguma planta que você quer crescer mais rápido, então
venha me pegar!

source: <$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,10)>I wonder how <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>’s doing with that yawn!
translation: <$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,10)>Eu me pergunto como <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color> está fazendo com esse bocejo!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,8)>I bet if there was a spot around here with some tall grass
near water, it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid—just the way I like it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,8)>Aposto que se houvesse um lugar por aqui com uma grama alta
perto da água, seria agradável e <$cdef(27)>úmido - do jeito que eu gosto!

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>I was thinking... Maybe you could make an area like that?
translation: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>Eu estava pensando... talvez você pudesse fazer uma área como essa?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Do you think you could grow some grass near the water
around here? I bet it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Você acha que poderia cultivar um pouco
de grama perto da água por <$cdef(27)>aqui?

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>You made a <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> habitat? Thanks so much,
<$cdef(27)>!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>, I wanted to ask...
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>You know that <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> habitat you made?
translation:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, eu queria perguntar...
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Sabe aquele <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>habitat que você fez?

source:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>It seems so nice and comfy and... Y’know, I’d really like
to move there!
translation:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Parece tão bom e confortável e... Sabe, eu realmente gostaria de
me mudar para lá!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>My home right now’s really nice too! But I bet if I lived in
that <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>, I’d have even more energy and
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>I’d be able to help you out even more!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Mas aposto que se eu vivesse nisso, teria
ainda<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> mais energia e seria
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>capaz de ajudá-lo ainda mais!

source:
Let’s grant <$cdef(27)>Squirtle’s request and help them <$cdef(27)>move into a
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> habitat!
To get a Pokémon to <$cdef(27)>move homes, have the Pokémon
follow you, then talk to them when you’re next to a
vacant habitat!
translation:
Vamos conceder o pedido de <$cdef(27)>Squirtle e ajudá-los a <$cdef(27)>se mudar para
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>um habitat!
Para conseguir que um <$cdef(27)>Pokémon mude de casa, peça que
os Pokémon o sigam, e fale com eles quando estiver perto de
um habitat vazio!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>I promise I’ll be lots more help if I could move into the
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu prometo que eu vou ser muito mais ajuda se eu poderia passar para
o<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>!

source:
Let’s grant <$cdef(27)>Squirtle’s request and help them <$cdef(27)>move into a
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> habitat!
To get a Pokémon to <$cdef(27)>move homes, have the Pokémon
follow you, then talk to them when you’re next to a
vacant habitat!
translation:
Vamos conceder o pedido de <$cdef(27)>Squirtle e ajudá-los a <$cdef(27)>se mudar para
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>um habitat!
Para conseguir que um <$cdef(27)>Pokémon mude de casa, peça que
os Pokémon o sigam, e fale com eles quando estiver perto de
um habitat vazio!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>This <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> will grant me amazing power...
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>And then I can help make it rain!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)>me dará um poder incrível...
E<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)> então eu posso ajudar a fazer chover!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh! So, hear me out, <$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Moving closer to water has really inspired me—I got a
brilliant idea!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>It’s sure to bring rain and help <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke to yawn properly!
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Então, me escute, <$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Aproximar-me da água realmente me inspirou. Tenho uma
ideia brilhante!
É<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)> certo trazer chuva e ajudar <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke a bocejar corretamente!

source: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>I was thinking...I could throw a <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color> party!
translation: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu estava pensando... eu poderia dar uma festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color>!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>A <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party is kinda like a ceremony that’s
supposed to make it rain, <$voicel(2,6)>but it requires lots of
preparation...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Do you think you could help me prepare for the
<$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Uma festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance é como uma cerimônia
que deveria fazer <$voicel(2,6)>chover, mas requer muita
preparação...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Acha que poderia me ajudar a me preparar para a
festa da <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance, <$cdef(27)>?

source: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks! So, here’s what I’ll need for the <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color> party...
translation: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Então, aqui está o que eu vou precisar para a festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color>...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>First, I need you to find a <$cdef(27)>plate and then put some <$cdef(27)>food
on it!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Primeiro, eu preciso que você encontre <$cdef(27)>um prato e depois coloque um pouco<$cdef(27)> de
comida nele!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)>And near that, I need you to place <$cdef(27)>something that makes
me think of rain! <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>It’s really important!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)>E perto disso, preciso que<$cdef(27)> coloque algo
que me faça <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>pensar em chuva!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>During the <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party, <$comcan(2)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>I need to keep my mind
focused on rain.
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,4)>If my thoughts wander even for a second... Even a quick
“it sure would be nice if it rained delicious berries too”
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)>will make the whole party fail!
<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>That’s why I need items that’ll help keep me focused on
rain, but...<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,4)>I guess that’s a little too vague, huh.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Durante a festa<$cdef(27)> da Rain Dance<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>, preciso manter minha
mente focada na chuva.
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,4)>Se meus pensamentos vaguearem por um segundo... até mesmo
um rápido "seria bom se chovesse deliciosas frutas também"
fará<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)> com que toda a festa fracasse!
É<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)> por isso que preciso de itens que me ajudem a manter o foco
na chuva, mas..<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,4)>. acho que isso é um pouco vago demais, né.

source:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Maybe we should ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth for help? <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I bet
the <$cdef(27)>professor will know what sort of thing we need!
translation:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Talvez devêssemos pedir ajuda ao <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth,<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)> aposto
que<$cdef(27)> o professor saberá que tipo de coisa precisamos.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Something that makes you think of rain? Now why in the
world would you need a thing like that?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Algo que te faça pensar em chuva, por que
você precisaria de algo assim?

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>What’s that? <$cdef(27)>Squirtle wants to hold a <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party?
How interesting...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,5)>You know, I think I have just the thing to help!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>O que é isso? <$cdef(27)>Squirtle quer fazer uma festa<$cdef(27)> de Rain Dance
? Que interessante...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,5)>Sabe, acho que tenho a coisa certa para ajudar!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>You know where I live, don’t you? It’s the cave where we
first met.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Sabe onde moro, não é? É a caverna onde nos
conhecemos.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>Have a look near my bed in that cave. <$voicel(1,8)>You should find
some <$cdef(27)>Castform dolls around there.

<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>Castform is a Pokémon who changes its appearance
depending on the weather.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If you arrange the dolls to show their rainy appearance,
they ought to be just perfect for your <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party!
translation:
<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>Castform é um Pokémon que muda sua aparência
dependendo do tempo.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Se você arrumar as bonecas para mostrar sua aparência chuvosa
, elas devem ser perfeitas para sua festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>You should find those <$cdef(27)>Castform dolls in my home. They’ll
be perfect for your <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Você deve encontrar aquelas<$cdef(27)> bonecas Castform na minha casa, elas serão
perfeitas para a sua festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>I say, that <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party idea is an interesting one!
<$voicel(1,5)>There were some Legendary Pokémon the humans used
to revere as deities. <$voicel(1,4)>THEY might be able to cause rain,
but <$voicel(1,6)>I do wonder if little <$cdef(27)>Squirtle is up for the job...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Eu digo, que <$cdef(27)>a ideia da festa da Rain Dance é interessante!
<$voicel(1,5)>Havia alguns Pokémon Lendários que os humanos costumavam
reverenciar como divindades, <$voicel(1,4)>eles podem ser capazes de causar chuva, mas
eu me<$voicel(1,6)> pergunto se o pequeno <$cdef(27)>Squirtle está pronto para o trabalho...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>To prepare for a <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party, first I need a <$cdef(27)>plate...
<$voicel(2,8)>And then I need you to put some <$cdef(27)>food on it.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Para me preparar para uma festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance, primeiro preciso de um <$cdef(27)>prato.
.<$voicel(2,8)>. e então preciso que você coloque um pouco de <$cdef(27)>comida nele.

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>And near that, I need you to place <$cdef(27)>something that makes
me think of rain!
translation:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>E perto disso, preciso que coloque<$cdef(27)> algo que me faça
pensar em chuva!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Let me know when everything’s ready. I’m gonna do
my best!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh wow! This is perfect! You made a wonderful
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(152)>!
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Thanks for setting all this up, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso é perfeito, você fez um maravilhoso
<$cdef(27)><$hatname(152)>!
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Obrigado por arrumar tudo isso, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Now then, it’s time to get this <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color> party started!
translation: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Agora, então, é hora de começar essa festa de <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color>!

source: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Well?! Is it starting to feel like it’s gonna rain?!
translation: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Está começando a sentir que vai chover?

source:
<$emotion(2,64)><$voicel(2,7)>I bet <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke will notice a change in the humidity!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Let’s go see if they can yawn properly now!
translation:
<$emotion(2,64)><$voicel(2,7)>Aposto que <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke notará uma mudança na umidade!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Vamos ver se eles podem bocejar corretamente agora!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Right? OK—now we can go check if <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke can yawn
properly!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You made a <$cdef(27)><$hatname(152)> for me! I can’t wait to have
a Rain Dance party!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Mal posso <$cdef(27)><$hatname(152)>esperar para ter uma festa
de Rain Dance!

source: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>Hmmm... Soil around here’s a little crumbly, huh?
translation: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>O solo por aqui está um pouco esfarelado, hein?

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, heya! Nice to meet ya! Do you live around here?
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I don’t really know a whole lot about this area, so you’ve
gotta show me the ropes, OK? <$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>I’m counting on you!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Prazer em conhecê-la, vive por aqui?
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu realmente não sei muito sobre esta área, então
você tem que me mostrar<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)> as cordas, OK?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>So anyway, I’m trying to get better at using <$cdef(27)>Rototiller on<$cdef(27)>
the dirt here...but I’m in a little bit of a pickle!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Enfim, estou tentando melhorar meu <$cdef(27)>Rototiller nesta<$cdef(27)>
terra... Mas acabei me metendo numa enrascada!

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>By which I mean—the soil around here is SO dry that <$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>it just
straight up crumbles when I try to till it!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Quero dizer, o solo por aqui é tão seco que<$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)> se
desmorona quando eu tento cultivá-lo!

source:
<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>If ONLY there was SOMEONE who was the nicest person
EVER and could water the dry soil around here for me...
translation:
<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>Se houvesse alguém que fosse a pessoa mais legal de todos
os tempos e pudesse regar o solo seco por aqui para mim...

source:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>I SAID—If only there was SOMEONE who could water the
dry soil around here for me...
translation:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu disse que se houvesse alguém que pudesse regar o
solo seco por aqui para mim...

source:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Whoa! Now the soil looks super nice and soft! And it’s all
thanks to YOU! Thanks so much!
translation:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Agora o solo parece super agradável e macio, e é tudo
graças a você, muito obrigado!

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>OK! Time to get my tilling on, so watch and learn—if you
want!<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)> Here I GOOO!
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Está na hora de começar a cultivar, então observe e
aprenda<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>, se quiser!

source: <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>Whoa—you did it! Dang, you’re pretty good at this!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>After you till the soil to loosen it up, you can grow veggie
seeds in it!
translation:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Depois de cultivar o solo para afrouxá-lo, você pode cultivar sementes
vegetais nele!

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Uhhh... Fun fact—I actually don’t have anywhere to crash
around here yet!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Na verdade, não tenho para onde parar por
aqui ainda!

source: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I’d REALLY love to live someplace like this, but...
translation: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu adoraria viver em um lugar assim, mas...

source:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>These parts sure don’t seem to be crawling with veggie
fields for me to live in!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>But you look like the type of Pokémon who could make it
happen! <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>So here, take THESE!
translation:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>Essas partes certamente não parecem estar rastejando com campos
de vegetais para eu viver!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Mas você se parece com o tipo de Pokémon que poderia
fazer<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)> isso acontecer!

source: <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>I’d love to live in a home like THIS!
translation: <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu adoraria viver em uma casa como esta!

source:
Loosen up soil with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)> to create a crop field
where you can plant seeds!
Try making a <$cdef(27)><$hatname(234)> to thank <$cdef(27)>Drilbur for
teaching you this move!
If you don’t have enough seeds, you can buy them at the
<$cdef(27)>PC shop!

você pode plantar sementes!

ensinar essa jogada!
Se você não tem sementes suficientes, você pode comprá-las na
<$cdef(27)>loja de PC!

source:
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>I just knew you were the right Pokémon to ask! <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>This is such
an awesome home! Thank you SOOO much!
translation:
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>Eu só sabia que você era o Pokémon certo para <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>perguntar, esta
é uma casa incrível, muito obrigado.

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Seems like some kinda seed? I found ’em earlier.
<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>I’m curious what they’ll grow into, <$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>but I’m hopeless when
it comes to gardening.
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Wanna try to grow ’em yourself? You may have better luck.
translation:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Parece uma espécie de semente?
<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Estou curioso para saber em que eles vão crescer<$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>, mas estou sem esperança
quando se trata de jardinagem.
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Quer tentar cultivá-los você mesmo?

source:
You can plant <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)>, <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)>, and other vegetable
seeds in soil that you’ve loosened with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)>.
After you plant the seeds, water them with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>
to help them grow into vegetables.
Watering them once a day is more effective than watering
them a bunch of times at once.
translation:
Você pode plantar <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)>, <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)>, e outras sementes
vegetais no solo que você afrouxou<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(2)>.
Depois de plantar as sementes, regue-as para<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>
ajudá-las a crescer em vegetais.
Rega-los uma vez por dia é mais eficaz do que regá-los um
monte de vezes ao mesmo tempo.

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>. Any luck with the seeds I
gave ya?

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, alguma sorte com as sementes que

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)>? Those seeds grew into this? Now there’s a

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)>, essas sementes cresceram e agora há uma visão feliz

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>... Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Heya, <$cdef(27)>. Got a sec? I could use
your help.
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I may not look it, but the thing is, I love flowers—how they
look, how they smell, all of it!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, preciso da sua
ajuda.
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Posso não parecer, mas a coisa é, eu amo flores - como eles
olham, como eles cheiram, tudo isso!

source:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>But anytime I try to pick a snazzy-lookin’ flower, these
sharp scythes of mine slice ’em to shreds...
translation:
<$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>Mas sempre que tento escolher uma flor snazzy, essas
foices afiadas da minha fatia em pedaços...

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Aw yeah, check out those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2533)>—they’re pretty
as heck! Just lookin’ at them chills me out.
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>Thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Y’know, I don’t share my flower-lovin’ side with most folks,<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>
but I’m glad I shared it with you!
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Ah, sim, confira aqueles <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2533)>, eles são bonitos
como o diabo, só de olhar para eles me acalma
.<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)> Obrigado um monte, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Você sabe, eu não compartilho meu lado amante de flores com a maioria das pessoas<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>
, mas estou feliz que eu compartilhei com você!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,14)><$kfacial(4)><$comeff(4,9)>I feel like there’s even more <$cdef(27)>humidity than before... It’s
really making me want to...to...
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,14)><$kfacial(4)><$comeff(4,9)>Sinto que há ainda mais <$cdef(27)>umidade do que antes...
está me fazendo querer...

source:
<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Th-that yawn just now... It was perfect! A <$cdef(27)>full
100-point yawn!
translation:
<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Aquele bocejo foi perfeito, um bocejo<$cdef(27)>
de 100 pontos!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>Hohoho! See, it’s just as I told you.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Now it should be easier to break the walls trapping <$cdef(27)>Onix in
that ca—
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>Hohoho, é como eu te disse.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Agora deve ser mais fácil quebrar as paredes prendendo <$cdef(27)>Onix
naquele ca...

source: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>The rain made me so happy that it kinda woke me right up!
translation: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>A chuva me fez tão feliz que meio que me acordou!

source: <$voicel(3,3)><$motion(3,807)><$facial(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)>Awww... But we all worked so hard!

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>Wh-what was that?!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>It sounded like it was coming from the ocean! Let’s all
go see!

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>O que foi isso?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Parecia que estava vindo do oceano! Vamos todos
ver!

something
to
walk
on
to
reach
that

preparar

algo
para
ir
até
aquele

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Could you go and talk to that Pokémon on our behalf?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Você poderia ir e falar com aquele Pokémon em nosso nome?

source:

Pokémon, <$cdef(27)>?
