perfeita, você!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Now you just need the stuff to build it and some
Pokémon to help! <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,8)>And you know I’m totally down to help
with the building part!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Agora você só precisa das coisas para construí-lo e alguns
Pokémon para ajudar!<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,8)> E você sabe que eu estou totalmente para ajudar
com a parte de construção!

source:
<$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>As for all the stuff needed to build it... Uh... Can I count on
you to get that squared away?! Sorry I can’t help there, yo!
translation:
<$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>Quanto a todas as coisas necessárias para construí-
lo... posso contar com você para acabar com isso?

source:
You’ll find a whole bounty of materials that can be used
for building if you go to a <$cdef(27)>Dream Island!
translation:
Você encontrará uma grande quantidade de materiais que podem ser usados
para construir se você for a uma <$cdef(27)>Ilha dos Sonhos!

source:
Just find a <$cdef(27)>doll and examine it—<$cdef(27)>Drifloon will come to you,
no matter what town you’re in, and take you to a
<$cdef(27)>Dream Island!
translation:
Basta encontrar uma <$cdef(27)>boneca e examiná<$cdef(27)>-la - Drifloon virá até você,
não importa em que cidade você está, e levá-lo para uma
<$cdef(27)>Ilha dos Sonhos!

source: There may be a <$cdef(27)>doll </color>somewhere in this town...
translation: Pode haver uma <$cdef(27)>boneca</color> em algum lugar nesta cidade...

source:
Also, it seems that the island you’re taken to can change
depending on the <$cdef(27)>type of doll you examine!
translation:
Além disso, parece que a ilha que você está levando pode mudar
dependendo do <$cdef(27)>tipo de boneca que você examinar!

source:
Somewhere in this world, there are islands where you can
find an abundance of building materials.
translation:
Em algum lugar neste mundo, há ilhas onde você pode encontrar
uma abundância de materiais de construção.

source:
<$cdef(27)>Drifloon, who can be found in <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>, will
take you to those mysterious islands if you ask!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Drifloon, que pode ser encontrado em <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>, vai levá
-lo para essas ilhas misteriosas, se você perguntar!

source:
By the way, <$cdef(27)>Drifloon seems to really love <$cdef(27)>dolls.
There might be a <$cdef(27)>doll somewhere in this town too!
translation:
A propósito, <$cdef(27)>Drifloon parece adorar <$cdef(27)>bonecas.
Talvez também haja uma <$cdef(27)>boneca em algum lugar desta cidade!

source: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Good luck gettin’ all the building materials, yo!
translation: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Boa sorte para conseguir todos os materiais de construção, cara!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>It’d be super cool if there were an island or somethin’
where you could get a bunch of materials, huh?!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,8)>I dunno, though... An <$cdef(27)>island like that would be a <$cdef(27)>dream
come true, wouldn’t it?!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Seria super legal se houvesse uma ilha ou algo assim onde
você pudesse obter um monte de materiais, hein?!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,8)>Eu não sei, porém... uma <$cdef(27)>ilha como essa seria um <$cdef(27)>sonho
tornado realidade, não é?

source:
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Yoooooo! We made a totally awesome house, and it’s all
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>What a cool experience!
translation:
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Nós fizemos uma casa incrível, e é tudo
graças a você, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Que experiência legal!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>But, uh...I guess you could probably make a house like this
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>all by yourself if you really tried, huh?
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Mas... acho que você poderia fazer uma casa como essa
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>sozinho se você realmente tentasse, hein?

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Definitely lemme know if you wanna use a <$cdef(27)>building kit,
though! <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>I’ll come runnin’ to help whenever you need me!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Definitivamente, deixe-me saber se você quer <$cdef(27)>usar um kit de
construção, <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>eu vou correr para ajudar sempre que precisar de mim!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Whaaa—is that some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(111)> you’ve got with you there,
<$cdef(27)>?
Can
I
have
some?
Pretty please?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>É um pouco que <$cdef(27)><$ifull(111)>você tem com você,
<$cdef(27)>pode
me
dar
um
pouco
, por favor?

source:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)><$kfacial(4)>Yayyy! This fluffy-puffy <$cdef(27)><$ifull(111)> is sooo cute! And the
texture is totally out of this world, right?
translation:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)><$kfacial(4)>Obaaa, esse <$cdef(27)><$ifull(111)> fofinho é tão fofo, e a textura
é totalmente fora deste mundo, certo?

source:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Thanks a million, <$cdef(27)>! I can
definitely
sleep
soundly
with THIS!
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,5)>Gee, I really wish I was this fluffy-puffy too...
translation:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Graças a um milhão, <$cdef(27)>,
posso
dormir
bem com
isso.
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,5)>Nossa, eu realmente gostaria de ser tão fofinho também...

source: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Poor <$cdef(27)>Meowth</color>, having their shack flooded like that...

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>You know, if you block the source of the water like you did
for the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>the water might drain away!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Você sabe, se você bloquear a fonte da água como você
fez para<$cdef(27)> o Centro Pokémon<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>, a água pode drenar!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Mud can be quite stubborn. Sometimes just spraying it with
water isn’t enough to wash it away.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>A lama pode ser bastante teimosa. Às vezes, pulverizá-la com
água não é suficiente para lavá-la.

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>It would be best to soften it first with some <$cdef(27)>bubbles</color>.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Pokémon who specialize in <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(8)>ing can probably spit
some <$cdef(27)>bubbles for you.
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Pokémon que se especializam em ing<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(8)> provavelmente podem cuspir
algumas<$cdef(27)> bolhas para você.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>You’ll need <$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)> to make that. I often
see those in caves or other dim places.
<$voicel(1,6)>It’s likely there are some around this town too.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Você vai precisar de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)> para fazer isso. Eu costumo
ver aqueles em cavernas ou outros lugares escuros.
É<$voicel(1,6)> provável que haja alguns em torno desta cidade também.

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Once you’ve made a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>, go ahead and
put it by <$cdef(27)>Meowth’s shack.
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Uma vez que você tenha feito um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>, vá em frente e
coloque-o na cabana de <$cdef(27)>Meowth.

source: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>This town is so dark, even during the day.
translation: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>Esta cidade é tão escura, mesmo durante o dia.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>If you manage to light the place up more, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>I think it might
lift the spirits of the Pokémon around here.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Se você conseguir iluminar o lugar mais,<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)> acho que pode
levantar os espíritos dos Pokémon por aqui.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>There are lots of different light sources you could use, but
I believe <$voicel(1,8)>electricity might be the most effective!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Há muitas fontes de luz diferentes que você poderia usar, mas
eu acredito <$voicel(1,8)>que a eletricidade pode ser a mais eficaz!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>I think you should make some homes Pokémon would
like to live in.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Acho que você deveria fazer algumas casas em que Pokémon
gostaria de viver.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>If you do, I’d say it’s likely more Pokémon will return, like
they did in the last town.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>And I’d wager they’ll help you out too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>Se você fizer isso, eu diria que é provável que mais Pokémon voltem,
como fizeram na última cidade.
E<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)> eu apostaria que eles vão te ajudar também!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,4)>So, uh...I literally just noticed this, but...
<$voicel(4,5)>I’m hearin’ some really weird noises coming from over
that way.
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,4)>Então, ahn... eu literalmente notei isso, mas...
<$voicel(4,5)>Estou ouvindo alguns ruídos realmente estranhos vindo dessa
maneira.
<$comeff(4,6)><$voicel(4,8)>O que você acha que está fazendo, cara?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I’m really interested in weird noises, y’know? But um...
It’s always more fun to do things with friends, so...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Why don’t you come check out where the noises are
comin’ from with me, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Estou realmente interessado em barulhos estranhos, sabe? Mas..
. é sempre mais divertido fazer coisas com amigos, então...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Por que não vem ver de onde vêm
os barulhos comigo, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks, yo! It’ll totally be reassuring to have you around,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>N-not that I was too scared to go alone or anything!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I’ll be followin’ right behind you! Lead us over to where
the noises are comin’ from!
translation:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Vai ser reconfortante ter você por
perto, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Não que eu estivesse com muito medo de ir sozinho ou algo assim!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu estarei seguindo logo atrás de você, nos leve para
onde os ruídos estão vindo!

source:
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,10)>Wh-what?! I’m not scared, yo!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I just thought that, y’know...you might be curious about it
too, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>And, uh... Maybe you wouldn’t mind leading the
way, either?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I’ll be followin’ right behind you! Lead us over to where
the noises are comin’ from!
translation:
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,10)>Eu não estou com medo, cara!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu só pensei que, você sabe... você pode estar curioso sobre
isso também, <$cdef(27)>!
E<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>, ahn... talvez você não se importaria de liderar o
caminho, também?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu estarei seguindo logo atrás de você, nos leve para
onde os ruídos estão vindo!

source:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>I think those weird noises are comin’ from over this
way, yo...
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu acho que esses barulhos estranhos estão vindo dessa maneira
, você...

source: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>The noises are gettin’ louder, yo! We must be close!
translation: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Os ruídos estão ficando mais altos, devemos estar perto!

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Those noises are really loud now! We must be super close!
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,10)>The noises sound really close now, yo!
translation: <$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,10)>Os ruídos soam bem perto agora, cara!

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Where exactly do you think they’re comin’ from, though?
Maybe someone’s hidin’ nearby and making weird noises?
translation:
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Mas de onde você acha que eles estão vindo, talvez alguém
esteja se escondendo por perto e fazendo barulhos estranhos?
Um <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> coberto de musgo está dormindo em paz!

source:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Yooo! So those weird sounds were the snores of this
sleeping <$cdef(27)>Snorlax?
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Então esses sons estranhos eram os roncos desse
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax adormecido?

source:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>It’s all thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>! I sure feel
silly
for
gettin’
all scared!
translation:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>É tudo graças a você, <$cdef(27)>, eu me sinto
boba
por
ficar
com medo!

source:
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>I-I told you I wasn’t scared, yo! But, uh...yeah, still totally
thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu te disse que não estava com medo, mas, ahn... sim, ainda
totalmente graças a você, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>But, yooo... This <$cdef(27)>Snorlax is totally covered in moss... More
like “<$cdef(27)>Mosslax,” am I right? Heh.
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Mas, yoo... esse <$cdef(27)>Snorlax está totalmente coberto de musgo...
mais como "<$cdef(27)>Mosslax", estou certo?

source:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>D’you think they’ve been sleepin’ here so long that all this
moss had time to just naturally grow on ’em?
translation:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Você acha que eles estão dormindo aqui há tanto tempo que todo esse
musgo teve tempo de crescer naturalmente neles?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Either way, this loud snorin’ is pretty disruptive...
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,5)>I think we’d better wake ’em up, but that might not be easy...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>De qualquer forma, esse ronco alto é bastante perturbador...
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,5)>Acho melhor acordá-los, mas isso pode não ser fácil...

source:
<$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh, I know!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>We can ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth! I bet they’ll know how
to wake up a sleepin’ <$cdef(27)>Snorlax! <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,10)>Let’s go ask together, yo!
translation:
<$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh, eu sei!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>Podemos perguntar ao <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth, eu aposto que eles
vão saber como acordar um <$cdef(27)>Snorlax,<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,10)> vamos perguntar juntos, cara!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>I really hope we can wake up <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, yo. Well, I actually
just wanna stop the snorin’, but, y’know... Yeah...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>Eu realmente espero que possamos acordar <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, bem, eu
realmente só quero parar o ronco, mas, você sabe...

source:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s go ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth if they know any way to
wake up a sleepin’ <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!
translation:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Vamos perguntar ao <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth se eles sabem como
acordar um <$cdef(27)>Snorlax adormecido!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)> and <$cdef(27)>Trubbish! <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>I’ve been
hearing
the
oddest
noises
for
a
while now.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I don’t suppose you two know something about that?
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)> e <$cdef(27)>Trubbish, já ouço<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)> os
ruídos
mais
estranhos

há
algum
tempo.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Suponho que vocês dois não saibam algo sobre isso?

source:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>That’s <$cdef(27)>Mosslax’s<$cdef(27)> snorin’, yo! They’re a <$cdef(27)>Snorlax who’s been
sleepin’ so long they’re all covered in moss!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)><$cdef(27)> and I found ’em!
translation:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>É o <$cdef(27)>ronco do <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, é um Snorlax <$cdef(27)>que dorme há tanto
tempo que está todo coberto de musgo!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)><$cdef(27)> e eu os encontramos!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! A mossy <$cdef(27)>Snorlax? Now you’ve certainly caught
my attention!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Um <$cdef(27)>snorlax musgoso, agora você certamente chamou
minha atenção.

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>And I was totally the first one to notice the sounds, yo.
translation: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>E eu fui totalmente o primeiro a notar os sons, cara.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I can’t draw any conclusions until I’ve seen this
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax for myself.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu não posso tirar nenhuma conclusão até que eu tenha visto
esse <$cdef(27)>Snorlax para mim.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I hate to put you out of your way, but please, take me to
that <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Odeio te colocar fora do seu caminho, mas por favor, me leve
a esse <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!

source: <$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey! I’m bored. Mind if I tag along?
translation: <$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Ei, estou entediada, se importa se eu aparecer?

source: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>It’s always more fun to go places with friends, yo!
translation: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>É sempre mais divertido ir a lugares com amigos, cara!

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(0,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s quite true! Let’s all go together, shall we?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Thanks a bunch! All right, let’s hit the trail!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Imagine sleeping so long, you wake up covered in moss...
That’s gotta be the comfiest nap spot EVER!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Imagine dormir tanto, você acorda coberto de musgo... esse deve ser o
ponto de cochilo mais confortável de todos os tempos!
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Você acha que o musgo tem bom gosto?

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Could you please take me to see <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,6)>If they’ve been sleeping for as long as you say...
<$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps they remember something from when the humans
were here.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,6)>Se eles estão dormindo há tanto tempo quanto você diz...
<$voicel(1,7)>Talvez eles se lembrem de algo de quando os humanos
estavam aqui.

source: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>There’s so much stuff in the way, I can’t really see...
translation: <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Há tanta coisa no caminho, eu não posso realmente ver...

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! That’s one mossy <$cdef(27)>Snorlax, all right.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>And some awfully impressive snoring...
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Esse é um <$cdef(27)>Snorlax musgoso, tudo bem.
E<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)> um ronco impressionante...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>I love my naps as much as the next ’mon, but this is
some next-level napping!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu amo meus cochilos tanto quanto o próximo, mas isso é
um cochilo do próximo nível!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes... It’s well known that once a <$cdef(27)>Snorlax falls asleep, they
don’t wake up easily.
<$voicel(1,7)>But I’ve never heard of one sleeping so long that they get
completely covered in moss!
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,3)>I have to imagine their body would grow weak after going
all this time without eating...
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim... é bem sabido que uma vez que um <$cdef(27)>Snorlax adormece, eles
não acordam facilmente.
<$voicel(1,7)>Mas eu nunca ouvi falar de um dormindo tanto tempo que eles ficam
completamente cobertos de musgo!
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu tenho que imaginar que seu corpo iria ficar fraco depois de
passar todo esse tempo sem comer...

source: <$emotion(5,29)><$voicel(5,8)>How d’you think we can wake ’em up, yo?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Don’t most folks naturally wake up when the sun comes out?
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,8)>I mean, nighttime is playtime for me, but...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>A maioria das pessoas não acorda
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,8)>naturalmente quando o sol sai?

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>I believe the reason <$cdef(27)>Snorlax won’t wake up is because this
town is simply too dark!
<$voicel(1,7)>So dark, in fact, they can’t even tell night from day!
<$voicel(1,10)>And that’s why they’re still sleeping! <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Probably!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu acredito que a razão pela qual <$cdef(27)>Snorlax não vai acordar é porque esta
cidade é simplesmente muito escura!
<$voicel(1,7)>Tão escuros, na verdade, eles não conseguem nem dizer a noite
<$voicel(1,10)> do dia, e é por isso que eles ainda estão<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> dormindo!

source:
<$emotion(5,37)><$voicel(5,9)>Yeah! That makes sense! You have the most professory
ideas, yo!
translation:
<$emotion(5,37)><$voicel(5,9)>Isso! Faz sentido! Você tem as ideias mais professorais,
cara!

source:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Which leads us to...<$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>If at all possible, I’d like you to <$cdef(27)>brighten up this town.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>If we can wake a Pokémon who’s been sleeping for such
an incredibly long time...
<$voicel(1,7)>Maybe we can hear more about when humans were
still around!
translation:
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>O que nos leva a... <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>Se possível, gostaria que <$cdef(27)>iluminasse esta cidade.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Se pudermos acordar um Pokémon que está dormindo há um tempo
tão incrivelmente longo...
<$voicel(1,7)>Talvez possamos ouvir mais sobre quando os humanos ainda
estavam por perto!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>As for <$cdef(27)>Meowth and <$cdef(27)>Trubbish, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>could you two please do
what you can to assist <$cdef(27)>?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If you all work together, I’m sure you can succeed!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>Quanto a <$cdef(27)>Meowth<$cdef(27)> e Trubbish<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>, podem fazer o
que puderem para ajudar <$cdef(27)>?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Se todos trabalharem juntos, tenho certeza que podem ter sucesso!

source:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I kinda like it dark, but how could I not return the favor
after <$cdef(27)> helped me out so much?
translation:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu meio que gosto do escuro, mas como eu poderia não retribuir
o favor depois que <$cdef(27)> me ajudou tanto?

source: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,9)>I’ll totally help out too if it’ll stop this snorin’!
translation: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,9)>Eu também ajudarei se isso parar com esse ronco!

source:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Heya, <$cdef(27)>! Guess what?
I just came up with a way <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>to brighten up the town!
translation:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>!
Eu só vim com uma maneira<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)> de iluminar a cidade!

source: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Remember how <$cdef(27)>Trubbish</color> asked ya to light a <$cdef(27)>streetlight</color>?
translation: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Lembra como <$cdef(27)>Trubbish</color> te pediu para acender uma<$cdef(27)> luz de rua</color>?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>I spotted some more <$cdef(27)>streetlights. <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,8)>Like the ones over
that way!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Eu vi mais <$cdef(27)>luzes da rua, como<$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,8)> as que estão
por ali.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)>I was thinkin’ we could find more <$cdef(27)>streetlights. If we
light ’em, that’ll brighten things up. Smart, right?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)>Eu estava pensando que poderíamos encontrar<$cdef(27)> mais luzes de rua.
Se as acendermos, isso vai iluminar as coisas. Inteligente, certo?

source: <$voicel(4,7)>Let’s start by finding <$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(3)></color> <$cdef(27)>streetlights</color> and making ’em shine!
translation: <$voicel(4,7)>Vamos começar por encontrar<$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(3)></color><$cdef(27)> luzes de </color>rua e fazê-los brilhar!

source: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s go find some <$cdef(27)>streetlights</color> to light up!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Lighting <$cdef(27)> of them should be enough to bump up the
brightness for now, right?
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>A iluminação<$cdef(27)> deles deve ser suficiente para aumentar
o brilho por enquanto, certo?

source:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Nice work, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I feel like it’s brighter now, thanks to all those <$cdef(27)>streetlights
you lit up!
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Bom trabalho, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu sinto que está mais brilhante agora, graças a todas <$cdef(27)>as luzes que
você acendeu!

source: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>I’m gonna check on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>. <wait(0.6)><$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,10)>You should come too!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>You think <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> is awake? Let’s go find out!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps it’s because the town’s gotten a bit brighter, but
there’s something strange about <$cdef(27)>Snorlax now.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you take a look, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez seja porque a cidade ficou um pouco mais brilhante
, mas há algo estranho sobre <$cdef(27)>Snorlax agora.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Pode dar uma olhada, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm? Nothing seems to have changed.
<$voicel(1,4)>I must have been imagining things...
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Nada parece ter mudado.
<$voicel(1,4)>Eu devia estar imaginando coisas...

source: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps the lights in town have gone out?
translation: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez as luzes da cidade tenham se apagado?

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>If a Pokémon generates electricity to power up something,
like a <$cdef(27)>streetlight, <$voicel(1,6)>the electricity will run out after a while.
<$voicel(1,7)>So, if your <$cdef(27)>streetlights dim, <$voicel(1,5)>try powering them up
again, and then come back here to check on things.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Se um Pokémon gera eletricidade para alimentar algo, como
uma luz<$cdef(27)> de rua, a <$voicel(1,6)>eletricidade vai acabar depois de um tempo.
<$voicel(1,7)>Então, se as <$cdef(27)>luzes das ruas ficarem<$voicel(1,5)> fracas, tente
ligar de novo, e depois volte aqui para ver as coisas.

source: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! The bud on their head opened up! Does that mean...
translation: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>O botão na cabeça deles se abriu!

source: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>No, they don’t seem too likely to wake up after all.
translation: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>Não, eles não parecem muito propensos a acordar depois de tudo.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hrmmm... Let’s see. I do feel like we were on the right
track just now...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>I’m very curious about their flower bed-head, though.
Wait... Could it be—
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Why, yes! I believe that’s it!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hrmmm... vamos ver. Eu sinto que estávamos no caminho
certo agora...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Estou muito curioso sobre a cabeça
de flor deles.
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, eu acredito que é isso!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Now listen here, <$cdef(27)>. Look closely
at
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
flower
bed-head.
<$voicel(1,5)>It’s not fully blooming, see?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>My gut is telling me...if you can get a whole flower garden
blooming on their head, <$voicel(1,10)>then <$cdef(27)>Snorlax will wake up!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)>...I presume!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Agora escute aqui, <$cdef(27)>, olhe atentamente

<$cdef(27)> para a
flor de
Snorlax.
<$voicel(1,5)>Não está totalmente florescendo, viu?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Meu instinto está me dizendo... se você conseguir um jardim
de flores florescendo na<$voicel(1,10)> cabeça<$cdef(27)> deles, então Snorlax
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)> vai acordar!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s see. I’m quite sure the flower bud on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s head
reacted to brightness.
<$voicel(1,7)>Which means... If we can get this town much, much
brighter, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>we’ll see a fully bloomed field of flowers!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Tenho certeza que o botão de flor na <$cdef(27)>cabeça de Snorlax
reagiu ao brilho.
O<$voicel(1,7)> que significa... que se conseguirmos ter esta cidade muito,
muito mais <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>brilhante, veremos um campo de flores totalmente florido!

source:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>But, we don’t currently have enough light for that.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Try <$cdef(27)>setting up lots of bright, electricity-powered machines,
like <$cdef(27)>streetlights. <$voicel(1,8)>I think that ought to help!
translation:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas, atualmente não temos luz suficiente para isso.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Tente<$cdef(27)> montar muitas máquinas elétricas
<$cdef(27)>brilhantes, <$voicel(1,8)>como postes de luz.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Here. Let’s assume that a field of flowers in full bloom is
worth <$cdef(27)>100 bloom points. In that case, I’d give <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
flower bed-head...<$cdef(27)><$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)> bloom .
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m sure it will be quite the challenge, but I hope you’ll all
work together and strive for <$cdef(27)>100 bloom points!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>And, of course, you can always come ask me if there’s
something you don’t understand!
candidate_translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Vejamos. Suponhamos que um campo de flores bem florido
valha <$cdef(27)>100 pontos de floração. Nesse caso, eu daria às flores de<$cdef(27)> Snorlax,
que parecem um canteiro na cabeça... <$cdef(27)><$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)> de floração.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Sei que será um desafio, mas espero que todos
trabalhem juntos para chegar a <$cdef(27)>100 pontos de floração!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>E, claro, podem me perguntar sempre que
tiverem alguma dúvida!

translation:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, ouvi dizer que está tentando tornar
a
cidade
mais
brilhante, certo?

source:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Well, guess what! I know a way to make things brighter
without using electricity!
translation:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Bem, adivinhe, eu sei como tornar as coisas mais brilhantes
sem usar eletricidade!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I’m sure a place like this would be bright even at night,
and might even get Pokémon who like fire <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>to show up!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Tenho certeza de que um lugar como este seria brilhante mesmo à
noite, e pode até fazer Pokémon que gostam de <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>fogo aparecer!

source:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>If you ever decide to make a place like that, please take
me with you! I can help!
translation:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Se você decidir fazer um lugar como esse, por favor
, me leve com você!

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>If you ever make a place like this, please take me there!
translation: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Se você fizer um lugar como este, por favor, me leve lá!

source:
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,3)>But... Gosh, I’m really sorry...
<$emotion(4,31)><$voicel(4,1)>I guess it’s not quite as bright as places with electricity...
translation:
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,3)>Mas... Deus, eu realmente sinto muito...
<$emotion(4,31)><$voicel(4,1)>Acho que não é tão brilhante quanto lugares com eletricidade...

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Yeah, you’re right! I bet Pokémon who like warm places
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>would be really happy here!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Aposto que os Pokémon que gostam de lugares quentes
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>ficariam muito felizes aqui!

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>RIGHT?! Me too!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I bet really mature, grown-up Pokémon like me would
really love this place.
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu também!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Aposto que Pokémon maduros e adultos como eu
adorariam esse lugar.

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>You can come find me again anytime you wanna use fire
for something! <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I wanna help out!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Você pode me encontrar de novo quando quiser
usar fogo para<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)> alguma coisa!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! The town sure does seem
to
be
getting brighter!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, a cidade parece estar ficando


mais brilhante.

source:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>But we still don’t have that fully bloomed field of flowers
we’d like to see on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s head.
translation:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas ainda não temos aquele campo de flores que gostaríamos
de ver na cabeça de <$cdef(27)>Snorlax.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder if there’s a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon somewhere who could <$cdef(27)>light
up the town with some powerful electricity.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu me pergunto se há um <$cdef(27)>Pokémon em algum lugar que poderia<$cdef(27)>
iluminar a cidade com alguma eletricidade poderosa.

source: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Look! There’s someone on the ground over there!
<$voicel(5,10)>Oh no! You’re right! What do we do?!
translation: <$voicel(5,10)>Você está certo, o que vamos fazer?

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? What’s all the commotion? Everyone’s gathering
around something on that island.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Todo mundo está se reunindo em torno
de algo naquela ilha.

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Whatever could it be? Come along then,
<$cdef(27)>!
Let’s
go
find out!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Everyone’s gathering on that island! Let’s go see what’s
going on!
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>There’s someone on the ground... What happened?
translation: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Tem alguém no chão... o que aconteceu?

source: <$emotion(4,58)><$voicel(4,7)>OK, food! Lessee here... Ah! All I’ve got is garbage, yo.
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Should I try to warm them up?!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Goodness, where am I? And where are my little friends?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Um, pleased to make your acquaintance...I think?
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Minha nossa, onde estou? E onde estão meus amiguinhos?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Hum, prazer em conhecer você... Eu acho?

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah, you woke up! I’m so glad you’re unharmed!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Now, let’s see here... From the looks of you, I’d say you’re
a <$cdef(27)>Pikachu, right? An awfully pale one...
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah, você acordou! Estou tão feliz que você está ileso!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Agora, vamos ver aqui... pelo seu olhar, eu diria
<$cdef(27)>que você é um Pikachu, certo?

source:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>I suppose you’re not wrong, my appearance is rather peaky
compared to other Pikachu... In fact, “<$cdef(27)>Peakychu” might
make for a rather charming nickname.
Pardon my asking, but where did all of YOU come from?
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Acho que você não está errado, minha aparência é um pouco
alta em comparação com os outros Pikachu...<$cdef(27)> na verdade, "
Peakychu" pode ser um apelido encantador.
Perdoe-me perguntar, mas de onde todos vocês vieram?

source:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>That’s what we’d like to ask YOU!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>We found you collapsed here all out of the blue! <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Where in
the world were you until then?
translation:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>É o que gostaríamos de perguntar a você!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Achamos que você desmoronou aqui do nada, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>onde no
mundo você estava até então?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>However DID I end up collapsed in this strange place?
<$voicel(2,4)>Hmmmmmm...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>Apologies, I just can’t seem to remember...
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Por mais que eu tenha entrado em colapso neste lugar
<$voicel(2,4)>estranho...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>sinto muito, mas não consigo me lembrar...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, at the very least, I DO remember feeling quite tired
and falling over...
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, pelo menos, eu me lembro de me sentir bastante
cansado e caindo...

source:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m so sorry—I just can’t remember what happened
very well.
translation:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Sinto muito, mas não me lembro muito bem do que
aconteceu.

source:
<$emotion(6,14)><$voicel(6,5)>You should totally take it easy, yo! Maybe you should
sleep a little bit if you’re feelin’ tired?
translation:
<$emotion(6,14)><$voicel(6,5)>Você precisa relaxar um pouco! Que tal tirar
uma soneca se estiver sentindo cansaço?

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Why, thank you. You’re too kind.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>But it appears I’ve been sleeping for some time, so I’m
feeling quite refreshed at the moment!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Obrigado, você é muito gentil.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Mas parece que eu tenho dormido por algum tempo, então estou
me sentindo bastante revigorado no momento!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm, I see... Sounds like a complicated situation...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I do have a favor to ask of you, though.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmm, eu vejo... parece uma situação complicada...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas tenho um favor para lhe pedir.

source:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>This town seems to be perpetually covered by dark clouds
for some reason.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>We’ve all been working hard to brighten the place up.
translation:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Esta cidade parece estar perpetuamente coberta por nuvens escuras
por algum motivo.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Todos nós temos trabalhado duro para iluminar o lugar.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Why, yes—now that you mention it, it IS quite dark
around here.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Ora, sim, agora que você mencionou, está bem
escuro por aqui.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>And since you’re a Pokémon who can use powerful
electricity, <$voicel(1,8)>we were really hoping you could help us out.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>What do you say?
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>E já que você é um Pokémon que pode usar
eletricidade poderosa<$voicel(1,8)>, nós realmente esperávamos que você
pudesse<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)> nos ajudar.

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Of course! If my power can be of any use at all, I would be
delighted to help!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, without further ado...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>...Huh?
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Se meu poder puder ser útil, ficarei feliz
em ajudar!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>Bem, sem mais
delongas,
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>hein?

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? What seems to be the problem?

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Heya, <$cdef(27)>! Guess what?
I just came up with a way <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>to brighten up the town!
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>!
Eu só vim com uma maneira<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)> de iluminar a cidade!

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Remember when <$cdef(27)>Trubbish asked ya to light up a
streetlight earlier?
translation:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Lembra quando <$cdef(27)>Trubbish te pediu para acender uma
luz de rua mais cedo?

source:
<$voicel(4,3)>Maybe we could find more <$cdef(27)>streetlights and light ’em.
<$voicel(4,6)>Wait... They’re already lit up.

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Dang, <$cdef(27)>, you already thought
of that?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I shoulda guessed you’d be way ahead of me!
translation:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Puxa, <$cdef(27)>, você já pensou
nisso?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Eu deveria ter adivinhado que você estaria muito à frente de mim!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>This should be bright enough to wake up <$cdef(27)>Snorlax, right?
<$emotion(4,40)><$voicel(4,7)>I’m gonna go check up on ’em again. <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Come on,
<$cdef(27)>—let’s go!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Isso deve ser brilhante o suficiente para acordar <$cdef(27)>Snorlax, certo?
<$emotion(4,40)><$voicel(4,7)>Vou checar de novo. <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Vamos,
<$cdef(27)>vamos!

source:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaa... <$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pi-pikaaa...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh dear, this is quite strange...
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaaaaa...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Um... <$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>It appears as though I am no longer able to generate
electricity...
translation:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaa,<$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)> Pi-pikaaa
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>, isso é muito estranho.
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaaaaaa...
...............
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Parece<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)> que não consigo mais gerar
eletricidade...

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! But <$cdef(27)>Pikachu are known for wielding incredible
electricity <$voicel(1,8)>and even summoning thunderbolts!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,10)>What exactly is going on?!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas Pikachu<$cdef(27)> é conhecido por empunhar eletricidade
incrível <$voicel(1,8)>e até mesmo convocar trovões!
O<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,10)> que exatamente está acontecendo?

source:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>What, indeed... I’m just as shocked as you are. I’m so sorry.
It doesn’t look like I’ll be able to aid you at all like this.
translation:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>O que, na verdade... eu estou tão chocado quanto você. Sinto
muito. Não parece que eu vou ser capaz de ajudá-lo em tudo assim.

source:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Nonsense! We’d still be very grateful for your aid.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Right now, we need any help we can get from any
Pokémon.
translation:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Ainda ficaríamos muito agradecidos por sua ajuda.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Agora, precisamos de qualquer ajuda que possamos obter de qualquer
Pokémon.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>And on top of that, <$cdef(27)> here has
some
sort
of
mysterious power.
<$voicel(1,7)>It’s possible that just by spending time with them, you may
recover your electricity. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>And remember the past too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>E além disso, <$cdef(27)> aqui tem algum
tipo
de
poder
misterioso.
É<$voicel(1,7)> possível que só passando tempo com eles, você possa recuperar
sua eletricidade e se <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>lembrar do passado também!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thank you... Right! There’s no use moping about!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>While I don’t know HOW exactly I can help right now,
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>I shall do my very best to be of assistance!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>It’s lovely to meet you all!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Não vale a pena trocar de roupa!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Embora eu não saiba exatamente como posso ajudar
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)> agora, farei o meu melhor para ajudar!
É<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)> um prazer conhecê-los!

source: <$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,10)>I love makin’ friends! The more the merrier, yo!
translation: <$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,10)>Eu amo fazer amigos, quanto mais melhor, cara!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,6)>Gadzooks! A Pokémon’s collapsed on the ground!
<$cdef(27)>, could you go check on them?
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,6)>Um Pokémon caiu no chão
, <$cdef(27)>, pode ir ver?

source:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>! Yooo, I found this building I
really
wanna
check out.
translation:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>Yooo, achei esse prédio que eu
realmente
quero
conferir.

source: <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,6)>That thing up there on the cliff! See it?
translation: <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,6)>Aquela coisa lá em cima no penhasco!

source:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>If you wanna check it out too, we can totally go together!
And, uh...I don’t mind at all if you take the lead, yo.
translation:
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Se quiser conferir também, podemos ir juntos e...
não me importo se você assumir a liderança, cara.

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Sweet! OK, lead the way! <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>I’ll be followin’ right behind you!
translation: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Certo, sigam o caminho<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>, eu vou atrás de vocês!

source:
<$emotion(4,58)><$voicel(4,3)>N-nah, I’m not scared, yo... That height? Pshhh. I’m totally
fine with goin’ alone.
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>But, uh... You look like you really wanna go too, so I’m
down to just follow you there, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$emotion(4,58)><$voicel(4,3)>N-não, eu não estou com medo, cara... essa altura? Pshhh. Eu estou
totalmente bem com ir sozinho.
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Mas, ahn... você parece que você realmente quer ir também,
então eu estou aqui para segui-lo lá, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s go check out that building on the cliff!
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,6)>Yoooooo! We made it all the way!
translation: <$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,6)>Yooooooo, nós fizemos isso todo o caminho!

source: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Whoooaaa... The view from so high up is totally awesome!
translation: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Uaaaau... a vista de tão alto é totalmente incrível!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)>Huh? What do you think that machine is, yo? It kinda looks
like a <$cdef(27)>streetlight,<$cdef(27)> but...kinda different...
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)>O que você acha que essa máquina é, tipo, parece
uma luz <$cdef(27)>de rua, mas<$cdef(27)>... meio diferente...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)>Yooo... It looks like it might light up if it had some
electricity! That’d make the town even brighter!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)>Yooo... parece que poderia acender se tivesse alguma
eletricidade! Isso tornaria a cidade ainda mais brilhante!

source:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>All these machines the humans made sure are fun! There’re
all kinds of ’em!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)><$kfacial(4)>I just wanna get power to each one I find just to see
what’ll happen!
translation:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Todas essas máquinas que os humanos fizeram
são divertidas!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)><$kfacial(4)>Eu só quero ter poder para cada um que eu encontrar só para ver o
que vai acontecer!

source:
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>It was super fun comin’ all the way up here and seein’ this
awesome view together! I couldn’t have made it without
your help, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,8)>Thanks a ton, yo!
translation:
<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>Foi muito divertido vir até aqui para ver esta
vista incrível com você! Eu não teria conseguido sem
a sua ajuda, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,8)>Muito obrigado, cara!

source:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$kfacial(2)>At this rate, I fear <$cdef(27)>Snorlax will waste away if they continue
to sleep without eating anything...
translation:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$kfacial(2)>Nesse ritmo, temo que o <$cdef(27)>Snorlax se desperdice se eles
continuarem dormindo sem comer nada...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I wish I could help brighten things up around here...
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But I can’t generate electricity anymore... Oh dear, what
ever should I do?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Gostaria de ajudar a iluminar as coisas por aqui...
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas não posso mais gerar eletricidade... o
que devo fazer?

source:
<$facial(2,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>It certainly is a worrying situation... <$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>But lamenting what we
CAN’T do will only make our moods as dark as this town.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>Right now we need to focus on what we CAN do!
translation:
<$facial(2,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>É mesmo uma situação preocupante... <$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas lamentar o que não podemos fazer só vai deixar
nosso ânimo tão sombrio quanto esta cidade.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>Agora, precisamos focar no que podemos fazer!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>For instance, what can we do to light up this cave? It’s too
dim in here.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Por exemplo, o que podemos fazer para iluminar
esta caverna?

source:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, shall we try making a lamp with <$cdef(27)><$ifull(290)>?
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Why, I think it would suit this place quite well!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Nesse caso, vamos tentar fazer uma lâmpada com <$cdef(27)><$ifull(290)>?
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Acho que se encaixaria muito bem neste lugar!

source: You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe</color> for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1622)></color>!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,7)>I was trying to come up with ways I could help, but...<$voicel(4,5)>I don’t

<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>If my theory is correct, we must first connect this machine

<$voicel(2,7)>Look here—this shape indicates it should be able
to store electricity.

<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,1)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)>Do you know how to do that, <$cdef(27)>?

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Exactly right! This machine requires a large amount of

by lightning!

<$voicel(1,7)>Not only that—<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,664)>a Pokémon I’ve never seen before has
appeared over there!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Não só isso<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,664)>, um Pokémon que eu nunca vi
antes apareceu lá!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>! You can leave <$cdef(27)>Snorlax to us!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Go find out what that other Pokémon has to say!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, pode deixar o <$cdef(27)>Snorlax conosco!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Vá descobrir o que o outro Pokémon tem a dizer!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Could you go find out what that Pokémon has to say? You
can leave <$cdef(27)>Snorlax to us!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Pode ir descobrir o que o Pokémon tem a dizer, pode
deixar o <$cdef(27)>Snorlax conosco!

source: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,3)>Y-yooo, that HAD to have woken up <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>...

<$cdef(27)>Snorlax woke up, but it seems they can’t move because of
the shock from the lightning!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax acordou, mas parece que eles não podem se mover por
causa do choque do relâmpago!

source:
<$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,27)>Whoa! Now this is a surprise!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,805)>When I saw the town all lit up, I figured the humans had
finally come back...
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>But you Pokémon got the town glowin’ again all
by yourselves?
translation:
<$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,27)>Agora isso é uma surpresa!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,805)>Quando vi a cidade toda iluminada, achei que os humanos
finalmente tinham voltado...
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>Mas vocês Pokémon fizeram a cidade brilhar de
novo sozinhos?

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Talk about a SHOCKIN’ development! I <$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,816)>even let loose an
extra-large lightnin’ bolt—that’s how shocked I was!
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)><$textsize(0)>And, uh, if it hit anyone...my bad.
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Falei sobre o desenvolvimento de um SHOCKIN<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,816)>! Eu até soltei um
parafuso de luz extra-grande, que é o quão chocado eu estava!
E<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)><$textsize(0)>, ahn, se atingiu alguém... minha culpa.

source:
<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Y’know, I’m not really sure where all the humans went.
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>With big bad natural disasters happenin’ all over the place,
I guess they ran off somewhere safe.
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>As for this town in particular, those huge clouds were
keepin’ it super dark all the time, right?
<$voicel(3,5)>Humans can’t live without sunlight, y’know!
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,7)><$motion(3,663)>By the time I realized what was goin’ on, this place was
already a ghost town...
translation:
<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Você sabe, eu não tenho certeza para onde todos os humanos foram.
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>Com grandes desastres naturais acontecendo em todo lugar, acho que
eles fugiram para algum lugar seguro.
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,806)>Quanto a esta cidade em particular, essas enormes nuvens estavam
mantendo-a super escura o tempo todo, certo?
<$voicel(3,5)>Os humanos não podem viver sem a luz do sol, você sabe!
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,7)><$motion(3,663)>Quando percebi o que estava acontecendo, este lugar já era
uma cidade fantasma...

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,666)>Looks like my awesome lightning cleared out those nasty
clouds, though!
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>Maybe the humans’ll come back when they realize the
clouds are gone?
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,666)>Parece que meu relâmpago incrível limpou essas nuvens desagradáveis
, no entanto!
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>Talvez os humanos voltem quando perceberem que as
nuvens se foram?

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>Anyway, I think I’m gonna head out! Tell your friends I
said, “What’s up!” <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,8)>I’m best buds with ALL of you now!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>De qualquer forma, eu acho que vou sair, diga aos seus amigos que
eu disse: "O que há!" Eu<$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,8)> sou o melhor amigo de todos vocês agora!

source:
<$cdef(27)>Raikou, the Thunder Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Raikou, o Pokémon Trovão, foi registrado em
seu Pokédex...
Seu posto de treinador aumentou para<$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Catch ya later, bud! Hope we can hang out next time our
paths cross!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Espero que possamos sair da próxima vez que nossos caminhos
se cruzarem!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)>Oho, so I was right! It’s quite astonishing that a Legendary
Pokémon would appear in this town as well!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)>É impressionante que um Pokémon Lendário
apareça nesta cidade também!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)>What an impressive lightning strike that was! I’d expect
nothing less of <$cdef(27)>Raikou!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)>Que raio impressionante! Eu não esperaria
menos de <$cdef(27)>Raikou!

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm, natural disasters, you say?
<$voicel(1,3)>Now that you mention it, all the land I saw before I met
you was terribly ruined... <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>What in the world happened?
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>Desastres naturais, você diz?
<$voicel(1,3)>Agora que você mencionou, toda a terra que eu vi
antes de te conhecer foi <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>terrivelmente arruinada.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh! How could I forget?! It seems <$cdef(27)>Snorlax is unharmed.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>What an incredibly tough Pokémon!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ah! Como pude esquecer?! Parece que <$cdef(27)>Snorlax não se machucou.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Que Pokémon incrivelmente resistente!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>But, oh dear... It looks as if they’re stunned and cannot
move due to the lightning.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,659)><$facial(2,5)>Could you try talking to them for us,
<$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Mas, oh querida... parece que eles estão atordoados e não
podem se mover devido ao raio.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,659)><$facial(2,5)>Pode tentar falar com eles por
nós, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
It seems like there’s still more for you to do in
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>.
translation:
Parece que ainda há mais para você fazer
em <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>.

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,16)><$motion(3,839)>*yaaawn*
Sure was a nice nap I jus’ had, though.
... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,656)><$comeff(3,15)>Wouldn’t hurt to sleep a li’l more, I s’pose...
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,16)><$motion(3,839)>*bocejo*
Foi uma soneca muito boa, viu.
... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,656)><$comeff(3,15)>Não faria mal dormir mais um pouquinho, eu acho...

source: <$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Hmmm? Who are y’all s’posed to be?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>You were sleeping here long enough to be completely
covered in moss, <$cdef(27)>Snorlax! Why, some other Pokémon
even took to calling you <$cdef(27)>Mosslax because of it!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,663)>We were quite worried that you would get weaker and
weaker, sleeping away without anything at all to eat, so
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>we all worked together to wake you!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Você estava dormindo aqui o tempo
suficiente<$cdef(27)> para ser completamente
coberto de <$cdef(27)>musgo, Snorlax!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,663)>Estávamos muito preocupados que você ficasse cada
vez mais fraco, dormindo sem nada para comer, então
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>trabalhamos juntos para acordá-lo!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)>Oh... Now that ya mention it, I am a li’l hungry.
... ... ...
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)>Ya reckon I lost some weight?
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)>Agora que você mencionou, estou com fome.
Você acha
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)>que eu perdi algum peso?

source:
...<$cdef(27)>Mosslax, huh? S’pose that describes me well enough.
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,27)>So, uh...y’all pretty much saved me, huh? <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,49)>That sure was a
nice thing to do! Thank ya kindly!
translation:
...<$cdef(27)>Mosslax, hein? Acho que esse nome combina comigo.
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,27)>Então, ahn... vocês praticamente me salvaram, né? <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,49)>Foi muito gentil da parte de vocês!
Agradeço de coração!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)>Listen, <$cdef(27)>Mosslax, do you remember anything about what
happened before you fell asleep?
<$voicel(1,4)>Do you know where the humans went?<$motion(1,654)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$cdef(27)>Mosslax, lembra-se de algo sobre o que
aconteceu antes de adormecer?
<$voicel(1,4)>Sabe para onde os humanos foram?<$motion(1,654)>

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>Hm? I don’t remember a whole lot, but—wait, the humans
are gone?!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,7)>Well, that ain’t good... They gave me food!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>Eu não me lembro de muita coisa, mas... espere, os humanos
se foram?
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,7)>Bem, isso não é bom... eles me deram comida!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Oh? Does that mean you <$voicel(1,8)>lived in harmony alongside
the humans?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Isso significa que <$voicel(1,8)>você viveu em harmonia com
os humanos?

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,3)>Sure did! Y’know how there’re naughty Pokémon out there
who like to play tricks on folks?
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Well, I’d run those Pokémon off, and the humans would
gimme food in return—<$comeff(3,5)>Ah! <$voicel(3,10)>I jus’ remembered somethin’!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>At some point, I stopped gettin’ as much food as I
used to!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>Seems the humans had run low on food themselves...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,3)>Claro! Sabe aqueles Pokémon travessos que gostam de pregar peças nas pessoas?

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Eu espantava esses Pokémon, e os humanos me davam comida em troca—
<$comeff(3,5)>Ah! <$voicel(3,10)>Acabei de lembrar de uma coisa!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Em algum momento, comecei a receber menos comida do que antes!

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>Parece que os humanos também ficaram sem comida...

source:
<$comcan(3)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>I wonder if those natural disasters <$cdef(27)>Raikou mentioned had
anything to do with that?
translation:
<$comcan(3)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Eu me pergunto se esses desastres naturais<$cdef(27)> que Raikou mencionou
tinham algo a ver com isso?

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,661)>Eventually, I started to get kinda hangry, and I scuffled
with a real ornery-lookin’ Pokémon, thinkin’ I might let
off some steam...
<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)>But I got whupped soundly! <$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)>And that frustrated me so bad
I figured I’d jus’ sleep it off.
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,661)>Eventualmente, eu comecei a ficar meio carrancudo, e eu me esbarrei
com um Pokémon de aparência ornitária, pensando que eu poderia soltar
um pouco de vapor...
E<$voicel(3,4)><$comeff(3,14)> isso me frustrou<$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,666)> tanto que
achei que ia dormir.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,899)>My goodness! Do you mean to say you were buried in the
dirt and covered in moss because...<$voicel(2,4)>you took a nap?<$motion(2,657)>
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,899)>Quer dizer que foi enterrado na terra e coberto
de musgo porque... você tirou<$voicel(2,4)> uma soneca?<$motion(2,657)>

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Huh... Yeah, I s’pose that’s what happened. Can’t say I
really remember it all that well, though.
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Sim, eu suponho que foi isso que aconteceu. Não posso dizer que
eu realmente me lembro muito bem disso, no entanto.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>So the humans were struggling as a result of natural
disasters...
So much so that they didn’t have enough food...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Then where did they go after that?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Então os humanos estavam lutando como resultado de
desastres naturais
... tanto que eles não tinham comida suficiente...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Então para onde eles foram depois disso?

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,8)>I dunno, but I sure am grateful to y’all for savin’ me!
Keep in touch now, y’hear!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,8)>Eu não sei, mas eu sou grato a todos vocês
por me salvarem!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Now that you’ve registered <$cdef(27)>Raikou in your Pokédex, you
may be able to pass through it!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Agora que você registrou<$cdef(27)> Raikou em seu Pokédex
, você pode passar por ele!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)>I think you should go check it out when you’re ready.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>And I’ll be coming with you, of course!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)>Acho que você deveria ir verificar quando estiver pronto.
E<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)> eu vou com você, é claro!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and remember that <$cdef(27)>sand-covered building we found
on the beach in <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Something about that keeps tugging at my mind as well.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Lembra daquele prédio<$cdef(27)> coberto de areia que
encontramos na praia em <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>?
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Algo sobre isso continua mexendo na minha mente também.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’d appreciate it if you could check on it every now
and then.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu agradeceria se você pudesse verificar isso de vez
em quando.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Thanks to you, this town has gotten much livelier—<$voicel(1,8)>and of
course much brighter!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Graças a você, esta cidade ficou muito mais animada e<$voicel(1,8)>, claro
, muito mais brilhante!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>If you’d like to explore somewhere you haven’t been
before, I recommend heading back to the previous town
<$voicel(1,5)>and going through that other gate there.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Se você gostaria de explorar algum lugar que você não
tenha estado antes, eu recomendo voltar para a cidade
<$voicel(1,5)>anterior e passar por esse outro portão lá.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>And whenever you do, you can be sure I’m coming
with you!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>E sempre que você fizer, você pode ter certeza que eu
vou com você!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)>Let’s do our best to brighten up the town! We must find a
way to wake up <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)>Vamos fazer o nosso melhor para iluminar a cidade, temos que encontrar
uma maneira de acordar <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)>Even small Pokémon can live an enjoyable life in this town!
The thought alone fills me with such joy.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)>Até os pequenos Pokémon podem viver uma vida agradável nesta cidade
, só o pensamento me enche de tanta alegria.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)>You’re skilled at so many things, <$cdef(27)>.
I am
quite envious!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)>Você é hábil em tantas coisas, eu <$cdef(27)>
sou
bastante invejoso!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>You’re always transformed to look like your
Trainer, <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>They must have been someone very important to you.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Você sempre se transforma para se parecer com
seu Treinador, <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Devem ter sido alguém muito importante para você.

source: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)><$kfacial(4)>There’s a place I wanna show you!
translation: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)><$kfacial(4)>Há um lugar que eu quero te mostrar!

source: <$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>I think a Pokémon like that lived in places like this!
translation: <$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Eu acho que um Pokémon como esse vivia em lugares como este!

source: <oneline><$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,53)>Oh, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! You can suck up water now!
translation: <oneline><$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,53)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, você pode sugar a água agora!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Here we are! I wanted to show you this pond,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>See, I was thinking maybe we could build a waterfall here!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Eu queria te mostrar esta
lagoa, <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Veja, eu estava pensando que talvez pudéssemos construir uma cachoeira aqui!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>First we need to find a Pokémon who can store lots of
water in their body, then <$voicel(4,6)>ask them how they do it!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Primeiro precisamos encontrar um Pokémon que possa armazenar muita
água em seu corpo, e depois <$voicel(4,6)>perguntar como eles fazem isso!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,50)>OK, let’s make that waterfall!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>First step is to go into the water and suck a bunch in!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,50)>Ok, vamos fazer essa cachoeira!
O<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)> primeiro passo é entrar na água e sugar um monte!

source:
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,8)>Whoa! You got a whole lot of water!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Now you just need to spit it all out from a high place!
translation:
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,8)>Você tem muita água!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Agora você só precisa cuspir tudo de um lugar alto!

source: <$voicel(4,7)>If you spit it out from up there, I bet it’d make a waterfall!
translation: <$voicel(4,7)>Se você cuspir lá de cima, eu aposto que faria uma cachoeira!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>First step is to go into the water and suck a bunch in!
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>O primeiro passo é entrar na água e sugar um monte!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)>Then just spit it out from up there! I bet that’ll make a
great waterfall!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)>Eu aposto que vai fazer uma grande
cachoeira!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Wow, you did it! You made a waterfall! You really are
amazing, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Você fez uma cachoeira, você realmente
é incrível, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>The sound of the waterfall you made me is sooo relaxing.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>I think my new favorite nap spot is gonna be right near it!
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,1)>Thanks so much!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>O som da cachoeira que você me fez é relaxante.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Acho que meu novo local de cochilo favorito vai estar
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,1)>bem perto dele!

source: <$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Huh? You want to store water inside your body?
translation: <$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Quer armazenar água dentro do seu corpo?

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Hehe, but first... I REALLY wanna eat some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)>,
y’see? <$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>Three of ’em!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Hehe, mas primeiro... eu realmente quero <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)>comer
um <$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>pouco, você vê?

source:
<$voicel(4,7)>Look! See that crop field over there? I betcha could grow
some really tasty <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)> there...
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)>Veja aquele campo de cultivo ali, eu aposto que você poderia
cultivar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)> muito saboroso lá.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>I’ll teach you how to store up water... But only AFTER my
tummy is full of tomatoes!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>Eu vou te ensinar como armazenar água... mas só depois que minha
barriga estiver cheia de tomates!

source: <$voicel(4,8)>Oh, and they’ve gotta be freshly picked <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(8)></color>!
translation: <$voicel(4,8)>Oh, e eles têm que ser <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(8)></color> recém-escolhido!

source: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Wow, <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(8)></color>! They look sooo yummy! Thank you!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>OK! As promised, I’ll show you the trick to storing water.
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Como prometido, vou te mostrar o truque para armazenar água.

source:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>So first, you gotta jump right in the water! Splash!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Then suck up the water like SCHWOOOP!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Yup, basically like that!
translation:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Então, primeiro, você tem que pular direto na água!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Então sugue a água como SCHWOOOP!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Sim, basicamente assim!

source:
You learned how to <$cdef(27)>suck up liquid!
When you’re in liquid, press <$keyicon(206)> while holding <$keyicon(153)>!

Você aprendeu a <$cdef(27)>chupar líquido!
Quando estiver em líquido, pressione<$keyicon(206)> enquanto segura<$keyicon(153)>!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)>Oh, sorry! I guess I should explain a bit more, huh?

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)>Oh, sorry! I guess I should explain a bit more, huh?

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)>So I was thinking first I’d slurp up a whole buuunch of

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)><$facial(4,4)>Then I’d go somewhere high up above the pond and spit

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)><$facial(4,4)>Então eu iria a algum lugar acima da lagoa e

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>And that’s gonna make a small waterfall!
<$voicel(4,3)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)>Well...it SHOULD, but I can’t store enough water...
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>E isso vai fazer uma pequena cachoeira!
<$voicel(4,3)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)>Bem... deveria, mas eu não posso armazenar água suficiente...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,806)>I know a Pokémon who’s good at storing water in their body!
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,38)>They lived in a place like this!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,806)>Eu conheço um Pokémon que é bom em armazenar água em seu corpo!

source:

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>You already figured it out? Gosh, you’re awesome!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)><$facial(4,4)>Now you can carry water to all sorts of places!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Meu Deus, você é incrível!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)><$facial(4,4)>Agora você pode levar água para todos os tipos de lugares!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)>All right, we should probably have you try it out at least

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)>Tudo bem, nós provavelmente deveríamos ter que experimentá-lo

source: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,38)>Wowwwee! You did it! You made a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$iname(1662)> </color>pond!

<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,805)>You’re real good at this!

<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,666)><$cdef(27)><$iname(1662)> tastes pretty bitter, huh? Hehe...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Now you can move water around wherever ’n’ whenever

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Agora você pode mover a água para onde
