source:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)>So there’s that ship out there on the water, right...
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)>I’m pretty sure I saw somethin’ move on it!
translation:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)>Então tem aquela nave lá fora na água, certo...
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)>Tenho certeza que vi algo se mexer!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Doesn’t that make you SUPER curious about what it might
be? Don’t you think you should maybe go check it out?!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Isso não faz você SUPER curioso sobre o que pode ser
? Você não acha que você deveria talvez ir conferir?!

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Sweet! I knew I could count on you! It’s not like I’m scared
or anything, but, uh...<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>I just can’t swim! Yeah! So I’ll wait
here while you go check it out, yo.
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Eu sabia que podia contar com você, não é como se eu estivesse com
medo ou qualquer coisa, mas<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>... eu não posso nadar, então vou esperar
aqui enquanto você vai dar uma olhada.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,805)>N-no way, yo! I’m not scared! I just, uh...I can’t swim! Yeah!
So I’ll wait here while you go check it out.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I’d be super happy if you could just come tell me what
you find after you check it out.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,805)>Não, de jeito nenhum, eu não estou com medo, eu só não sei nadar, então
vou esperar aqui enquanto você vai dar uma olhada.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Ficaria super feliz se pudesse me contar o que
encontrar depois de dar uma olhada.

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)>I think I saw somethin’ move inside that ship out on the

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)>Acho que vi algo se mover dentro daquela nave na

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>It’d be super cool if you could go check it out, yo! It’s not
like I’m scared or anything, though! I-I mean it!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>Seria super legal se você pudesse dar uma olhada, não é como se
eu estivesse com medo ou qualquer coisa, no entanto!

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)>Yooo! So <$cdef(27)>Happiny was on the boat, huh? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>Now I feel kinda

translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)>Eiii! Então <$cdef(27)>Happiny estava no barco? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>Até fiquei sem graça
de ter sentido tanto medo. Ahn... Não que eu estivesse com medo.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Anyway, I feel a lot better now that you’ve checked it out

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>De qualquer forma, eu me sinto muito melhor agora que
você verificou para mim<$cdef(27)>!

source: You hear a faint voice calling out from somewhere.
translation: Você ouve uma voz fraca gritando de algum lugar.

source:
The voice sounds closer. It seems to be coming from
up above!
translation:
A voz parece estar vindo de
cima!

source: You can hear the voice clearly now. Try searching nearby!
translation: Você pode ouvir a voz claramente agora.

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh... You’re right. You don’t really look all that scary.

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh... You’re right. You don’t really look all that scary.
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Ah... Tem razão. Você nem parece tão assustador assim.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Um, so, I was just sleeping at home before...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)>And then this awful sound woke me up, and I dunno how,
but I was on this ship!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Então, eu só estava dormindo em casa antes...
E<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)> então esse som horrível me acordou, e eu não sei como,
mas eu estava nessa nave!

source:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>And even worse, I still hear the sound sometimes. I’m

translation:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>E pior ainda, eu ainda ouço o som
às vezes.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>You seem sorta strong. Could you find out what the
sound is for me?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Pode descobrir qual é o som
para mim?

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>I think the sound’s coming from down lower in the ship.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I peeked through that hole to check, but it was too dark to

source:

<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,49)>Could you go figure out what’s making the noise?

do fundo do navio!
<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,49)>Pode ir descobrir o que está fazendo esse barulho?

source:

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Parece que sempre ouço o som na mesma hora

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Whaaat?! It was just an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>? <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,14)><$motion(4,806)>I guess that’s

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Whaaat?! It was just an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>? <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,17)><$facial(4,14)><$motion(4,806)>I guess that’s

source:
<$voicel(4,3)>I dunno how come there was an alarm clock on this ship.
<$voicel(4,5)>But this room is really relaxing. It reminds me of home!
translation:
<$voicel(4,3)>Não sei por que houve um despertador nesta nave.
<$voicel(4,5)>Mas este quarto é realmente relaxante, me lembra de casa!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)>And if you put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> in here for me,
<$voicel(4,9)>I think it’ll feel even more like my home!
<$voicel(4,8)>Like this!

<$voicel(4,7)>E se você colocar o <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> aqui para mim, acho que
<$voicel(4,9)>vai se sentir ainda mais como a minha casa!
<$voicel(4,8)>Assim!

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>YAY, thank you! It really looks like my home now!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>I’m gonna live HERE from now on!
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Sim, obrigado, parece mesmo minha casa agora!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Eu vou viver aqui a partir de agora!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I wanna do something to say thank you, though... Oh!
I know!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>I found a really interesting machine on this ship!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Quero fazer algo para te agradecer,
eu sei!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>Achei uma máquina muito interessante nesta nave!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>I’ll show it to you! Come on, follow me!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I wanna show you something neat as thanks for helping
me! Come on, let’s go!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Quero te mostrar algo legal como obrigado
por me ajudar!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Wait... That smell! Do you have <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)> with you
already? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Aww, I wanna eat some...
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Yesss! These look sooo tasty. Thank you!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>OK! As promised, I’ll show you the trick to storing water.
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Como prometido, vou te mostrar o truque para armazenar água.

source:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>So first, you gotta jump right in the water! Splash!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Then suck up the water like SCHWOOOP!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Yup, basically like that!
translation:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Então, primeiro, você tem que pular direto na água!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Então sugue a água como SCHWOOOP!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Sim, basicamente assim!

source:
You learned how to <$cdef(27)>suck up liquid!
When you’re in liquid, press <$keyicon(206)> while holding <$keyicon(153)>!

Você aprendeu a <$cdef(27)>chupar líquido!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>You already figured it out? Gosh, you’re awesome!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)><$facial(4,4)>Now you can carry water to all sorts of places!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Meu Deus, você é incrível!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)><$facial(4,4)>Agora você pode levar água para todos os tipos de lugares!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)>All right, we should probably have you try it out at least
once! So first...

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)>Tudo bem, nós provavelmente deveríamos ter que experimentá-lo
pelo menos uma vez!

deeelightful! <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)>Obrigado um monte!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,50)>Obrigado de novo por me ajudar,<$cdef(27)>
de verdade!

living in dimmer places.

Pokémon who like it dark.

viver em lugares mais sombrios.
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)>Talvez você deva fazer casas em áreas cobertas para
Pokémon que gostam de escurecer.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,27)>Ooh, OOOH, <$cdef(27)>! I just thought of
something
really cool!

algo muito
legal!

<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Algo assim!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>The only hard part is, it’s gotta be really waaarm water!
I mean, it’s a HOT spring!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>A única parte difícil é que tem que ser água de quentinho, quero

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Actually, that reminds me. I heard that in the winter,
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,8)>humans used to drink nice warm water with all
sortsa different flavors in it!

<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,8)>, os humanos bebiam água quente com todos

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>Você poderia fazer uma fonte quente
como esta?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,49)>I heard that humans used machines called
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(616)> to <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)>hold really warm water!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,1)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, você tem um pouco de água!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)>Oh, huh? But we need really WARM water, remember?
<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)>You can’t make a hot spring with water like this!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)>Mas precisamos mesmo de água quente, lembre-se,
você<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)> não pode fazer uma fonte termal com água assim!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Can you maybe find some really waaarm drinks in a

um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(616)> em vez disso?

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,38)>YAYYY! It’s a hot spring! It’s so waaarm and nice and
PERFECT! <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,38)>OBAAA! É uma fonte quente! É tão quentinho e agradável
e <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>PERFEITO! Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,666)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(616)> sure are useful! You can get all
sortsa different waters from them!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,666)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(616)> com certeza é útil! Você pode obter
todo tipo de águas diferentes deles!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>And I bet you could think of lots of things to do with all
that stuff, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>E eu aposto que você poderia pensar em muitas coisas para fazer
com todas essas coisas, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
The sound that freaked out <$cdef(27)>Happiny was coming from an
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>!

O som que assustou <$cdef(27)>Happiny estava vindo
de um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>!

source: Bring it to <$cdef(27)><$cname(93)> </color>to put their mind at ease!
translation: Traga-o para <$cdef(27)><$cname(93)></color> para colocar sua mente à vontade!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)>I can sometimes hear this really scary sound from down in

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)>Às vezes ouço um barulho muito assustador vindo
do fundo do navio!

source:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>It seems like I always hear the sound at the same time
of day!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,807)>It’s kinda freaking me out, so could you please go figure
out what’s making it?
translation:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Parece que sempre ouço o som na mesma hora
do dia!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,807)>Está me assustando, então você poderia, por favor, descobrir o
que está fazendo isso?

source:
The <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> you picked up on the lower deck must
have been making that sound!
translation:
O <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> que você pegou no convés inferior
deve ter feito aquele som!

source: Show it to <$cdef(27)><$cname(93)></color> to put their mind at ease!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>You’d like to power up more <$cdef(27)>streetlights to brighten up the

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Você gostaria de ligar mais <$cdef(27)>luzes da rua para iluminar o

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>If you bring a Pokémon who can <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> electricity to

source: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>So, you’re hoping to build a habitat with some fire in it?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>In that case, you should probably prepare things like

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>Once you’ve done that, bring a Pokémon who can

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>Depois de fazer isso, traga um Pokémon que

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>We need to make this whole town brighter to

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Precisamos tornar toda a cidade mais brilhante para

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>And I think the best way to accomplish that would be to
place various light sources all around town.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>E acho que a melhor maneira de conseguir isso seria
colocar várias fontes de luz em toda a cidade.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>But putting too many lights in one place would just be a
waste. <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comcan(1)>Be sure to space them out to spread the light!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>Mas colocar muitas luzes em um lugar seria apenas um desperdício
. <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comcan(1)>Certifique-se de espalhá-las para espalhar a luz!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,2)>When you feel like the town’s gotten a bit brighter, come

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,2)>Quando sentir que a cidade ficou um pouco mais brilhante,

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I’d like you to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1622)>. It would help cheer

Peakychu<$cdef(27)> também.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Seria melhor colocá-lo perto de <$cdef(27)>Snorlax<$cdef(27)>, se você puder.
E<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)> não se esqueça de trazer um Pokémon que pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>
eletricidade para ajudá-lo a ligá-lo.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Try placing some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to connect the power
from the <$cdef(27)><$bfull(33)>.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Tente colocar um pouco de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> para conectar

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Bear in mind that <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> won’t connect if you

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Tenha em mente que <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> não vai se conectar se

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Try placing a <$cdef(27)>streetlight next to a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> that’s
already hooked up to electricity.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Tente colocar<$cdef(27)> uma luz de rua ao lado de um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> que
já está ligado à eletricidade.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>If you manage to turn on the <$cdef(27)>streetlight, you can do the
same thing again and again <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>to brighten up the whole town!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Se você conseguir ligar a <$cdef(27)>luz da rua, você pode fazer a
mesma coisa de novo e de novo<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)> para iluminar toda a cidade!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>You can power lots of lights at once using a <$cdef(27)>generator
and <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)>.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Você pode acender muitas luzes ao mesmo tempo<$cdef(27)> usando
um gerador e <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>However, you’ll need a good deal of <$cdef(27)><$ifull(107)> and other
materials to make them.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>No entanto, você vai precisar de uma boa dose de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(107)> e outros
materiais para fazê-los.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Why not get help from the other Pokémon to procure
the materials?
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Por que não obter ajuda dos outros Pokémon para adquirir
os materiais?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,2)>Could you connect this device to a great deal of
electricity? <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$cdef(27)>Peakychu appears to have a plan!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,2)>Poderia ligar este dispositivo a uma
grande <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$cdef(27)>quantidade de eletricidade?

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>If you look closely, you’ll see several little lights.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>Se olhar de perto, verá várias pequenas luzes.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>I think we can assume this device will be usable once all
those lights are on.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Acho que podemos assumir que este dispositivo será utilizável quando todas
as luzes estiverem acesas.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Oho! It looks like the humans were doing some sort of
work here...

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Parece que os humanos estavam fazendo algum tipo de
trabalho aqui...

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps we’ll find some trace of what happened to them.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Or maybe the humans themselves will still be around!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez encontremos algum vestígio do que aconteceu com eles.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Ou talvez os próprios humanos ainda estejam por perto!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>As am I! The path seems to continue on ahead of us, so
let’s follow it!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>O caminho parece continuar à nossa frente, então
vamos segui-lo!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Right! The path seems to continue on ahead of us, so let’s
follow it!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>O caminho parece continuar à nossa frente, então vamos
segui-lo!

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,6)>First of all, let’s go see what’s up ahead of us!
translation: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro de tudo, vamos ver o que está à nossa frente!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... This is slightly more rugged terrain than we’ve
encountered up until now.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Este é um terreno um pouco mais acidentado do que
encontramos até agora.

source: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,6)>And I don’t even see any Pokémon, let alone humans.
translation: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,6)>E eu nem vejo nenhum Pokémon, muito menos humanos.

source:
<$voicel(1,1)>I just hope we can find something—even the smallest
trace of what happened to the humans.
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)>Só espero que possamos encontrar algo, até mesmo o menor
vestígio do que aconteceu com os humanos.

source: <$voicel(1,6)>Now then... Where to begin, where to begin...
translation: <$voicel(1,6)>Agora, então... por onde começar, por onde começar...

source:
<$voicel(1,8)>Oh! Over there! Is that...a <$cdef(27)>PC?
<$voicel(1,5)>And the pile of rubble next to it looks like what’s left of a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center.
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)>Isso é um <$cdef(27)>PC?
E<$voicel(1,5)> a pilha de escombros ao lado parece o que sobrou de um
<$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>That tells us that in the past, <$voicel(1,8)>this too was a town where
humans and Pokémon lived together!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Isso nos diz que no passado, esta<$voicel(1,8)> também era uma cidade
onde humanos e Pokémon viviam juntos!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>I don’t see anything else that looks like a clue, so let’s
start by checking out that <$cdef(27)>PC.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Come on, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Não vejo mais nada que pareça uma pista, então vamos
começar verificando o <$cdef(27)>PC.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Vamos, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>Phew! That rugged path sure made for a challenging walk!
Now then, could you please examine that <$cdef(27)>PC?
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>Esse caminho acidentado fez uma caminhada desafiadora
, agora, por favor, pode examinar o <$cdef(27)>PC?

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Now that’s an odd-looking screen, if I ever saw one...
Is this a newer model or something?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>At any rate, try pushing some buttons and see
what happens.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Essa é uma tela estranha, se eu já vi uma... é
uma modelo nova ou algo assim?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>De qualquer forma, tente apertar alguns botões e ver

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Now it’s just this big ol’ boulder blocking our fun.
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>All right, time to show you my <$cdef(27)>Strength!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Agora é só um grande pedregulho bloqueando nossa diversão.
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Está bem, é hora de mostrar minha <$cdef(27)>Strength!

source:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>Phew! Well? You impressed or what?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>A lotta blood, sweat, and hard work went into building my
bod up enough to—
translation:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>Impressionou-se ou o quê?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Um monte de sangue, suor e trabalho duro foram para construir meu corpo
o suficiente para...

source:
<$comeff(4,11)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>WHAT?! You learned <$cdef(27)>Strength just by watching me?!
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,5)>You gotta be kiddin’... Ain’t you ever heard that biceps
don’t get built in a day?
translation:
<$comeff(4,11)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Você aprendeu <$cdef(27)>Strength apenas me observando?
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,5)>Você nunca ouviu falar que os bíceps não são
construídos em um dia?

source: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>You’re tellin’ me you can use <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> now? Seriously?
translation: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Está me dizendo que pode usar <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> agora?

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Whoa, I like that confidence! All right then, how about
you give me a little demonstration?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>See this boulder here? Try usin’ <$cdef(27)>Strength to move it!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Tudo bem, que tal você me dar uma
pequena demonstração?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Veja este pedregulho aqui? Tente usar <$cdef(27)>Strength para movê-lo!

source:

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>See this boulder here? Try usin’ <$cdef(27)>Strength to move it!

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Veja este pedregulho aqui? Tente usar <$cdef(27)>Strength para movê-lo!

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>How about... Oh! See those other boulders over there?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>Try bringin’ this one over to its buddies!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Que tal... Ah! Viu aquelas outras pedras ali?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>Tente levar esta para perto das companheiras dela!

source: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Use <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> to drag that boulder over here!
translation: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Use a <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> para arrastar a pedra até aqui!

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Whoa, you’re doin’ it! You’re really movin’ that boulder!
Keep it up! You got this!
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Ei, você está fazendo isso! Você está realmente mudando aquele pedregulho!
Continue assim! Você conseguiu isso!

source: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>Whoa, hey! You tryin’ to ditch our workout mid-sesh?
translation: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>Você está tentando largar nosso treino no meio da sesh?

source: <$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>You gotta stick with it to the end, pal!
translation: <$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>Você tem que ficar com ele até o fim, amigo!

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Wow, you’re somethin’ else, pal! I can’t believe you got the
hang of usin’ <$cdef(27)>Strength already. <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>That was so awesome!
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,2)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>So you needed a hand, yeah? I’m happy to help now that
I’m all warmed up! What can I do?
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Uau, você é outra coisa, amigo! Não acredito que você já
pegou o jeito de usar <$cdef(27)>Strength. Isso<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)> foi tão incrível!
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,2)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Então você precisava de uma mão, sim? Estou feliz em ajudar agora
que estou todo aquecido! O que posso fazer?

source: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>You need me to move that mega heavy <$cdef(27)>PC</color>? Gotcha.

<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>All right, just leave it to me! My <$cdef(27)>Strength’ll make quick
work of that!
translation:
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Deixe isso comigo, minha <$cdef(27)>Strength vai fazer um
trabalho rápido!

source: <$comeff(4,11)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,7)>But wait, you can use <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> now, right?
translation: <$comeff(4,11)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,7)>Mas espere, você pode usar <$cdef(27)>Strength</color> agora, certo?

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Then whaddya need ME for? You can handle it yourself!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Besides, the best way to master a move you just learned is
to practice using it over and over!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Então, para que você precisa de mim?
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Além disso, a melhor maneira de dominar um movimento que você acabou de
aprender é praticar usando-o repetidamente!

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m gonna train some more. Can’t afford to let you get
stronger than me! Ha!
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Vou treinar mais, não posso deixar você ficar
mais forte do que eu!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Well then, see where the sparks of electricity are? <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>Try
moving the heavy <$cdef(27)>PC over to that spot!

So close! It needs to face a different direction to connect!
Try turning the <$cdef(27)>PC in the right direction!
translation:
Precisa enfrentar uma direção diferente para se conectar
, tente virar o <$cdef(27)>PC na direção certa.

source:
*beep beep beep*
Battery restored. All functions are now available.
translation:
*beep beep beep*
Bateria restaurada. Todas as funções estão agora disponíveis.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho! Looks like you got that <$cdef(27)>PC up and running
just fine!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>So, why don’t you dive right in and see what you can learn

translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Parece que você tem o <$cdef(27)>PC funcionando
muito bem!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Então, por que você não mergulha e vê o que pode aprender
com isso?

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>It looks like the <$cdef(27)>PC is working! Why don’t you investigate
it now?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Parece que o <$cdef(27)>PC está funcionando, por que não investiga

source:
Welcome to the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
Here, you can continue taking on <$cdef(27)>challenges to improve
the quality of your environment!
Each <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center offers its own original <$cdef(27)>challenges.
Please do your best to complete them!
translation:
Bem-vindo ao <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon!
Aqui, você pode continuar enfrentando <$cdef(27)>desafios para
melhorar a qualidade do seu ambiente!
Cada <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon oferece seus próprios <$cdef(27)>desafios originais. Por
favor, faça o seu melhor para completá-los!

source:
The <$cdef(27)>Life Coins you get from completing <$cdef(27)>challenges can be
used at any Pokémon Center!
You can exchange them at any <$cdef(27)>PC for items of your
choosing!
Be sure to check out the new items we’ve added—and
keep on living your best <$cdef(27)>Poké Life!
translation:
As <$cdef(27)>Moedas da Vida que você recebe ao completar <$cdef(27)>desafios podem ser
usadas em qualquer Centro Pokémon!
Você pode trocá-los em qualquer <$cdef(27)>PC por itens de sua
escolha!
Certifique-se de verificar os novos itens que adicionamos -
e continuar vivendo sua melhor<$cdef(27)> vida Poké!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ll wager you can get some awfully handy items from the
<$cdef(27)>PC here too!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu aposto que você pode obter alguns itens muito úteis do
<$cdef(27)>PC aqui também!

source: <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>But...this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color> is terribly broken down as well.
translation: <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas... este <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon</color> também está terrivelmente quebrado.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope someday we can work together with the Pokémon
of this town to rebuild this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Espero que um dia possamos trabalhar juntos com os Pokémon
desta cidade para reconstruir este <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon!

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m so glad you can use the <$cdef(27)>PC now,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you think you can learn anything about what
happened to the humans from it?
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Estou tão feliz que você pode <$cdef(27)>usar o
PC agora, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Acha que pode aprender alguma coisa sobre o
que aconteceu com os humanos?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Hrmmm, that’s a shame.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>And I doubt <$cdef(27)>Machoke can help us either—they don’t
seem to think about much beyond their own muscles.
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>I can only hope we find a Pokémon who knows more
about humans.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Hrmmm, isso é uma pena.
E<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)> eu duvido que <$cdef(27)>Machoke possa nos ajudar também - eles
não parecem pensar muito além de seus próprios músculos.
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Só espero que encontremos um Pokémon que saiba mais
sobre humanos.

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? Did you hear a voice just now?

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Ah! Yes, that was definitely someone shouting! <$voicel(1,8)>I think I
heard the voice coming from this direction!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, foi alguém gritando, acho <$voicel(1,8)>que
ouvi a voz vindo dessa direção.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>I heard someone shouting! The voice came from this
direction—let’s go, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Ouvi alguém gritando! A voz veio daquela
direção. Vamos, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>The voice is coming from back here!
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>There’s an awful lot of stuff lying around, so be careful!
translation: <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Há um monte de coisas por aí, então tenha cuidado!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>The voice is coming from back here! Let’s go,
<$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>A voz está vindo daqui de trás! Vamos,
<$cdef(27)>!

source: There seems to be someone inside the barrel.
translation: Parece haver alguém dentro do barril.

source:
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Why would a barrel talk?! It’s ME that’s talking—the best
chef in town!
translation:
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Sou eu quem está falando, o melhor chef
da cidade!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Wha—?! Could...could this be a human?
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-why exactly are you inside that barrel?
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Poderia ser um ser humano?
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,8)>Por que exatamente você está dentro desse barril?

source:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,3)>Why?! Well...when I woke up, there was nobody around! <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>
So just as anyone with any sense would do, I started
looking for food.
translation:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,3)>Bem, quando acordei, não havia ninguém por perto, então, <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>
assim como qualquer um com qualquer senso faria, comecei
a procurar comida.

source: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Right... But how did you get stuck in a barrel?
translation: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Certo, mas como você ficou preso em um barril?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>I mean, somebody went to the trouble of suspending a
barrel like this... Wouldn’t YOU assume that it has
something extra special inside?!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>I figured it must be food, but when I climbed in to check,
I got stuck—now I can’t get out!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Quero dizer, alguém se deu ao trabalho de suspender
um barril como este... você não assumiria que ele tem
algo extra especial lá dentro?!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Achei que devia ser comida, mas quando entrei para verificar,
fiquei preso. Agora não consigo sair!

source: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>I see. You’re...quite powerfully motivated by food.
translation: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,4)>Entendo, você é... poderosamente motivada por comida.

source: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>N-no, it was...IT WAS FOR COOKING RESEARCH!
translation: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>Não, foi... foi por causa da pesquisa de CULINÁRIA!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Well...all that aside, it might be <$voicel(1,4)>a human stuck
inside this barrel.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you think you can rescue them somehow,
<$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem... tudo isso à parte, pode ser um <$voicel(1,4)>ser humano preso
dentro deste barril.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Acha que pode resgatá-los de alguma
forma, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Can you actually do that? Oh, yes, please! Cut that chain
posthaste!
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, sim, por favor, corte essa corrente depois
da pressa!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes, I think that’s a very sensible idea! Use one of your
moves to slice through that chain, if you’d be so kind!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim, acho que é uma ideia muito sensata, use um de seus
movimentos para cortar essa corrente, se você fosse tão gentil!

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait a second... If you do that, you might slice ME right
in half!
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Se fizer isso, pode me cortar ao
meio!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>That’s a very good point!
All right, instead of the barrel, <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>why don’t you cut the chain
holding it up? <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>Go on—slice it with one of your moves!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Esse é um ponto muito bom!
Tudo bem, em vez do <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>barril, por que
não corta <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>a corrente segurando-a?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>All I know is that when I woke up a bit ago, the town was
in the state it is now.
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>I have no idea what’s going on or what happened.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$facial(2,1)>But this place was already in a decline before...since so
many of the humans who worked as coal miners left.
<$motion(2,654)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Even my buddy’s restaurant, which used to always be so
full of customers, was seeing less business.
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>I know they were worrying about that...

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Tudo o que sei é que quando acordei há um pouco, a cidade
estava no estado que é agora.
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>Não faço ideia do que está acontecendo ou o que aconteceu.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$facial(2,1)>Mas este lugar já estava em declínio antes... desde que muitos dos
humanos que trabalhavam como mineradores de carvão partiram.
<$motion(2,654)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Até o restaurante do meu amigo, que sempre foi tão cheio
de clientes, estava vendo menos negócios.

every single human had disappeared.

para o estado dela.

we can do to get them to come back.

source: For now, try raising the<$cdef(27)> environment level </color>to level <$cdef(27)>three</color>!
translation: Por enquanto, tente elevar o <$cdef(27)>nível ambiental</color> para o nível<$cdef(27)> três</color>!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)>The Pokémon here have been really lively lately. They
seem like they’re really enjoying themselves!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I know we have you to thank for their comfortable
lifestyles here, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)>Os Pokémon aqui têm sido muito animados ultimamente. Eles
parecem que eles estão realmente se divertindo!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Sei que temos que agradecer por seu estilo de
vida confortável aqui, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>I’d like to take this opportunity to show my gratitude once
again—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>Gostaria de aproveitar esta oportunidade para mostrar minha gratidão
mais<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)> uma vez, obrigado, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$voicel(4,3)>I think I hear sounds coming from down in there...
translation: <$voicel(4,3)>Acho que ouço sons vindo de lá...

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>I was wondering if maybe you’d go check things out and
see where the sounds are coming from.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>If you find anything, could you let me know?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Eu queria saber se talvez você iria verificar as coisas
e ver de onde os sons estão vindo.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>Se encontrar algo, pode me avisar?

<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>Se encontrar algo, pode me avisar?

source: There’s a tough-looking wall blocking the way forward!
translation: Há uma parede de aparência dura bloqueando o caminho a seguir!

source:
It seems you won’t be able to break this wall unless you
power up <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>.
translation:
Parece que você não será capaz de quebrar esta parede a menos que
você ligar<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>.

source:
This wall is especially tough—it won’t break easily!
Try eating <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak to power up <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>!
translation:
Esta parede é especialmente dura - não vai quebrar facilmente!
Tente comer <$cdef(27)>bife de hambúrguer para se alimentar<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(4)>!

source: <$voicel(4,3)>I think I hear sounds coming from down in there...
translation: <$voicel(4,3)>Acho que ouço sons vindo de lá...

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>I was wondering if maybe you’d go check things out and
see where the sounds are coming from.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>If you find anything, could you let me know?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Eu queria saber se talvez você iria verificar as coisas
e ver de onde os sons estão vindo.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>Se encontrar algo, pode me avisar?

source:
It looks like you’ll need to break through the tough wall to
go deeper.
translation:
Parece que você vai precisar atravessar a parede dura para ir
mais fundo.

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)>So <$cdef(27)>Rotom was playing music down there, huh? What a
relief to know! The sounds were kinda scaring me...
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,661)><$cdef(27)>Rotom estava tocando música lá embaixo, que
alívio saber que os sons estavam me assustando.

lot
more
Pokémon
in
this town.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Graças a você, <$cdef(27)>, há agora muito

mais
Pokémon
nesta
cidade.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,5)>And they really seem like they’re enjoying themselves
here too. They’re all so lively!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I know we have you to thank for their comfortable
lifestyles here, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,5)>E eles realmente parecem estar se
divertindo aqui também.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Sei que temos que agradecer por seu estilo de
vida confortável aqui, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>I’d like to take this opportunity to show my gratitude once
again—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>Gostaria de aproveitar esta oportunidade para mostrar minha gratidão
mais<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)> uma vez, obrigado, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Ha-HA! You scared?!
<$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)><$facial(3,9)>Huh. <$voicel(3,5)>I, uh...I guess not. Darn.
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,17)><$motion(3,663)>Maybe I’ve gotten rusty... It’s been a hot minute since
I tried to scare a human.
translation:
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Você está com
<$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)><$facial(3,9)>medo<$voicel(3,5)>, eu acho que não.
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,17)><$motion(3,663)>Talvez eu tenha ficado enferrujado... tem sido um minuto quente desde
que tentei assustar um humano.

source:
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Oh, yeah! I was bumpin’ some <$cdef(27)>tunes!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>And, uh... Who are you?
Wait, you’re...not a human?
You’re...a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,27)>Yoooooo! That transformation is WILD! I thought you were
actually a human!
translation:
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Oh, sim, eu estava batendo algumas <$cdef(27)>músicas!
E<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)> quem é você? Espere,
você não é um ser humano?
Você é... um<$cdef(27)> Ditto?
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,27)>Yoooooo, essa transformação é selvagem, pensei que você
fosse um humano.

source:
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,665)>Whaaat?! Yooo! You’re...a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?! Whoa! <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,38)>That transformation
is WILD!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>So, uh... Anyway... I guess you came to check stuff out
’cause you heard some noise?
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>My bad, yo! I was just bumpin’ some <$cdef(27)>tunes!
translation:
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,665)>Yooo, você é... um <$cdef(27)>Ditto, essa <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,38)>transformação é
selvagem.
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>Então, enfim... acho que você veio checar as coisas
porque ouviu algum barulho?
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Eu só estava batendo algumas <$cdef(27)>músicas!

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)>I can go into all sorts of machines ’n’ electronics, y’know?
<$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,659)>This one is SUPER cool! It plays music!!!
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>I was waitin’ here alone hopin’ someone would come
along, but no one ever did... So I’ve been playin’ music
to keep the mood high and the vibes right!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)>Eu posso entrar em todos os tipos de máquinas 'n' eletrônicas, você
<$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,659)> sabe? Este é SUPER legal! Ele toca música!!!
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>Eu estava esperando aqui sozinho esperando alguém aparecer
, mas ninguém nunca apareceu... então eu tenho tocado música
para manter o humor alto e as vibrações certas!

source:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>But, hey! Now that YOU’RE here, <$cdef(27)>Ditto, how ’bout listenin’
to some hot tracks with me before you run off?!
translation:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>Agora que você está aqui, <$cdef(27)>Ditto, que tal ouvir
algumas faixas quentes comigo antes de fugir?

source:
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,6)><$facial(3,9)>Huh? You don’t have time for that?
<$motion(0,824)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,827)>Because all the humans and Pokémon disappeared?! Yooo!
Seriously?!
<$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,6)>But the Pokémon are slowly comin’ back, you say? Hm...
<$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)>And you’re tryin’ to make a new town with great vibes?<$motion(3,654)><$motion(0,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,6)><$facial(3,9)>Você não tem tempo para isso?
<$motion(0,824)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,827)>Porque todos os humanos e Pokémon
desapareceram?
<$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,6)>Mas os Pokémon estão lentamente voltando, você diz? Hm... E
você<$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)> está tentando fazer uma nova cidade com grandes vibrações?<$motion(3,654)><$motion(0,652)>

source: <$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,39)>That is SO cool! Yo, I wanna help out too!
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,49)>Guess I won’t waste any more time just sittin’ around here!
translation: <$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,49)>Acho que não vou perder mais tempo sentado por aqui!

source: <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,14)>I’ll see ya again in a bit!
translation: <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,14)>Te vejo de novo daqui a pouco!

source:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>I wanna help you make the town a vibe, yo! But lemme go
meet everybody else first!
translation:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>Quero ajudá-lo a fazer da cidade uma vibe, mas deixe-me
conhecer todo mundo primeiro!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>You’re called <$cdef(27)>Rotom—is that right, pumpkin? Goodness,
you do seem to have a lot of energy!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Você se chama <$cdef(27)>Rotom, certo, meu bem? Nossa,
você parece ter energia de sobra!

source:
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>I heard you all wanna make a totally poppin’ town here!
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,9)>And I have a real good idea for how to make the vibes
IMMACULATE.
translation:
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>Ouvi dizer que todos querem fazer uma cidade totalmente popular aqui!
E<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,9)> eu tenho uma boa idéia de como fazer as vibrações
IMMACULAR.

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, you’re going to help us out too? What a sweetie you
are! Thank you!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, você vai nos ajudar também? Que querido você
é! Obrigado!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Indeed! We would be very grateful. Would you please
share your idea with us?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Ficaríamos muito agradecidos, por favor, compartilhe
sua ideia conosco.

source:
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>There’s only one way to make it happen, yo—we gotta have
a PARTYYY!
translation:
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>Só há uma maneira de fazer isso acontecer, temos que ter uma
PARTYYYY!

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>A...party? What exactly are you thinking of?

<$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, a party sounds lovely! This brings back so many fond
memories...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, uma festa parece adorável, isso traz de volta tantas lembranças
afetuosas...

source:
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,9)>Yeah! A PARTY! With hype music! And singing! And
dancing! And eatin’ good food, yo!
translation:
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,9)>Sim, uma festa, com música animada, e cantando, e
dançando, e comendo boa comida, cara!

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Ahh, right, yes, a PARTY! Yes, of course—that is more
or less what I was picturing.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, indeed... That does sound quite fun!
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Sim, claro, isso é mais ou menos o que
eu estava imaginando.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, de fato... isso soa bem divertido!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>And what would those be? Could you tell us what we
ought to do?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Poderia nos dizer o que devemos
fazer?

source: <$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,6)>We can figure that out as we go, yo! Let’s get to it!
translation: <$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,6)>Podemos descobrir isso enquanto vamos, vamos lá!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, I am SO looking forward to having a party! After all,
the most important thing you need for a party is FOOD!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I’ll show you all my very best cooking and whip up a
special spread just for the party!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Afinal, a coisa mais importante que
você precisa para uma festa é comida!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>Vou mostrar a vocês a minha melhor comida e preparar
um prato especial só para a festa!

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Yes, please do look forward to it! That being said...
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I wonder what I should cook.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>A special dish for a special party... <$voicel(2,3)>I need to think hard
about this.
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Sim, por favor, aguardo com expectativa o que digo... eu
me<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)> pergunto o que devo cozinhar.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Um prato especial para uma festa especial.<$voicel(2,3)>.. preciso pensar muito
sobre isso.

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>...Now that you mention it, I hadn’t thought that far.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I wonder, what SHOULD I cook?
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>A special dish for a special party...<$voicel(2,3)>I need to think hard
about this.
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Agora que você mencionou, eu não tinha pensado tão longe.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu me pergunto, o que devo cozinhar?
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Um prato especial para uma festa especial.<$voicel(2,3)>.. preciso pensar muito
sobre isso.

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>I definitely want to include <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> in whatever
we make... And of course <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> are a must...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>But the big question is, what dish will incorporate ALL
of that?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>Aaah, my mind’s a scrambled mess right now—I just can’t
seem to get my thoughts in order!
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu definitivamente quero incluir <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> em tudo o que
fazemos... e é claro que <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> é uma obrigação...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas a grande questão é, que prato vai incorporar
tudo isso?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>Aaah, minha mente está bagunçada agora. Não consigo
colocar meus pensamentos em ordem!

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>You know what—maybe it would be better if we set up the
party venue before worrying about all that!
<$comeff(2,5)><$voicel(2,6)>So you’re going to need this, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Talvez seja melhor montarmos o local da festa
antes de nos preocuparmos com tudo isso!
<$comeff(2,5)><$voicel(2,6)>Então você vai precisar disso, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(2,8)>This place looks good for a party. It’s got a lot of space!
<$voicel(2,6)>Would you be a dear and clear away some of that ash and
stone that’s in the way?
<$voicel(2,7)>Then you can set up that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> somewhere
around here.
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)>Este lugar parece bom para uma festa, tem muito espaço!
<$voicel(2,6)>Você seria um querido e limparia algumas das cinzas e
pedras que estão no caminho?
<$voicel(2,7)>Então você pode montar o <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> em algum lugar
por aqui.

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>If you set up a wonderful party venue...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I’m sure it’d inspire me to come up with a wonderful
dish too!
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Se você montou um local de festa maravilhoso...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>Tenho certeza que me inspiraria a criar um prato maravilhoso
também!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>Would you be a dear and set up the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)>
somewhere around here?
<$voicel(2,8)>After you’ve made a bit more space, of course, by getting
rid of the rocks and ash and stuff!

<$comeff(8,3)><$motionoff(8,814)><$voicel(8,5)>Whoa! What’re you s’posed to be?! And what’s all that
noise down there? That you and your friends, bud?
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motionoff(8,814)><$voicel(8,5)>E o que é todo esse barulho lá embaixo
, que você e seus amigos, amigo?

source:
... ... ...
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Hah! You all sound like you’re havin’ a good time—and
with no humans around to help, either!
translation:
...............
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Vocês todos parecem estar tendo um bom tempo - e sem
humanos por perto para ajudar, também!

source:
... ... ...
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Hah! That sounds pretty awesome, but I think I’ll pass!
<$comeff(8,10)><$motionoff(8,801)><$voicel(8,9)>It’s cool that you’re all down there havin’ such a blast
without any humans to help out!
translation:
... ... ...
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Ha! Parece incrível, mas acho que vou ficar de fora!
<$comeff(8,10)><$motionoff(8,801)><$voicel(8,9)>É muito legal ver vocês se divertindo tanto lá embaixo
sem nenhum humano para ajudar!

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,7)>I was actually thinkin’ it’s kinda nice how quiet it’s been
without humans around...
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,9)>But y’know...a little party ruckus every now and then may
not be half bad!
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,7)>Na verdade, eu estava pensando que é meio legal o quão silencioso tem
sido sem humanos por perto...
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,9)>Mas você sabe... uma pequena festa ruckus de vez em quando pode
não ser meio ruim!

source:
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Who knows? Never could bring myself to like humans.
Couldn’t care less what they’re up to.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>I bet it’s their fault the world’s so messed up now!
translation:
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Quem sabe, nunca poderia gostar de humanos, não poderia me
importar menos com o que eles estão fazendo.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>Aposto que é culpa deles que o mundo está tão bagunçado agora!

source:
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Who knows? Never could bring myself to like humans.
Couldn’t care less what they’re up to.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>I bet it’s their fault the world’s so messed up now!
translation:
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Quem sabe, nunca poderia gostar de humanos, não poderia me
importar menos com o que eles estão fazendo.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>Aposto que é culpa deles que o mundo está tão bagunçado agora!

source:
<$comeff(8,4)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,3)>I mean, uh... I guess there might be good humans too,
somewhere out there.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,5)>They’re a tough bunch, y’know? Can’t underestimate ’em.
I’m sure they figured out a way to survive this mess.
translation:
<$comeff(8,4)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,3)>Quero dizer, acho que pode haver bons humanos também,
em algum lugar lá fora.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,5)>Eles são um bando duro, sabe? Não posso subestimá-los. Tenho certeza
de que eles descobriram uma maneira de sobreviver a essa bagunça.

source:
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,7)>Anyway, it’s been a hot minute since I’ve had my mood
lifted quite like this, bud. It’s kinda nice!
<$comeff(8,5)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,10)>You all can consider me a friend now!
translation:
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,7)>De qualquer forma, tem sido um minuto quente desde que
eu tive meu humor levantado bem assim, amigo.
<$comeff(8,5)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,10)>Vocês podem me considerar um amigo agora!

source:
<$cdef(27)>Volcanion, the Steam Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Volcanion, o Pokémon a Vapor, foi registrado no
seu Pokédex...
Seu posto de treinador aumentou para<$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!

source: <$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Well, I guess it’s about time for me to get goin’.
translation: <$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Bem, acho que está na hora de eu ir.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oooiii, <$cdef(27)>! Were you able to
make
friends
with
that Pokémon?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Are they going to come join the party?
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oooiii, <$cdef(27)>, você foi capaz de
fazer
amizade
com
aquele Pokémon?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Eles vão se juntar à festa?

source:
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Sounds like your friends are callin’ for ya, bud.
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,10)>I’m gonna show you all something cool real quick before I
head out. It’s somethin’ the humans left behind.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>But first, you go back to your pals, all right?
translation:
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Parece que seus amigos estão chamando por você, amigo.
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,10)>Vou mostrar a todos vocês algo legal
muito rápido antes de sair.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Mas primeiro, volte para seus amigos, certo?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>That sound and the rumblin’ of the ground just now was a
VIBE, yo! Was it that Pokémon up on the mountain?
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Aquele som e o rumblin do chão agora era um
VIBE, foi aquele Pokémon na montanha?

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m guessing that Pokémon likes to eat pretty substantial
servings as well. Do you think we have enough <$cdef(27)>curry?
translation:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Acho que Pokémon gosta de comer
porções substanciais também<$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$emotion(8,14)><$voicel(8,5)>Sounds like your friends are callin’ ya from down below,
bud. Go on, get outta here.
translation:
<$emotion(8,14)><$voicel(8,5)>Parece que seus amigos estão te chamando de baixo,
vá em frente, saia daqui.

source:
It seems like there’s still more for you to do
in <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(3)>.
translation:
Parece que ainda há mais para você
fazer em <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(3)>.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>, o que pode nos dizer sobre

aquele
Pokémon?

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>What’s that? That was the Mythical Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Volcanion?!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Truly incredible Pokémon do seem to appear when
you’re around...
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Esse era o Pokémon Mítico <$cdef(27)>Volcanion?!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Pokémon realmente incríveis parecem aparecer quando você
está por perto...

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>So I take it <$cdef(27)>Volcanion won’t be coming to our party?
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)><$lookat(1,0,8)>What are they planning to do over there?
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Então eu acho que <$cdef(27)>Volcanion não virá à nossa festa
,<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)><$lookat(1,0,8)> o que eles estão planejando fazer lá?

source:
<$voicel(8,9)><$motion(8,801)><$facial(8,4)>Thanks for givin’ me a glimpse of that fun party of yours!
Here’s a li’l present from me in return!
translation:
<$voicel(8,9)><$motion(8,801)><$facial(8,4)>Obrigado por me dar um vislumbre dessa festa divertida sua
! Aqui está um presente de mim em troca!

source: <$voicel(1,10)>Oho! If I’m not mistaken, those are...fireworks?
translation: <$voicel(1,10)>Se não me engano, são fogos de artifício?
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Eu nunca vi fogos de artifício antes!

source:
<$comeff(6,21)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,801)><$voicel(6,9)>Those are fireworks, huh? How breathtakingly beautiful...
Just like me!
translation:
<$comeff(6,21)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,801)><$voicel(6,9)>Isso são fogos de artifício,
não é?

source: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>Dang, I can feel those booms in my biceps!
translation: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>Puxa, eu posso sentir aqueles booms no meu bíceps!

source:
<$emotion(3,14)><$voicel(3,7)>All right, everybody! Now it’s time to REALLY get this
party started!
<$emotion(3,8)><$voicel(3,9)>It’s gonna be a BLAST—like those fireworks!
translation:
<$emotion(3,14)><$voicel(3,7)>Agora é hora de realmente começar
essa festa!
<$emotion(3,8)><$voicel(3,9)>Vai ser um ESTOURO-como aqueles fogos de artifício!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>We’ve still got plenty of <$cdef(27)>curry, too, everyone! Please go
ahead and eat your fill!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Nós ainda temos muito <$cdef(27)>curry, por favor, vão em frente
e comam sua comida!

source:
And so the Pokémon party continued, even long after
<$cdef(27)>Volcanion left...
translation:
E assim a festa Pokémon continuou, mesmo muito tempo depois
que <$cdef(27)>Volcanion saiu...

source:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Phew! I may have overdone it on the food...but it’s been
ages since I really let loose and made merry like that!
translation:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Posso ter exagerado na comida... mas já faz muito
tempo desde que me soltei e me alegrei assim!

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>And <$cdef(27)>Volcanion’s fireworks were truly a sight to behold!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder if we’ll ever get another chance to see them...
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>E os fogos de artifício do <$cdef(27)>Volcanion foram realmente uma visão
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)> para ver! Eu me pergunto se teremos outra chance de vê-los...

source: You came up with <$cdef(27)>recipes</color> for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1850)></color> and <$cdef(27)>fireworks</color>!
translation: Você veio com <$cdef(27)>receitas</color> para um <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1850)></color> e <$cdef(27)>fogos de artifício</color>!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Wait a moment... Are you telling me that you’ve even
come up with a way to make fireworks?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>You are quite the prodigy!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Está me dizendo que chegou a um jeito
de fazer fogos de artifício?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Você é um grande prodígio!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope you’ll launch some for us the next time we hold
a party like this!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Espero que você lance um pouco para nós da próxima vez que fizermos
uma festa como essa!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>Sadly, the humans didn’t join us this time, but it was clear
to me everyone here had a tremendous time.
<$voicel(1,7)>And if this town continues to be so happy and lively,
perhaps one day the humans will take note.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>Infelizmente, os humanos não se juntaram a nós desta vez, mas ficou
claro para mim que todos aqui se divertiram muito.
E<$voicel(1,7)> se esta cidade continuar tão feliz e animada,
talvez um dia os humanos tomem nota.

source:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>And once again, from the very roots of these old vines,
thank you, <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>E mais uma vez, das raízes dessas velhas
videiras, obrigado, <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>This town has grown quite lively thanks to your efforts!
<$voicel(1,9)>And you put on a splendid party!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Esta cidade ficou muito animada graças aos seus esforços
<$voicel(1,9)>e você fez uma festa esplêndida!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>If you’re itching to move on and explore unknown lands,
I recommend returning to the previous town first.
<$voicel(1,7)>Then you can head to the other gate that leads from there.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Se você está ansioso para seguir em frente e explorar terras
desconhecidas, eu recomendo voltar para a cidade anterior primeiro.
<$voicel(1,7)>Então você pode ir para o outro portão que leva de lá.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>And whenever you do, you can be sure I’m coming
with you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>E sempre que você fizer, você pode ter certeza que eu
vou com você!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, and remember that <$cdef(27)>sand-covered building we found
on the beach in the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Something about that keeps tugging at my mind as well.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Lembra daquele <$cdef(27)>prédio coberto de areia que
encontramos na praia no <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(1)>?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Algo sobre isso continua mexendo na minha mente também.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d appreciate it if you could check on it every now
and then.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu agradeceria se você pudesse verificar isso de vez
em quando.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Now that you’ve registered <$cdef(27)>Volcanion in your Pokédex,
you may be able to pass though there!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Agora que registrou <$cdef(27)>Volcanion na sua Pokédex,
talvez consiga passar por ali!

source:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I think you should go check it out when you’re ready.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>And of course, I’ll be coming with you!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Acho que você deveria ir verificar quando estiver pronto.
E<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>, claro, eu vou com você!

source:
<$comeff(3,5)><$facial(3,13)><$motion(3,665)><$voicel(3,9)>Say whaaat?! You and <$cdef(27)>Volcanion are best buds now? Yo,
<$emotion(3,38)><$voicel(3,8)>you are a VIBE, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>I was really hoping that sweetie <$cdef(27)>Volcanion would try some
of my <$cdef(27)>curry.
translation:
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu realmente esperava que a querida <$cdef(27)>Volcanion tentasse um pouco
do meu <$cdef(27)>curry.

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Ah, well. For now, I’ll work on my cooking skills to prepare
for the next time they show up!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Por enquanto, vou trabalhar em minhas habilidades culinárias para me preparar
para a próxima vez que elas aparecerem!

source:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>So you’re gonna build <$cdef(27)>houses around here, too?
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Well, I’m pretty good at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing, y’know! I can’t wait
to help out!
translation:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Então você vai construir<$cdef(27)> casas por aqui também?
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Bem, eu sou muito bom em ing, <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>você sabe! Eu mal posso esperar
para ajudar!

source:
A Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort level increases more easily if they’re
living in a <$cdef(27)>house.
After the <$cdef(27)>house is built, don’t forget to put <$cdef(27)>three types of
furniture in it!
translation:
O nível de <$cdef(27)>conforto de um Pokémon aumenta mais facilmente se ele estiver
morando em uma<$cdef(27)> casa.
Depois que a<$cdef(27)> casa for construída, não se esqueça de <$cdef(27)>colocar três
tipos de móveis nela!

source:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I can’t wait for you to start building those houses,
<$cdef(27)>!
I’m good at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing, so I’ll help out too!
translation:
<$comeff(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Mal posso esperar para você começar a construir essas
casas, <$cdef(27)>!
Eu sou bom em <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>, então eu vou ajudar também!

source:
A Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort level increases more easily if they’re
living in a <$cdef(27)>house.
After the <$cdef(27)>house is built, don’t forget to put <$cdef(27)>three types of
furniture in it!
translation:
O nível de <$cdef(27)>conforto de um Pokémon aumenta mais facilmente se ele estiver
morando em uma<$cdef(27)> casa.
Depois que a<$cdef(27)> casa for construída, não se esqueça de <$cdef(27)>colocar três
tipos de móveis nela!

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>I bet if you keep building more <$cdef(27)>houses, the town will look
like it did way long ago!
translation:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Aposto que se continuar construindo mais <$cdef(27)>casas, a cidade
parecerá como há muito tempo!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, ouvi dizer que você é um gênio
em
fazer
saladas<$cdef(27)>, o
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)><$cdef(27)>Scorbunny me
contou

tudo
sobre isso.

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I’d love to try one of your <$cdef(27)>salads, but I want to eat it...
gracefully. Beautifully. You get me?
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Like a <$cdef(27)>salad where everything’s shredded real finely. Think
you could make something like that?
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Adoraria experimentar uma de suas <$cdef(27)>saladas, mas
quero comê-la... graciosamente.
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Como uma <$cdef(27)>salada onde tudo é triturado finamente, acha
que poderia fazer algo assim?

source:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m excited! Thanks, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, and if you need help cutting up the salad greens,
lemme know. Always happy to lend a wing.
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Heh. It’ll be like a special salad collaboration between you
and me!
translation:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Que empolgação! Valeu, <$cdef(27)>.

<$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!
The <$cdef(27)>environment level will increase as more Pokémon
arrive and their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels improve!
translation:
Tente obter o nível<$cdef(27)> de meio ambiente até <$cdef(27)>três para satisfazer
o <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!
O nível<$cdef(27)> do ambiente aumentará à medida que mais Pokémon
chegarem e seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto melhorarem!

source:
You can check the current <$cdef(27)>environment level anytime at
the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC!
translation:
Você pode verificar o nível <$cdef(27)>atual do ambiente a qualquer momento
no <$cdef(27)>PC do Centro Pokémon!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d like you to increase the Pokémon population of this
town too, and help improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu gostaria que você aumentasse a população Pokémon desta cidade
também, e ajudasse a melhorar seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! I see more Pokémon
have
arrived
in
this
town too!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>And they all seem to be enjoying themselves, as well! We
have you to thank for that—so, thank you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Vejo<$cdef(27)> que mais Pokémon
chegaram
a
esta
cidade
também!
E<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)> todos eles parecem estar se divertindo, também, temos
que agradecer por isso, então, obrigado!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>And that all leads me to something I’d like to ask of you.
<$voicel(1,8)>Would you work together with everyone to rebuild this
town’s <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>E isso tudo me leva a algo que eu gostaria de pedir a você.
<$voicel(1,8)>Você trabalharia em conjunto com todos para reconstruir o
<$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon desta cidade?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m certain it’s possible if you all work together!
<$voicel(1,8)>It may take a while, but I’ll be waiting!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Tenho certeza que é possível se todos trabalharem juntos!
<$voicel(1,8)>Pode demorar um pouco, mas estarei esperando!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Now that I think of it, <$cdef(27)>, have you
tried
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>ing
into
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>a

who
can

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>If you could do that, it would make traveling between

translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Agora que eu penso nisso<$cdef(27)>, você já
tentou
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>
entrar em
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>um
Pokémon
que
pode
voar,
como <$cdef(27)>Rookidee?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Se você pudesse fazer isso, faria viajar entre
ilhas muito mais fácil, não acha?

source:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm, yes... I’d forgotten that you in particular can’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into just any Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Quite an odd quirk, when you consider how well you can
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a human.
translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm, sim... eu tinha esquecido que você em particular
não pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em qualquer Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Muito estranho, quando você considera o quão bem você
pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em um ser humano.

source:
