translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm, sim... eu tinha esquecido que você em particular
não pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em qualquer Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Muito estranho, quando você considera o quão bem você
pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em um ser humano.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>There’s a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Dragonite that’s a true
flying expert.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m quite sure it would be useful if you could <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>
into a Pokémon like that!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Why don’t you try searching for them?
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>Há um Pokémon chamado <$cdef(27)>Dragonite que é um verdadeiro
especialista em voo.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Tenho certeza de que seria útil se você pudesse <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>
em um Pokémon como esse!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Por que não tenta procurá-los?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>This town seems to be comprised of several different
islands. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Why don’t you try exploring the other ones?
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Esta cidade parece ser composta de várias ilhas
diferentes. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Por que você não tenta explorar as outras?

source: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>You might meet some new Pokémon out there.
translation: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Você pode encontrar alguns novos Pokémon lá fora.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite is an expert flier. If you could <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into
a Pokémon like that, <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>you could travel between islands
with a lot less hassle!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Se você pudesse <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em um Pokémon como esse,
você poderia viajar<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)> entre ilhas com muito
menos aborrecimento!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho! It seems this really was a machine meant to
transport folks from island to island!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I had a hunch that’s what it was!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Parece que era uma máquina destinada a
transportar pessoas de ilha em ilha!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Eu tinha um palpite que era o que era!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! Look at that, <$cdef(27)>! I spy a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>But...as I suppose I should have expected, it’s gone to ruin.
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Olhe isso, <$cdef(27)>, espiei um
Centro<$cdef(27)> Pokémon!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Mas... como eu deveria ter esperado, está arruinado.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Look, there’s a Pokémon near it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Right, then! First, let’s try talking to that Pokémon.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Olha, tem um Pokémon perto dele!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Primeiro, vamos tentar falar com aquele Pokémon.

<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, sabe como está
sempre
fazendo
casas
para
nós?

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Well, I know a home you could make! I’ll tell you all
about it!
translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Bem, eu sei uma casa que você poderia fazer, eu vou te contar tudo
sobre isso!

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>It’s for a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Froakie. I saw them in places
like this all the time!
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>É para um Pokémon chamado <$cdef(27)>Froakie. Eu os vi em lugares
como este o tempo todo!

source:
<$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! <$comeff(4,6)>You like making homes
for Pokémon, right?
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,8)>Then lemme share a li’l secret!
translation:
<$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,3)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, você <$comeff(4,6)>gosta de fazer casas
para Pokémon, certo?
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,8)>Então deixe-me compartilhar um segredo!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>There’s a pond with a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1416)> in it around here, and a
long time ago...
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>I saw a <$cdef(27)>Dragonite living in a spot like that!
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Há um lago com um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1416)> por aqui, e há muito
tempo...
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Eu vi um <$cdef(27)>Dragonite vivendo em um lugar como esse!

source:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite seems super spacey, but they look SO cool
when they fly!
translation:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite parece super espacial, mas eles parecem tão
legais quando voam!

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>You made me such a niiice home. I really want to do
something for yooouuu in return...but what can I do...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Eu realmente quero fazer algo por yoouuu
em troca... mas o que eu posso fazer...

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>You’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, riiight? So you should be able to
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into meee...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Then I can teach you how to fly. Like this...
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Você é <$cdef(27)>um Ditto, riiight, então você deve ser
capaz de <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em meee...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Então eu posso ensiná-lo a voar.

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,2)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>OK... We should praaactice a little to make sure you can
have fun and stay safe. <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Come over heeere with me...
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,2)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Devíamos fazer um pouco de praaactice para ter certeza
de que você pode se<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)> divertir e ficar seguro.

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>You’re still a beginner, so it might be hard for you to
really zip around in the sky...
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,8)>Maaaybe fly wasn’t the right word... <$cdef(27)>Glide? Yeahhh,
you’ll be gliding...
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>Você ainda é um iniciante, então pode ser difícil para
você realmente se virar no céu...
A<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,8)> mosca de Maaaybe não era a<$cdef(27)> palavra
certa... Glide?

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Ummm... It’s not flying exactly... More like <$cdef(27)>falling
reeeaaally sloooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>But that’s OK. You won’t have to worry about getting
hurt, and moving between islands will be really easy...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Não está voando exatamente... mais como <$cdef(27)>cair
reeeaaaaally slooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Mas tudo bem. Você não terá que se preocupar em se
machucar, e se mover entre ilhas será muito fácil...

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Ummm... It’s not flying exactly... More like <$cdef(27)>falling
reeeaaally sloooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)>But that’s OK. You won’t have to worry about getting
hurt, and moving between islands will be really easy...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)>Não está voando exatamente... mais como <$cdef(27)>cair
reeeaaaaally slooooowly...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)>Mas tudo bem. Você não terá que se preocupar em se
machucar, e se mover entre ilhas será muito fácil...

source:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s try going to the next islaaand. Just <$cdef(27)>glide and follow
my leeeaaad...
<$comeff(4,13)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,10)>Yayyy. You did really well. Flying is lots of fun, iiisn’t it?

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Now anytime you want to go to another islaaand, you can
just use <$cdef(27)>Glide and it will be suuuper easy...
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,7)>Agora, sempre que quiser ir para outra ilha,
pode usar<$cdef(27)> o Glide e será mais fácil...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>I thiiink it’s coming from the top of that building
over there...
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>Está vindo do topo daquele prédio
ali...

source:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,3)>I reeeaaally want to know what it is, but I need to head
back pretty soon...
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>I bet you could climb up to the top of the building and
check it out, thooouuugh...
translation:
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,3)>Eu quero saber o que é, mas preciso voltar
em breve...
<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Aposto que você poderia subir até o topo do prédio e
dar uma olhada, thoouuugh...

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeesh, what a mess. Didn’t expect that weird machine
thingy to literally blow up in my face!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Não esperava que aquela máquina estranha
explodisse na minha cara!

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Huh? Who’re you? Where’d you come from? What’re you
even doin’ here?
translation:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Quem é você, de onde veio, o que está
fazendo aqui?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, I’ll be! You’re fixin’ up the town to bring in more
Pokémon?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>That sure sounds like a fun undertaking, it does!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Você está arrumando a cidade para trazer mais
Pokémon?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso soa como um empreendimento divertido, faz!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Bahahaha! Sorry ya had to see all that mess. Don’t worry
’bout me—I’m built hardy enough that I can handle a big
boom like that.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>So...you’re fixin’ up a town to bring in more Pokémon?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,6)>That sure sounds like a fun undertaking, it does!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>Bahahaha, desculpe ter que ver toda essa bagunça, não se preocupe
, eu sou forte o suficiente para que eu possa lidar com um grande
boom como esse.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Então... você está arrumando uma
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,6)>cidade para trazer mais Pokémon?

source:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>I love big, tall buildings, see.
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I spend my time collectin’ junk from here and there and
tryin’ to assemble it all into somethin’ interesting.
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Like this tower here! I built this whole thing, believe it
or not! It’s why I call myself the <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!
translation:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu amo prédios grandes e altos, veja.
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu passo meu tempo coletando lixo daqui e ali
e tentando montar tudo em algo interessante.
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Como esta torre aqui, eu construí tudo isso, acredite ou
não, é por isso que eu me chamo o <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Well, could I ask ya to give me a hand with somethin’
while you’re at it, kid?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m thinkin’ it might even help with that town-building
you’ve got goin’ on!
translation:

’n’ disappeared someplace? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)>And you’re doin’ what ya
can to rebuild the towns and bring the Pokémon back?<$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,802)>Well I’ll be! Can’t believe all that’s been happenin’ while I
was asleep! <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,3)>Now that’s a wake-up call, I tell you what!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>O que é isso, agora? Os Pokémon e os humanos desapareceram
em algum lugar? E você <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)>está fazendo o que pode para
reconstruir as cidades e trazer os Pokémon de volta?<$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,802)>Não posso acreditar em tudo o que aconteceu enquanto eu estava
dormindo! Agora <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,3)>é uma chamada de despertar, eu digo uma coisa!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>That expression on yer face is a bit lackadaisical, but the
way you’ve been livin’ is anythin’ but! <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)>I think I like you!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Essa expressão no seu rosto é um pouco lascadaica, mas o jeito que
você tem vivido é qualquer coisa, mas eu acho <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)>que eu gosto de você!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>You can count me as a friend from now on, young’un!
Don’t be a stranger now, ya hear?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Você pode me contar como um amigo a partir de agora, jovem
, não seja um estranho agora, ouviu?

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,16)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,9)>*yaaawn*
Hm... I was hopin’ to teach ya a nice move, <$facial(4,1)>but fer the
life o’ me <$voicel(4,4)>I can’t remember what it was...
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Mebbe I overslept? My head’s all fuzzy inside.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,16)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,9)>*bocejo*
Hm... Eu estava esperando para te ensinar um bom movimento<$facial(4,1)>, mas se a
vida de mim <$voicel(4,4)>eu não consigo me lembrar o que era...
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Mebbe, eu dormi demais, minha cabeça está toda confusa por dentro.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>The best remedy fer a sleepy noggin is a nice hot meal!
That’d clear up my head in a jiffy, I bet!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>O melhor remédio para um sonolenta é uma boa refeição quente! Isso
limparia minha cabeça em um instante, eu aposto!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,661)>Sorry fer the trouble, but do ya think you could bring me
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>one pipin’ hot <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)>?
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>If I can get my head thinkin’ straight again with a hot meal,
I can teach ya a move <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)>that’s sure to be helpful!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,661)>Desculpe o problema, mas você acha que poderia me
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>trazer um pipin quente <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)>?
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>Se eu conseguir endireitar minha cabeça com uma refeição quente,
posso te ensinar um movimento<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)> que certamente será útil!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>*sniff sniff*
I can smell it...waftin’ through the air...
I wager there’s a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> <$voicel(4,4)><$facial(4,1)>somewhere on
this island!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>"Sniff sniff"
Eu posso sentir o cheiro... flutuando pelo ar...
Aposto que há um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> em <$voicel(4,4)><$facial(4,1)>algum lugar
nesta ilha!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Hm? Well I’ll be! You’ve already got a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> or
two on ya!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Você já tem um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> ou dois em
você!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Sorry to trouble ya, but would ya mind sharin’ <$cdef(27)>one of ’em
with me?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Desculpe incomodá-lo, mas você se importaria de <$cdef(27)>colocar um deles
comigo?

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Ya sure are kind, young’un! Hope ya don’t mind if I dig in
right away!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Espero que não se importe se eu entrar
imediatamente!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,17)>*munch munch munch*
Wowee! That’s hot as all get out! Jus’ gotta blow on it a
li’l bit... There we go! *munch munch*
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,17)>*nhac, nhac*
Nossa! Está quente demais! É só assoprar um pouquinho...
Pronto! *nhac, nhac*

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,19)>Ahhh! So hot! Jus’ how I like it! Ya won’t hear me talkin’
about bein’ drowsy anymore! That’s the truth!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>And I’ve jus’ remembered the move I wanted to teach ya
as well!
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,19)>Ahhh! Que calor bom! Bem do jeito que eu gosto! Você não vai mais me ouvir reclamar de sono, pode acreditar!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>E acabei de lembrar do movimento que eu queria ensinar para você também!

source:
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>The move’s called <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>Ya sometimes come across waterfalls when you’re usin’
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)> to swim around, don’tcha?
translation:

Às<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)> vezes, você se depara com cachoeiras quando
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)> está nadando, não é?

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)>Well, that jus’ won’t do. Can’t master <$cdef(27)>Waterfall without a
li’l swimmin’!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,29)>Como assim? Você não sabe nadar?
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)>Assim não dá. Você não vai dominar a técnica <$cdef(27)>Waterfall sem aprender a nadar um pouquinho!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,801)>But you’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, after all! I’ll bet ya could jus’
<$voicel(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a Pokémon who can swim!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,801)>Mas você é um <$cdef(27)>Ditto, afinal de contas, eu aposto que você poderia
<$voicel(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)>entrar em um Pokémon que sabe nadar!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)>If ya go to a nice li’l harbor town surrounded by water, I
bet you’ll run into a Pokémon who can use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,803)>Once you’ve figured out how to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a
Pokémon like that, you come on back to me, ya hear?
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>Then I can teach ya how to use <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)>Se você for a uma bela cidade portuária cercada por água,
aposto que encontrará um Pokémon que pode usar<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,803)>Uma vez que você descobriu como <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em um Pokémon
como esse, você vem de volta para mim, ouviu?
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>Então eu posso te ensinar como usar<$cdef(27)> Waterfall!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Search a harbor town someplace fer a Pokémon who can
use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Once ya figure out how to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a Pokémon
like that, I can teach ya how to use <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Procure em uma cidade portuária em algum lugar para ver um Pokémon que possa
usar<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Uma vez que você descobrir como <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> em um Pokémon como
esse, eu posso te ensinar como usar <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Then all you gotta do is jus’ swim up to one of ’em, give
the water upstream a good strong glare...
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>Then psyche yerself up and go, go, GO! <$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>As long as ya got
guts, you’ll make it to the top!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Então tudo que você tem que fazer é nadar até um deles, dar
à água a montante um bom e forte brilho...
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>Então a psique se levanta e vai, vai, vai, <$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>contanto que você
tenha coragem, você vai chegar ao topo!

source:
You learned <$cdef(27)>Waterfall! Press <$keyicon(6)> in front of a waterfall
while <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>ing!
translation:
Você aprendeu <$cdef(27)>Waterfall! Aperte <$keyicon(6)> diante de uma cachoeira
enquanto usa <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>If ya can master <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, it’ll surely be useful while
you’re explorin’!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>Se você pode dominar<$cdef(27)> Waterfall, certamente será útil enquanto
você está explorando!

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>So you’ve gone and learned <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>, have ya? Great! All
right then—I’m ready to teach ya <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, as promised!
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>Então você foi e aprendeu, tem<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>? timo! Tudo bem, então
- Estou pronto para te ensinar <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, como prometido!

source: <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>First, look fer a waterfall as you’re <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>in’ </color>about...
translation: <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Primeiro, olhe para uma cachoeira enquanto<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)> você</color> está...

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Then all you’ve gotta do is jus’ swim up to it with poise!
Give the water upstream a good strong glare! And then
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>psyche yerself up and go, go, GO!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>So long as you’ve got guts, you’ll make it to the top!
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Então tudo o que você tem que fazer é nadar até ele com
equilíbrio, dar a água a montante um bom brilho forte, e então
a<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)> psique se levanta e vai, vai, vai!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>Contanto que você tenha coragem, você chegará ao topo!

translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>Se você pode dominar<$cdef(27)> Waterfall, certamente será útil enquanto
você está explorando!

source:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>Why, hello there! I sensed a visitor, but I wasn’t expecting
one as adorable as you.
translation:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>Senti uma visita, mas não esperava uma tão
adorável quanto você.

source:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,13)>Oh? You’re building towns with the help of other Pokémon
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,1)>in the hope that humans may return someday?
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>What a wonderful sentiment.
translation:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,13)>Você está construindo cidades com a ajuda de outros Pokémon na
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,1)>esperança de que os humanos possam voltar algum dia?
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>Que sentimento maravilhoso.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>You’ll find this island is filled with furniture and other
items left behind by humans.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)>Feel free to take them—they might be of use to you.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>Você descobrirá que esta ilha está cheia de móveis e outros
itens deixados pelos humanos.
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)>Sinta-se livre para levá-los, eles podem ser úteis para você.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>You know... I sense something within you. A strange,
mystical power.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Eu sinto algo dentro de você, um estranho e
místico poder.

source:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>Actually, would you mind accompanying me for a while?
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)>I’d like to show you an interesting spot on this island.
translation:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,661)>Na verdade, você se importaria de me acompanhar por um tempo?
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)>Gostaria de mostrar um lugar interessante nesta ilha.

source: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I have a feeling you may find it useful. It’s right this way.
translation: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Sinto que pode achar útil, é por aqui.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>There’s a spot on this island that caught my eye.
Follow me, little one.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Há um lugar nesta ilha que me
chamou a atenção.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>There’s a cave beneath this building that has piqued my
interest. <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,805)>I sense a powerful aura coming from deep within.
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>Há uma caverna debaixo deste prédio que despertou meu
interesse<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,805)>. Eu sinto uma aura poderosa vindo de dentro.

source:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,663)><$facial(4,9)>I’ve been hesitant to venture in by myself. Would you be
willing to explore it with me?
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,663)><$facial(4,9)>Eu tenho hesitado em me aventurar sozinho. Você estaria
disposto a explorá-lo comigo?

source: <$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>Why thank you! Let’s be off, then.
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$facial(4,4)>Why thank you! Let’s be off, then.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>When I spotted this cave earlier, I was unable to get past
the entrance due to flooding.
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>If that is still the case, first we’ll need to block off the
source of the water...
translation:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>Quando vi esta caverna mais cedo, não consegui passar pela
entrada devido a inundações.
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Se esse ainda for o caso, primeiro precisamos bloquear
a fonte da água...

source: <$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>Let’s venture into the cave, shall we?

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Though if the entrance is still flooded, we’ll need to block
off the water source first...
translation:

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, you must be that prim ’n’ proper <$cdef(27)>Pikachu I’ve heard
all about!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks for makin’ your way all the way out here. Musta
been exhausting!
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, você deve ser aquele Pikachu<$cdef(27)> que eu já
ouvi falar!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Obrigado por fazer o seu caminho
até aqui.

source:
<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>Erm, I don’t know that I appreciate being called “prim and
proper”... I’m tougher than I look—I assure you!
Well then, no time like the present. <$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,8)>How may I help?
translation:
<$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>Não sei se gosto de ser chamado de "prímula e adequada"...
sou mais durão do que pareço... asseguro-lhe! Bem,
então, não há tempo como o presente. Como<$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,8)> posso ajudar?

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa, sorry ’bout that! I wasn’t tryin’ to say you’re weak
or anything! <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>We’re counting on your help once we start
work on the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor!
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu não estava tentando dizer que você é fraco ou algo
assim, contamos<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)> com sua ajuda quando começarmos a
trabalhar no <$cdef(27)>quarto andar!

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Awesome, we’re set to get crackin’ on the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor!
Leave the rest to me ’n’ my happy helpers!
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Ótimo, já podemos começar o <$cdef(27)>quarto andar!
Deixe o resto comigo e com meus dedicados ajudantes!

source: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>This’ll take a while. Come check on us later!
translation: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Isso vai demorar um pouco, venha nos ver mais tarde!

source: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>The <$cdef(27)>fourth floor</color> isn’t quite ready yet! Come back later!

<$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>We did it! We all worked together and totally fixed up this
big building!
translation:
<$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>Todos trabalhamos juntos e arrumamos esse
grande prédio!

source:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>! All of you! Thanks so much
for
helpin’
me out!
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>I had a blast!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>So it’s finally finished, is it? That’s quite the feat for
Pokémon alone to accomplish!
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Então, finalmente está terminado, não é? Isso é bastante o feito
para Pokémon sozinho para realizar!

source: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>I had a lot of fun too!
<$comeff(3,21)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,10)>It really has become quite a magnificent building!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! Well then, what are we waiting for? Let’s take a
look inside, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, o que estamos esperando? Vamos dar uma
olhada lá dentro, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$voicel(3,4)>Oh my! Wh-what was that just now?
This building... What is happening here?
translation: Este prédio... o que está acontecendo aqui?

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>What the heck’s that voice? I hear it comin’ from above!
translation: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Que voz é essa? Estou ouvindo ela vir lá de cima!

source: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,665)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, my! There’s something very odd happening in the sky!
translation: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,665)><$voicel(4,9)>Tem algo muito estranho acontecendo no céu!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)>I believe someone was moving on the <$cdef(27)>roof just now!
<$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>! Will you please go check the
<$cdef(27)>roof
of
this building?
<$voicel(1,5)>It might be a Pokémon we haven’t met before!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)>Acho que alguém estava se movendo no <$cdef(27)>telhado agora!
<$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, por favor, vá ver o telhado
<$cdef(27)>
deste
prédio.
<$voicel(1,5)>Pode ser um Pokémon que não conhecemos antes!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)>Please, <$cdef(27)>! Do it for me!
<$voicel(2,7)>I’d be crushed if anything happened to this beautiful
building we just finished!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)>Por favor, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,7)>Eu ficaria esmagada se algo acontecesse com este belo
prédio que acabamos de terminar!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>There’s someone on the <$cdef(27)>roof! Would you go check it
out, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Hm... You’re an odd <$cdef(27)>Ditto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Did you and your friends construct this building?
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Você é um estranho <$cdef(27)>Ditto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Você e seus amigos construíram este prédio?

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>I see... I was concerned that humans might be using the
power of their so-called science <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>in unwise ways again...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>But to hear that this large building was erected by
Pokémon is quite a surprise.
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>Entendo... estava preocupado que os humanos pudessem estar
usando o poder da chamada ciência de <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>maneiras insensatas de novo...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>Mas ouvir que este grande edifício foi erguido por
Pokémon é uma grande surpresa.

source:
<$comeff(8,5)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,5)>I...am a Pokémon who was created by humans.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>I was concerned that humans might be using the power of
their so-called science <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>in unwise ways again...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>But if this large building was indeed constructed by
Pokémon—well, that’s quite the surprise.
translation:
<$comeff(8,5)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,5)>Eu sou um Pokémon que foi criado por humanos.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>Eu estava preocupado que os humanos pudessem estar usando o poder
de sua chamada ciência de maneiras<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)> insensatas novamente...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>Mas se este grande edifício foi realmente construído por
Pokémon, bem, isso é uma grande surpresa.

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>I do not know.
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>The last time I saw a human was in a city where rain no
longer fell... <$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>I believe it was called <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>They were putting up a peculiar building on a
nearby beach.
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>Eu não sei.
A<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)> última vez que vi um humano foi em uma cidade onde a chuva
não caiu mais<$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>... creio que se chamava <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Eles estavam montando um prédio peculiar em uma
praia próxima.

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>I do not know.
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>The last time I saw a human was in a city where rain no
longer fell... <$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>I believe it was called <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>They were putting up a peculiar building on a
nearby beach.
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>Eu não sei.
A<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)> última vez que vi um humano foi em uma cidade onde a chuva
não caiu mais<$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>... creio que se chamava <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Eles estavam montando um prédio peculiar em uma
praia próxima.

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,3)>I think it highly likely that they were plotting something
nefarious.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,7)>If you’re curious about humans, I suggest you investigate
around there.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>Although...a great deal of time has passed. I can’t be sure
that the building still exists.
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,3)>Acho muito provável que eles estivessem planejando algo
nefasto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,7)>Se está curioso sobre humanos, sugiro que investigue
por aí.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>Embora tenha passado muito tempo, não sei se
o prédio ainda existe.

source:
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Hmmm... I don’t usually speak at such length. <$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,10)>Perhaps this
is a sign that I’ve taken a liking to you.
translation:
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Eu não costumo falar tão longamente, <$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,10)>talvez seja
um sinal de que eu gosto de você.

source:
<$cdef(27)>Mewtwo, the Genetic Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex.
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(4)>!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Mewtwo, o Pokémon Genético, foi registrado em
seu Pokédex.
Seu posto de treinador aumentou para<$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(4)>!

source:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,5)>It’s time I took my leave. Perhaps we shall meet again
somewhere.
translation:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,5)>É hora de me despedir, talvez nos encontremos de novo em
algum lugar.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! How did it go? Who did
you
find
on
the roof?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>...What’s that? Well, I’ll be! You found <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>So now you’ve even become friends with the Legendary
Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo—astonishing!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, como foi, quem você
encontrou

no
telhado?
O<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)> que é isso? Bem, eu estarei! Você encontrou <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Então, agora você até se tornou amigo do Pokémon
Lendário <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo – surpreendente!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>I can’t believe an incredible Pokémon like that came all
this way to celebrate us completin’ the building!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Não acredito que um Pokémon incrível como esse veio
até aqui para nos celebrar completando o prédio!

source: <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh my, oh my! Were they terribly good-looking?
translation: <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, oh, oh, eles eram terrivelmente bonitos?

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>So tell us, did <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo </color>say anything about the humans?
translation: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Então nos diga, <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo</color> disse alguma coisa sobre os humanos?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Really? Well, that’s unfortunate!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>But it did seem like you two were talking for quite a while.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Are you certain they didn’t tell you ANYTHING about the
humans? Really try to remember.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, isso é lamentável!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas parecia que vocês estavam conversando por um bom tempo.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Tem certeza que eles não lhe disseram
nada sobre os humanos?

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! That building we discovered near the cave where you
and I first met, eh...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>It may be a good idea to investigate that building a
bit further.
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Aquele prédio que descobrimos perto da caverna onde você e
eu nos conhecemos, eh...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Pode ser uma boa idéia investigar o prédio um
pouco mais.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>But aside from everything else, it seems the sudden
appearance of <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo can be chalked up to the
impressive job you all did rebuilding this great structure!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,10)>Well done indeed, everyone!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas, além de tudo, parece que a súbita aparição de
<$cdef(27)>Mewtwo pode ser atribuída ao impressionante
trabalho que vocês fizeram reconstruindo esta grande estrutura!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,10)>Muito bem, pessoal!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope we can continue working together like this so that
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>all Pokémon in all the towns can live comfortably!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Espero que possamos continuar trabalhando juntos assim para que todos
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>os Pokémon em todas as cidades possam viver confortavelmente!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>If there’s anyone up on the <$cdef(27)>roof, tell ’em to use the front
door like a regular Pokémon!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>Se houver alguém no <$cdef(27)>telhado, diga a eles para usar a porta da
frente como um Pokémon comum!

source:
<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,9)>A visitor on the <$cdef(27)>roof? Do you think they were drawn here
by the smell of my cooking?
translation:
<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,9)>Você acha que<$cdef(27)> eles foram atraídos pelo
cheiro da minha comida?

source:
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,665)><$voicel(3,5)>I’m getting an odd feeling from this place... Please be
careful out there, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,665)><$voicel(3,5)>Estou tendo uma sensação estranha desse lugar...
por favor, tenha cuidado, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Hellooo! <$cdef(27)>! Who did you find on
the roof?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Please come back here soon and tell us what you learned!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, quem você encontrou no
telhado?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Por favor, volte aqui em breve e nos diga o que você aprendeu!

source:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>It’s about the <$cdef(27)>first floor of this building and its...entrance?
Whaddya call it, a foyer?
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>Anyway, I was wonderin’ if we could jazz it up in here a
little. Right now it’s kinda meh.
translation:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>É sobre o <$cdef(27)>primeiro andar deste prédio e
sua... entrada?
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>De qualquer forma, eu estava pensando se poderíamos fazer jazz
aqui um pouco, agora é meio que meh.

source:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>What about that machine? Y’know, the <$cdef(27)>PC at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
Center. You can <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>get all kinds of items from it, right?
translation:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Você sabe, o <$cdef(27)>PC do Centro Pokémon, você<$cdef(27)> pode
pegar todos <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>os tipos de itens dele, certo?

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Think you could nab <$cdef(27)>two <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> and plonk ’em

translation:

translation: <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu tenho um pressentimento que vai fazer este espaço parecer muito bom!

source:

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Think you could nab <$cdef(27)>two <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> and plonk ’em

translation:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Acha que poderia<$cdef(27)> pegar dois <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> e colocá

Prepare yourself well, my dearest disciple!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Juntos, afundaremos no próprio núcleo da arte,
prepare-se bem, meu querido discípulo!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,7)>Aha... AHAHAHA! These colors! Simply stunning!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes, this is the beauty—nay, the very ESSENCE of art!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,7)>Ahahaha, essas cores, simplesmente deslumbrantes!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, esta é a beleza, ou melhor, a própria essência da arte!

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, just a little more... Keep going...
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>Art is hunger, and hunger is art...
translation: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>Arte é fome, e fome é arte...

source:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>From an empty stomach springs boundless creativity! No
muse inspires like the rumble of a tummy!
translation:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>De um estômago vazio brota criatividade sem limites, nenhuma
musa inspira como o barulho de uma barriga!

source:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Be that as it may... I’m a little too hungry for my liking.
<$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>In fact, this is no time for art at all! I must eat!
translation:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Seja como for... estou com fome demais para o meu gosto. Na verdade
<$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>, este não é o momento para a arte em tudo! Eu devo comer!

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>You there, won’t you help a poor, starving artist? All I ask
for is a simple <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>.
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Você aí, não vai ajudar um artista pobre
e faminto<$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>?

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm? Do you already have one to give?

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh my, what a ripe, juicy-looking berry! And that color...
Red as the burning flames of inspiration...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Why, merely gazing upon it sets my withered heart ablaze!
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh meu Deus, que fruta madura, de aparência
suculenta, e essa cor... vermelha
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)> como as chamas ardentes da inspiração...

source: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>AHAHA! Yes, yesss, I’ve come up with a brilliant idea!
translation: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, sim, sim, eu tive uma ideia brilhante!

source: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Hold on to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color> for now, my friend!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh. The master can’t be outdone by the student, you
know? Behold my glorious new <$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,6)><$spwfull(21)>ing technique!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>O mestre não pode ser superado pelo
aluno, eis minha gloriosa<$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,6)><$spwfull(21)> técnica!

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>You really startled me... How’d you spot me, anyway?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>I thought I camouflaged myself perfectly!
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Você realmente me assustou...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>como você me viu, afinal?

source: <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s OK! It’s my fault for trying to hide like that anyway!
translation: <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>A culpa é minha por tentar me esconder assim de qualquer maneira!

source:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m practicing my camouflage! I thought I was doing pretty
good, too, but I guess not...
translation:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Pensei que estava indo muito bem também,
mas acho que não...

source: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>You did pretty good though, spotting me like that!
translation: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Você se saiu muito bem, me vendo assim!

source:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>So I bet you’d be good at this... Could you help me
practice camouflaging myself? Pleeeaaase?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I wanna get way better at it!
translation:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>Então eu aposto que você seria bom nisso...
você poderia me ajudar a me camuflar?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu quero ficar muito melhor nisso!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>I wanna try camouflaging myself as something
more complex!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Quero tentar me camuflar como algo
mais complexo!

source: <$voicel(1,9)>Just...nothing super big. I can’t do that.
translation: <$voicel(1,9)>Nada super grande, não posso fazer isso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>What would be perfect is maybe...something small, like a
toy, that you can change into different shapes!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Got anything like that, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>O que seria perfeito é talvez... algo pequeno, como um
brinquedo, que você pode mudar em diferentes formas!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Tem algo assim, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oooh, <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)>! That’s a great idea! I wanna try
camouflaging myself as those!
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oooh, <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)>, é uma ótima ideia, quero tentar
me camuflar como essas.

source:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>If you can get some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)>, could you please come
show me?
translation:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Se você pode pegar um pouco de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)>, por favor, venha me
mostrar?

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Ohhh-kayyy! Time to try out my new camouflage!

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I know, right?! Ooh, I got an idea! Do you wanna learn this
move too?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>You do, right?!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu tenho uma ideia, você quer aprender esse movimento
também?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Você tem, certo?

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Well, since you asked so nicely, I’ll teach it to you.
JUST YOU!
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>Now watch real close!
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, já que você pediu tão bem, eu vou te
ensinar.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>Agora olhe bem de perto!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Go ahead and use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)>, and then I’LL tell you if
you’re doing it right!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Vá em frente e use<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)>, e então eu vou te dizer se
você está fazendo certo!

source: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Go on! <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)> </color>yourself as something! I can wait!

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Could you <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)> yourself as something and then
come show me, pretty please?
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Você mesmo<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)> poderia como algo e depois vir
me mostrar, muito por favor?

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Wha... WHAAAT?! <$cdef(27)>?!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>I had NO idea that was you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>O que é isso, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Eu não sabia que era você!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Looks like you can use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)> perfectly now! I knew
you could do it!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Parece que você pode usar <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(6)>perfeitamente agora, eu sabia que
você poderia fazê-lo!

source:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll teach you a game this’ll be perfect for! You’re gonna
be so good at it, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Vou te ensinar um jogo que vai ser perfeito para
você ser tão bom nisso, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s called <$cdef(27)>hide-and-sneak</color>! Have you heard of it?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I bet you’ll really love it now that you can do what you
can do, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que vai adorar agora que pode fazer
o que pode, <$cdef(27)>!

source: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If you ever wanna play, just come ask me!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa! You ALREADY HAVE some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)>?! Can I
have ’em, pretty pleeeaaase?
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Você já tem um pouco?<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1274)> Posso
tê-los, muito prazer?

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Ohhh-kayyy! Time to try out my new camouflage!

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I know, right?! Ooh, I got an idea! Do you wanna learn this
move too?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>You do, right?!
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu tenho uma ideia, você quer aprender esse movimento
também?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Você tem, certo?

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Well, since you asked so nicely, I’ll teach it to you.
JUST YOU!
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>Now watch real close!
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, já que você pediu tão bem, eu vou te
ensinar.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,8)>Agora olhe bem de perto!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Anythin’s fine s’long as it’s edible! Just set it down right
there, would ya? ’Preciate it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Qualquer coisa está bem, por mais que
seja comestível!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Won’tcha share some food with an ol’ Pokémon? You can
just set it down right there, if ya’d be so kind!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Você não vai compartilhar um pouco de comida com um velho Pokémon?
Você pode simplesmente colocá-lo bem ali, se você fosse tão gentil!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$kfacial(2)>Oh! Brought me some food, did ya?!
Ah... Now THIS takes me back, I tell ya what.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$kfacial(2)>Ah! Trouxe comida para mim, foi?!
Ah... Isso me traz tantas lembranças!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,661)>A long, looong time ago, humans used to bring me food,
kinda like you just did for me...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,661)>Há muito tempo, os humanos me traziam comida
, como você fez por mim...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Kind folks like yourself were always givin’ me the tastiest
treats to eat...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Pessoas gentis como você sempre me davam as guloseimas mais
saborosas para comer...

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$comeff(2,21)>Phew... This really brought some nice old memories to the
surface. Thanks, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$comeff(2,21)>Isso realmente trouxe algumas boas lembranças antigas
para a superfície<$cdef(27)>.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Obrigado por<$cdef(27)> sempre me
trazer
guloseimas

saborosas
para
comer.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Say, you’re pretty knowledgeable about food, aren’t ya?
I’ve got a somewhat specific request...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Ei, você entende bastante de comida, né?
Tenho um pedido meio específico...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)>I dunno why, but I’ve got a real hankerin’ for <$cdef(27)>somethin’
spicy right about now...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>As long as it’s <$cdef(27)>spicy, I ain’t gonna be picky... Think you
could arrange that for me?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu não sei por quê, mas eu tenho um verdadeiro<$cdef(27)> desejo
por algo picante agora...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>Enquanto estiver <$cdef(27)>picante, não serei exigente... acha que
pode arrumar isso para mim?

source:
<$cdef(27)>Mosslax wants to eat some human food... Look for a
Pokémon who can teach you about cooking!
translation:
<$cdef(27)>Mosslax quer comer alguma comida humana... procure um
Pokémon que possa te ensinar sobre cozinhar!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>I really wanna eat <$cdef(27)>somethin’ spicy. Think you could bring
me that kinda food? I’d appreciate it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>Eu realmente quero<$cdef(27)> comer algo picante, acho que você
poderia me trazer esse tipo de comida?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,5)>Oh! This! This is...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,1)>This is EXACTLY like some of the food humans used to
give me way back when!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,5)>Isso é...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,1)>Isso é exatamente como alguns dos alimentos que os humanos costumavam
me dar de volta quando!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>The humans are all gone, and there’re way fewer Pokémon
around than there used to be...
Everythin’ has changed so dang much...<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)>but this happiness
I’m feelin’ right now is the same I felt back then!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Os humanos se foram, e há muito menos Pokémon por
aí do que costumava haver...
Tudo mudou tanto... mas essa felicidade<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)> que estou
sentindo agora é a mesma que eu sentia naquela época!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)>Thank ya, <$cdef(27)>. I’m really grateful!
As for this tasty-lookin’ morsel ya brought me...<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,664)>I think I’ll
eat it later and really savor each li’l bite...
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)>Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>. Agradeço de verdade!
Quanto a esse petisco delicioso que trouxe para mim...<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,664)>Acho que vou
guardar para depois e saborear cada pedacinho...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>If you can make human food... Why, I’ll wager you could
probably <$voicel(2,10)>make a place that the humans would wanna
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>return to someday!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Se você pode fazer comida humana... eu aposto que você
poderia <$voicel(2,10)>fazer um lugar que os humanos gostariam
de<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)> voltar algum dia!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>Yeah! You can do it! I’m sure of it! Just keep workin’ hard
and don’t give up, ya hear?
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>Só continue trabalhando duro e não
desista, ouviu?

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)>. I have a favor to
ask...
Could
I
borrow
you
for
a moment?
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Desculpe-me, <$cdef(27)>, tenho um favor
para lhe
pedir

emprestado
por
um
momento?

source: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>It has to do with my inability to generate electricity.
translation: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Tem a ver com minha incapacidade de gerar eletricidade.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>Sabe, eu tinha uma família pequena antes, alguns Pokémon
mais jovens que eram frágeis e fracos, então <$voicel(2,8)>eu tive o
hábito de compartilhar minha eletricidade com eles.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>Mas chegou um dia em que todos eles adoeceram de uma só
vez, e em resposta,<$voicel(2,6)> eu levei as coisas um pouco longe demais...

source:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.
translation:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu me empurrei para o limite absoluto tentando compartilhar
ainda mais eletricidade com eles e, bem... eu não
poderia <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> uma única faísca depois disso.

source:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
translation:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Se por acaso meus familiares também
voltaram para a área, eu ficaria muito
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>feliz em vê-los novamente.

source: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?
translation: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Nesse caso, posso pedir que procure Pichu<$cdef(27)> </color>primeiro?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu era um confiável, sempre procurando suportar os
fardos dos outros...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)>Mas<$cdef(27)> Pichu sempre ansiava por amor e atenção.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Mal posso esperar para dar banho neles com carinho quando
estivermos juntos!

<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>eletricidade no passado, você<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)> realmente cresceu

<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu! Um, um, while you were gone, <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>I

source:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>So, now you don’t have to work so hard to look after me!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Thank you ever so much for reuniting me with <$cdef(27)>Pichu,
<$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Toxel was such a kind, sweet child. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Always fretting over

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Toxel era uma criança gentil,<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)> sempre se preocupando
comigo, me preocupando muito...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>They used to be a bit of a loner, and I worry they are off

source:
<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>O-oh, OK... That’s good... <$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>I saw you looking really tired after
you’d given us electricity, and...

<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>O-oh, OK... isso é bom... eu<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)> vi você parecendo muito cansado depois
que você nos deu eletricidade, e...

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I promise I won’t tire you out like that ever again! I’m

<$voicel(2,5)>And they brought me so many presents from their little

<$comeff(5,4)><$facial(5,9)><$motion(5,807)><$voicel(5,5)>Dang, I just have SO many things I want to tell you! <$comeff(5,7)><$motion(5,802)><$voicel(5,8)>Argh!

<$comeff(5,4)><$facial(5,9)><$motion(5,807)><$voicel(5,5)>Puxa, eu só tenho tantas coisas que eu quero te dizer<$comeff(5,7)><$motion(5,802)><$voicel(5,8)>! Argh

<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee! Take all the time you need, <$cdef(27)>Dedenne. <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m glad to

<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,9)>Hehehe, yup, that’s me! Full blast, all day every day! And I

nem preciso mais roubar sua eletricidade para

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>For now, I just want them to keep seeing me as the

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Por enquanto, eu só quero que eles continuem me vendo como o
