translation: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Tem a ver com minha incapacidade de gerar eletricidade.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Quando acordei pela primeira vez, não conseguia lembrar a razão pela qual
minha eletricidade tinha desaparecido...

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Mas quanto mais tempo eu passo aqui, mais minha memória
voltou em pedacinhos, e eu me <$voicel(2,7)>lembrei de uma memória
importante de muito tempo atrás.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>Sabe, eu tinha uma família pequena antes, alguns Pokémon
mais jovens que eram frágeis e fracos, então <$voicel(2,8)>eu tive o
hábito de compartilhar minha eletricidade com eles.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>Mas chegou um dia em que todos eles adoeceram de uma só
vez, e em resposta,<$voicel(2,6)> eu levei as coisas um pouco longe demais...

source:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.
translation:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu me empurrei para o limite absoluto tentando compartilhar
ainda mais eletricidade com eles e, bem... eu não
poderia <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> uma única faísca depois disso.

source:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
translation:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Se por acaso meus familiares também
voltaram para a área, eu ficaria muito
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>feliz em vê-los novamente.

source: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?
translation: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Nesse caso, posso pedir que procure Pichu<$cdef(27)> </color>primeiro?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu era um confiável, sempre procurando suportar os
fardos dos outros...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)>Mas<$cdef(27)> Pichu sempre ansiava por amor e atenção.
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Mal posso esperar para dar banho neles com carinho quando
estivermos juntos!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>If you do find <$cdef(27)>Pichu, please bring them to me. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>I would be
in your debt.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>Se você <$cdef(27)>encontrar Pichu, por favor, <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>traga-
os para mim.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Quando acordei pela primeira vez, não conseguia lembrar a razão pela qual
minha eletricidade tinha desaparecido...

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Mas quanto mais tempo eu passo aqui, mais minha memória
voltou em pedacinhos, e eu me <$voicel(2,7)>lembrei de uma memória
importante de muito tempo atrás.

source:
<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* Great. Just great... I don’t wanna do anything...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,2)>I’m completely, utterly burned out...
translation:
<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,3)>timo, eu não quero fazer nada.
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,2)>Estou completamente, completamente queimado...

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh. Heya, <$cdef(27)>... Sorry you gotta see
me
like this.

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Fixin’ up that big ol’ building with you was so much fun...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>I’ve never worked on anything so exciting before!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Consertar aquele prédio grande com você foi tão divertido...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>que nunca trabalhei em nada tão emocionante antes!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I tell ya, I poured everything I had into it... Make no
mistake, it’s my masterpiece!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu te digo, eu derramei tudo o que tinha nele... não se
engane, é a minha obra-prima!

source:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But now, well... As you can see, I ain’t got nothin’ left
in me.
translation:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas agora, bem... como você pode ver, eu não tenho nada
em mim.

source:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,1)>I’ve tried imaginin’ other buildings, y’know? HUGE ones!
But none of ’em make me feel anything—like they’re not
even worth buildin’.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>What am I supposed to do now...?
translation:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,1)>Tentei imaginar outros prédios, sabe, enormes, mas
nenhum deles me faz sentir nada, como se nem valessem
a pena construir.
O<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)> que devo fazer agora?

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, that’s not a bad idea! Maybe a little travel will get me
outta this funk, eh?
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ei, isso não é uma má ideia, talvez uma pequena viagem me
tire desse funk, não é?

source:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Wallowin’ here feelin’ sorry for myself sure ain’t gonna fix
anything. Maybe it’s time I hit the road and did some
building sightseeing!
translation:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Wallowin está aqui sentindo pena de mim mesmo com certeza não vai
consertar nada. Talvez seja hora de eu pegar a estrada e fazer alguns
passeios de construção!

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Say, those <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers here and there all have a
different look to ’em, don’t they?
translation:
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Digamos, esses <$cdef(27)>Centros Pokémon aqui e ali todos têm
um olhar diferente para eles, não é?

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know, I’ve always wanted to see ’em for myself! Think
you could bring me to ’em, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Sabe, eu sempre quis vê-los por mim mesmo, acha
que poderia me levar a eles, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, and maybe you can share some fun memories while
we’re walkin’! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Can’t have a journey without stories to tell
along the way, eh?
translation:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, e talvez você possa compartilhar algumas memórias divertidas
enquanto caminhamos<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>! Não pode ter uma jornada sem histórias para contar ao
longo do caminho, hein?

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I’d love it if you could bring me to the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers
here and there!
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu adoraria se você pudesse me trazer para<$cdef(27)> os Centros
Pokémon aqui e ali!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>So, this is it, huh? Gotta say...this is WAY better than
I expected!
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Tenho que dizer... isso é muito melhor do que eu
esperava!

source: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>The perfect <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color> for a town full of nature!
translation: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>O <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon</color> perfeito para uma cidade cheia de natureza!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>And ya first met <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth here too, didn’t ya?
So this is where it all happened—where it all began!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>C’mon, now! How ’bout ya tell me some stories about
this place?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>E você conheceu o <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth aqui também, não foi?
Então foi aqui que tudo aconteceu, onde tudo começou!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Que tal me contar algumas histórias sobre
esse lugar?

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... You got everyone workin’ together to make it rain,
all so you could rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix?!
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>And then <$cdef(27)>Kyogre even made an appearance?
translation:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Você tem todo mundo trabalhando juntos para fazer chover, tudo
para que você possa resgatar <$cdef(27)>Onix?
E<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)> então <$cdef(27)>Kyogre fez uma aparição?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,9)>Wow! Now that’s what I call an epic tale! I seriously wish I
coulda been there to see it all myself. <$voicel(2,8)>I can just imagine
all the plants ’n’ everything coming back after the rain...
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,9)>Uau! Isso é o que eu chamo de um conto épico! Eu realmente
gostaria de ter estado lá para ver tudo <$voicel(2,8)>sozinho. Eu posso
imaginar todas as plantas 'n' tudo voltando depois da chuva...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>That reminds me... I once heard that the roofs on
buildings are for keepin’ out the rain!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso me lembra... uma vez ouvi dizer que os telhados
dos prédios são para manter a chuva fora!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe the humans built roofs so they could watch the rain
together ’n’ still stay dry...
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Talvez os humanos construíssem telhados para que pudessem assistir a
chuva juntos e ainda ficarem secos...

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! That’s gotta be the coolest thing I’ve
ever
seen!
Those
lights
shinin’
on
the
building
look
GREAT!
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>Essa deve ser a coisa mais legal
que
já vi,
aquelas
luzes
brilhando

no
prédio
estão
ótimas!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Speaking of lights...this is where you and <$cdef(27)>Peakychu met,
right, bud?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>How’d that go down? What actually happened?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Falando em luzes... É aqui que você e Peakychu <$cdef(27)>se conheceram,
certo, amigo?
O<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)> que realmente aconteceu?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Huh... So <$cdef(27)>Mosslax was nappin’ in the mountains, and you
lit up the whole town to wake ’em up?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Então <$cdef(27)>Mosslax estava cochilando nas montanhas, e você
acendeu a cidade inteira para acordá-los?

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>And then <$cdef(27)>Raikou showed up with a crash of lightning?!
Now THAT’s what I call a shocking entrance!
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>E então <$cdef(27)>Raikou apareceu com um estrondo de trovão?!
ISSO é que eu chamo de uma entrada eletrizante!

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Still, I feel a li’l bad for <$cdef(27)>Mosslax... Imagine losin’ your
home and <$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>gettin’ trapped in the mountains while you
were nappin’...
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Ainda assim, me sinto um pouco mal por <$cdef(27)>Mosslax... imagine perder
sua casa<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)> e ficar preso nas montanhas enquanto você
estava cochilando...

source:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>See, I got trapped too one time. I was doin’ a bit of cave
mining for materials <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>when the ceiling suddenly collapsed
on me! I thought I was done for!
translation:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Veja, eu fiquei preso também uma vez. Eu estava fazendo um
pouco de mineração <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>de cavernas para materiais quando o
teto de repente desmoronou em mim!

source:
<$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>If a kind <$cdef(27)>Diglett hadn’t gotten me outta there, I’d probably
still be lost in that cave...
translation:
<$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Se um tipo que <$cdef(27)>Diglett não tivesse me tirado de lá, eu provavelmente ainda
estaria perdido naquela caverna...

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>I can’t tell ya how relieved I was to get back to my own
pad, bud. Truly there’s no place like home.
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Não posso te dizer como fiquei aliviado por
voltar ao meu próprio lugar, amigo.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>I sure hope <$cdef(27)>Mosslax was able to find a place they could
call home...
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Espero que <$cdef(27)>Mosslax tenha encontrado um lugar que possam
chamar de lar...

source:
<$comeff(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Now this is a fine building if I ever saw one! <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>This alone
makes our whole trip worth it!
translation:
<$comeff(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Agora, este é um belo prédio se eu já vi um, só <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>isso faz
toda a nossa viagem valer a pena!

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>I bet lunch would taste even better if ya ate it while
admirin’ this marvelous structure...
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Aposto que o almoço seria ainda melhor se você comesse enquanto
admirava essa estrutura maravilhosa...

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,5)>Speaking of food, this is where you met <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente, right?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>What kind of shenanigans did you get up to here, bud?
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,5)>Por falar em comida, <$cdef(27)>foi aqui que
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)> conheceu o Chef Dente, certo?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Wait... You’re tellin’ me <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente was stuck in a barrel?
<$voicel(2,5)>And there was a <$cdef(27)>Rotom who got into a <$cdef(27)>CD player?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Espera, está me dizendo que<$cdef(27)> o Chef Dente estava preso em um
<$voicel(2,5)>barril e havia um <$cdef(27)>Rotom que entrou em um <$cdef(27)>Leitor de CD?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>You all worked together to set the <$cdef(27)>mood and get a proper
party goin’, <$voicel(2,8)>and then <$cdef(27)>Volcanion showed up?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)>Todos trabalharam juntos para definir<$cdef(27)> o clima e conseguir
uma festa adequada<$voicel(2,8)>, e então <$cdef(27)>Volcanion apareceu?

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Hah! Not where I expected this story to go at all!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Next time you throw one of your parties, make sure you
send an invite my way, bud.
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Não é onde eu esperava que essa história fosse!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Da próxima vez que você der uma de suas festas, certifique-se de enviar
um convite para o meu caminho, amigo.

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Settin’ the <$cdef(27)>mood for a party, eh... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Gotta say, putting up
decorations and stuff was a good move.
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Ajustando o <$cdef(27)>clima para uma festa, eh... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>tenho que dizer, colocar
decorações e coisas assim foi uma boa jogada.

source:
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Y’know, now that I think about it, maybe I’ve been too
focused on functionality. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Might be fun to make somethin’
and go hard on the aesthetic!
translation:
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Sabe, agora que penso sobre isso, talvez eu tenha sido
muito focado em funcionalidade.<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)> Pode ser divertido fazer alguma
coisa e ir duro com a estética!

source: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Well, thanks for tellin’ me a fun story, bud!
translation: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Bem, obrigado por me contar uma história divertida, amigo!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, I think we’ve seen all the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers out
there... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>We should head back to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>,
don’tcha think?
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, acho que vimos todos <$cdef(27)>os Pokémon Centros
lá fora<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>... devemos voltar <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>para
o, não acha?

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Seein’ as we stopped at all those different places, I think
it’s fittin’ if we wrap up our journey at a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Vendo que paramos em todos esses lugares diferentes, acho que
é adequado se encerrarmos nossa jornada em um <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon!

source: <oneline><$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>We should head back to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)></color>, eh?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Seein’ as we stopped by all those different places, I think
it’s fittin’ if we wrap up our journey at a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Vendo como paramos por todos esses lugares diferentes, acho que
é adequado se encerrarmos nossa jornada em um <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Even familiar places look fresh and new once you get back
from a journey, eh, bud?
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Mesmo lugares familiares parecem frescos e novos quando você volta
de uma viagem, não é, amigo?

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>That was just what I needed to shift gears and clear
my head!
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Era exatamente o que eu precisava para mudar de marcha e limpar
minha cabeça!

source: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>I think I was too caught up with makin’ things BIG!
translation: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu acho que eu estava muito envolvido em fazer coisas GRANDES!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>But seein’ the different sights, hearin’ your stories...
They made me realize somethin’.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>There’s just no place like home!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)>Mas vendo as diferentes visões, ouvindo suas histórias... eles
me fizeram perceber alguma coisa.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>Não há lugar como em casa!

source:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>So what I’m gonna make next is...a nice, warm, and
welcoming building where everyone can live together!
translation:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Então o que vou fazer a seguir é... um edifício agradável
, acolhedor e acolhedor onde todos possam viver juntos!

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Come on, let’s build one here! Not to worry, bud—I’ll help
ya out!
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Vamos, vamos construir um aqui, não se preocupe, amigo, eu vou
ajudá-lo!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! Oh, this is the best! I can’t wait to get
to work!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>Oh, isso é o melhor, mal posso esperar para começar a
trabalhar!

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>I need you to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> a <$cdef(27)><$bfull(30)>
somewhere around here, bud.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)>Don’t you worry, though—I’ll be right here, helpin’
you out!
translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Preciso de você para <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> um <$cdef(27)><$bfull(30)> em
algum lugar por aqui, amigo.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)>Não se preocupe, eu estarei aqui, te
ajudando!
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>Esse é o prédio que eu desenhei!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks, bud... Hearing you say that makes me glad I spent
time travelin’ and gettin’ my head sorted out!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Obrigado, amigo... ouvir você dizer que me faz feliz por ter
passado o tempo viajando e ter minha cabeça resolvida!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>But this isn’t the last of what I’ve got—I’m gonna keep
makin’ stuff that’ll shock and awe!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Mas este não é o último do que eu tenho - eu vou manter
fazendo 'coisas que vai chocar e pavor!

source: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>...Whoops. Almost forgot to give these to ya.
translation: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Quase esqueci de dar isso para você.

source:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>I just wanted to say thanks for helpin’ me out with
everything. Those kits’ll let you build what we just
finished making, <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>so put ’em to good use!
translation:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu só queria dizer obrigado por me ajudar com tudo
. Esses kits vão deixar você construir o que acabamos
de fazer, então <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>coloque-os em bom uso!

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>And gimme a call anytime when you need to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>
somethin’ else!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>E me ligue quando precisar de <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>
outra coisa!

source: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* I just don’t feel like doin’ anything...
translation: <$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu só não sinto vontade de fazer nada...

source: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ve got something weighin’ on my mind, y’know?
translation: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu tenho algo pesando na minha mente, sabe?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>I’d be real grateful if you could bring me to the
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>...
Y’know, whenever you got a spare moment.
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Ficaria muito grato se você pudesse me levar
ao <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>...
Sabe, sempre que tiver um momento livre.

source: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>D’you think you could bring me to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(4)></color>?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Bah... I’d hoped comin’ here would do the trick.
translation: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Bah... eu esperava que vir aqui fizesse o truque.

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>You remember that giant building we worked on, right?
We made it into the biggest, most amazing building ever!
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Lembra daquela construção gigante em que trabalhamos?
Fizemos dela a maior e mais incrível de todas!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I tell ya, I poured everything I had into it... Make no
mistake, it’s my masterpiece!
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu te digo, eu derramei tudo o que tinha nele... não se
engane, é a minha obra-prima!

source:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But now, well... As you can see, I ain’t got nothin’ left
in me.
translation:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas agora, bem... como você pode ver, eu não tenho nada
em mim.

source:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,1)>I’ve tried imaginin’ other buildings, y’know? HUGE ones!
But none of ’em make me feel anything—like they’re not
even worth buildin’.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>What am I supposed to do now...?
translation:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,1)>Tentei imaginar outros prédios, sabe, enormes, mas
nenhum deles me faz sentir nada, como se nem valessem
a pena construir.
O<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)> que devo fazer agora?

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, that’s not a bad idea! Maybe a little travel will get me
outta this funk, eh?
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ei, isso não é uma má ideia, talvez uma pequena viagem me
tire desse funk, não é?

source:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Wallowin’ here feelin’ sorry for myself sure ain’t gonna fix
anything. Maybe it’s time I hit the road and did some
building sightseeing!
translation:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Wallowin está aqui sentindo pena de mim mesmo com certeza não vai
consertar nada. Talvez seja hora de eu pegar a estrada e fazer alguns
passeios de construção!

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Say, those <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers here and there all have a
different look to ’em, don’t they?
translation:
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Digamos, esses <$cdef(27)>Centros Pokémon aqui e ali todos têm
um olhar diferente para eles, não é?

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know, I’ve always wanted to see ’em for myself! Think
you could bring me to ’em, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Sabe, eu sempre quis vê-los por mim mesmo, acha
que poderia me levar a eles, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, and maybe you can share some fun memories while
we’re walkin’! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Can’t have a journey without stories to tell
along the way, eh?
translation:
<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, e talvez você possa compartilhar algumas memórias divertidas
enquanto caminhamos<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>! Não pode ter uma jornada sem histórias para contar ao
longo do caminho, hein?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>So this goes over there... No, wait, maybe here...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,807)>Hmmmmmm...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Oh, hello, <$cdef(27)>! Sorry I didn’t
notice
you there!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,1)>I was so caught up in what I was doing—getting ready
to move!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Oh, olá, <$cdef(27)>, desculpe não ter
notado
você lá!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,1)>Eu estava tão envolvido no que eu estava fazendo, me preparando para
me mover!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>When I saw that building we found on the beach take off
into the sky...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Quando vi aquele prédio que encontramos na praia decolar
para o céu...

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>It made me think—or perhaps it’s just a gut feeling...
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>Isso me fez pensar, ou talvez seja apenas uma sensação...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>What if the humans did that too, and moved to a new
home up in the sky? It’s possible!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>E se os humanos fizessem isso também, e se
mudassem para uma nova casa no céu?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Looking back, I’ve lived in this cave for an awfully long
time. I thought maybe it was time <$voicel(1,4)>for me to make a new
home and move.<$motion(1,651)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Olhando para trás, vivi nesta caverna por um longo
tempo, pensei que talvez fosse hora<$voicel(1,4)> de fazer um novo
lar e me mudar.<$motion(1,651)>

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>But when I tried to think of what I should put where, my
thoughts kept going round and round until my head
was spinning!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Mas quando eu tentei pensar no que eu deveria colocar onde, meus
pensamentos continuaram girando até que minha cabeça
estivesse girando!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>But now I’ve had a fine idea! Would YOU make my new
home, <$cdef(27)>?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Mas agora eu tive uma boa ideia, você faria minha
nova casa, <$cdef(27)>?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,5)>You’ve helped so many Pokémon with their requests up
until now, I daresay you’re a homebuilding pro!
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>I’m sure you could make me a wonderful home!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,5)>Você ajudou tantos Pokémon com seus pedidos até agora, eu ouso
dizer que você é um profissional de construção de casas!
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Tenho certeza que você poderia me fazer uma casa maravilhosa!

source:
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)>Oho! So you’ll do it? That will be a tremendous help! But it
wouldn’t do to leave EVERYTHING to you, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)>so I’ll try to
think of what I’d like to have in my home...
translation:
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)>Isso vai ser uma grande ajuda, mas não adianta deixar
tudo para você, então vou tentar<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)> pensar no
que eu gostaria de ter em minha casa...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>Hmmm... Oh, of course! You know that wheelbarrow in
my cave?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>Sabe aquele carrinho de mão na minha
caverna?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>No home of mine would be complete without that! I most
certainly want it in my new home too.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Nenhuma casa seria completa sem isso, eu certamente
quero isso na minha nova casa também.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Now let’s see, what else would be nice? Hmmm...
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Agora vamos ver, o que mais seria bom?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>In that case, I’d like to have some human tools around!
They’re always exciting to look at!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>Nesse caso, eu gostaria de ter algumas ferramentas humanas ao redor
! Eles são sempre emocionantes de olhar!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,49)>And how about one of those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> you
sometimes show me?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>Put ’em all together and you get something like...this!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,49)>E que tal um daqueles <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> que você às
vezes me mostra?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>Coloque-os todos juntos e você terá algo como... isto!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’m not too picky about the exact placement. I’ll leave the
arrangement to you and your sense of style!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu não sou muito exigente sobre a colocação exata. Vou deixar
o arranjo para você e seu senso de estilo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, right. One last thing. You can put my new home
anywhere you want—as long as it’s not too far away.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>I’m not getting any younger, after all.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Você pode colocar minha nova casa onde
quiser, contanto que não esteja muito longe.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Não estou ficando mais jovem, afinal.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>I look forward to seeing what you create,
<$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Estou ansioso para ver o que você
cria, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Please do this old Pokémon a favor and make me a new
home to move into! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)>But not too far away.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Por favor, faça um favor a esse velho Pokémon e faça de mim
uma nova casa para morar<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)>, mas não muito longe.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! I hear you’ve finished
making my new home!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Ouvi<$cdef(27)> dizer que você acabou de
fazer minha nova casa!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>That makes me so happy! I look forward to living there!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Isso me deixa tão feliz, estou ansioso para morar lá!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I must say, this is a very fine home you’ve made for me!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Devo dizer, esta é uma casa muito boa que você fez para mim!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>The human tools are an excellent accent. I knew I could
trust your taste, <$cdef(27)>. It’s so...
<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)>s-so...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>As ferramentas humanas são um excelente sotaque, eu sabia que podia
confiar no seu gosto<$cdef(27)>, é tão... tão.
.<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)>. tão...

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Brrr... It’s...just a little chilly, I’m afraid. I think I might catch
a cold here...
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Brrr... Aqui está... um pouquinho frio demais. Acho que vou
acabar pegando um resfriado...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>I apologize for asking so much of you, but do you think
you could place a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> nearby?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>And don’t forget to set it alight!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Peço desculpas por pedir tanto de você,
mas você acha <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>que
poderia<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)> colocar um por perto?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Place a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> near my home and light it, please!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Coloque um <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> perto da minha casa e acenda-o, por favor!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Are you asking about my comfort level? I can assure you,
it couldn’t be better! <$voicel(1,6)>Now I can stay nice and warm.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Você está perguntando sobre o meu nível de conforto? Posso garantir que
não poderia ser melhor! Agora<$voicel(1,6)> eu posso ficar agradável e quente.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You know, this reminds me... Way back when we first met,
you prepared a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> for me, just like this.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sabe, isso me lembra que quando nos conhecemos,
você preparou um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> para mim, assim mesmo.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,14)>You and I have sure come a long way together.
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,14)>Você e eu certamente percorremos um longo caminho juntos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>Back when I was traveling on my own, searching for some
trace of what happened to the humans, <$voicel(1,6)>I never could
have imagined this...<$motion(1,654)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>Quando eu estava viajando sozinha, procurando algum
vestígio do que aconteceu com os humanos, <$voicel(1,6)>eu nunca poderia
ter imaginado isso...<$motion(1,654)>

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,668)>That the world could be restored so beautifully...or that
I’d make such a steadfast friend!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,668)>Que o mundo pudesse ser restaurado tão lindamente... ou
que eu fizesse um amigo tão firme!

source:

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>esse pedaço de grama alta é pequeno, mas eu gosto, adoro
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)> folhas, grama e coisas assim, e viver de muitas

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei, você sabe qual área tem mais sol por aqui? Eu amo

todos<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,13)> os dias, mas eu realmente não conheço esse lugar muito

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)>! Desculpe, essa é a nossa primeira reunião, não é? Meu

partir de agora!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Why, hello there! What a pleasure to meet you! Let me

<$voicel(1,7)>But still, wouldn’t you agree that this lovely, sweet scent

- você foi atraído pelo cheiro da minha flor!...

<$voicel(1,7)>ainda assim, você não concorda que esse aroma adorável e doce
me convém a um T
? <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>Se você quiser me encontrar, apenas siga seu nariz!

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)>Uh-oh! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Be careful around my tail—<$motion(1,803)>if you bump into it,

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)>My friend stepped on my tail once and got SUPER mad

<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)>Cuidado<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)> com a minha cauda, se você <$motion(1,803)>bater nela, você pode

amigo<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)> pisou na minha cauda uma vez e ficou super louco
porque estava tão quente...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>mesmo que eu seja aquele cuja cauda foi pisada! Doeu tanto que eu

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh? Did our eyes just meet? All right,<$motion(1,802)> let’s battle!
...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? Wait a sec. <$motion(1,805)>You LOOK like a human, but...<$voicel(1,10)>you’re
actually a Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Guess I’m not the only one who can do a pretty slick
human impression.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>But anyway, nice to meet another talented trickster!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh? Nossos olhos acabaram de se encontrar? <$motion(1,802)>Tudo bem, vamos

Pokémon<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>! Acho que não sou o único que pode fazer uma impressão
humana muito lisa. Mas
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>de qualquer maneira, bom conhecer outro talentoso trapaceiro!

source:

<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,807)>Strong Pokémon all have a special bond—we just “get”

<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>So, I was thinkin’ that if I could find someone as strong as

<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>W-Water Gun?! Maybe I spoke too soon...

Pokémon local forte, você teria? Pokémon
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,807)> forte todos têm um vínculo especial - nós apenas "
se pegamos" um ao
outro<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>, você sabe? Então, eu estava pensando que se eu pudesse

quanto<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)> eu, talvez pudéssemos nos tornar amigos! Sem <$lookat(0,1,1)><$motion(0,748)>ofensa
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>, mas você não parece tão forte para
mim<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>! W-Water Gun? Talvez eu tenha falado muito cedo...

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh wow, nice to meet you! Welcome to my place!

<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s a nice spot, though, right? Once I hide in my shell

Water Gun!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem-vindo à minha casa, ainda não é minha

<$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)>Whoa! This looks like a pretty sweet spot to live!
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re sayin’<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)> YOU made this place?
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>Wow, that’s super awesome! Thanks a bunch! I hope we
can play together here soon!
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)>OH! Y’know what’d be fun to do here? A little nighttime
hide-and-seek!
translation:
<$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)>Parece um lugar muito legal para se viver! Você está
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,8)>dizendo que você<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)> fez este lugar? Uau,
isso<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)> é super incrível! Obrigado! Espero que possamos brincar
juntos aqui em breve! Oh! Você
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)>sabe o que seria divertido fazer aqui? Um pouco de esconde-
esconde da noite!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Oy! Whaddaya doin’ on MY turf, huh?<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,7)> You better not try
anything funny—I’ll suck your blood if you mess with me!
...<$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>What? You’re tellin’ me YOU made this spot here?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Dang, that’s really something!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,7)>I shoulda known no one with a silly mug like yours could
be some kinda villain. My bad, pal.
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope we can put this behind us and be friends!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>É melhor não tentar nada engraçado.<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,7)> Vou chupar seu
sangue se você mexer comigo!... O quê? Você está me dizendo
que <$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>você fez esse lugar aqui? Droga, isso é realmente
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>algo! Eu não deveria saber que
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,7)>ninguém com uma caneca boba como a sua poderia ser algum
tipo de vilão. Meu amigo ruim. Espero
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)>que possamos deixar isso para trás e ser amigos!

source:
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>OUCH ouch ouch ouch owwww! Hey! Umm...that’s not
grass, y’know! <$comeff(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Ooooh, my aching head...
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)>Gosh, you really gave me a shock!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Whenever I get some sleep, everyone always thinks my
head is plain ol’ grass.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>So...uhm...if you’re ever plucking grass around here, just
be a little gentle, pretty please!
translation:
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Ei, hum, isso não é grama, sabe, ooooh, minha
cabeça dolorida<$comeff(1,2)><$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>... Deus, você realmente
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)> me deu um choque! Sempre que
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>durmo, todo mundo sempre acha que minha cabeça é
grama pura. Então... uhm.
.<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>. se você está sempre arrancando grama por aqui, seja
um pouco gentil, muito por favor!

source:
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>This place is so comfortable...it makes me want to drool...
<$comeff(0,5)><$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,816)>*sluuuuuurrrp*...<$motion(0,81)><$comeff(0,19)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>H-hey, you don’t look so good. Are you feeling OK?<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,1)><$motion(0,652)>
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)>What? An overwhelming stench? You can’t stand it?
I wonder what it could be. <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,19)><$comeff(0,19)>*sluuurrrp*...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I actually think...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)>something smells kinda nice.
translation:
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)>Este lugar é tão confortável... me faz querer babar...
<$comeff(0,5)><$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,816)>*sluuuurrrp*... H-hey<$motion(0,81)><$comeff(0,19)>,
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>você não parece tão bem. Você está se sentindo bem<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,1)><$motion(0,652)>?
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)>O quê? Um fedor esmagador? Você não aguenta? Eu
me pergunto o que poderia ser<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,19)><$comeff(0,19)>. *sluuurrrrp*
.<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>.. Hmm... Eu realmente acho<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)>... algo cheira meio legal.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hello there. Did you come to get a better look at these
petals of mine?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)>Let me impart something you may find useful—you’ve
heard the phrase, “Every rose has its thorn,” have
you not?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)>Well, there are some flowers that are best admired from
afar. You shouldn’t go approaching just anything.
<$voicel(1,7)>Oh! <$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>You needn’t worry about me—I’m a kind soul through
and through.
<$voicel(1,3)>And you don’t look particularly tasty, anyway.
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? Oh, nothing! Just talking to myself.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá. Você veio para ver melhor essas pétalas minhas?
Deixe-me transmitir
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)> algo que você pode achar útil. Você já ouviu a
frase, "Toda rosa tem seu espinho", não é? Bem,
há algumas
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)>flores que são melhor admiradas de longe. Você não deve
se aproximar de nada. Oh! Você não precisa se
<$voicel(1,7)>preocupar<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)> comigo - eu sou uma alma gentil por toda parte
. E você não
<$voicel(1,3)>olha, você não parece particularmente saboroso
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,6)>. Nada, só estou falando comigo mesma.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmm... None here, huh.
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh. Uh... Did you need me for something?<$motion(1,826)> Sorry I didn’t
notice you.
<$voicel(1,8)>I was just really focused on finding some berries.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Even though I JUST ate, I’m already sooo hungry.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)>Um... Do you think I’m gonna get bigger and bigger as I
grow up?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)>That would make me really happy...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmm... Nenhum aqui, não.
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh... Você precisa de mim para alguma <$motion(1,826)>coisa? Desculpe
eu não notei
<$voicel(1,8)>você. Eu estava realmente focado em encontrar algumas
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>frutas. Mesmo que eu apenas comeu, eu já estou com
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)>fome. Hum... Você acha que eu vou ficar cada vez maior
como eu
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)>crescer? Isso me faria muito feliz...

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hello. Hello. You also are looking for a place to live?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>I just found this location.
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>The humidity is high. It is very nice.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,13)>I will take it easy here for some time I think.

<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Wow, such a pretty light!
<$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>Oh, hello there! Nice to meet you!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Were you drawn to this light too? <$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>I bet we have so much
in common!
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,5)>Have you ever wondered why we’re drawn to shiny things
like this? <$voicel(1,7)>It’s weird, isn’t it?
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Que luz tão bonita! Oh, olá
<$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>, prazer em conhecê-lo! Você foi
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>atraído por essa luz também? Aposto <$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>que temos tanto em
comum! Você já
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,5)>se perguntou por que somos atraídos por coisas brilhantes
como esta<$voicel(1,7)>? É estranho, não é?

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Uwahhh! <$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$motion(1,817)>*flap flap flap*
<$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Ahem! My apologies. I was just a bit startled to be spoken
to so suddenly.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>If I may ask, by the way, how are you at handling poison?
<$comeff(0,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>You see, I seem to have flapped my wings rather
vigorously in my surprise, and whenever I do that,
I unfortunately tend to scatter poison scales.<$motion(0,81)><$comeff(0,19)>
<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Oh dear, you may be experiencing a short bout of
dizziness. I do apologize...
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Uwahhh! *<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$motion(1,817)> flap flap flap *
A-ham<$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>! Minhas desculpas. Eu estava um pouco assustado para ser falado
com tão de repente.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Se eu posso perguntar, a propósito, como você está em lidar com veneno
<$comeff(0,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>? Você vê, eu pareço ter batido minhas asas bastante
vigorosamente na minha surpresa, e sempre que eu faço isso,
infelizmente, eu tendem a espalhar escalas de veneno.<$motion(0,81)><$comeff(0,19)>
Oh<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)> querido, você pode estar experimentando um curto surto
de tontura. Eu peço desculpas...

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,817)>*POP*<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,1)>Oh, hi there! I hope I didn’t startle you.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>And, uh, maybe a weird time to say this, but...nice to
meet you!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)>You know, the dirt around here is so soft and moist...
It’s just perfect!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>I was thinking I might actually start living here. I hope we
can be friends!<$motion(0,181)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,817)>*POP*<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,1)>Ah, oi! Espero não ter assustado você.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>E, ahn, talvez seja uma hora estranha para dizer isso, mas... prazer
em conhecer você!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)>Sabe, a terra por aqui é tão macia e úmida...
É perfeita!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Estava pensando em começar a morar aqui. Espero que
possamos ser amigos!<$motion(0,181)>

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>Oof! <$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$comeff(1,5)>Ow, ow, ow...
<$voicel(1,8)>Sorry ’bout that! Probably didn’t feel too great for you
either, huh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,19)>Y’know, I recently bumped my head against a rock poppin’
myself outta the ground! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Glad I hit a Pokémon this time,
at least!
<$voicel(1,5)>But hey, us meetin’ like this... Sorta feels like fate, don’t
ya think?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Guess we’ll just have to be buds from now on!
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>Opa! <$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$comeff(1,5)>Ai, ai, ai...
<$voicel(1,8)>Foi mal! Acho que a trombada não foi muito
agradável para você também, né?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,19)>Outro dia, bati a cabeça numa pedra quando fui sair
do chão! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Pelo menos, desta vez
foi num Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,5)>Mas, ei, a gente se encontrar assim... Parece coisa
do destino, né?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Acho que vamos ter que ser amigos de agora em diante!

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,13)>Meow?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Meow me—ack, where’d it go?! <$comeff(1,4)>You gotta be kitten me!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Hey, you with the face! Have you seen my treasure?!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,46)>I coulda sworn it rolled this way...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Aw, fine. Guess I’ve gotta look for a NEW treasure now.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>If you’re lucky, maybe I’ll let you help me out!
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,13)>Meow?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Meow meack, onde ele foi?! Você <$comeff(1,4)>tem que ser gatinho me! Ei
,<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)> você com o rosto! Você viu meu tesouro?! Eu poderia
jurar<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,46)> que rolou desta forma... Ah, tudo bem
.<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)> Acho que eu tenho que procurar um novo tesouro agora. Se
você<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)> tiver sorte, talvez eu vou deixar você me ajudar!

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>Who do we have here? I’ve not seen your face before.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>In any case, it’s a pleasure to meet you. Allow me to
extend my warmest greetings.<$motion(1,807)>
<$voicel(1,9)>Well? How did you like my elegant bow?<$motion(0,215)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Goodness, what a graceful little greeting! Color
me impressed.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,21)>I must say, I’m slightly saddened that your bow was more
elegant than mine...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,13)> But I won’t hold it against you.
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>Quem temos aqui? Eu não vi seu rosto antes. Em qualquer
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)> caso, é um prazer conhecê-lo. Permita-me estender
minhas saudações mais calorosas<$motion(1,807)>
.<$voicel(1,9)> Bem? Como você gostou do meu arco <$motion(0,215)>
elegante<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>? Bondade, que saudação graciosa! Cor me
impressionou. Devo
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,21)>dizer, estou um pouco triste que seu arco foi mais elegante
do que o meu... Mas<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,13)> eu não vou segurar contra você.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,1)>Hmmm... What did I do yesterday? I can’t remember.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Oh, it’s you.<$motion(1,802)> Ummm... We’re friends...right?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oops! Never mind. Uh... It’s nice to meet you, then!<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)> Let’s
be friends from now on!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,1)>O que eu fiz ontem? Não me lembro. Oh, é você.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Hummm... somos <$motion(1,802)>amigos... certo? Ops! Não
importa<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>. ahn... É um prazer conhecê-lo, então! Vamos <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)>ser
amigos a partir de agora!

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Whoo! This place is great! Nice and quiet—and the water
is wicked gorgeous!
<$voicel(1,8)>Say, bud! Wanna join me for a little swimming?
<$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,6)>...What?! You CAN’T swim?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>With those slick hands and feet of yours, I figured you’d
be a great swimmer! Huh...
translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Este lugar é ótimo! Bom e tranquilo - e a água é linda!
Diga, amigo! Quer
se<$voicel(1,8)> juntar a mim para um pouco de natação?...O quê
<$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,6)>? Você não pode nadar? Com
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>essas mãos e pés lisos de seu, eu imaginei que você seria
um grande nadador! Hum...

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Ruff! Ruff ruff!<$motion(0,82)><$comeff(0,5)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Oh, whoops, sorry. Did I scare you?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,5)>I thought you’d come to steal my home...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>But now that I look at you, I can tell you’re not that kind
of Pokémon. <$voicel(1,8)>My mistake!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>I hope you’ll be my friend!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Au! Au, au!<$motion(0,82)><$comeff(0,5)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Ah, opa, desculpe. Assustei você?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,5)>Pensei que tivesse vindo roubar minha casa...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>Mas agora percebo que você não é esse tipo
de Pokémon. <$voicel(1,8)>Foi engano meu!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>Espero que possamos ser amigos!

source:
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,23)><$voicel(1,3)>*yawn* My body’s gotten all stiff...
<$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>GRAAAWR!
<$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh! Did I scare you? Sorry ’bout that, bud.

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Heyyy. Hey yooouuu! Listen to my good idea.
<$comeff(1,13)>... ...<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)> ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>Uhhh... What was it again?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Ohhh well. Anyway, hope to see you around...

<$comeff(1,13)>ideia, <$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)>o
que<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)> foi de novo, ohhhh
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>, bem, espero te ver por aí...

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Ah. It is a human. I must emit my friendship waves.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>*beep beep* Hello. Hello. Konnichiwa. Merci. Xie xie.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>reação não é o que eu esperava. O que eu faço. O <$motion(0,182)>que

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,5)>*bzzzt bzzzt* Greetings.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>I do look like just three Magnemite sticking together,
yes?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Well, we are just sticking together. Yes.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Actually, it requires much skill to work together as three.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>So I think we too can be good friends. We and you.
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, estamos apenas
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)> nos mantendo juntos. Sim, na verdade,
requer
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>muita habilidade para trabalhar
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>juntos como três. Então eu acho que nós também
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)> podemos ser bons amigos. Nós e você.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? An intruder? In my territory?! Yooo! Are you after
my leek?!?!
<$comeff(1,22)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>My faithful leek’s been with me for years! There’s NO WAY
I’ll hand it over without a fight! En garde ’n’ stuff, yo!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Oh. You’re, uh...not here to steal my leek? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>My bad, yo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Phew. Well, that’s a relief. But I’m feelin’ kinda hungry
after all that excitement...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>... ... ...
Yo, this leek’s lookin’ super tasty right now...
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Hã? Um intruso? No meu território?! Yooo
! Você
<$comeff(1,22)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>está atrás do meu alho-poró?! Minhas alho-
poró estão comigo há anos! Não há nenhuma
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>maneira que
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)> eu vou entregá-lo sem uma luta!<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)> En garde
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)> 'n' coisas, cara!............ Oh. Você está
, ahn... não está aqui
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)> para
roubar meu alho-porro? Meu mau... cara!

source:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow, a human! Yaaay! ♪ I’m gonna follow it!<$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Gah! Whaaat? You’re just a Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Aw, that’s too bad. If you were a human, I figured you’d
be carrying a ton of tasty trash...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
Huh?<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)> You’re searching for humans too?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, neat! Well, if I can do anything to help, let me know.
translation:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Uau, um humano! Obaaa! Eu vou segui-lo! Gah! O quêêê<$motion(0,182)>?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Você é apenas um Pokémon. Ah, isso é muito
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>ruim. Se você fosse um humano, eu imaginei que você estaria carregando
uma tonelada de lixo saboroso... hein? <$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
Você <$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)>está procurando por seres humanos também?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, limpo! Bem, se eu puder fazer alguma coisa para ajudar, me avise.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh heyyy. I have a question for you.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you tell me the diiirtiest place around here?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>It used to be sooo much easier to find sludge and sewage
back in the day.
<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>But it looks like there’s wayyy less of it these days.
That’s a seeerious environmental issue, don’t you think?
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu tenho uma pergunta para você
,<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)> poderia me dizer o lugar mais diiertioso por
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)> aqui, costumava ser muito mais fácil encontrar
lama e esgoto
no<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)> dia, mas parece que há menos coisas nos dias
de hoje, isso é uma questão ambiental, não acha?

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, I bet living here would be a real gas. Plus, there’s
no way the wind can get to me!
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s not that I’m scared or anything—I’m just not a fan of
strong gusts of wind <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>since I always get blown away! Hehe!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Aposto que viver aqui seria um gás de verdade, e não há
como o vento me atingir, não é
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>que eu esteja com medo ou algo assim, só não sou fã de
fortes rajadas de vento<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>, já que sempre fico impressionado.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey there, nice to meet you. It’s so dark and quiet here...
I like it.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Now all it needs is some unsuspecting humans to pass by
every once in a while.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>I like to sneak up and tap ’em on the shoulder, then watch
’em scream and scatter. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s pretty fun.

<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? This human’s got a weird shadow. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>I can’t figure out
how to slip into it...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa! You’re not a human?! <$motion(0,181)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s an awesome
transformation, bud!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>But man, I can’t find a single human around here. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Where
the heck did they all go?
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Esse ser humano tem uma sombra estranha. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>Não consigo descobrir
como entrar nela. Você <$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,182)>
não<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)> é um ser humano? Isso é uma<$motion(0,181)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)> transformação
incrível, amigo! Mas cara,
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>eu não consigo encontrar um único ser humano por aqui. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Para
onde diabos todos eles foram?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Oh? You there... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re quite the digger, aren’t ya?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)>You may not be the same type as me, but I bet you can dig
in the ground freely <$voicel(1,5)>and change the terrain as you like...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I know you have that potential, bud. I can see it in ya!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Você é o escavador<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>, não é? Você pode não ser do mesmo
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)> tipo que eu, mas aposto que você pode cavar no chão
livremente e mudar o <$voicel(1,5)>terreno como quiser... Eu sei que você
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)> tem esse potencial, amigo. Eu posso ver isso em você!

source:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, uh... N-nice to meet you. <$comeff(1,6)>You’re...not a human?
You’re a Pokémon? <$motion(0,40)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, thank goodness!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’see, when humans were around, they’d always come
poke me with stuff, thinking I was a Poké Ball...
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>They’d end up getting zapped, and I always felt so bad
for them...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>W-well, I hope you and I can be friends, anyway!
Bzzzzzzrt...
translation:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, ahn... não é bom conhecê-lo. Você<$comeff(1,6)> não é... um ser humano?
Você é um Pokémon? Oh<$motion(0,40)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>, graças a Deus! Você!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Quando os humanos estavam por perto, eles sempre vinham me
cutucar com coisas, pensando que eu era um Poké Ball... Eles
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>acabariam ficando zapados, e eu sempre me senti tão mal por eles
... W-bem, eu
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>espero que você e eu possamos ser amigos, de qualquer maneira
! Bzzzzrt...

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Yooo, what a great place!
<$voicel(1,7)>Huh?! You made this? <$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>That’s so awesome! Respect, yo!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll do my best to not explode while I live here!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Yooo, que ótimo lugar! Você
<$voicel(1,7)> fez isso? Isso é tão <$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>incrível! Respeito, cara! Farei o
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>meu melhor para não explodir enquanto eu moro aqui!

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Huh? What’s your deal? ...Hang on a sec!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>OK, folks: any thoughts on this funky-lookin’ rando?
translation: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Certo, pessoal, algum pensamento sobre esse rando de aparência engraçada?

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>I say we act cool and be nice. I mean, our visitor here
doesn’t seem like a bad egg.
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Digo que agimos bem e somos legais, quero dizer, nosso visitante
aqui não parece um ovo ruim.

source: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>All right, thanks for waiting! Let’s be friends!

<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey. Heyyyy. You there. Can you weigh in on something
for us reeeaaal quick?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Sooo here’s the thing. I’m sleepy right now and would
love a nice naaap...
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei. Eiii. Você aí. Pode dar uma opinião
para a gente bem rapidiiinho?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>É o seguinte. Estou com sono agora e adoraria
tirar uma soneeeca...

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>But I want to eat some berries...
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>And I want to go for a waaalk...
translation: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>E eu quero ir para um waaalk...

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sooo uh... Can you think of some way we can take a nap
and eat and go on a walk all at the same tiiime?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Você pode pensar em alguma maneira de tirar uma
soneca e comer e ir dar uma volta no mesmo tiime?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$comeff(1,5)>Ack! A human!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>Wait, maybe not? Are you...a Pokémon? Phew! OK, guess
I’m safe for now.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)>This place looks nice ’n’ quiet, so I think I’ll stay around
here for a while! <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Let’s be friends, OK?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>... ... ...
Mom prob’ly woulda liked a place like this too...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$comeff(1,5)>Ack! Um humano!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>Espere, talvez não? Você é... um Pokémon? Ufa! Ok, acho que
estou seguro por
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)>enquanto. Este lugar parece bom 'n' quieto, então eu acho que vou
ficar aqui por um tempo<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>! Vamos ser amigos, OK?.
.<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>............
. Mãe prob'ly gostaria de um lugar como este também...

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hello there. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>May I ask why you’re shaped like a human?<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Ah, so you’re searching for humans, are you?
Fascinating.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,20)>If there’s any way I can be of assistance, I’d be happy
to help.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Being unable to meet your loved ones must be terribly
sad, after all.
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Olá. É um prazer conhecê-lo. Posso perguntar por que
você<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)> tem a forma de um ser humano? Ah, então <$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>você está procurando por humanos, está? Fascinante
. Se há
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,20)>alguma maneira de eu ajudar, eu ficaria feliz em ajudar.
Ser incapaz
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>de conhecer seus entes queridos deve ser terrivelmente
triste, afinal.

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,132)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh! You all right there? Sure am sorry if I startled ya!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m always practicin’ my kicks every chance I get—<$comeff(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>watch
yerself when walkin’ through this area!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Low kick! Hiyah! <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Mid kick! Hiyah!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>And a high kick! Hiyah!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, indeed! My kicks are snappy again today! Hahahaaa!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>HIAAA!<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,132)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah! Está tudo bem? Desculpe se te assustei!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Estou sempre praticando meus chutes sempre que posso—<$comeff(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>cuidado
ao passar por esta área!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Chute baixo! Hia! <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Chute médio! Hia!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>E um chute alto! Hia!
