<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>I am sorry for the sudden yelling.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>There are sometimes Pokémon who get poisoned badly by

<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>Eu sou bonitinho
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,662)><$comeff(1,22)><$textsize(2)>, é a verdade, mas não

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>muito por gritar, às vezes

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Hm. You do not appear to be here for the purpose of
disturbing my territory.
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>That is good. I am happy. ♪
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)>I have decided. I will live here from today. Let us
be friends.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>But use caution when getting close to me.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,10)>My body chips with the slightest provocation. It spreads

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Não parece estar aqui com o propósito de perturbar
meu território. Isso é
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>bom. Estou feliz. Eu decidi
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)>. Eu vou viver aqui a partir de hoje. Vamos ser
amigos. Mas
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>tenha cuidado ao chegar perto de mim. Meu
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,10)>corpo se encaixa com a menor provocação. Isso espalha
veneno. Isso é perigoso.

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey! Nice to meet ya—

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,10)>Gaaah! I’ve been defeated! It’s all going dark...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>Eh, whatever! You don’t seem like a bad Pokémon or

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Er, when I’m not playing dead, that is!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei! Prazer em conhecê-lo
-<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)> quero dizer, espere,
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,10)>não! Gaaah! Eu fui derrotado! Está tudo ficando escuro...

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,635)><$comeff(1,6)>te enganando, não? Eu acho que eu não posso jogar morto uma vez que

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>o que quer! Você não parece um Pokémon ruim ou qualquer

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Er, quando eu não estou jogando morto, isso é!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)>Time to...play dead!

<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Ha! You’re pretty sharp, blobhead!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)>Hora de... Jogar morto!....

<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>fingindo? Ha! Você é muito afiado, cabeça de bolha
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>! Eu odiaria ser seu inimigo... então vamos ser amigos em vez disso!

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hey there.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>I’m searching for my captain. Have you seen anyone who
looks kinda like me around here?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmm...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,635)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>I hope we can meet up again soon. Feels so weird when
my crew’s not around.
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oi!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Estou procurando meu capitão. Você viu alguém parecido comigo
por aqui?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,634)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmm...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,635)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Espero que a gente se encontre de novo em breve. É estranho quando
minha tripulação não está por perto.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hi. That’s an unusual look...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>You look like one of those, uh—what are they called?
Uh... Uhhh...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)>Oh, I remember: humans! You look like a human. Hee hee,
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>thanks for waiting while I tried to remember.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>You’re really nice. As long as I’m with you, I feel like
everything’s gonna work out fine from now on. ♪

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>parece um daqueles, ahn-como eles são chamados? Uhhh.
.. Oh, eu me
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)>lembro: humanos! Você parece um ser humano. Hee hee hee,
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>obrigado por esperar enquanto eu tentei lembrar.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Você é muito bom. Contanto que eu esteja com você, eu sinto
que tudo vai funcionar bem a partir de agora.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hey! Nice to meetcha!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)>I know my head LOOKS a little scary... <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>But I’m honestly not

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,14)>Peeek...aaa...

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,14)>Cadêêê...

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)>Ahaha, PEGUEI VOCÊ!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)>Gimmi?! Yo! You found me! You’re pretty good at treasure
hunting, huh?!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>But, uh, sorry... I can’t give ya my coin... <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,39)>This here’s my

<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I can totally help ya out with other stuff, though! Definitely

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>não posso te dar minha moeda... Este é o meu<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,39)> tesouro! Eu
posso te
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>ajudar com outras coisas, no entanto! Definitivamente me dê

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmmmmm? I’m all hard and tough, but you’re all
soft and squuuiiishy...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>It’s kinda neat that we’re so diiifferent like that. I hope we
can be friiieeends.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>My body’s real shiny, you knooow? So I might be kinda
dazzling to look at, <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>and it would be suuuper cool if you
could just ignore that.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmmmmm? Eu sou todo duro e duro, mas você é todo
macio e squuuiiishy... É
meio<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)> legal que somos tão diferentes assim. Espero que possamos ser

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>muito brilhante, você sabe? Então eu poderia ser um pouco

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>desculpe perguntar! É só, se as coisas estão sujas ao meu redor, é muito

<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,8)>maneira, hum... Prazer em conhecê-lo! Se
você<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)> ficar todo empoeirado, eu posso te dar um tapinha com minhas asas!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>For example... Hmmm... Oh! If you’re ever having trouble

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,816)>I can wrap you up in my wings and sing you a lullaby! ♪

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>! Estou cor-de-rosa para vê-la, sabe? Faz tanto tempo que

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>! Por exemplo... Hmmm... Oh! Se você está tendo problemas

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,816)>posso envolvê-la em minhas asas e cantar uma canção de ninar!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,53)>! Eu te digo, estar aqui me faz sentir como se eu pudesse subir no

como<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)> eu posso fazer qualquer coisa, você apenas me avisa se alguma

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,5)>! Sim, eu acho que vou ficar feliz em chamar isso de minha

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Yo yo yooo! You vibin’, friend? I know I sure am! And you
know why? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>It’s ’cause I found this totally SWEET home!<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Say WHAAAT?! You MADE this place?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>E aí, amigo, curtindo? Eu estou curtindo, com certeza! E sabe
por quê? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Porque encontrei uma casa incrível!<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>O QUÊ?! Foi você que construiu este lugar?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)>You’re TOO GOOD, yo! That makes the vibes here
even better!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>So we’re basically best friends now, yeah?! Let’s party
right, twin—WOOO!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)>Isso torna as vibrações aqui ainda
melhores,
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>então somos basicamente melhores amigos
agora, certo?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Whoa! It’s been a minute since I’ve seen another Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I’ve been all alone here for a while.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>I might wanna follow you outta here <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,817)>and explore the wider
world! So I don’t lose my edge, y’know?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Já faz um minuto que não vejo outro Pokémon, estou
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>sozinho aqui há algum tempo, talvez
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,806)> queira te seguir daqui e explorar<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,817)> o mundo todo,
então não perco minha vantagem, sabe?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)>*yaaawn* Dang—what a great nap!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hey! Who are you? You need me for somethin’?<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Huh? You wanna be my friend?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ahaha! HECK YEAH! Let’s be buddies! Come chat with me
whenever you have time!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)>Ah, quem é você? Você precisa
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)> de mim para alguma coisa? Você quer ser<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>meu amigo? Ahaha! Caramba Sim
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>! Vamos ser amigos! Venha conversar comigo
sempre que tiver tempo!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>... ... ...
Hm. I did not expect any visitors here.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I’ve been on my own here for quite some time... I suppose
this is as good an opportunity as any to venture outside.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>And I’d like to learn more about you as well.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu não
esperava nenhum visitante aqui, eu estive
aqui<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> por um bom tempo, acho que esta é uma oportunidade tão
boa quanto qualquer outra para me aventurar lá fora, e eu
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>gostaria de aprender mais sobre você também.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Whoa, whoa, whoa! What’s with the merrymakin’ you’ve
got goin’ on here?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>A par...ty? You get all your buds together to have a good
time? <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>That sounds pretty awesome!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Hey, whaddya say to us bein’ buds? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>I wanna get in on
these parties of yours too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Opa, opa, opa! Que festa é essa que está rolando por
aqui?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Uma fes...ta? Vocês juntam todos os amigos para se divertir
juntos? <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Que incrível!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Ei, que tal virarmos amigos? <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Também quero participar
dessas festas!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>I came ’cause I heard the bell ringin’, but I wasn’t expectin’
to find a Pokémon. You...are a Pokémon, aren’t ya?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Anyway, nice to meet ya!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>I usually fly around this area, so if you ever wanna chat,
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>just ring that bell again!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Eu vim porque ouvi o sino tocar, mas não esperava encontrar um
Pokémon. Você... é um Pokémon, não é? De qualquer
forma<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>, prazer em conhecê-lo!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Eu costumo voar por essa área, então se você quiser conversar
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>, toque o sino novamente!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,666)>That bell has SUCH a lovely and soothing tone...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>AND I’ve met a new Pokémon! Oh, today IS a good day!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I’ll come visit again when I hear that bell, so I hope we’ll
get along!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,666)>Esse sino tem um tom tão adorável e reconfortante...
E<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)> eu conheci um novo Pokémon! Oh, hoje é um bom dia! Eu vou
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)> visitar novamente quando ouvir esse sino, então espero que nos
daremos bem!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Howdy! Sure is nice runnin’ into you again. It’s been a
while, huh?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I sometimes hear y’all laughin’ it up on the surface while
I’m restin’ underwater. <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Always sounds like a good time!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)>Can’t have too many good times, if ya ask me! Keep ’em
comin’, ya hear?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Olá! É bom correr para você de novo. Já faz um tempo,
não é? Às vezes
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>ouço vocês rindo na superfície enquanto estou descansando
debaixo d'água. Sempre <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>parece um bom momento! Não pode
ter<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)> muitos bons momentos, se me perguntarem! Mantenha-os
chegando, ouviu?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I got woken from a deep sleep by a buncha laughter on
the surface... That was y’all, wasn’t it?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha! Sure sounded like y’all were havin’ a good time!
It’s infectious, really! Bet I’ll have fun dreams tonight!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Keep up the good times, ya hear? I’d love to hear y’all’s
voices again. I’ll be listenin’ fer yer merrymakin’!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Acordei de um sono profundo com as risadas de vocês aqui em cima... Eram vocês, não eram?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha! Deu para ouvir que vocês estavam se divertindo! É contagiante! Aposto que vou ter sonhos divertidos esta noite!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Continuem se divertindo, ouviram? Adoraria ouvir suas vozes de novo. Vou ficar atento à festa!

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Shell, shell, shelllll... I’m so relaxed... <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>This place is perfect
for hiding!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, hey! Wanna chill here together? <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Shell, shelllll...

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoooaaa! Almost bumped into somethin’ again!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Phew. Y’see, I jus’ bumped into a big boulder a minute ago
’n’ sent it flyin’! <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,6)>Glad I didn’t do that to you too!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>This big ol’ shell o’ mine gets in the way from time to time,
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>but I hope you’ll lemme hang around anyhow! Gwahaha!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hey! Nice to meetcha! The coral here is so nice and round,
don’tcha think?
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Hiding in spots like this is so calming... <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, we should
relax here together, if you wanna!

<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, whoa, WHOA! You tryin’ to trash my turf?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,7)>Bring it on! You see these spikes? They sting real bad
when I stick ’em—
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>...Say what? You made this sweet spot? <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Dang, you shoulda
opened with that, pal!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ve decided I’m gonna live here from now on, so swim on
by sometime!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa! A human! Time to play! <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,6)>*chomp*
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Huh? I missed... <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Hold up—you’re <$cdef(27)>Ditto!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Sorry for trying to bite you.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>I just can’t help it when I see someone moving around
like that. <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>But I’ll be careful from now on!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Whoa, this spot’s super spacious! <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>The water’s crystal clear,
too. Dang, this rules!<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$facial(1,1)>
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, you! What’s your deal, pal? You live around here?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Great—let’s go swimming together! Nothin’ beats a
good swim!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Wow! You’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, eh? What’re ya doin’ out here?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>And lookin’ like a human, no less!<$comeff(0,14)><$motion(0,824)><$comcan(0)><$motion(0,652)>
<$emotion(1,16)><$voicel(1,8)>What’s that, now? You’re gettin’ this place all spruced up?<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>
Gwahaha! Ain’t you a funny li’l Pokémon!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Then it’s ’cause of yer hard work that I managed to snag
me this mighty fine home! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Thank ya kindly, <$cdef(27)>Ditto!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Whoa, hey! Nice to meet you.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>This place is neat, huh? I feel like my, y’know, light is
shining brighter than usual. <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Means I can see you clearly.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>All right... I memorized exactly how you, uh, look, so...
When I see you around, I’ll know who you are!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Why, hello there! How nice to meet you, sweetie!
I suppose you must have been drawn here by my light?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee. It’s so bright and lovely, isn’t it? It gives off a
wonderful shine everywhere I go!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,5)>If you’re ever hoping for a chat with me, hon, just look for
my light!

<$comeff(1,16)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>*yawn* Now, let’s see. What is this place? It certainly has
a pleasant atmosphere.<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>...What’s that?! You arranged this place for me? <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>That’s
very generous. It’s quite comfortable.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Are you planning to work on other places as well? If so, I’d
be pleased to help. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>I seem to have slept for a long time,
so I’m eager for some physical activity.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Hehehe... I just knew you’d show up! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>My whisker radar was
getting all twitchy.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I was gonna run away if you were scary, but your face looks
kinda droopy and soft. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I think you’re probably friendly!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I hope we can be friends!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,5)><$textsize(2)>Scaaaaaahhh!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,2)>This is myyy spot. <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,4)>Go awayyy.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>Well, that’s what I would nooormally say...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>But this spot is reeeaaally nice, so I’m in a good mood.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll make a special exception just for you... Come see me
whenever you waaant.

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,1)>*pant pant*...
Um, hi! Nice to meetcha!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,3)>Sorry, I was just practicing my moves, so I’m all tired out...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>But this place is really comfy and perfect for a rest.
... ... ...
... ... ...<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>OK! I got a little rest!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>Now it’s time for a bit more practice! ♪

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Briooo! Brioooooo! ♪ Nice to meet you! ♪
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Wanna dance together?<$motion(0,250)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>WHOA! Such unique, floppy movement! <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>I’m totally
OBSESSED with the way you dance!
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>Hehe, that’s so fun! I’ll practice it a bunch!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Thanks for teaching me your sweet moves. In return, I’ll
help you out with anything. Just lemme know!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)>Laaa la la laaa... ♪<$lookat(1,1,0)><$facial(1,1)>
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, hello there. Pleasure to meet you.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d not realized my song had attracted such an adorable
audience!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Once I found this cozy little spot, I couldn’t help but sing!
Soon enough, I was completely swept up in my song.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Now then, what shall I sing about next?
<$voicel(1,6)>The stunning blue sky? The clear ocean water? <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Why, I can
hardly choose!

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh hey! I’m here! Inside the apple! <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>It gets mistaken for a
regular apple all the time, and it always makes me sad...
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>But I’m so happy you found me today! ♪

<$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,7)>Ahhh! You scared me, yo! It’s been so long since I saw any
humans, so...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hold on a sec... Now that I got a good look at you, you’re
...a Pokémon?!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>You had me so surprised thinkin’ I’d seen a human, I curled
right up into a li’l apple ball!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, heyyy. Nice to meet you...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Did my yummy scent bring you here, too?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Everyone says I smell sweet and yummyyyy...
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>I just looove eating sweet stuff. Maybe that’s why I smell
this way...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Nice to meet you. You’re...a Pokémon, right?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Yeah, a Pokémon that kinda looks like a human just struck
up a conversation.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicetonevar(1,7)>Huh, sounds interesting! Guess I’ll say hi, too.
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicetonevar(1,9)>Hey there, pal! Greetings from inside this apple! Thanks
for coming to chat with us!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>That was the owner of the tail you see sticking out. I’m the
face you see here. The two of us are like peas in a pod.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Or...wyrms in an apple, I guess.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Anyway, hope we can all be friends.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow! You’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, aren’t ya? That’s one heck of a
transformation!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,644)><$voicel(1,8)>Hey! Lemme get a look too... Wow! You’re right!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,4)>Hm. They’re the spittin’ image of a human fer sure.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,2)>Think I’ve got ’em beat in the looks department, though.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! You’ll have to excuse the ruckus! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Hope we can
all be good friends!

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Whoa! You, uh...you wanna talk to ME?!<$motion(0,40)>
<$comeff(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Yooo... Not many people wanna talk to me. <$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>You must be,
like, a suuuper nice Pokémon or somethin’!
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>It’d be real cool if we could be friends or whatever!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>...Hm? Did I catch your eye, little one?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m not surprised. Others are often quite entranced by
my beauty.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>But I must say that your gentle smile is also quite lovely.

<$voicel(1,3)>Why don’t you go see what <$cdef(27)>

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Este lugar já mudou tanto, que mal é
reconhecível com tantos mais Pokémon aqui!
<$voicel(1,5)>Você pode querer considerar explorar outros lugares além do
portão da área.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)>You might meet other Pokémon you can’t find around here!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)>Você pode encontrar outros Pokémon que você não pode encontrar por aqui!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>Of course there’s nothing wrong with continuing to
improve THIS area! <$voicel(1,6)>I’m sure the Pokémon here would
be thrilled.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>You’re free to do as you please! Go ahead and try plenty
of different things!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>É claro que não há nada de errado em continuar a melhorar
esta área! Tenho <$voicel(1,6)>certeza que os Pokémon aqui ficariam
emocionados.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Você é livre para fazer o que quiser, vá em frente e tente
muitas coisas diferentes.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, there was that odd building on the beach...
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>You remember, don’t you? On the beach near the cave
where you and I first met.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, havia aquele prédio estranho na praia...
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>Na praia perto da caverna onde você e
eu nos conhecemos.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>I’m sure that was made by humans. <$voicel(1,7)>But it seemed a bit
different from most ordinary buildings.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Tenho certeza que foi feito por humanos<$voicel(1,7)>, mas parecia um pouco
diferente da maioria dos edifícios comuns.

source:
<$voicel(1,6)>If we investigate that building on the beach...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d wager there’s a chance we could find a clue about what
happened to the humans!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)>Se investigarmos o prédio na praia...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que há uma chance de encontrarmos uma pista sobre o que
aconteceu com os humanos!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... At this point, <$voicel(1,4)>I don’t think there’s much more
advice I can give you.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Neste momento, acho que<$voicel(1,4)> não há muito mais conselhos
que eu possa lhe dar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Thanks to all your hard work, Pokémon have returned, and
all the towns look so nice you’d hardly recognize them.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,1)>You could keep improving the environment for the
Pokémon here...
<$voicel(1,5)>Or make habitats so more new Pokémon can join us...
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,652)><$comeff(1,1)>Honestly, I think you’re best off just doing whatever you
feel like!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Graças a todo o seu trabalho duro, Pokémon voltaram, e todas as
cidades parecem tão boas que você dificilmente as reconheceria.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,1)>Você poderia continuar melhorando o ambiente para
os Pokémon aqui...
<$voicel(1,5)>Ou criar habitats para que mais novos Pokémon possam se juntar a nós...
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,652)><$comeff(1,1)>Honestamente, acho que é melhor você fazer o que
quiser!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)>I’ll admit I was shocked when that building on the beach
flew off.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>But as I watched it go, I got the feeling that humans are
coming back someday. <$voicel(1,6)>So we can just take it easy and
wait for their return!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)>Admito que fiquei chocado quando aquele prédio na
praia voou.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Mas enquanto eu assistia, tive a sensação de que os humanos
voltariam algum dia<$voicel(1,6)>, então podemos ter calma e
esperar o retorno deles!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>It seems that once there’s a place they’d like to live—that
is to say, a habitat—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)>Pokémon will come back here!<$motion(1,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>Parece que, assim que houver um lugar onde queiram morar—
ou seja, um habitat—<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)>os Pokémon voltarão para cá!<$motion(1,652)>

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>There may be times when it takes quite a while for
Pokémon to show up after you finish making a habitat.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comcan(1)><$facial(1,14)>But patience is often rewarded, you know! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Some Pokémon
are rather shy, that’s all.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>Pode haver momentos em que leva um bom tempo para Pokémon
aparecer depois que você terminar de fazer um habitat.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comcan(1)><$facial(1,14)>Mas a paciência é muitas vezes recompensada<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>, alguns
Pokémon são tímidos, só isso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Of course, different Pokémon probably all prefer different
environments. That’s the sticking point.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$kfacial(1)>If only there were hints about habitats just lying
around somewhere...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Claro, Pokémons diferentes provavelmente
preferem ambientes diferentes.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$kfacial(1)>Se ao menos houvesse pistas sobre habitats
em algum lugar...

source:
Sometimes when you’re out exploring, you may find
something sparkling—those are traces of a Pokémon!
If you touch one, you can get a hint about a habitat for a
Pokémon you haven’t yet befriended.
You can check the hints you’ve gathered at any time in
your <$cdef(27)>Pokédex!
translation:
Às vezes, quando você está explorando, você pode encontrar
algo brilhante - esses são vestígios de um Pokémon!
Se você tocar em um, você pode obter uma dica sobre um habitat para
um Pokémon que você ainda não fez amizade.
Você pode verificar as dicas que você reuniu a qualquer momento
em seu <$cdef(27)>Pokédex!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Well, first of all, I’d suggest looking around near
their home.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Bem, em primeiro lugar, eu sugiro olhar ao redor perto
de sua casa.

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,13)><$facial(1,9)>If they’re not home, they could be out and about
somewhere.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Try asking other Pokémon where to find them!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,13)><$facial(1,9)>Se eles não estão em casa, eles poderiam estar em
algum lugar.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Tente perguntar a outros Pokémon onde encontrá-los!

source:
If you’re having trouble finding a Pokémon, open your
Pokédex to that Pokémon’s page and select <$cdef(27)>Search!
If you talk to another Pokémon while you’re searching,
they might tell you where your friend is!
Some of them might even take you directly to the
Pokémon you’re searching for!
translation:
Se você está tendo problemas para encontrar um Pokémon, abra
seu Pokédex para a página do Pokémon e selecione <$cdef(27)>Localizar!
Se você falar com outro Pokémon enquanto você está procurando
, eles podem te dizer onde seu amigo está!
Alguns deles podem até levá-lo diretamente para o
Pokémon que você está procurando!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>If you STILL can’t find them, then I recommend using
some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)> near their home.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>Se você ainda não consegue encontrá-los, então eu recomendo
usar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3994)> perto de sua casa.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>That sweet, irresistible scent will draw them back—just
you watch and see!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Esse cheiro doce e irresistível vai atraí-los de volta
, só você vê e vê!

source:
<$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Comfort level, eh? It might be a good idea to <$cdef(27)>talk to
various Pokémon.
translation:
<$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Pode ser uma boa ideia falar com<$cdef(27)>
vários Pokémon.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Then you could <$cdef(27)>put something you think those Pokémon
would like near their homes. <$voicel(1,6)>Why don’t you try that?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Então você <$cdef(27)>poderia colocar algo que você acha
que os Pokémon gostariam <$voicel(1,6)>perto de suas casas.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>They’re sure to be pleased—that ought to improve
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Eles certamente ficarão satisfeitos - isso deve melhorar
seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>The sticks and rocks lying around could be good
item-making materials.
<$voicel(1,5)>If you use your moves on logs and vines and such, I’d wager
you’ll get something useful from them too.<$motion(1,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>As varas e pedras ao redor podem ser bons materiais
de fabricação de itens.
<$voicel(1,5)>Se você usar seus movimentos em troncos e videiras e tal, eu apostaria
que você vai ter algo útil com eles também.<$motion(1,652)>

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>You might find different materials if you explore a bit
farther away.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>Você pode encontrar materiais diferentes se explorar um
pouco mais longe.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and I’ve heard that Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Drifloon have some
sort of special power...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>And if you manage to befriend them, they’ll take you
to a land no one’s ever laid eyes on.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, e eu ouvi que Pokémon chamado <$cdef(27)>Drifloon tem algum
tipo de poder especial...
E<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)> se você conseguir fazer amizade com eles, eles vão levá-lo para
uma terra que ninguém nunca colocou os olhos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>You’ll most likely also find some Pokémon who’d be happy
to take the things you’ve gathered <$voicel(1,6)>and turn them into
useful materials!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Você provavelmente também encontrará alguns Pokémon que ficariam
felizes em pegar as coisas que você <$voicel(1,6)>reuniu e transformá-las
em materiais úteis!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>The more Pokémon you meet, the more different items
you’ll be able to make!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Quanto mais Pokémon você encontrar, mais itens
diferentes você poderá fazer!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Remember—as you improve the environment around here,
you can get items from the <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Humans really did have a great deal of convenient items!
<$voicel(1,7)>I think you ought to stop by the <$cdef(27)>PC every now and then to
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>check and see if you can get anything useful.
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Lembre-se, como você melhorar o ambiente por aqui
, você pode obter itens do <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Os seres humanos realmente tinham uma grande quantidade de itens convenientes!
<$voicel(1,7)>Eu acho que você deveria passar pelo <$cdef(27)>PC de vez em quando para
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)> verificar e ver se você pode obter algo útil.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>Also, so long as you’ve got the <$cdef(27)>recipes and the right
<$cdef(27)>materials, <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>I’m sure you can make more items yourself!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Além disso, contanto que você tenha as <$cdef(27)>receitas e os materiais
<$cdef(27)>certos, tenho<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)> certeza que você pode fazer mais itens sozinho!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, and one more thing! If you search underground...
<$voicel(1,5)>you might find a lost relic left behind by humans.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>E mais uma coisa, se você procurar no subsolo...
<$voicel(1,5)>Você pode encontrar uma relíquia perdida deixada para trás pelos humanos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,668)>If you do, just show it to me, and I’ll <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> it and
tell you what you’ve found!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,668)>Se você fizer isso, apenas mostre para mim, e eu vou <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> e
dizer o que você encontrou!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Even Pokémon can build houses if we’ve got <$cdef(27)>building kits</color>!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Até os Pokémon podem construir casas se tivermos <$cdef(27)>kits de construção</color>!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,4)>Place one wherever you like, and then once you’ve
collected the necessary materials and gathered some
Pokémon to help out, <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing can begin!<$motion(1,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,4)>Coloque um onde quiser, e então, uma vez que você
tenha coletado os materiais necessários e reunido alguns
Pokémon para ajudar,<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> pode começar!<$motion(1,652)>

source: You can purchase <$cdef(27)>building kits</color> at the <$cdef(27)>PC shop</color>.
translation: Você pode comprar <$cdef(27)>kits de construção</color> na loja de <$cdef(27)>computadores</color>.

source:
Even if something is sold out, the store may restock it
at a later date, so keep checking regularly!
translation:
Mesmo que algo seja vendido, a loja pode reabastecê-lo em uma data
posterior, então continue verificando regularmente!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Using your moves over and over can really tire you
out—eventually it’ll be hard to use any move at all!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Usar seus movimentos repetidamente pode te cansar
- eventualmente, será difícil usar qualquer movimento!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>If you find yourself feeling worn to a frazzle like that,
try to find a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> or some other food, because
<$voicel(1,6)>that’s a good sign you need to eat!<$motion(1,652)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>Se você se sentir desgastado por um frazzle como esse, tente
encontrar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> ou alguma outra comida, porque isso é
um<$voicel(1,6)> bom sinal de que você precisa comer!<$motion(1,652)>

source:
Just as <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth says, eating berries is the most
basic way to restore <$cdef(27)>PP.
But you can also use an item called a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> to raise
your maximum <$cdef(27)>PP!
translation:
Assim como o <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth diz, comer frutas é a maneira
mais básica de restaurar <$cdef(27)>PP.
Mas você também pode usar um item chamado <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> para aumentar
seu <$cdef(27)>PP máximo!

source:
You can buy <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> at the <$cdef(27)>shop once you’ve raised the
environment level enough!
translation:
Você pode comprar <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3976)> na <$cdef(27)>loja uma vez que você tenha aumentado o nível
do meio ambiente o suficiente!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, it’s <$cdef(27)>! Glad to see you
in
top
form
as always!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Is there anything you’re having trouble with?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>If there’s something you don’t understand, please don’t
hesitate to ask me about it!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Fico feliz<$cdef(27)> em vê-lo em sua
melhor

forma,
como sempre!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Tem alguma coisa com que está tendo problemas?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Se há algo que você não entende, por favor, não hesite
em me perguntar sobre isso!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Gwah! Oh, it’s just you, <$cdef(27)>. You
sure
startled
me,
popping
up
and
talking
out
of
the
blue
like that.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Now...what was it? I could swear I’d just thought of
something truly incredible... <$voicel(1,6)><$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)>Ah, well.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>So, how can I help? If there’s something you don’t
understand, go right ahead and ask!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Oh, é só você, <$cdef(27)>, você
me
assustou
,

aparecendo

e
falando

do
nada
assim.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Eu podia jurar que tinha pensado em
algo realmente incrível<$voicel(1,6)><$comcan(1)><$facial(1,1)>...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Se há algo que você não entende,
vá em frente e pergunte!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Wha—?! Oh, hello there, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>No, no, of course I wasn’t sleeping on my feet. I’ve still got
plenty of energy in me yet!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>If there’s anything you don’t understand, please don’t
hesitate to ask!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Oh, olá, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Não, não, claro que não estava dormindo de pé, ainda
tenho muita energia em mim!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Se há algo que você não entende, por favor, não hesite
em perguntar!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>When I think of all the Pokémon who might return here
thanks to your efforts—<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>I’m almost giddy with anticipation!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>But of course, I can’t let you young’uns show me up, so I
intend to do my part!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>If there’s ever something you don’t understand, please
don’t hesitate to ask me!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando penso em todos os Pokémon que podem voltar aqui
graças aos seus esforços, <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>estou quase enlouquecido de antecipação!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas é claro, não posso deixar que vocês, jovens, me mostrem, então
pretendo fazer a minha parte!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Se há algo que você não entende, por favor, não
hesite em me perguntar!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! What are you getting up
to today?
<$voicel(1,5)>Remember—slow and steady! What’s important is to just
keep going!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>And if there’s ever anything you don’t understand, please
don’t hesitate to ask me.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$cdef(27)>, o que está fazendo
hoje?
<$voicel(1,5)>Lembre-se, devagar e firme, o importante é
continuar!
E<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)> se houver algo que você não entenda, por favor, não
hesite em me perguntar.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Oho! This is a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color>! No doubt about it!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,826)>This place was bustling with humans and Pokémon in
the past.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,826)>Este lugar estava cheio de humanos e Pokémon no
passado.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Maybe that’s why just having this building here makes me
feel more at ease.
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Talvez seja por isso que ter este prédio aqui me faz
sentir mais à vontade.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>You know, now that I stop and take a good look at it, this
whole area has changed quite a lot <$voicel(1,8)>since I met you.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>Agora que parei e dei uma boa olhada, toda
essa área mudou muito desde que<$voicel(1,8)> te conheci.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,800)>Each of the Pokémon here must have been living on their
own before...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,9)>But now they seem to love being here. <$voicel(1,10)>We’ve got you to
thank for that.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,800)>Cada um dos Pokémon aqui deve ter vivido por conta
própria antes...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,9)>Mas agora eles parecem adorar estar aqui<$voicel(1,10)>, temos que
agradecer por isso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,18)>If the humans were to come back too, I couldn’t wish for
anything more...
<$voicel(1,4)>We must still be missing something...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,18)>Se os humanos voltassem também, eu não poderia desejar
mais nada...
<$voicel(1,4)>Devemos ainda estar perdendo algo...

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)>Ah well. No rush, I suppose.
<$voicel(1,9)>With you around, I’m sure we’ll see humans
again someday.
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)>Sem pressa, suponho.
<$voicel(1,9)>Com você por perto, tenho certeza que veremos humanos
de novo algum dia.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>There must have been many other places besides here
where humans all lived together.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,23)>It could be interesting to look for them!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Deve ter havido muitos outros lugares além daqui
onde os humanos viviam juntos.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,23)>Pode ser interessante procurá-los!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>I’m guessing this <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center will really come in
handy for you from now on.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Of course, it would be wonderful if the humans came
back too...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>Acho que este <$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon será muito útil para
você a partir de agora.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Claro, seria maravilhoso se os humanos voltassem
também...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>But all that aside, this place is starting to look more like it
used to, all thanks to you.
<$voicel(1,6)>Let’s keep it up, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Mas tudo isso de lado, este lugar está começando a se parecer mais
com ele, tudo graças a você.
<$voicel(1,6)>Vamos continuar, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>, just the Pokémon I was
hoping
to
see!
There’s
something
I
wanted
to
talk
to
you about.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>This town’s become quite lively thanks to you, hasn’t it?
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, só o Pokémon que eu
esperava

ver,
há algo
que
eu
queria

falar
com
você.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Esta cidade se tornou muito animada graças a você, não é?

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>I believe everyone’s enjoying their lives here, but...well,
this place really was a wasteland before, you know.
<$voicel(1,7)>So there may be some Pokémon who aren’t really satisfied
with their environment.
<$voicel(1,5)>I’d really like to raise everyone’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels, but I think
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>running all over the place to ask everyone what they need
may be a bit beyond me.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you have any bright ideas?
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Acredito que todos estão curtindo suas vidas aqui, mas... Bem,
este lugar era realmente um deserto antes, você sabe.
<$voicel(1,7)>Então pode haver alguns Pokémon que não estão realmente
satisfeitos com seu ambiente.
<$voicel(1,5)>Eu realmente gostaria de elevar os <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto de todos, mas acho que
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>correr por todo o lugar para perguntar a todos o que eles precisam pode
estar um pouco além de mim.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Você tem alguma ideia brilhante?

source:
It sounds like raising the<$cdef(27)> environment level will help put
<$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth’s mind at ease!
The<$cdef(27)> environment level increases as more Pokémon arrive
and as their individual<$cdef(27)> comfort levels increase.
translation:
Parece que elevar o nível do<$cdef(27)> meio ambiente ajudará a colocar a
<$cdef(27)>mente do Professor Tangrowt à vontade!
O <$cdef(27)>nível ambiental aumenta à medida que mais Pokémon
chegam e seus níveis de <$cdef(27)>conforto individuais aumentam.

source:
Report to <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth once you’ve raised the
<$cdef(27)>environment level to <$cdef(27)>five!
You can check the current <$cdef(27)>environment level at any time
at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC!
translation:
Reporte-se ao <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth, uma vez que você tenha elevado o
<$cdef(27)>nível de meio ambiente para <$cdef(27)>cinco!
Você pode verificar o nível <$cdef(27)>atual do ambiente a qualquer momento
no <$cdef(27)>PC do Centro Pokémon!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you look like you’ve had
a brainwave!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>In that case, I’ll leave the method up to you, but would
you please raise <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>the <$cdef(27)>comfort levels of this town’s Pokémon
even further?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I know you’re the one for the job!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, você parece que teve uma
onda cerebral!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Nesse caso, deixarei o método com você, mas você poderia
aumentar ainda<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)> mais os <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto dos Pokémon
desta cidade?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Eu sei que você é o único para o trabalho!

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! I have a favor to ask.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>There are a great deal more Pokémon in this town now
thanks to you, wouldn’t you say?
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>But I suspect among them, there may be some who aren’t
quite satisfied with their environment.
<$voicel(1,6)>Pokémon have such varied tastes, after all.
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>, tenho um favor a pedir.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Há muito mais Pokémon nesta cidade agora
graças a você, não acha?
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas eu suspeito que entre eles, pode haver alguns que
não estão satisfeitos com seu ambiente.
<$voicel(1,6)>Pokémon têm gostos tão variados, afinal.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>I know I’ve asked this of you before, but I’m asking here in
this town, too—<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>would you please raise the <$cdef(27)>comfort levels
of this town’s Pokémon even further?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll leave the method up to you. I look forward to
seeing your results!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu sei que já perguntei isso de você antes, mas eu estou perguntando aqui
nesta cidade, também<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)> - você poderia, por favor, <$cdef(27)>aumentar os níveis de
conforto dos Pokémon desta cidade ainda mais?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Vou deixar o método para você. Estou ansioso para
ver seus resultados!

source:
It looks like you’ll have to improve the <$cdef(27)>environment level
to satisfy <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!
translation:
Parece que você terá que melhorar o <$cdef(27)>nível ambiental para
satisfazer o <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!

source:
Try raising the <$cdef(27)>environment level to <$cdef(27)>five in this town, too,
then report to<$cdef(27)> Professor Tangrowth!
You can check the current <$cdef(27)>environment level any time at
the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC!
translation:
Tente elevar o nível<$cdef(27)> de meio ambiente para<$cdef(27)> cinco nesta cidade, também
, então, informe<$cdef(27)> ao Professor Tangrowt!
Você pode verificar o nível <$cdef(27)>atual do ambiente a qualquer momento
no <$cdef(27)>PC do Centro Pokémon!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you remember how dried-up and empty this town was
before you came?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>There’s much more moisture now, and I believe many
Pokémon are very pleased about that.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Tenho um conselho para você.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Você se lembra de como a cidade estava seca e vazia antes
de você chegar?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Há muito mais umidade agora, e eu acredito que muitos
Pokémon estão muito satisfeitos com isso.

source:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>But some Pokémon do prefer drier environments.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Those Pokémon would probably prefer to live a bit of a
ways away from plants and water.
<$voicel(1,8)>I think it would be kind to move their homes.
translation:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas alguns Pokémon preferem ambientes mais secos.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Esses Pokémon provavelmente prefeririam viver um pouco
longe das plantas e da água.
<$voicel(1,8)>Acho que seria bom mudar suas casas.

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>On the other hand, some Pokémon probably prefer even
more humidity!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d advise making homes for those Pokémon near water,
trees, and other plants.
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Por outro lado, alguns Pokémon provavelmente preferem ainda
mais umidade!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu aconselharia fazer casas para os Pokémon perto de água
, árvores e outras plantas.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Thanks to all you and <$cdef(27)>Peakychu’s<$cdef(27)> hard work, this town has
really brightened up.
<$voicel(1,7)>But that brightness also affects Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Tenho um conselho para você.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Graças a todo o trabalho<$cdef(27)> duro de <$cdef(27)>você e Peakychu, esta cidade
realmente se iluminou.
<$voicel(1,7)>Mas esse brilho também afeta os <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto dos Pokémon.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>Pokémon who like especially bright places would probably
be pleased if <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>you set their homes near <$cdef(27)>streetlights or
the like.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>Pokémons que gostam de lugares especialmente iluminados provavelmente ficariam
satisfeitos se <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>você colocasse suas casas perto das<$cdef(27)> luzes das ruas ou
coisas do tipo.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Meanwhile, you could build roofs on the homes of
Pokémon who prefer dark places <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>or move their homes
inside caves and such to improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Enquanto isso, você poderia construir telhados nas casas
de Pokémon que preferem lugares escuros<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)> ou mover suas casas
dentro de cavernas e tal para melhorar seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>And given your track record, I’m sure you could even dig
into the ground <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>and make caves yourself!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>E dado o seu histórico, tenho certeza que você poderia até
cavar no chão e <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>fazer cavernas você mesmo!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>I’m sure you’ll agree that <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente has really helped us
out in this town.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>The power of cooked food is certainly nothing to
sneeze at!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Tenho um conselho para você.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Tenho certeza que concordará <$cdef(27)>que o Chef Dente realmente nos
ajudou nesta cidade.
O<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)> poder da comida cozida certamente não é nada para
espirrar!

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>And of course, Pokémon do love to eat.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>If you place their favorite foods near their homes, I believe
that should improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels.
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Se você colocar suas comidas favoritas perto de suas casas, acredito
que isso deve melhorar seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ve got a piece of advice for you.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I was quite shocked and impressed by
<$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster’s skilled <$cdef(27)>building in this town.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)>Tenho um conselho para você.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Fiquei bastante chocado e impressionado com
<$cdef(27)> o prédio qualificado de<$cdef(27)> Tinkmaster nesta cidade.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>And this applies to other towns as well, but if you <$cdef(27)>build a
house and have a Pokémon live in it, <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>that should improve
their <$cdef(27)>comfort level.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>E isso se aplica a outras cidades também, mas se você <$cdef(27)>construir
uma casa e tiver um Pokémon vivo nela<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>, isso deve melhorar
seu nível<$cdef(27)> de conforto.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>You’ll also recall you learned how to make <$cdef(27)>lifts and
<$cdef(27)>elevators here.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Você também vai se lembrar que aprendeu <$cdef(27)>a fazer
<$cdef(27)>elevadores aqui.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>Machines like that make it easier for <$voicel(1,6)>Pokémon to move
around as they please.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I can only imagine things like that would help with
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels as well.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Máquinas como essa tornam mais fácil para <$voicel(1,6)>os Pokémon se
movimentarem como quiserem.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu só posso imaginar coisas assim que ajudariam com
seus <$cdef(27)>níveis de conforto também.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>I can really tell these days that the Pokémon in this town
<$voicel(1,7)>are all living very comfortably.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Posso dizer hoje em dia que os Pokémon nesta cidade estão todos
<$voicel(1,7)> vivendo muito confortavelmente.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s clear you remembered my request and worked
hard to grant it, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>You have my heartfelt thanks!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Está claro que você se lembrou do meu pedido e
trabalhou duro para atender, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Você tem meus sinceros agradecimentos!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I hope you’ll continue befriending and working together
with more Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’d be so pleased to see this town become a real paradise!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Espero que continue fazendo amizade e trabalhando
com mais Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Ficaria muito feliz em ver esta cidade se tornar um verdadeiro paraíso!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>It seems all the Pokémon are really living comfortably<$voicel(1,8)> in
this town as well.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Parece que todos os Pokémon estão realmente vivendo confortavelmente<$voicel(1,8)>
nesta cidade também.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>And I’m certain that’s thanks to you and the others
working so hard together!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>—I mean that!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>E tenho certeza que é graças a você e aos outros
trabalhando tão duro juntos!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>. Quero dizer isso!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I hope you’ll continue befriending and working together
with more Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>I’d be so pleased to see this town become a real paradise!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Espero que continue fazendo amizade e trabalhando
com mais Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>Ficaria muito feliz em ver esta cidade se tornar um verdadeiro paraíso!

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You’ve truly mastered the art of building towns! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>All the
Pokémon seem very comfortable living here.
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Você realmente dominou a arte de construir cidades! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Todos os
Pokémon parecem muito confortáveis vivendo aqui.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I hope you’ll continue working together with the
other Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’d be so pleased to see this town become a real paradise!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Espero que continue trabalhando com os
outros Pokémon.

since I met you.
<$voicel(1,8)>So many Pokémon have come back...

the way they once were.

E<$voicel(1,5)> pude testemunhar várias cidades gradualmente voltarem
ao que eram antes.

<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Então estará pronto para o dia em que os humanos finalmente

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Ahh, isso me leva de volta...

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Parece ter palavras humanas por toda parte.

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando conseguir mais, adoraria dar algo

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hello, <$cdef(27)>. What’s that? You’d like
one of my feathers?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Hmmm... Well, I suppose I can make an exception, just
because it’s you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Oi, <$cdef(27)>, o que é isso, você gostaria de
uma das minhas penas?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Bem, acho que posso abrir uma exceção, só
porque é você!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>So we meet again, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>That expression of yours tells me...you’d like one of my
feathers. Am I right? Here you are!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Então nos encontramos de novo, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Essa sua expressão me diz... que você gostaria
de uma das minhas penas.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, are you curious about my feathers,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I don’t know if it’d be of any use to you, but here...you can
have one!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Está curioso sobre minhas
penas, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu não sei se seria de alguma utilidade para você, mas aqui... você
pode ter um!

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I do love flying in the sky. There’s nothing like the feel of
the wind against your face.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Sometimes it actually feels so nice that I fall asleep while
I’m still flying.
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu amo voar no céu, não há nada como a sensação do
vento contra seu rosto.
Às<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)> vezes me sinto tão bem que adormeço enquanto ainda
estou voando.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>One thing about me is that I really love rainbows.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>They shine with that beautiful prismatic light... I could
gaze at a rainbow for ages!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Uma coisa sobre mim é que eu realmente amo arco-íris.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eles brilham com aquela bela luz prismática... eu poderia olhar
para um arco-íris por séculos!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>I’d love to become closer friends with more of the other
little darlings around here...<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>but they’re all scared of me!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)>Honestly, I’ve never considered myself to be all that scary.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu adoraria me tornar amigos mais próximos com mais dos outros
queridinhos por aqui... mas <$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>eles estão todos com medo de mim!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)>Honestamente, eu nunca me considerei tão assustador.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>So tell me, <$cdef(27)>, what do you plan
to
use
my
feather for?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Are you going to use it as a decoration for your house?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Então me diga, <$cdef(27)>, para que você
planeja

usar
minha pena?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Você vai usá-lo como decoração para sua casa?

source:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>It’s really quite difficult to control the strength of the
flames I spit out.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Even just a sneeze can send out a huge burst of fire, so I
have to be very careful.
translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>É muito difícil controlar a força das chamas
que eu cuspi.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Até mesmo um espirro pode enviar uma grande explosão de fogo, então eu
tenho que ter muito cuidado.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Back in the day, whenever I met a human, they always
seemed absolutely thrilled to see me.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Do you suppose they considered me to be a good omen
or something?
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>No passado, sempre que eu conheci um humano, eles sempre
pareciam absolutamente emocionados em me ver.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Você acha que eles me consideravam um bom presságio
ou algo assim?

source:
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>You know, <$cdef(27)>, I was wondering...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Do you think you could fly if you transform into something
suitable? <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>If so, I’d love to fly together!
translation:
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sabe, <$cdef(27)>, eu estava pensando...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Você acha que poderia voar se se
transformasse<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)> em algo adequado?

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve got a dear friend called <$cdef(27)>Lugia.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>They may look a liiittle intimidating, but honestly they’re
very kind. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>If you ever meet them, I hope you’ll be friends!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Tenho uma querida amiga chamada <$cdef(27)>Lugia.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Eles podem parecer um pouco intimidantes, mas honestamente eles
são muito <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>gentis. Se você os conhecer, espero que sejam amigos!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>. I see you starin’ at
me
real
hard...
What’s
up, bud?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>You want one of my feathers? Well, I guess that’s not a
big ask... <$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Here ya go! Just for you.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Ei, ei, <$cdef(27)>, eu vejo você me
encarando

muito...
e aí,
amigo?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Bem, acho que isso não é uma grande pergunta
... aqui <$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>está, só para você.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>What’s up, <$cdef(27)>? We meet again!
What’s that? You want one of my feathers? <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>Heh. Fine, fine.
Here ya go!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>E aí, <$cdef(27)>, nos encontramos de novo!
O que é isso? Você quer uma<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)> das minhas
penas?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>! What’s up? You like
the
look
of
my feathers?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>I don’t think they’re all that special or anything...
But hey, why not. Here ya go!<$comcan(1)>
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, o que há, gosta da aparência

das

minhas penas?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu não acho que eles são tão especiais ou algo
assim... mas por que não?<$comcan(1)>

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Flying on a clear day isn’t bad, but nothin’ beats flying on
a stormy day <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>in pouring rain and howling winds!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>That feelin’ of the rain peltin’ ya nonstop is just so nice!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Voar em um dia claro não é ruim, mas nada de batidas voando em um
dia tempestuoso <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>em chuva torrencial e ventos uivantes!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Essa sensação da chuva te pisando sem parar é tão legal!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>My wings are pretty huge, yeah? Back in the day, I sent a
bunch of Pokémon flyin’ with a single flap! <$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>I think it
kinda freaked ’em out...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>So I’m doin’ my best these days to not scare everybody!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Minhas asas são enormes, sim? No passado, eu mandei um
monte de Pokémon voando com uma única aba<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>! Eu acho
que meio que assustou...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Então eu estou fazendo o meu melhor hoje em dia para não assustar todo mundo!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you ever feel like you need to be alone for a bit?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>When I need some “me time,” I dive all the way down to
the bottom of the sea. It’s real quiet down there.
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Já sentiu que precisa ficar sozinha um pouco?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Quando preciso de um tempo,
mergulho até o fundo do mar.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>That bell ya rang for me sure has a nice sound. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>I could
listen to it forever.
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>O sino que você tocou para mim tem um som bonito, <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>eu poderia
ouvi-lo para sempre.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ll bet your Trainer was a real good person,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>That’s just the feelin’ I get from lookin’ at ya!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que seu treinador era uma boa
pessoa, <$cdef(27)>.
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Isso é apenas o sentimento que eu recebo de olhar para você!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Hey, bud. What’re you gonna do with all those feathers of
mine you’re collectin’ anyway?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Don’t tell me you’re gonna make ’em into a feather duster
to clean your home or anything like that!
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>O que vai fazer com todas as minhas penas
que está colecionando?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Não me diga que vai transformá-los em um empoeirador de
penas para limpar sua casa ou algo assim!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>You don’t see Pokémon like me too often, who can fly in
the sky AND swim in the sea, y’know?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>But I bet you could with that ability to transform of yours!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Heh... It’s cool how we’re similar in that way.
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Você não vê Pokémon como eu com muita frequência, quem
pode voar no céu e nadar no mar, sabe?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas eu aposto que você poderia com essa
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>habilidade de transformar a sua!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, I’ve got a buddy named <$cdef(27)>Ho-Oh who REALLY likes
to talk...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>You should chat with ’em sometime if ya ever meet ’em.
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Sabe, eu tenho um amigo chamado <$cdef(27)>Ho-Oh que realmente gosta
de falar...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Você deve conversar com eles algum dia se você conhecê-los.

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Howdy, <$cdef(27)>! Ya caught me in a
REAL
good
mood
right now.
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Mebbe I’ll make it rain a li’l or somethin’!
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oi, <$cdef(27)>! Você me pegou num
bom
humor
daqueles
agora.
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Quem sabe eu faça chover um pouquinho!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>... Do ya think this place
could
use
a

translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu os via pescando na lagoa ou brincando<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)> com Pokémon
de insetos na grama alta!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,8)>Yeah! They were pretty noisy, but really lively and
fun too!
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,29)>Where DID all those humans go, anyway?
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,8)>Eles eram muito barulhentos, mas muito animados e divertidos
também!
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,29)>Para onde todos esses humanos foram, afinal?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)>Good question—<$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,14)>I really don’t have a clue...
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>But <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth says they’ll all <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>come back some
day! When they do, I bet this whole area’ll <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>become
a lot more lively!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)>Boa pergunta. <$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu realmente não tenho ideia...
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Mas o <$cdef(27)>professor Tangrowth diz que todos <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>voltarão algum dia,
quando voltarem, aposto que toda essa área se <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>tornará
muito mais animada!

source: <$voicel(2,9)>Uh-huh! <$emotion(2,8)>I’m sure it will! I can’t wait!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Heyyy... About that thing on your back...

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>Ehehe, I know, right?! And it’s been gettin’ bigger ’n’
bigger, too!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,803)>Whoooaaa. That’s pretty cooool. I wish I had a bud...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Yeah, but YOU’VE got your little buddy on your tail, there!
That’s, like, super-ultra-MEGA cool!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Think your buddy’ll get bigger, like my bud?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Oh, I don’t know about thaaat. They’re already pretty
heavy... <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>I don’t want them to get any bigger...
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,815)>Ahhh. Ooouuuch. Nooo. Stop iiit...

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>AHAHA! Your buddy’s all like, “I wanna grow up big ’n’
strong too!”

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Your flower looks striking as ever! I’m sure plenty of
Pokémon come running up to you for nectar.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Am I right?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Sua flor parece impressionante como sempre! Tenho certeza que
muitos Pokémon vêm correndo até você para o néctar.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Estou certo?

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>No, I wouldn’t say that... Does that often happen to you?
