translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Não, eu não diria isso... isso acontece com frequência com você?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Yes! It happens all the time.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>Everyone says the flower on my back smells so nice, and
the little darlings just absolutely swarm it!
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>But it’s hard to know what you yourself smell like, don’t
you think?
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Sim, acontece o tempo todo.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>Todo mundo diz que a flor nas minhas costas cheira tão bem,
e os pequenos queridinhos simplesmente a cercam!
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Mas é difícil saber o que você mesmo cheira,
não acha?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Now that you mention it—I believe you’re right. I’m not
really conscious of my own smell.
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,663)>It might actually be quite foul. Is that the case?
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Agora que você mencionou, acho que está certo, não estou realmente
consciente do meu próprio cheiro.
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,663)>Na verdade, pode ser muito ruim.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>What? No, I don’t think so! In fact, I’m catching a pleasant
whiff of you now...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>*sniff sniff*
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Na verdade, estou pegando um cheiro agradável
de você agora...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>sniff sniff

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>I’d advise a bit more caution! If you come too close
to my flower—
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Eu aconselharia um pouco mais de cautela, se você chegar muito
perto da minha flor.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>What are you talking about, dear? It’s really quite a nice
smell, so no need to worry!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Here—I’ll get myself a hefty lungful so I can tell you what
I think. *sniiiffffff* ...Ngh?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>É realmente um cheiro muito bom, então não
precisa se preocupar!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Aqui, eu vou ter um pulmão pesado para que eu possa
te dizer o que eu acho.

<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,841)>Urk... Tosse de tosse... Wheeze... o que
foi isso?

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,663)>My apologies. My flower produces quite a lot of pollen...
<$voicel(2,4)>And I’m afraid it’s poisonous as well.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I’m sure that won’t be a problem for you, but another
Pokémon might well have collapsed by now.
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,663)>Minha flor produz muito pólen... e temo
<$voicel(2,4)> que seja venenoso também.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Tenho certeza que não será um problema para você, mas outro
Pokémon pode ter entrado em colapso agora.

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,842)>*cough cough* I wish you’d told me that earlier, dear!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)>Ahhh... At least I’ve figured out why the other Pokémon
don’t flock to your flower... *cough*
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,842)>Tosse de tosse Eu gostaria que você tivesse me dito isso mais cedo, querida!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)>Pelo menos eu descobri por que os outros
Pokémon não se juntam à sua flor.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>This place sure has turned into a nice place to live!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>Este lugar com certeza se transformou em um bom lugar para viver!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I know, right? There are a lot more Pokémon around than
there were before. Makes things so lively!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Eu sei, há muito mais Pokémon
por aí do que havia antes.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Hee hee—you’re so right, dear.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Ahhh... It makes me a bit nostalgic about when the humans
were still here...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Hee hee - você está tão certo, querida.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Me deixa um pouco nostálgico sobre quando os humanos ainda
estavam aqui...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)>I definitely feel ya there. They’d be right there with us
during battles. <$voicel(2,5)>Sometimes I’d even give ’em rides on my
back. Nothin’ but good memories!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)>Eu definitivamente sinto você lá. Eles estariam lá conosco
durante as batalhas<$voicel(2,5)>. Às vezes eu até daria passeios nas minhas
costas. Nada, mas boas lembranças!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>I was always playing together with humans, ever since I
was small...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>I wonder if I’ll ever see them again... Oh dear... Now I
feel lonely.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Sempre brinquei com humanos, desde que era
pequeno...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Eu me pergunto se algum dia eu vou vê-los
de novo...

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>Not really feelin’ that myself to be honest!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>This place is startin’ to get real nice, y’know? I bet the
humans’ll just <$voicel(2,10)>randomly show up again one of these days!
translation:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>Não estou realmente sentindo isso para ser honesto!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Este lugar está começando a ficar muito legal, eu aposto que os
humanos vão <$voicel(2,10)>aparecer aleatoriamente novamente um dia desses!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hee hee... You’re right! Goodness gracious, just look at
me... <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,49)>I’ve grown so sentimental as I’ve gotten older!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Meu Deus, olha para mim... fiquei tão
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,49)>sentimental à medida que envelheci!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Hey, I got an idea! When the humans come back, let’s
make friends with some of ’em and go on a trip together!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Dense forests, cool mountains with an awesome view of
the moon... There are so many places I wanna go!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Quando os humanos voltarem, vamos fazer
amizade com alguns deles e fazer uma viagem juntos!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Florestas densas, montanhas frias com uma vista incrível
da lua... há tantos lugares que eu quero ir!

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>Those sound like lovely places! What do you think about
adding a stop at a mountain covered in pure-white snow?
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>O que acha de adicionar uma parada em
uma montanha coberta de neve branca?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>That sounds awesome too! We gotta do it! Let’s make it a
promise. Don’t you forget about it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Isso soa incrível também! Temos que fazer isso! Vamos fazer
uma promessa. Não se esqueça disso!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Pidgey</color>, I was wondering... Is it fun to fly?
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>Pidgey,</color> eu estava pensando... é divertido voar?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, you bet! Up in the big, blue sky, a nice wind rustling
through your feathers... <$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>It’s the BEST!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>No céu azul, um bom vento atravessando
suas penas... é <$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>o melhor!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Whoa, that’s awesome! I wanna give it a go someday.
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,29)>So, uh... How did YOU learn to fly, <$cdef(27)>Pidgey?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Eu quero dar uma chance um dia.
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,29)>Então, como você aprendeu a voar, <$cdef(27)>Pidgey?

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm. How DID I? I don’t really remember learning!
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu realmente não me lembro de aprender!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$comcan(2)>You don’t? So you’ve just...always been able to?
That’s amazing! I’m super jealous!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$comcan(2)>Você não? Então você só... sempre foi capaz? Isso
é incrível! Eu sou super ciumento!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Really? But you’ve got that awesome flame on your tail, <$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,4)>and
you can breathe fire, right? I’d say that’s plenty amazing!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>I think life’s more fun when you’ve got friends who can do
stuff you can’t!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Mas você tem aquela chama incrível em <$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,4)>sua
cauda, e você pode respirar fogo, certo?
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Eu acho que a vida é mais divertida quando você tem amigos que podem fazer
coisas que você não pode!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Yeah, but that’s not enough for me! I wanna fly up in the
sky AND breathe fire at the same time!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Sim, mas isso não é suficiente para mim, eu quero voar
no céu e respirar fogo ao mesmo tempo.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Hee hee! Knowing you, I bet you might just be able to do
that someday! I’ll be cheering for you!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Conhecendo você, eu aposto que você pode fazer isso
um dia, eu estarei torcendo por você!

source:
<$facial(0,1)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)><$cdef(27)>! Lemme ask you something.
Me and <$cdef(27)>Litwick are competing to see <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,8)>who has the
hottest flame!
<$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)>There’s no way yours is hotter than mine! <wait(0.2)><$motion(2,816)><wait(0.2)><$voicel(2,8)>Lookit!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Oh yeah? Well, check out how hot <$motion(1,816)>MINE is!
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>I think we all know who’s got the hottest flame around.
Right, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>Awww yeah! I knew you’d get it!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,38)>Yayyy! I knew my flame was hotter!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>Yikes! Looks like we got a little TOO heated! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Uhhh,
<$cdef(27)>...? <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Aww, look at you, <$cdef(27)>Charmeleon—just full of beans!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>But fighting is dangerous, you know. Why don’t we have
a nice chat instead?
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, olha só você, <$cdef(27)>Charmeleon, com energia de sobra!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Mas brigar é perigoso, sabe? Que tal uma
boa conversa em vez disso?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,7)>Trying to get me to drop my guard so you can sneak attack
me, huh? Yeah right, I ain’t fallin’ for that! <$voicel(1,10)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(1,814)><$motion(2,814)>Take THIS!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,7)>Tentando me fazer largar minha guarda para que você possa me
atacar sorrateiramente, certo, eu não vou me apaixonar<$voicel(1,10)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(1,814)><$motion(2,814)> por isso!

source: <$voicel(2,5)>Oh dear, that really is dangerous! <$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,21)>Come on—easy now...

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,15)>Wha—!<$facial(1,7)> ...Tryin’ to put out my flame with that goo of yours,
huh? <$voicel(1,9)>You think that’s gonna stop me? Think again! <$voicel(1,10)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(1,816)><$motion(2,814)>GRAR!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,15)>O quê—!<$facial(1,7)> Tentando apagar minha chama com essa sua gosma,
hein? <$voicel(1,9)>Acha que isso vai me deter? Nem pensar! <$voicel(1,10)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(1,816)><$motion(2,814)>GRAR!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,8)>All right, all right. That’s enough fighting, now. Let’s make
up with a hug!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,8)>Certo, já chega de brigas, vamos fazer
um abraço!

source:
<$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,5)>AHHH!!! MY FLAME! Get your goo away from my tail!
<$voicel(1,1)><$motionoff(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>OK, fine, I admit defeat!
translation:
<$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,5)>AHHH!!! MEU CHAMA! Tire sua gosma da minha cauda!
<$voicel(1,1)><$motionoff(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Ok, tudo bem, eu admito a derrota!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)>Whaddya mean, you’re scared?! <$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,7)>You ASKED me to show
you my coolest pose—practically begged me, even!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>And hey! Quit sprayin’ water everywhere!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)>Você me pediu para te mostrar<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,7)> minha pose mais
legal - praticamente me implorou, até mesmo!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>Pare de pulverizar água em todos os lugares!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,23)>I’m sorry! I can’t help it—any time I’m startled the bubbles
come out.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Still, you may be scary, but you’re REAL COOL too,
<$cdef(27)>Charizard!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,23)>Desculpe, não posso evitar. Sempre que me assusto, as
bolhas saem.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Ainda assim, você pode ser assustador, mas você é muito legal também
, <$cdef(27)>Charizard!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Hey, as long as you get how cool I am, we’re good.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,5)>But listen, water ’n’ me...we don’t mix so well, y’know?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Ei, contanto que você consiga o quão legal eu sou, nós somos
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,5)>bons, mas ouça, água e eu... nós não nos misturamos tão bem, sabe?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)>Heh. Maybe some other time, bud.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>If I rock that pose too much, you’ll stop appreciatin’ what
makes it so cool.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)>Heh. Talvez outra hora, amigo.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>Se eu fizer essa pose demais, você vai deixar de apreciar
o que ela tem de tão especial.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)>No I won’t! <$emotion(1,8)>Your poses are super cool no matter how many
times I see them, <$cdef(27)>Charizard!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>Suas poses <$emotion(1,8)>são super legais, não importa quantas
vezes eu as veja, <$cdef(27)>Charizard!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)>I mean, yeah, of course. But breathin’ wicked-sweet flames
takes a lot outta me, y’know? <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Maybe tomorrow?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)>Sim, claro, mas respirar chamas doces me
tira muito, sabe, <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>talvez amanhã?

source: <$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,13)>Ugh. Fine! FINE! Just lemme rest a sec first!
translation: <$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,13)>Tudo bem, deixe-me descansar um segundo antes.

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,11)>Oof! Hey! Wait a minute... You’re doin’ that on purpose,
aren’tcha? <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>It’s seriously killin’ my fiery vibes...
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,11)>Espere um minuto... você está fazendo
isso<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)> de propósito, não está?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>You’re pretty impressive for bein’ so small. You’re good at
making buildings and stuff, yeah?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>Você é muito impressionante por ser tão pequeno. Você é bom em
fazer edifícios e coisas assim, certo?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Yup, I’m pretty great at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing stuff! Well, most stuff.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,58)>Tall buildings kinda give me a hard time. Carrying heavy
materials up to the roof is tough <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>when you’re little.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Sim, eu sou muito<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> bom em ing coisas!
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,58)>Levar materiais pesados até o telhado
é difícil quando você<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)> é pequeno.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>Hey, everyone’s got their strengths and weaknesses.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Well, how about this? You can leave that stuff to me when
we’re workin’ together.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Gettin’ up to the roof’s no sweat for me.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>Todo mundo tem seus pontos fortes e fracos.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Você pode deixar essas coisas para mim quando estivermos
trabalhando juntos.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Subir até o telhado não é suor para mim.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh yeah, you’ve got those awesome wings, <$cdef(27)>Pidgeotto!
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,64)>But can you carry real heavy stuff to the roof? Like heavy
metal beam kind of heavy?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh sim, você tem essas asas incríveis, <$cdef(27)>Pidgeotto!
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,64)>Mas você pode levar coisas pesadas para o telhado, como
um feixe de metal pesado?

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>You kiddin’? That’s a piece of cake!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,55)><$cdef(27)>Electrode, huh? That might be a little tricky—it’s so
smooth and slippery, I could end up dropping it.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,6)>Anyway, why do you even need to bring<$cdef(27)> Electrode up onto
a roof?
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,55)><$cdef(27)>Isso pode ser um pouco complicado, é tão suave e
escorregadio que eu poderia acabar largando.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,6)>De qualquer forma, por que você precisa <$cdef(27)>trazer eletrodo para um
telhado?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Oh, I don’t! I was just curious.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Y’know, I’m excited to get working with you, <$cdef(27)>Pidgeotto!
I bet that’ll make<$cdef(27)> <$spwfull(1)>ing even MORE fun!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ah, não quero nada! Só estava curioso.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Estou animado para trabalhar com você, <$cdef(27)>Pidgeotto!
Isso vai tornar <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> ainda mais divertido!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Same here, pal! I’ll carry pretty much anything you
need—besides <$cdef(27)>Electrode!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Vou levar tudo o que precisar,
além do <$cdef(27)>eletrodo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>...Oh! I’m so sorry! I was just, errrr... Oh!
<$voicel(1,6)>I was watching how hard you’re always working <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>and
thinking about how impressive you are!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>Oh, sinto muito, eu estava apenas, errr...
<$voicel(1,6)>Eu estava vendo o quanto você está sempre trabalhando<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)> e
pensando sobre o quão impressionante você é!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Hehe, you’re gonna make me blush! But, uh... <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>Does it
really look like I’m workin’ that hard?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Hehe, você vai me fazer corar, mas... <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>realmente
parece que estou trabalhando duro?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Yes, yes, exactly! Isn’t it exhausting always flopping and
hopping around like that?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Just watching you makes me want to snatch—errrr, I mean,
it makes me anxious for you, dear!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Sim, sim, exatamente! Não é cansativo sempre
flutuando e pulando assim?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Só de ver você me faz querer arrebatar, quero dizer, me
deixa ansiosa por você, querida!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>Huh... I’ve never really thought about it, yo! I just know
I can go all kinds of cool places <$voicel(2,4)>as long as I keep floppin’!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu só sei que posso ir a todos os tipos de
lugares legais, desde que <$voicel(2,4)>eu continue pulando!

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)>I...I see... Well, I’m glad to hear it.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>I was just a little worried about you, and I thought I could
help by carrying you around instead.
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)>Eu... eu vejo... bem, estou feliz em ouvir isso.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Eu estava um pouco preocupado com você, e pensei que
poderia ajudar carregando você.

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)>Awww! Thanks, yo! But don’t worry about me! I’m super
used to it! I could flop for days!
<$textsize(0)>... ... ...<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Whoops.
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)>Ah, valeu! Mas não se preocupe comigo! Estou mais
que acostumado! Posso ficar me debatendo por dias!
<$textsize(0)>... ... ...<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Opa.

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>Oh dear, oh dear! Are you all right, sweetie?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>You know, <$cdef(27)>Magikarp, you can always just let me know if
you’re ever having problems like that.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>I’ll come and catch—I mean, gently carry you wherever
you want to go!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>Você está bem, querida?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Sabe, <$cdef(27)>Magikarp, você sempre pode me avisar
se estiver tendo problemas assim.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Eu virei e pegarei... Quero dizer, leve-o gentilmente para
onde você quiser ir!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Um, hey. I was wondering—how do you get your leaves
to be so shiny all the time? <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>I’m kinda jelly.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Eu estava me perguntando, como você consegue que
suas folhas sejam tão brilhantes<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)> o tempo todo?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Hmmm... Yeah, I’m not exactly sure. Maybe it’s ’cause I’ve
been sleeping in some yummy dirt?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Hum... É, não tenho certeza. Talvez seja porque
tenho dormido numa terra deliciosa?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Nonono—not like that. I just mean I bury myself in the dirt
when I sleep.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Não, não, não... Não é isso. Só quis dizer que me enterro
na terra para dormir.

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Ohhh OK. But then...how do you know the dirt is yummy?
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Ahhh, está bem. Mas então... como sabe que a terra é deliciosa?

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)>Er... It’s just really hard to put into words?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>When I’m sleeping in some really good dirt, it just...feels
yummy? Or something like that?
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)>Ahn... É difícil explicar.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Quando durmo numa terra muito boa, ela parece...
gostosa? Ou algo assim?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Ohhh, wow! I didn’t know dirt was so...deep.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,6)>So, um—where’s this dirt you’re talking about? I’m in the
mood for a little snack.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Uau! Não sabia que o assunto “terra” era tão... profundo.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,6)>Então, hum... Onde fica essa terra de que você está falando? Deu
vontade de fazer um lanchinho.

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,59)>Uh... Respectfully, you should probably give up on the
whole “eating dirt” thing.
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,59)>Ahn... Com todo o respeito, acho melhor desistir
dessa ideia de “comer terra”.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Hey... I smell this sweet scent whenever I’m talking to
you. Why is thaaat?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Sinto esse cheiro doce sempre que
falo com você.

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>Nectar? Waaaiiit.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Whoooaaa. So that’s not drool, it’s nectar?
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>Néctar?
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Então isso não é babar, é néctar?

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>Do you...do you want to try some?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,50)>Ohhh. Can I? Yayyy. Let’s see...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Om nom nom nom...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,52)>Ohhh nooo!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,58)>Uagh! Wh-what’s wrong? Did you not like it?
translation: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,58)>O que há de errado, você não gostou?

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Nooo, that’s not it. It’s really yummyyy, but...
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>I bet it would be even beeetter with a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(61)>.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,64)>Heyyy, could I borrow a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(61)>?
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Não, não é isso, é muito gostoso, mas...
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Aposto que seria até mesmo uma abelha com um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(61)>.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,64)>Eiii, pode me emprestar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(61)>?

source: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,46)>Um, maybe you could go find your own...?
translation: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,46)>Talvez você possa encontrar o seu próprio...?

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I am doing very great. Of course. Very great.
translation: <$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Estou indo muito bem, claro, muito bem.

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Really? Huh, maybe my timing’s off...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,65)><$textsize(0)>I swear you smell like your spirit’s just about to leave your body...
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Talvez meu sincronia esteja desligado...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,65)><$textsize(0)>Eu juro que você cheira como se seu espírito estivesse prestes a deixar seu corpo...

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, no, it’s nothing... Just talking to myself.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,3)>By the way, it seems like your mushroom’s a bit bigger than
when I last saw it...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, não, não é nada... só falar comigo mesmo.
A<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,3)> propósito, parece que seu cogumelo é um pouco maior do que quando
eu o vi pela última vez...

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,64)>I’m so jealous... Do you have a trick to making it grow?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,64)>Estou com tanta inveja... você tem um truque para fazê-lo crescer?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I think you must find a very good dark and damp place
and stay there.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu acho que você deve encontrar um lugar muito bom escuro e
úmido e ficar lá.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,51)>You know... Sometimes when I talk to you, I’m not sure if
I’m talking to you or the mushroom...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,51)>Às vezes, quando falo com você, não sei se estou
falando com você ou com o cogumelo.

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>*sniff sniff* Oh, it’s <$cdef(27)>Venonat</color>! Thank you so so SO much!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Huh? Thank me for what? What’d I do?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Wha—? I thought for SURE you brought some berries for
yours truly... Did you not?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Pensei que você trouxesse umas frutas
para a sua, não foi?

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Huh? I never said I’d do that!
Speaking of berries, though...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,46)>My special stash went missing! I was saving those berries
for later, but now they’re all gone...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>I bet someone stole them!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu nunca disse que faria
isso, por falar em frutas.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,46)>Estava guardando essas frutas para mais tarde,
mas agora elas se foram... aposto
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>que alguém as roubou!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)>WHAT?! I will NEVER EVER forgive the thief! Those were
MY precious berries!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)>Nunca perdoarei o ladrão, essas eram minhas
preciosas frutas.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>Uh, no, they were MINE...
Oh well. Maybe I’ll <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,48)>go look for more berries over there.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>Não, eles eram meus.
.. bem, talvez <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,48)>eu vá procurar mais frutas lá.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>*sniff sniff* Hmmm... Are you SURE you aren’t hiding some
berries, <$cdef(27)>Venonat?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>’Cause I’d recognize that sweet-and-sour smell
ANYWHERE—and it’s coming from your back!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Você tem certeza que não está escondendo algumas
frutas, <$cdef(27)>Venonat?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Porque eu reconheceria esse cheiro doce e azedo em
qualquer lugar e está vindo de suas costas!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huh? No, why would I—<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>OH! I know what happened!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Não, por que eu... <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>eu sei o que aconteceu!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>C’mon, tell me! You ARE hiding some berries, right?!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Vamos, me diga, você está escondendo algumas frutas, certo?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Y’see, the berries were so ripe and looked so delicious...
I was <$voicel(1,6)>so happy I kinda...snuggled up with them and fell asleep.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Then, when I woke up, they were all gone... And now my
back is kinda wet and sticky.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Veja, as frutas estavam tão maduras e pareciam tão deliciosas...
eu <$voicel(1,6)>estava tão feliz que meio que... aconcheguei com elas e adormeci.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Então, quando acordei, todos se foram... e agora minhas
costas estão molhadas e pegajosas.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>And you aren’t exactly the lightest sleeper. Oh, my poor,
poor berries, crushed by your tossing and turning...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>E você também não fica quieto quando dorme. Ah, minhas
pobres frutas, esmagadas enquanto você se virava na cama...

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Errr, you wouldn’t happen to be eating the berry that was
sitting here, would you?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Errr, você não estaria comendo a fruta que estava
sentada aqui, não é?

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Om nom no—ahhh. Sorryyy. Was it yooouuurs?

<$voicel(1,6)>It was. But more importantly,
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>it was covered in a fair amount of my scales. Are you OK?<$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>
They’re highly toxic.
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)>Mas, mais importante,
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>Estava coberto com uma boa quantidade das minhas <$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>
escamas, você está bem?

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Wha—you swallowed it!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Um, you’re not in pain, are you? Does your stomach
hurt at all?
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>O quê... Você engoliu!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Hum, não está sentindo dor, né? A sua barriga
está bem?

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Uhhh... Now that you meeention it... I think...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>I think it was preeetty spicy! Maybe even tastier than uuusual!
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Agora que você entendeu... eu acho...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Acho que foi bem picante, talvez até mais saboroso do que vulgar.

source: <$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>I-I see. Well, I’m just glad you’re unharmed.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Yooo! You’re lookin’ pretty goopy today! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Maybe even
goopier than usual? Or am I way off base?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,6)>Hehe, you can totally tell, right? I’m feeling SUPER goopy
today! <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)>I bet I could melt pretty much ANYTHING!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>And if I’m not mistaken—YOUR mouth goop is looking
pretty top-tier today, too!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Hehe! I knew you’d notice! I’ve been meltin’ berries in, like,
half a second today! <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Hold up, you gotta check this out...

*nom nom* <$motion(1,19)>*gloooop*
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,666)>How ’bout THAT?! Pretty awesome meltin’ prowess, huh?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,53)>AWESOME! So cool! You ’n’ me are basically the melting
MASTERS today!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,1)>Totally, yo! <$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,10)>We’re goopin’, gloopin’, meltin’ machines! I’m
gonna melt somethin’ else!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)>WHOA! My bad, yo! I almost sprayed my acid goop right
<$voicel(1,4)>at ya!

<$facial(0,1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)><$cdef(27)>! Glad you’re OK! Guess we
gotta
learn
to
rein
it in
on
days when we’re crushin’ it...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Ohhh, you can teeell? You must be a real scent
connoisseur. Come cloooser, get a real good whiff...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Ahhh, você consegue percebeeer? Deve entender mesmo
de aromas. Chegue mais peeerto e sinta bem o perfume...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>Wait wait wait. You’re saying that’s coming from YOU?!
With THAT scary face?!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>Espera, espera. Está dizendo que esse cheiro vem de VOCÊ?!
Com ESSA cara assustadora?!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>Awww, come on. My face doesn’t have anything to do with
it. Check it ooouuut...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,817)>Bwahhhhhh...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>Meu rosto não tem nada a
ver com isso.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,817)>Bwahhhhhh...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Whoa! You don’t just smell good, you smell AMAZING!
It’s wild you’ve got a scent like this with a face like that!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Você não apenas cheira bem, você cheira incrível
, é selvagem você ter um cheiro assim com um rosto assim!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,663)>I said my face doesn’t have anything to dooo with—huh?
Heyyy... <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>I think I smell something good coming off you too.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,663)>Eu disse que meu rosto não tem nada a ver com...
acho que <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>sinto o cheiro de algo bom saindo de você também.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yeah... It’s a sweet smell, kinda like a flowwwer...
...<$comeff(1,10)>Even though your face <$emotion(2,5)>is kinda scaaary too...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Sim... é um cheiro doce, meio que como um cortador de fluxo.
.. <$comeff(1,10)>mesmo que seu rosto também <$emotion(2,5)>seja um tipo de scaaary...

source: <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>H-Hey, what’s my face got to do with it?!
translation: <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>O que meu rosto tem a ver com isso?

source: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee... Hahaha. You’re pretty forgetful, huh?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)>The wiiind sure does feel good today...

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,16)><$motionoff(2,804)>*yaaaaaawn* It happened again...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>We’ll neeever stop yawning if this keeps happening...
<$voicel(2,2)>*yaaaaaaawn*

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>*yawn* All this yawning is...starting to make me feel...
really...sleepy...
<$comeff(1,15)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,2)>Zzz...
<$facial(2,9)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>Why are you making that funny faaace? Are you hungry?
translation: <$facial(2,9)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>Por que está fazendo aquela faaace engraçada?

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,66)>...I think I may be able to remember something important
when I do this.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,66)>Acho que consigo me lembrar de algo importante
quando faço isso.

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Like what you had for diiinner last night?
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Como o que você tinha para jantar ontem à noite?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,67)>...I think maybe we <$cdef(27)>Slowking and <$cdef(27)>Slowbro used to walk on
all fours in the past, just like <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke does.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,67)>Acho que talvez nós,<$cdef(27)> Slowking e <$cdef(27)>Slowbro, costumávamos andar
de quatro no passado, assim como <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke faz.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>...But something must’ve happened. Something that caused
us to stand up on two legs.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Mas algo deve ter acontecido, algo que nos fez
ficar de pé em duas pernas.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Whoooaaa... You’re so smart. No wonder they call you king.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Você é tão inteligente, não admira que te chamem de rei.

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>But what could it have been? What changed us?
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>I feel like it was something kind of unpleasant...
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>Mas o que poderia ter sido?
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>Sinto que foi algo desagradável...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)>Ohhh. I have an idea... Maaaybe our tails were itchy?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>It’s a lot easier to scratch with our hands, y’knooow?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)>Ahhh. Tive uma ideia... Talvez nossas caudas estivessem coçando?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>É muito mais fácil coçar com as mãos, saaabe?

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>...You’re pretty clever yourself, aren’t you, dear?
translation: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>Você é muito inteligente, não é, querida?

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Marowak! Yooo, sorry if this kinda sounds like it’s comin’
outta nowhere, but I seriously look up to you!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Yooo, desculpe se esse tipo parece que está vindo
do nada, mas eu realmente olho para você!

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>That’s very flattering—but may I ask why?
translation: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Isso é muito lisonjeiro, mas posso perguntar por quê?

source:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Your Bonemerang, yo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>That BEAU-TI-FUL finesse you got throwing that bone!
It’s, like, totally awesome!
translation:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Seu Bonemerang, você!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aquela bela finesse que você tem
jogando aquele osso!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Ahhh, yes, thank you. It took me quite some time to
master that mo—
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Ahhh, sim, obrigado. Levei algum tempo para
dominar esse mo...

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>And yo—hear me out! HEAR! ME! OUT! I trained REAL
hard and figured out my own move.
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>I use my leek and call it...the Leekarang!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu treinei muito e descobri meu
próprio movimento.
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu uso meu alho-poró e o chamo de... o Leekarang!

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>You...use a leek? I must admit, that sounds like a more
impressive feat.
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Devo admitir que parece uma façanha mais
impressionante.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>Whaaat? No way!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>OH! But hey! Hey! HEYYY! While I’ve got you here, <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>can I
show you it—my move?!
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>De jeito nenhum!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Enquanto eu estiver aqui, posso te <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>mostrar
minha jogada?

source: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh yes, please do show me. I’m quite intrigued.
translation: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Sim, por favor, mostre-me, estou muito intrigado.

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Incredible... You’ve managed to throw that thin, flimsy
leek just like a boomerang.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>But I suppose in terms of power, Bonemerang probably
remains superior.
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Incrível... você conseguiu jogar aquele alho-poró fino
e frágil como um bumerangue.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Mas acho que em termos de poder, Bonemerang provavelmente
permanece superior.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>That might be true, yo, but leeks can ALSO be emergency
rations if you ever find yourself lackin’ food!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Pode até ser verdade, cara, mas alho-poró também serve como ração de emergência
se algum dia faltar comida!

source: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>I...I see. This has been very educational...

<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, pal, you seen any nice-lookin’ boulders around here?
Haven’t sharpened my tusks in a while and it’s buggin’ me.
translation:
<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,5)>Ei, amigo, você viu algum pedregulho bonito por aqui? Não
aguçou minhas presas há um tempo e está me incomodando.

source: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>How do you sharpen your tusks, bud?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Uhhh, so usually, I push my tusks right up against a big
boulder and just kinda...<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>scrape ’em against it, I guess.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Uhhh, então, normalmente, eu empurro minhas presas contra
uma grande pedra e meio que<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>... arranco contra ela, eu acho.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK, I think I get it. Maybe I could help out. I’ll just apply
a li’l pressure, and...
<$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,6)>How’s that?!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Certo, acho que entendo, talvez eu possa ajudar, só vou
aplicar uma pressão e...
<$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,6)>Como assim?

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>HEY! Watch it!
<$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh, be a little more careful, will ya? I wanna sharpen
my tusks, not break ’em!
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Cuidado!
<$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh, tenha um pouco mais de cuidado, quero afiar minhas
presas, não quebrá-las!

source: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Oh, dang. Sorry, bud. Guess it’s trickier than I thought...
translation: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Desculpe, amigão, acho que é mais complicado do que eu pensava...

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Actually... Hold still a sec—your body might be just hard
enough<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)> to sharpen my tusks on!
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Na verdade, espere um segundo, seu corpo pode ser duro o
suficiente <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>para afiar minhas presas!

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, yeah? Cool. I’ll stay perfectly still, then. <$voicel(1,9)>Go ahead
and do your thing.
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Tudo bem, ficarei quieta, então, vá em frente<$voicel(1,9)> e
faça o que quiser.

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks, pal! OK, here goes nothing...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>*scrape scrape scrape*
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ok, aqui vai nada...
* <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>raspagem raspagem raspagem raspagem raspagem raspagem

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>HEY! Didn’t I tell ya to watch it?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh... Guess I’ll go find a boulder that doesn’t move.
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu não te disse para assistir?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Acho que vou encontrar um pedregulho que não se mova.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Y’know, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, those pincers of yours are somethin’ else!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>They both look just like heads!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Sabe, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, essas suas pinças
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)> são outra coisa.

source:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,1)>That pose makes me appear as though I have
three heads...
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>Which causes many would-be opponents to flee in terror,
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>sparing me from unnecessary battles.
translation:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,1)>Essa pose me faz parecer que tenho
três cabeças...
O<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)> que faz com que muitos oponentes fujam aterrorizados,
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>poupando-me de batalhas desnecessárias.

source:
<$motionoff(1,634)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>So you win without even having to fight by scaring
away opponents? Now THAT’S strategy!
translation:
<$motionoff(1,634)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Então você ganha sem ter que lutar
assustando oponentes?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,3)>Wait, hold on... We’ve got six heads, right? But no one
ever <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,9)>gets scared of us. <$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)>They don’t take us seriously at all!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,3)>Espere, espere... temos seis cabeças, mas ninguém
nunca<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,9)> se assusta conosco<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)>, eles não nos levam a sério!

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>What? We’ve got the same face, pal!<$motionoff(1,634)>

<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Yo, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, help us out here!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$motionoff(1,804)>Which of us do you think looks the strongest?
translation:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$cdef(27)>Scizor, nos ajude aqui!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$motionoff(1,804)>Qual de nós você acha que parece mais forte?

source: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Well... I’d say you all look fairly strong.
translation: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Bem... eu diria que todos vocês parecem bastante fortes.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Ha! Yeah, of course you’d get it!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>That’s our pal <$cdef(27)>Scizor for ya!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Sim, claro que você conseguiria!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Esse é o nosso amigo <$cdef(27)>Scizor para você!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Exeggutor</color>! Got a quick question for ya...
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei, ei, <$cdef(27)>Exeggutor, tenho</color> uma pergunta rápida para você...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>You got three heads, same as us. Y’all ever fight with
each other?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Você tem três cabeças, iguais
a nós.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,9)>Lutar? Naaaão. Somos sempre os melhores amigos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Hey, I’m not sayin’ we’re not best buds, either. We’re the
bestest of buds! <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>Except we always fight over food...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>You know a good way for us to avoid gettin’ into fights?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Ei, eu não estou dizendo que não somos melhores amigos, nós somos
os melhores amigos<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>, exceto que sempre lutamos por comida.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Sabe uma boa maneira de evitar brigas?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>You fight over food? I dunnooo... Maybe just split things
nice and easy like friends? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>How do you usually do it?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>Você luta por comida, eu dunnooo, talvez só divida coisas
agradáveis e fáceis como amigos, <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>como você costuma fazer isso?

source: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,1)>I call dibs on all the sweet treats.
translation: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,1)>Eu chamo de dibs em todas as guloseimas doces.

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>I take care of the spicy stuff.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>And I gobble up the sour food.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Ohhh. What about stuff that’s both sweet AND sour?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>E as coisas que são doces e azedas?

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,3)>I ate somethin’ sweet and sour recently. Things got ugly
real fast...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,17)>Well, yeahhh. Even I think that’s kinda not OK.
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,17)>Bem, até eu acho que isso não está bem.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,51)>We fought about some bitter food too, didn’t we, fellas?
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,51)>Nós também brigamos por comida amarga, não é, amigos?

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Weeell, who’s in charge of the bitter foods?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Weeell, quem está no comando dos alimentos amargos?

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,43)>These two didn’t wanna to eat it! That’s why I got
so mad!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>We found a perfectly good berry and left it uneaten!
That’s wasteful, don’tcha think?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,43)>É por isso que eu fiquei tão
brava!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Achamos uma fruta perfeitamente boa e a deixamos sem comer
, isso é um desperdício, não acha?

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,18)>... ... ...
Maybe you three just need to grooow up.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Gosh! What’s wrong? Why are you crying, <$cdef(27)>Misdreavus</color>?

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Did something sad happen to you too?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$comeff(1,2)>I totally get it. Every time I think about my mom I... I...
*sniffle* WAAAAAAH!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Aconteceu algo triste com você também?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$comeff(1,2)>Toda vez que penso na minha
mãe, eu...

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$comeff(1,2)>Waaaaaah! Mommy... Where did you go, Mommy?
WAAAAAAAH!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)>Um, I’m sorry! It was just a little prank! <$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>I didn’t think you’d
cry this hard...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)>Foi só uma brincadeira, eu não achei<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)> que você
choraria tanto...

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>I, er... I’m really sorry. I guess there’s only one thing to do
now: cry. <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,2)>Waaah! WAAAAAAH!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Eu realmente sinto muito, acho que só há uma coisa
a fazer <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,2)>agora: chorar.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)>So we finally get to spar, huh?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)>Those legs of yours look like they’ve got more reach than
my punches. <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Gotta be sure I keep a safe distance.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)>Então finalmente começamos a brigar, hein?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)>As suas pernas parecem ter mais
alcance <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>do que os meus socos.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Ohoho! Why, that’s a keen observation ya jus’ made.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Well then! I’ll show ya what one of my kicks can do. Keep
yer eyes peeled now, y’hear? <$motion(1,815)>Hiyah!!!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Ora, essa é uma observação aguçada que você fez.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Vou te mostrar o que um dos meus chutes pode fazer. Mantenha
seus olhos descascados agora, <$motion(1,815)>você ouve?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,802)>What?! How did your legs stretch out so far? Are my eyes
playing tricks on me?!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,802)>Como suas pernas se esticaram até agora, meus olhos
estão brincando comigo?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha! I can kick anyone, anywhere! There’s nowhere to
run when I come a-kickin’!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha, eu posso chutar qualquer um, em qualquer lugar, não há
para onde correr quando eu chegar.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Me, run? Not likely. In fact, let me return the favor by
showing you my punches. <$motion(2,200)>Hup-hup-HYAH!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Na verdade, deixe-me retribuir o favor
, mostrando meus<$motion(2,200)> socos.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Well, I declare! That was faster than I expected...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>I could feel the air ’round yer fists heat up from the
sheer speed!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Bem, eu declaro que foi mais rápido do que eu esperava...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Eu podia sentir o ar ao redor de seus punhos esquentar a partir da
velocidade pura!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh. That’s ’cause I put my soul into each punch.
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Enough talk—let us spar!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Isso é porque eu coloquei minha alma em cada soco.
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Chega de conversa, vamos brigar!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$motionoff(1,804)>Hoo yeah! Don’tcha dare hold back now—’cause ya know
I sure won’t!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$motionoff(1,804)>Não se atreva a se segurar agora, porque você sabe
que eu não vou!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>Whenever I’m with you, there’s always the nicest smell...
I wonder what it is.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>Sempre que estou com você, sempre há o cheiro mais agradável...
Eu me pergunto o que é.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Huh? I dunno... Maybe it’s the berries I have?
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Eu não sei... talvez sejam as frutas que eu tenho?

source: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Naw, it’s not that. It smells even nicer than berries...
translation: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Não, não é isso, cheira ainda melhor que frutas.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>Huh... I don’t have anything else with me. I dunno what
it could be!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>Não tenho mais nada comigo, não sei o que
poderia ser.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Oh! It smells even stronger now... *sniff sniff* *sniff sniff*
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>I got it—it’s the smell of your vines!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Cheira ainda mais forte agora... farejador de farejador... farejador de farejador...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Eu entendi, é o cheiro de suas videiras!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,803)>Whoa, really? My vines? You think my vines smell nice?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Hee hee! That makes me kinda happy!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,803)>Acha que minhas videiras cheiram bem
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>, isso me deixa feliz?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Mmm, yeah, they smell WONDERFUL. It’s the bestest
smell I think I’ve ever smelled...
<$comeff(2,7)>...*rumble*
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Y’know, your vines smell so tasty...and my tummy is just
about running on empty here...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>É, eles cheiram maravilhosamente, é o melhor
cheiro que eu acho que já senti.
.<$comeff(2,7)>..*rumble*
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Sabe, suas videiras cheiram tão saborosas... e minha barriga
está quase correndo vazia aqui...

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>Wha—?! No, don’t eat them!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Here! Look, I’ll give you a berry—just don’t eat my vines!
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>Não, não os coma!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Olha, eu vou te dar uma fruta-apenas não coma minhas videiras!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)>Wow! That’s some mighty fine speed and precision, if I do
say so myself!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)>Essa é uma ótima velocidade e precisão, se eu disser
isso eu mesmo!

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Heh, thanks! These scythes of mine are extra sharp today!
translation: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Essas minhas foices estão mais afiadas hoje!

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>My claws aren’t too shabby either, y’know! Watch this!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Zree! Drrrrrrrrr!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Minhas garras também não estão muito sujas
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>, você sabe!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Whoa, those things pack a powerful punch! And that shine
on your drill... Gotta say, I’m impressed!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Essas coisas dão um soco poderoso, e isso brilha no seu
treino... tenho que dizer, estou impressionado!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Heh... Comin’ from a strong Pokémon like you, I’ll gladly
take that compliment.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Vindo de um Pokémon forte como você, aceitarei com
prazer esse elogio.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Ha! I could say the same, pal.<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>. Were you watchin’ us?
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>Well, whaddya think? We’re both pretty amazing, right?
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Eu poderia dizer o mesmo, amigo.<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Estava<$cdef(27)> nos vigiando?
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>Bem, o que você acha?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh, you must be pretty sharp to recognize our greatness.
You got promise, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Você deve ser muito esperto para reconhecer nossa grandeza
, você tem a promessa, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Now I’m feelin’ even more flattered! This has me inspired
to get my drill into even better shape!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Agora estou me sentindo ainda mais lisonjeada, isso me inspirou a
colocar minha broca em uma forma ainda melhor!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Yeah, for sure! And I’m gonna work on sharpening up
these scythes even more!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Sim, com certeza, e vou trabalhar para afiar
ainda mais essas foices!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)>Uh, what?! <wait(0.8)>Are you serious? But we were so cool just now!
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)>Você está <wait(0.8)>falando sério, mas nós éramos tão legais agora!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Urrrgh! I’m gonna have to train my drill even harder now
so <$cdef(27)> understands jus’ <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,10)>how
amazin’
it is!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Vou ter que treinar meu treino ainda mais agora
, <$cdef(27)>então entenda o <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,10)>quanto
é
incrível!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>Aw yeah, good plan! I’ll do some extra training too! You
just wait, <$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>Ah, sim, bom plano! Eu vou fazer um pouco de treinamento extra também
! Você apenas espera, <$cdef(27)>!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Pinsir! Is it my imagination, or do your horns
somehow look MORE pathetic than usual?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>Pinsir, é minha imaginação, ou seus chifres de alguma forma
parecem mais patéticos do que o habitual?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Hmph! Big talk fer someone who’s only got one horn,
<$cdef(27)>Heracross—and a sorry excuse fer one at that!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Uma grande conversa sobre alguém que só tem um
chifre, <$cdef(27)>Heracross... e uma desculpa para isso!

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,14)>What’d you say?!
<$voicel(2,5)>I’ve picked up a <$cdef(27)>Graveler with this horn before and flipped
’em right over!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,10)>I saved ’em after they’d gotten stuck upside down and
couldn’t move!
translation:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,14)>O que você disse?
<$voicel(2,5)>Peguei um <$cdef(27)>Graveler com esse chifre antes e os
virei logo!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,10)>Eu os salvei depois que eles ficaram presos de cabeça para baixo e não
conseguiram se mover!

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,15)><$facial(1,7)>That ain’t nothin’ to boast about!
<$voicel(1,5)>Why, I once saw me a <$cdef(27)>Graveler rollin’ outta control down
a mountain...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,806)>I stopped ’em dead in their tracks with these horns o’
mine—sure did!
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,15)><$facial(1,7)>Isso não é nada para se vangloriar!
<$voicel(1,5)>Uma vez eu vi um Graveler<$cdef(27)> rolando fora do controle por
uma montanha...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,806)>Eu os parei mortos em seus rastros com esses chifres de
certeza que sim!

source: <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,43)>Pfft... Don’t you know when to admit you’re beat?!
translation: <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,43)>Pfft... você não sabe quando admitir que está derrotado?!

source: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,43)>I could say the same of you, I tell you what!
translation: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,43)>Eu poderia dizer o mesmo de você, eu digo uma coisa!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Ugh. Talkin’ to you is a waste of time! I’m goin’ home!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,10)>I’m just glad<$cdef(27)> made us
separate
homes!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Falar com você é uma perda de tempo!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,10)>Estou feliz que <$cdef(27)> nos fez
casas
separadas!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,7)>Darn right! That way we won’t get into these ridiculous
squabbles every dang day!
<$voicel(1,10)>Y’know what?! I’m goin’ home too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,7)>Dessa forma, não vamos entrar nessas brigas
ridículas todos os dias!
<$voicel(1,10)>Eu vou para casa também!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Y’know, I’ve been meanin’ to ask ya about this fer a
while now...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>Why’re you always luggin’ around that big ol’ steel beam?
Ain’t it heavy?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Sabe, faz tempo que quero te perguntar uma coisa:
por que você vive carregando aquela viga de aço enorme? Ela é pesada?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>My buddy here’s been with me since I was a kid. What am
I supposed to do—put it down? Not likely, pal!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>We’re always together, even while I’m sleepin’.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>Meu amigo aqui está comigo desde que eu era criança. O que eu
deveria fazer? Abaixá-lo? Não é provável, amigo!
Estamos<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)> sempre juntos, mesmo enquanto eu estou dormindo.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Well...I s’pose it’s fine if it helps ya sleep ’n’ whatnot.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Bem... eu acho que está tudo bem se isso te ajudar a dormir.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,8)>Yeah! I work out with it, take naps with it... <$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,806)>That kind of
stuff just blasts my stress away!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,8)>Eu me exercito com isso, cochilo com isso...<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,806)> esse tipo
de coisa acaba com meu estresse!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)>Hmmm...I see. You got somethin’ stressin’ ya bad?
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)>Eu vejo, você tem alguma coisa te estressando?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$motionoff(2,804)>Yeah, I’m really, REALLY itchin’ to smash somethin’ up with
this steel beam. Like, real bad.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$motionoff(2,804)>Sim, eu estou realmente, realmente tentando quebrar alguma
coisa com este feixe de aço.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,15)>Do what now? Them’s dangerous urges ya got there.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,15)>Eles são impulsos perigosos que você chegou lá.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>Back when humans were around, new buildings were
constantly popping up all over the place.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>And when I knocked down old buildings with my buddy
here, the humans got real happy<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)>—it made me feel great!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)>Quando os humanos estavam por perto, novos edifícios
apareciam constantemente por todo o lado.
E<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)> quando derrubei prédios antigos com meu amigo aqui,
os humanos ficaram muito felizes. <$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)>Isso me fez sentir ótimo!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ahhh, I see. So smashin’ stuff was yer job, more or
less, huh?

<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)>Yeah. Now the human buildings are mostly in shambles.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,807)>And I’m not about to go around smashin’ up the stuff that
<$cdef(27)> and others work so hard
to build.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,26)>Those construction-happy humans... Where’d they all go?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)>Agora os edifícios humanos estão em ruínas.
E<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,807)> eu não estou prestes a sair por aí esmagando as coisas que
<$cdef(27)> e outros trabalham tão duro para
construir.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,26)>Aqueles humanos felizes em construção... para onde todos eles foram?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey, what’re you doing, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>being so still there like that?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>I found a SUN SPOT! Basking in one o’ these makes
me feel SO nice and warm!<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,6)> You wanna soak up some rays?!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Sure, I’ll join you!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,16)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Oh wow... I’m getting so warm... *yawn*

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Hehehe... Warming up in the sunlight totally makes you
feel sleepy, right? Wanna get some shut-eye?

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,16)>Oh, I know the...perfect place...for a nap...<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,666)> It’s all full...
of...flowers...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,620)><$motion(2,620)><$facial(1,1)>*yawn* Such a good nap... Wakey, wakey, <$cdef(27)>Leafeon</color>!

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$cdef(27)>Eevee! Mornin’!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>I was having this dream, and it felt like I was
in this place with TONS of flowers... <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>Oh yeah, it was an
AWESOME place!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$voicel(1,6)>That’s the spot I was talking about!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>We should go together sometime!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>There’s sooo much yummy stuff around here...

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>Yeah... I found some suuuper yummy mud near the ocean
the other day. <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)>It tasted reeeaaally good with berries...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Whoooaaa, really? Maybe I should try that sometime...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Do you have any fun food pairings like thaaat, <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>?

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Not reeeaaally... Everything tastes pretty equally good to
me. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,1)>Maybe just eating things in large amooouuunts?

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Yeeeaaah, I get that. When I’m really hungry, <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>I can eat
a bunch of berries and the whooole berry tree with them...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Oh yeah... I bet wooden chairs are pretty yummy. I want to
try one...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Do you have any suggestions for huuuman stuff we could
eat, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Whaaat? You don’t make that stuff for eeeaaating? Awww...

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Cacturne... I noticed that you just kinda...stay put
during the day. You don’t move much at all.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>Cacturne... notei que você meio que
... fica parado durante o dia.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Well...yeah. It’s just so hot and bright during the day.
Night’s a better time for me to move around. I don’t get as tired.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Bem... sim, é tão quente e brilhante durante o dia. A
noite é um momento melhor para eu me mover. Eu não fico tão cansado.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Heh heh... I get it. I spend most days just <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>sleeping in my
home, so I guess we’re kinda the same.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Passo a maior parte dos dias dormindo<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)> na minha
casa, então acho que somos o mesmo.

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Heh... I guess so.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>But these days I’ve been oversleeping so much... <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,7)>I can’t
help it! The home <$cdef(27)>
made
for
me
is
too comfy!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Acho que sim.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Mas hoje em dia eu tenho dormido demais... não <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,7)>posso
evitar, a casa feita<$cdef(27)>
para
mim é
muito

confortável!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Oh... In that case, would you want me to come and wake
you up, <$cdef(27)>Cacturne?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Nesse caso, quer que eu vá te acordar
, <$cdef(27)>Cacturne?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>It’s no problem! Not to brag, but I’ve never overslept once
in my whole life.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)>I’ll come wake you up at exactly the same time every day,
so you can rest easy!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Não é problema, não me gabar, mas nunca dormi demais uma vez em
toda a minha vida.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu vou te acordar exatamente na mesma hora todos os dias, para
que você possa descansar!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Salutations, <$cdef(27)>Chandelure. I see your flames are as beautiful
as ever.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Saudações, <$cdef(27)>Chandelure, vejo que suas chamas estão tão bonitas
como sempre.

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Why thank you. That’s a kind thing to say.
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>É uma coisa gentil de se dizer.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Whenever I see that bewitching light, it seems my
mind grows clear and sharp.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>And I’m able to ponder things far, far more deeply than
usual.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Sempre que vejo aquela luz enfeitiçante, parece que
minha mente fica clara e afiada.
E<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)> eu sou capaz de refletir sobre as coisas muito, muito mais profundamente do que o
habitual.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)>I’m honored to be of service.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)>Though I’m sad to say my flames have lost some of their
previous vibrancy...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)> They seem smaller now, too.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)>Sinto-me honrado por estar a serviço.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)>Embora eu esteja triste em dizer que minhas chamas perderam parte de
sua vibração anterior... <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)>elas parecem menores agora também.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Oh dear... That’s not any good. Can you think of a reason
why?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Querida, isso não é bom, você pode pensar em uma razão para
isso?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Well, I imagine it’s the lack of spirits. I’ve not absorbed
one for a while now.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Bem, eu imagino que é a falta de espíritos. Eu não absorvo
um por um tempo agora.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)>You see, my flames<$motion(2,816)> come from the spirits of departed
humans and Pokémon.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)>Minhas chamas vêm<$motion(2,816)> dos espíritos dos humanos
falecidos e Pokémon.

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>To all appearances, humans have completely vanished...
<$voicel(2,5)>And there are still precious few Pokémon, as well.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>And since <$cdef(27)> is working tirelessly
to
fix that...
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)>I can’t very well take the spirits of the Pokémon around
here, can I?
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Para todas as aparências, os humanos desapareceram completamente...
E<$voicel(2,5)> ainda há poucos Pokémon, também.
E<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)> já que <$cdef(27)> está trabalhando incansavelmente para

consertar isso...
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)>Eu não posso muito bem levar os espíritos dos Pokémon por
aqui, posso?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>But if I could acquire the spirit of a Pokémon as wise and
as dignified as you...<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>surely my flames would burn more
brilliantly than ever before.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Mas se eu pudesse adquirir o espírito de um Pokémon tão sábio
e digno como você... <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>certamente minhas chamas queimariam
mais brilhantemente do que nunca.

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,27)>...Oh my!
<$voicel(1,2)>I, erm...<$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)>I just remembered an errand that requires my
attention, so I must immediately excuse myself!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,27)>Oh, meu Deus!
<$voicel(1,2)>Acabei de <$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)>me lembrar de um recado que requer minha
atenção, então devo me desculpar imediatamente!

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Don’t be silly. I was only joking!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, no! <$cdef(27)>Tyrogue</color>, dear, you’re injured! <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,4)>Are you all right?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,5)>Yeah, I’m all good! <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(2,803)>I always get like this after training.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>I gotta work hard if I wanna get big, strong muscles!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,5)>Sempre fico <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(2,803)>assim depois do treino.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Eu tenho que trabalhar duro se eu quiser ter músculos grandes e fortes!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hee hee, I’m sure you will, dear! But please don’t
overdo it.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>If you really want to grow strong, you need to prioritize
recuperation and good nutrition!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Tenho certeza que sim, querida, mas por favor,
não exagere.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Se você realmente quer crescer forte, você precisa priorizar
a recuperação e boa nutrição!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>That just means getting plenty of rest and plenty of food!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Speaking of which, I’ve got a present for you!
translation:
