<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>Isso só significa descansar bastante e muita comida!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Falando nisso, tenho um presente para você!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Whoa, that looks yummy! Thanks a bunch for looking out
for me, <$cdef(27)>Slowking!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>And there’s more where that came from! Here, take this,
too...and this... And this!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re young, so you need to get plenty to eat!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Aqui, pegue isso, também... e
isso... e isso!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Você é jovem, então precisa comer muito!

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>You sure? This sure is a lot. I dunno if I can eat it all...
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Isso é muito, não sei se posso comer tudo.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>Hee hee hee... You know, I just happen to have some time
on my hands right now.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>So I’ll just keep you company <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,8)>until you eat aaallll of those
up and fall into a nice, refreshing sleep!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>Sabe, eu só tenho algum tempo em
minhas mãos agora.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Então eu vou te fazer companhia <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,8)>até que você coma um monte deles
e caia em um sono agradável e refrescante!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>Um, no thanks. If I eat all that I won’t be able to move!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>Não, obrigado, se eu comer tudo o que eu não vou ser capaz de se mover!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>*sniff sniff* Hey! I’d know that delicious smell anywhere!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>You’ve been out collectin’ nectar, haven’t ya?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,27)>Eep! <$cdef(27)>Heracross! Don’t tell me...you want nectar again,
don’t you?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Heh! Guilty as charged! *droooool*
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Maybe you could share some with me, eh? Just a little bit?

<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>No way!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)>Last time you said that, <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>you ate ALL the nectar I had!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Awww, c’mon!<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>I’m not even that hungry! A taste is all I’m askin for...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>But I collected this to give to the queen!
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>There’s still lotsa nectar in the flower fields—go get
some yourself!

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)>Hrnnngh...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>You can’t spare even a teensy-weensy drop for your ol’
pal <$cdef(27)>Heracross?

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)>NO! No matter how many times you ask me, the answer’s
still NO!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>... I can’t decide. Should I focus on
punching or kicking? Hmmm...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Hitmontop, which one do you think is better?
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>Não posso decidir, devo me
concentrar em socar ou chutar?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)><$cdef(27)>Hitmontop, qual você acha que é melhor?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Y’know, that’s a GREAT question, <$cdef(27)>Tyrogue! I agonized over
that same decision back in the day! I worried myself
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>round and round in circles...until I found THE ANSWER!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Sabe, essa é uma grande pergunta<$cdef(27)>, Tyrogue, eu
agonizava com essa mesma decisão no passado, eu me
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>preocupava em círculos, até encontrar a resposta.

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>You should focus on...BOTH! And...NEITHER! The true
answer to life is SPINNING! YEAHHH! SPIN TO WIN!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>A verdadeira resposta para a vida é
ESPINHO, SIM, ESPINHO PARA GANHAR!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>YEAH! You should spin—just like this! That way you can
punch and kick at the SAME TIME!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>Sim, você deveria girar assim, dessa forma você pode dar
um soco e chutar o mesmo tempo.

source: <$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Uh... That doesn’t really help me pick...

<$voicel(2,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>Ultimate defense! Unstoppable attacks! Spinning on your
head gives you BOTH and frees up your arms AND legs!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>It’s a total waste to only specialize in a single thing!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>Defesa final! Ataques imparáveis! Girar na cabeça dá
a ambos e liberta os braços e as pernas! É um
desperdício<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)> total se especializar apenas em uma única coisa!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Um...OK. I think <wait(0.5)>I need to think about this more...
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Acho que preciso<wait(0.5)> pensar mais sobre isso...

source: <$motion(2,670)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$cdef(27)>Drilbur</color>! Not like you to pout, buddy! What’s wrong?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$cdef(27)>Hitmontop! OK, get this—when I dig through the dirt, I
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,815)>usually do it like THIS, yeah?
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,53)>But I figured if I added a little spin move to it, I could
MEGA ULTRA DIG! <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,47)><$kfacial(2)>But, uh, it’s not exactly going well...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,666)>Dang... Maybe I’m just not cut out for this.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>What?! Uh-uh, no WAY that’s true! Your rotation on that
last one was GREAT!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Yeah...YEAH! You’re so right! My spin wasn’t THAT bad!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,644)><$facial(2,7)>All right, ONE MORE TRY!

<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)>WHOA! That one was fantastic! Amazing! <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)>You and me are
like, SPIN TWINS!

<$emotion(2,5)>...Wowww.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Your spin was basically a million times better than I could
ever do. Guess I’m really NOT built for the spinning life...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)>Ack! Nooo! <$cdef(27)>Drilbur</color>! Don’t give in to despair! You got this!<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)><$cdef(27)>Illumise</color>! C’mon, let’s go for a walk together!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh dear, <$cdef(27)>Volbeat, that’s no way to extend an invitation to
a lady!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh querida, <$cdef(27)>Volbeat, isso não é maneira de estender um convite para uma
senhora!

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Your choice of words is too coarse. You must speak in a
more courteous, refined manner.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>And your demeanor is lacking—you need to be more...
fabulous! And elegant!
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Sua escolha de palavras é muito grosseira, você deve falar de
uma maneira mais cortês e refinada.
E<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)> seu comportamento está faltando, você precisa ser mais
... fabuloso e elegante!

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,58)>I gotta be <$cdef(27)>Zweilous and <$cdef(27)>Elekid?! Wh-what does that
even MEAN?
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,58)>Eu tenho que ser <$cdef(27)>Zweilous<$cdef(27)> e Elekid, o que isso
quer dizer?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,50)>That’s not what I said, you silly bean.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,21)>In any case, it appears that you’re not quite ready to be
issuing invitations!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,50)>Não foi o que eu disse, seu feijão bobo.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,21)>De qualquer forma, parece que você não está pronto
para emitir convites!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,20)>Aww... I only wanted to hang out together some.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>It’s just that my happiest moments are whenever I’m with
YOU, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,20)>Aww... eu só queria sair juntos um pouco.
É<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)> que meus momentos mais felizes são sempre que estou com
você, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,6)>Oh, you absolute darling. That was very sweet.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,1)>Well, if it means that much to you, I suppose we could go
for a short stroll. How does that sound?
translation:
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,6)>Oh, sua querida absoluta, isso foi muito doce.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,1)>Bem, se isso significa muito para você, acho
que podemos dar um curto passeio.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,7)>FOR REAL?! Hahaha! HECK YEAH! I’m psyched! ♪
I seriously love you, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,7)>SÉRIO?! Hahaha! ISSO AÍ! Que alegria! ♪
Eu amo você de verdade, <$cdef(27)>Illumise!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Your Majesty! We gathered up lots and lots of nectar
for you!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>See? Here’s some REALLY sweet nectar I found! <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>It’s all
sticky and yummy!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Sua Majestade, reunimos muito néctar para
você!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Aqui está um néctar muito doce que encontrei<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>, é
pegajoso e gostoso.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>Hey! Stop trying to hog the spotlight!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>I was the one who found the flowers that smelled the
strongest! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>So I bet MY nectar’s way tastier!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>Pare de tentar pegar os holofotes!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>Fui eu que encontrei as flores que cheiravam mais forte,
então aposto <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>que o meu néctar era mais saboroso!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>No, no, I think the queen’s gonna like mine
the best!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>It’s got a nice refreshing aftertaste so you can eat as
much of it as you want!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Não, não, acho que a rainha vai gostar da minha
melhor!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>Tem um sabor refrescante para que você possa comer
o máximo que quiser!

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Come now, let’s not argue.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>I love equally all the nectar you three bring me. In fact,
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,803)>I will happily enjoy all of it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Venha agora, não vamos discutir.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Eu amo igualmente todo o néctar que
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,803)>vocês três me trazem.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Really?! So, um, does that mean we can bring you
even MORE?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Então, isso significa que podemos te trazer
ainda mais?

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Oooh, yaaay! We found lots more that we couldn’t carry,
<$voicel(1,6)>so we’ll bring AAALL that back too!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Encontramos muito mais que não poderíamos carregar, então
<$voicel(1,6)> vamos trazer TUUUDO de volta também!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)>Yeah, the liquidy stuff was that way, and the stuff that
smelled like berries was over that way!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)>Sim, as coisas líquidas eram assim, e as coisas
que cheiravam a frutas eram assim!

source: <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>We’re gonna bring you SO much nectar, Your Majesty!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Oh my... You truly have much more than this? I’m not
certain I can finish all that on my own...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>I know—let’s eat the nectar together! Yes, that’s what we
should do!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Você realmente tem muito mais do que isso, não tenho
certeza se posso terminar tudo sozinho.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Eu sei, vamos comer o néctar
juntos!

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Phew... I played a ton! Maybe I should take a little break.
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Eu joguei uma tonelada, talvez eu devesse fazer uma pequena pausa.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>How about a little stroll across the skyyy, then? Just hop
on, and I’ll take it from theeere.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Que tal um passeio pelo céééu, então? É só subir
e deixar o resto comiiigo.

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)><$facial(2,4)>Really?! That sounds so fun!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)>But, umm... I’m always on fire. I don’t want to burn
you, <$cdef(27)>Drifblim...
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)><$facial(2,4)>Isso parece tão divertido!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)>Mas estou sempre pegando fogo, não quero queimá
-lo, <$cdef(27)>Drifblim.

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Nahhh. I actually really like the heat...
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Ah, não. Na verdade, eu gosto bastante do calor...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Whenever I give a hot Pokémon a riiide, I always feel like I
can go wayyyyyy higher than usual...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)>I go so high that all the Pokémon on the grooouuund look
like little specks.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Sempre que dou um riiide a um Pokémon quente, sempre sinto que
posso ir mais alto do que o habitual...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,815)>Eu vou tão alto que todos os Pokémon no groouuund parecem
pequenas manchas.

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,5)>Uhhh... You can go THAT high up?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,4)>Hey, umm... How long does a stroll usually take? Could I,
like, get off in the middle, if I had to?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Um, not that I’m scared!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,5)>Você pode ir tão alto?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,4)>Ei, quanto tempo leva um passeio? Eu
poderia, tipo, sair no meio,
se<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)> eu tivesse que?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>I guess it depends on the wind... I once floated around
aaalllll daaay.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Hehehe... I sure would like to try going hiiigher and
floating off even faaarther than I did then.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Acho que depende do vento... uma vez eu flutuei em torno
de Aalll Daaay.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Hehehe... eu com certeza gostaria de tentar ir mais hiiigher e
flutuando até mesmo faaarther do que eu fiz então.

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>N-no way! Absolutely not! No rides for me, thank you
very much!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>Your claws are so big and cool, <$cdef(27)>Drilbur. I’m jealous...
My tusks are still pretty small.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>Suas garras são tão grandes e legais, <$cdef(27)>Drilbur, estou com ciúmes..
. minhas presas ainda são bem pequenas.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hehehe—they’re amazing, right?! I can dig a hole straight
through to wherever I need to go!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Eu posso cavar um buraco direto para
onde eu precisar ir!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Whoa, that sounds so cool... <$comeff(2,6)>Can you dig a cave that I can
fit in?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I like caves <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>’cause it’s like having my own cozy secret base!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Isso parece tão legal... você pode <$comeff(2,6)>cavar uma caverna em que eu possa me
encaixar?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Eu gosto de cavernas<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)> porque é como ter minha própria base secreta aconchegante!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>’Course I can! I can do whatever you want, really. I could
make a SUPER long tunnel, or <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,9)>even cover this whole
area with holes if you wanted!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu posso fazer o que você quiser, realmente, eu poderia fazer
um túnel longo SUPER, ou mesmo<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,9)> cobrir toda esta área
com buracos, se você quisesse!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Awesome! Yeah, let’s make some caves together!
And tunnels! HUGE ones!!!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Sim, vamos fazer algumas cavernas
juntas, túneis, enormes!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>YEAH! Let’s do it!
Wait, hold on... Isn’t <$cdef(27)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>fixing
up
the
land
for
everyone
around here?<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Uhh... Should we really be digging a big ol’ cave?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, vamos fazer isso!
Espere, espere... <$cdef(27)> não
está<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>
arrumando
a
terra

para todos
por aqui?<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Devemos cavar uma grande caverna?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Vamos, <$cdef(27)>, você tem que cavar
conosco,

podemos<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>
fazer
a
maior
caverna
de<$voicel(1,6)> todos

os tempos!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>I always get all dried out whenever I chat with <$cdef(27)>Lampent...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>Could I ask you to splash me with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>?

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>You were talking about how you kept that lost kid safe,
right, <$cdef(27)>Lampent? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)>Gosh, you’re so amazing...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Nah, I just managed to help them out ’cause I know my
way around caves...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Wait...are you drying up again, <$cdef(27)>Goomy?
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)>,
could
you
hit
them
with
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)><$cdef(27)>
again, please?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Uhhh...but how do you stop yourself from getting lost in a
cave in the first place?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>When I turn a corner, I usually leave some kind of mark.
It helps me keep track of where I came from...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>That’s a great idea! I gotta try it out next time.<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)>Um, hey... Sorry to keep asking, <$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>but couldja spray me with
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> again, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Maybe that’s enough talking for today... I had so much fun!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,50)>Yeah! We got to talk a LOT today! <$lookat(2,1,0)>And it’s all thanks to
you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Whoa, your tusks are HUGE! Are mine gonna look like
that someday?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Suas presas são enormes, as minhas vão ficar assim
algum dia?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Well, now! If ya want tusks like mine, the most important
thing ya need...is courage!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Se você quer presas como a minha, a coisa mais importante
que você precisa... é coragem!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>I’ll give ya an example. Let’s say ya pick up a berry, and
it’s hard as a rock. What do ya do?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Vou dar um exemplo. Digamos que você pegue uma fruta e
ela esteja dura como uma pedra. O que você faz?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>I’d split it open and eat it!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,31)>Oh, but I could hurt my tusks if I don’t split it right.
I don’t want that...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Eu quebraria para abrir e comer!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,31)>Ah, mas posso machucar minhas presas se quebrar errado.
Melhor não arriscar...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>All right. What about when a strong Pokémon wants to
tussle with ya? Do ya fight back with yer tusks?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Certo. E quando um Pokémon forte quer
brigar com você? Você se defende usando as presas?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>What?! No way! I’d be too scared. And I don’t wanna
damage my trusty tusks! I’d run away.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>De jeito nenhum, eu ficaria com muito medo, e não quero
estragar minhas presas de confiança, eu fugiria.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)>Well, that ain’t no good! No good at all! How do ya expect
to get stronger doin’ like that?!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Now listen up, <$cdef(27)>Axew. Even if ya break a tusk, it’ll jus’ grow
back! And each time it does, it’ll get stronger!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Get rid o’ that fear! Chow down on lots of hard food!
Knock tusks with the toughest of opponents!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)>Bem, isso não é bom, não é bom de jeito nenhum, como você
espera ficar mais forte fazendo assim?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Agora escute, <$cdef(27)>Axew, mesmo que você quebre uma presa, ela voltará a
crescer, e cada vez que isso acontecer, ficará mais forte!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Livrem-se desse medo, espreitem-se com muita comida dura
, batam presas com os adversários mais duros!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh... I think—I think I get it now, <$cdef(27)>Haxorus!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>I gotta be brave and step it up. So...I challenge you to
a battle! Bring it!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Acho que entendi agora, <$cdef(27)>Haxorus!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)>Eu tenho que ser corajoso e intensificar isso, então... eu desafio
você a uma batalha!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)>Heck yeah! That’s the spirit! Bring it on, <$cdef(27)>Axew</color>!

<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Just...just getting a bit...dried out... Just let me get to...
get to some shade and...I’ll be fi—

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>How was that for ya?! My Hydro Pump works wonders,
don’t it?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ooof... You don’t hold back at all, do you, <$cdef(27)>Blastoise?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>But that did the trick! I’m all nice and moisturized!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>I bet you are! But I reckon you might need a li’l more
waterin’! Get ready to get soaked! Hoo-ah!

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(1,9)>Wuhhh... I feel it echoing round ’n’ round ’n’ round... Oh,
<$cdef(27)>!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)> <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)>Did they get you too?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Hey, you know what? I can use <$cdef(27)>Supersonic </color>too!
<$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh yeah? You think it’s that easy? I’d like to see you try!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Hee hee, just you wait! Now listen close! *inhale*... ... ...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,5)><$textsize(2)>AAAAAAAAAAAA!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Hey. You. Quit copying me, got it?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)>Save it, pal! I see those huge wings you’ve got. They look
just like mine!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>And what about those cute little eyes, huh? Don’t try and
deny you’re copying mine!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Did you say cuuute? <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>Do you think your eyes are
cuuute, <$cdef(27)>Golbat?

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>To top it all off, you’ve got the GALL to try and steal my
best, most charming feature... My MASSIVE MOUTH!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Mine iiisn’t a mouth, it’s a beak. Your mouth is pretty big,
though... <$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,29)>You don’t get tired having it open all the time?

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>Hey! Don’t try and change the subject!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>You see it, right, <$cdef(27)>? They’re
totally
copying me!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Whaaat? If I were trying to copy you, I would do a waaay
better job at it. <$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(2,7)>See? Like this<$motionoff(2,804)>...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,10)>HEY! What did I JUST say about copying me?! That pose is
off-limits from now on, got it?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>What?! You can’t be serious!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Here I thought if anyone could spot a copycat, it’d be a
<$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,8)><$spwfull(36)>ation pro like you...

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>I heard no one’s ever seen what’s under there, so I figure
you gotta be hiding some awesome treasure or something!

<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)>What? I’m not hiding any treasure...
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>I’m wearing this cloth so I don’t scare everyone...

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Really? Huh.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>...OK, now I gotta see! Can I take a peek?
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>W-weren’t you listening?! That’s really not a good idea...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)>Don’t worry about it. I’m not scared of nothin’!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,5)>Ahhh! They saw me...and now <$cdef(27)>Meowth has collapsed on
the ground!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>What should we do, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>The horror... The horror!
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,18)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>How come I feel like I just lost one of my nine lives?
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I did warn you... Don’t ever look again, OK?

<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Here, you can have this. I’ve got a lot of them, so I
wanted to share. ♪
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Aqui, você pode ter isso. Eu tenho um monte deles, então eu
queria compartilhar.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(1,18)><$motion(2,750)>Oh? Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Psyduck! That’s real nice of ya, bud!
Where’d you get all these berries from, anyway?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(1,18)><$motion(2,750)>Ei, ei, <$cdef(27)>Psyduck, isso é muito legal da sua parte,
amigo, de onde você tirou todas essas frutas?

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$facial(1,1)>Um, so... My head was hurting really bad earlier, <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,13)>so I
closed my eyes reeeaaally tight, and then...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>A whole bunch of berries suddenly dropped out of the
tree right in front of me—

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$facial(1,1)>Minha cabeça estava doendo muito antes, então <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,13)>fechei
meus olhos reeeaaaaally apertado, e então...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Um monte de frutas de repente caiu da árvore

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Aha! I see! That’s your superpower at work, my friend.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,803)>Sounds like you can’t really control it yet, though.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Esse é o seu superpoder no trabalho, meu amigo
,<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,803)> parece que você ainda não pode controlá-lo.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Whoa, I have a superpower? Uh... How am I supposed
to control it—?

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>OK! Here’s what we’ll do—as my way of sayin’ thanks, I’ll
give you a crash course in usin’ that superpower of yours!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Now then, what were you thinkin’ about when this berry
incident took place, bud?

eu vou te dar um curso intensivo em nós em que o seu superpoder!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Agora, então, o que você estava pensando quando este incidente
de frutas ocorreu, amigo?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>I was thinking. Um... What was it—? Uhhh, I can’t really

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)>DAH!

<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu estava pensando... o que foi isso? Uhhh, eu realmente
não consigo me <$facial(1,14)>lembrar
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)>agora.

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,11)><$facial(2,14)>OOF!
<$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,23)>Hey! Hey! Hold up! That superpower of yours is really
layin’ into me here...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)>Y’know what? Maybe just don’t think at all for a second!
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,11)><$facial(2,14)>UI!
<$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,23)>Ei! Ei! Espere! Esse seu poder está
me dando uma surra...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)>Sabe de uma coisa? Tente não pensar em nada por um instante!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)>Oh, am I not supposed to think? Uhhh, I dunno—that

<$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>DAH!

<$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>.

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)>S-sorry, bud... This crash course might have to wait till

translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,11)>Bwaggghhh!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,1)>Desculpe, amigo... este curso de colisão pode ter que esperar

source:

take a little break.

<$voicel(2,3)>Everyone gets scared and runs away when they see what

<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Não, isso é uma sensação instintiva.
Embora eu não tenha coragem.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Porque eu sou um computador.

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I see... Well, maybe someday when I feel brave enough,

source:

has
that

<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)>Bu!

source:
...<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>Sorry, kid, but that wasn’t scary. Like, at all.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>I doubt that’d make any human feel scared, let alone
a target like <$cdef(27)>.
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>Desculpe, garoto, mas isso não foi assustador.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Duvido que isso faria qualquer ser humano se sentir assustado,
muito menos um alvo como <$cdef(27)>.

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,7)>Whaaat?! Aw...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Well, just you wait. One day, I’m gonna be SUPER scary,
just like <$cdef(27)>Gengar !
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,7)>O quêêê?! Ah...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Pois espere só. Um dia, vou ser SUPER assustador,
igual a <$cdef(27)>Gengar!

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Ugh! Me too! I used to prank humans on days like this...
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Eu também brincava com humanos em dias como este...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Those were the days, huh?! Whenever humans got close
to my home, <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>I’d spook ’em real good from the shadows!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,14)>I can still remember the looks on their faces!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Sempre que os humanos se aproximavam da minha
casa, eu <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>os assustava muito bem das sombras!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,14)>Ainda me lembro dos olhares deles!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Hahaha! Yeah, I can imagine! Humans make the best
scared faces, don’t they?
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>I loved hidin’ in the shadows, slowly stealin’ people’s
warmth till they started shiverin’ in their boots—<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>then I’d
pop out and scare ’em! It never got old!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Hahaha! É, imagino! Os humanos fazem as melhores
caras de susto, não é?
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>Eu adorava me esconder nas sombras e ir roubando
o calor deles até começarem a tremer...<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Então eu
pulava para assustar! Nunca perdia a graça!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Wicked. Sounds like you were a pro at spookin’ people.
Wish I coulda seen you in action!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Demais, parece que você era um profissional em assustar as
pessoas, gostaria de poder vê-lo em ação!

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,46)>Ugh, I really wanna scare some humans again...
translation: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,46)>Eu realmente quero assustar alguns humanos de novo...

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>And then, when I thought I was safe and could finally go
home...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>I heard a voice! And it said...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,10)>“I fooouuund yooouuu!”

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, hey, HEY! None of that, now! YOU’RE the one who
asked to hear my scary story!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,6)>Don’t tell me you’re gettin’ all scared!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>What?! Uh-oh. Don’t tell me you’re so scared that—

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Y-you’re not about to self-destruct, are ya?! ARE YA?!
<$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,22)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m not tellin’ you a scary story just so you can up and
EXPLODE on me!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Phew, that felt good! Sorry—I was holding that sneeze in
for so long... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Your story was really scary, <$cdef(27)>Gengar!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>O-oh...heh. That’s good. But I think YOU gave ME the
bigger scare, bud! <$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>I was bracin’ for a big explosion...

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>So I turned around, totally terrified, but there was no one
behind me!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,5)>Thinkin’ it was just my imagination, I figured I was safe and
could finally head back home... <$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>But then I heard a voice!
And it said...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>“I fooouuund yooouuu!”

<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,7)>You weren’t even listenin’ to my story, were you?! And I
was really givin’ it my all, too!
<$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>So, so, so, so, so so so...scaryyyyyy!!!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Hahaha! So I had ya frozen with fear, huh? Niiice!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,22)>Oof... You gotta lotta nerve, bumpin’ into me! You better
watch where yer walkin’, or el—
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Huh?! You ain’t walkin’ at all! Uhhh, well, watch where yer
rollin’, I guess!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,817)><$comeff(2,22)>É melhor ver onde você
anda, ou el...
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Você não está andando de jeito nenhum! Uhhh, bem, veja onde você
está rolando, eu acho!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)>Sorry!!! Super sorry, yo! I was kinda zonin’ out!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,817)>Ohhhhhh!!! I can’t contain my anger—or my electricity!
Now jus’ how’re we gonna settle this?!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,817)>Ohhhhhh!!! Não consigo conter minha raiva—nem minha eletricidade! E agora, como vamos resolver isso?!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>So, uh, actually, I have this thing where I get, like...super
drawn to strong sources of electricity...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,801)>I guess your sparklin’, cracklin’ electricity just got me all
disoriented, <$cdef(27)>Electivire...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Então, ahn, na verdade, eu tenho essa coisa onde eu fico, como... super
atraído por fortes fontes de eletricidade...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,801)>Acho que seu brilho, sua eletricidade me deixou
desorientada, <$cdef(27)>Electivier...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>And, uh...my rollin’ always gets a little unsteady when I’m
around really cool and strong Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>It felt like—like fate brought me to you, I guess? <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,816)>I was just
so moved by the whole experience, yo. Felt like I’d been
zapped with electricity and couldn’t move right!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>E, ahn... Sempre me atrapalho um pouco ao rolar quando estou
perto de Pokémon fortes e incríveis.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Pareceu que... o destino me trouxe até você, sabe? <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,816)>Aquilo
me emocionou tanto! Foi como levar um choque e ficar sem
conseguir me mexer direito!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Guess I can’t fault ya fer that! Jus’ be more careful next
time, ya hear?!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Não posso te culpar por isso! Só tome mais cuidado da próxima vez, ouviu?!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>Yooo! And you’ve got a big heart too?! Didn’t know I could
look up to you more than I already did, but here we are!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>E você tem um grande coração também, não sabia que eu poderia
olhar para você mais do que eu já fiz, mas aqui estamos nós!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Gwahahaaa! OK, OK! That’s enough compliments
outta you!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Gwahahaaa! Ok, OK! Isso é elogios suficientes
fora de você!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh my, <$cdef(27)>Koffing, your face is looking a bit...purple. Are you
OK, sweetie?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Have you been eating properly?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? I look weird? And well... I might forget to eat
breakfast sometimes...

<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, no! That won’t do at all! You’ve got to eat breakfast
every day!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>As for WHAT to eat... Hmm... I recommend either sludge
or some nice, rotting garbage!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Which do you prefer for your morning meal, <$cdef(27)>Koffing, dear?
Sludge or trash?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Uhhh... If I had to say, I guess I prefer trash? Sludge is
pretty hard to pass up too, though...<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>What about you, <$cdef(27)>? What do you
prefer
to eat?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Yes, sludge really is quite scrumptious. And perfect for
breakfast, since you can slurp it right down in one go!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>All right... I know what I’m having tomorrow morning!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Yeah, you get it! Isn’t trash so tasty? Whenever I eat it for
breakfast, it makes me feel good all day...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>All right... I know what I’m having tomorrow morning!

<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,7)>Do you mean to say you DON’T like to eat trash and
sludge and stuff, <$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>There’s no need to eat it if you’d rather not, dear!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Your morning sets the tone of your whole day, so it’s best
to start it eating something you like!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Talking about this is making me hungry... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I kinda wanna go
scrounging for some garbage now.

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Just be careful not to overdo the snacks, darling <$cdef(27)>Koffing.
It’s all about balance, you know!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Yup, not a scratch to be seen! As expected, today’s egg
report iiis: smooth as heck!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Sim, não é um arranhão para ser visto, como esperado, o relatório de
ovos de hoje é: suave como o diabo!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>What a smooooth egg... Heyyy, can I touch it?

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Sure! But be careful, OK?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>I give away eggs whenever I meet hungry Pokémon in
distress—<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>’cause these things are PACKED with nutrients!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,8)>I’ve given eggs to humans before, too! They were SUPER
happy with ’em!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Mas tenha cuidado, certo?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu dou ovos sempre que encontro Pokémon famintos em
perigo, <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>porque essas coisas estão cheias de nutrientes!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,8)>Eu já dei ovos para humanos antes, eles estavam super
felizes com eles!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Heheee. That egg’s really important to you, huuuh?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Esse ovo é muito importante para você, huuuh?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Yup! And I won’t give an egg to just anyone!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>There’s no WAY I’d give one to any baddies! No way,
no how!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>E não darei um ovo a ninguém!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Não há nenhuma maneira que eu daria a qualquer
bandido!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Yeahhh. Yeahhh! That sounds smart. But isn’t it hard to
protect the egg all by yourself?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>I can help you out if baddies come...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Isso parece inteligente, mas não é difícil
proteger o ovo sozinho?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Posso ajudá-lo se os bandidos vierem...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Hehe... Thanks! But I’m all good on that front! If a baddie
ever got in my face, <$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)>I’d give ’em one of THESE!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Mas eu sou bom nessa frente, se um baddie tivesse
na minha cara, eu <$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)>daria a eles um desses!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Heheheee. You got really good form. I guess
you don’t have aaanything to worry about.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Heheheee, você tem uma boa forma, acho
que não tem nada com que se preocupar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Pelipper! Think you could gimme a lift somewhere
far away?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Pelipper<$cdef(27)>, acha que pode me dar uma carona em algum
lugar longe?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>Whaaat? You?! Hmmmmmm...
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>Sorry... I don’t know if I can do that...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)>O que é isso?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>Desculpe... não sei se posso fazer isso...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)>Huh?! What’d I ever do to you?

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)>S-sorryyy... I’m just not very good with electricity...
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,7)>So the current running across your body scaaares me a
little, <$cdef(27)>Electabuzz...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)>S-sorryyy... eu não sou muito bom com eletricidade...
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,7)>Então, a corrente que atravessa seu corpo me escama
um pouco, <$cdef(27)>Electabuzz...

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Hmmm, yeah, I see the problem...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Oh, I know! If I wrap myself up in something that stops my
electricity from touchin’ you, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>could you carry me then?
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Hmm, sim, eu vejo o problema...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Se eu me envolver em algo que impeça minha
eletricidade de te tocar, você <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>poderia me carregar?

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Awww yeah! All right, I’m gonna go look for something
that’ll do the job!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Tudo bem, vou procurar algo que faça
o trabalho!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(1,4)>Hee hee, you seem like you’re in a good mood, <$cdef(27)>Lapras.
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(1,1)>Are you singing because something nice happened?

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Hello there, little <$cdef(27)>Audino.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>The sky was just so gorgeous that I couldn’t keep myself
from singing.

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,14)>Your voice is so pretty, <$cdef(27)>Lapras. When I hear you singing,
it makes me want to stop everything and just listen.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>There’s so much joy in your singing that it brings me joy,
too! Hee hee... ♪
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Is that so? Well then, why don’t you sing with me, <$cdef(27)>Audino</color>?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,62)>Oh wow... That’s a great idea! Um, OK... Laaa la laaa! ♪

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>Eh, it’s nothin’. I just can’t get my fur to be all pointy and
cool the way I like it today...<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)> It’s kinda gettin’ me down.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,48)>Eh, não é nada. Eu não consigo fazer meu pelo ser todo pontudo e legal
do jeito que eu gosto hoje... É <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>meio que me deixando para baixo.

source: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Huh? But isn’t it the same as it always is...?
translation: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Mas não é o mesmo que sempre é?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,43)>Are you kiddin’ me?! It looks TOTALLY different than
usual! Though I guess you wouldn’t know that, huh?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>Wait a sec—weren’t you sighing before, too? What gives?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,43)>Você está brincando comigo? Parece totalmente diferente do
habitual! Embora eu ache que você não saberia disso, né?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,64)>Espere um segundo, você não está suspirando antes, também?

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,31)>Weeell, my wool just doesn’t wanna be fluffy today...
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,31)>Weeell, minha lã não quer ser fofa hoje...

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,48)>Uh, really? Looks the same as usual to me, pal.
translation: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,48)>Parece o mesmo de sempre para mim, amigo.

source: <$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,58)>Not at all! It is so totally and completely different!

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, for real? My bad.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Hey, let’s not fight anymore—it’ll just mess up our coats
even more. Besides, I don’t wanna fight with my friends!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, de verdade?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Ei, não vamos brigar mais, isso só vai estragar nossos casacos
ainda mais, além disso, eu não quero brigar com meus amigos!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, hello, <$cdef(27)>Marill</color>, dear! Are you heading for a swim?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Olá, Marill<$cdef(27)>, querida</color>, você está indo para um mergulho?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Yup! I’m gonna swim pretty far today!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>How nice. But are you safe all on your own? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)>What if you
get tired while you’re swimming?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Que bom. Mas não é perigoso ir sem companhia? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)>E se você
se cansar enquanto estiver nadando?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Nope, I’ll be OK! Even if I get tired, I got my tail with me!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Não, eu vou ficar bem, mesmo que eu me canse, eu tenho a minha cauda comigo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Uh-huh! My tail’s super floaty—there’s no WAY I could
sink! <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>So I’ll be totally OK!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Minha cauda é super flutuante, não há como eu
afundar<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>, então ficarei bem!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Oh, I see! Well, that’s a relief...I think. Just don’t get so
excited <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>that you can’t find your way home!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Oh, eu vejo! Bem, isso é um alívio... eu acho. Só não fique tão animado
que você não<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)> pode encontrar o seu caminho para casa!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>Marill! How come you don’t <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>sit on your tail
like me?
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>It’s so easy to bounce around on, and I can go really fast!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, that’s ’cause I got bigger! I’m too big to sit on my
tail now!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>Huh? Really?! Does that mean that when I grow up, <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>I’ll
get too big to ride around on my tail, too?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Um, I guess? I think you’ll probably <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>end up walking around
on your feet, just like me!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Whaaaaaat?! Nooo, I don’t wanna! I wanna stay just like
I am NOW!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>But you’ll be able to run way faster, then! And play all you
want without getting tired...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>There are all sortsa good things about getting bigger!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>You really mean it? Huh, then I guess I DO wanna hurry
and grow up!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>And then I can play with you all the time, <$cdef(27)>Marill!

<$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee! I can’t wait!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>But you know, I’ll be even MORE grown up by that time!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)>Azurill! Hey there! Always happy to have you come over!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,805)>What’s up today?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)>Sempre feliz por ter você vindo! O
que<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,805)> há hoje?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)>Let’s play together! ♪
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>I wanna float around in the water and bob up and down
with you!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)>Vamos brincar juntos!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>Eu quero flutuar na água e bob para cima e para baixo
com você!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Sure thing! For you, big sis is ALWAYS ready to play!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>But once we’re DONE playing, you and I gotta help out
<$cdef(27)>, OK?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Para você, a irmã está sempre pronta para jogar!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Mas uma vez que estamos jogando, você e eu temos que
ajudar <$cdef(27)>, certo?
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,663)>Ah, a gente vai ter que ajudar? Riiill...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Yup yup! And if you do help out, there just miiight be
something good in it for YOU, y’know?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Hmmm... I wonder if <$cdef(27)> has any
plans
to
make
FUN
TOYS
or
PLAYGROUND
STUFF today...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>E se você ajudar, pode haver algo de
bom nisso para você, sabe?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Eu me pergunto se <$cdef(27)> tem algum plano
para fazer

brinquedos

divertidos

ou jogos de
futebol hoje...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)>Huh? Toys?! Yeah, I’ll help out—I’ll help out SO MUCH!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>C’mon! Let’s go! Let’s go find <$cdef(27)>
RIGHT NOW!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,801)>Sim, eu vou ajudar, eu vou ajudar muito!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Vamos, vamos encontrar <$cdef(27)> agora
mesmo!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huh? Uhhh...weren’t we gonna go play together?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh yeah... I forgot! Eh heh heh.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Umm, so there’s a place I wanna go see,<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,47)> but there’s a river
in the way...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>And I’m not really good at swimming...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Hum, então há um lugar que eu quero <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,47)>ver, mas há um rio
no caminho...
E<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)> eu não sou muito bom em nadar...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, really? Well, uh—maybe I could take you there?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>You’re pretty small, so you could ride on my back while
I swim over... How about it?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Bem, talvez eu possa te levar lá?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Você é bem pequeno, para poder andar de costas
enquanto eu nadava...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Yaaay! Really? Really really?! Oh, and can I invite some
friends too?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Ah, e posso convidar alguns amigos
também?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Sure! You can sit on my back and chat. ♪
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)>And if anything tries to attack us, I’ll keep you safe. Here,
let me show you how...
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,816)>CLUH!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Pode sentar-se de costas e conversar.
E<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)> se alguma coisa tentar nos atacar, vou
mantê-lo seguro.
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,816)>CLUH!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,5)>Oopah?! So those round spots turn into spikes?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Uh... I’d better be careful not to sit on those.
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,5)>Então esses pontos redondos se transformam em espinhos?
É<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> melhor eu ter cuidado para não sentar neles.

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>I found this WICKED treasure, yo!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,47)>Heh. Nah, I wish. I didn’t find anything.
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Encontrei um tesouro INCRÍVEL, cara!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,47)>Hehe. Quem dera! Não encontrei nada.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>There used to be so much shiny stuff just scattered
all over the place...<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)> I wonder where it all went.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Costumava haver tanta coisa brilhante espalhada por
todo o lugar... eu me <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>pergunto para onde tudo foi.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>I never see the humans themselves around either...
Perhaps they took it all with them?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>But no matter. I still have one thing to say.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Eu nunca vi os próprios humanos por aí... talvez
eles tenham levado tudo com eles?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Mas não importa, ainda tenho uma coisa a dizer.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Continue on your search for the shiniest, sparkliest, most
beautiful objects you can find!!!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>That is all. I’m sure these treasures still exist somewhere
in this world.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>And you, my friend, are more than capable of finding
them. I have only the highest expectations.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Continue em sua busca pelos objetos mais brilhantes, brilhantes
e bonitos que você pode encontrar!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Tenho certeza que esses tesouros ainda existem em algum lugar
neste mundo.
E<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)> você, meu amigo, é mais do
que capaz de encontrá-los.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Yoooooo! You can totally count on me, boss! <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’ll go right
back out there and hunt some more!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Você pode contar comigo, chefe<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>, eu vou
voltar lá e caçar mais!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Magnezone, I’ve got a question. You’re super huge,
and you don’t have wings, so...<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)> How come you can fly?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,3)><$cdef(27)>Magnezone, eu tenho uma pergunta, você é super grande,
e você não tem asas, então... <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>por que você pode voar?

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>To say it in simple words—electric power.
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>Para dizê-lo em palavras simples: energia elétrica.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,665)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>No way! You can fly with electric power? That’s awesome!
Wait... Does that mean I can fly too?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,665)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Você pode voar com energia elétrica, isso é incrível, espere
, isso significa que eu posso voar também?

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>I do not know.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,21)>But it requires much electricity and great precision of
control.
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu não sei.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,21)>Mas requer muita eletricidade e grande precisão de
controle.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m gonna try right now! Here I go...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,860)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Hyayayayaaah!
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,51)>That was a jump. You did not fly. Delusions are not good.
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,51)>Foi um salto, você não voou, delírios não são bons.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Goodness gracious! Are you all right, dear?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Yeah, I’m fine...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>It’s just...I fall over real easily since my head is
so heavy...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Sim, estou bem...
É<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)> que... eu caio facilmente, já que minha cabeça está
tão pesada...

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>But...are you sure you’re OK?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Here, let me just check you for any injuries!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Mas... tem certeza que está bem?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Deixe-me verificar se há ferimentos!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>P-please don’t worry! Nothing hurts or anything!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>I won’t let a little scuff or two bother me!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Por favor, não se preocupe, nada dói ou nada!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Não vou deixar que um pouco de escárnio ou dois me incomodem!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>My dear <$cdef(27)>Piplup, you cannot afford to take injuries lightly!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>If you ignore them, they can get worse, and then you’re
REALLY in trouble!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Meu caro <$cdef(27)>Piplup, você não pode se dar ao luxo de tomar ferimentos
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>leves! Se você ignorá-los, eles podem piorar, e então você está
realmente em apuros!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>Eeep?! I-I don’t think that’ll happen to me... Will it?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Maybe you should have a look, just to be safe...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>Eu não acho que isso vai acontecer comigo, vai?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Talvez você deva dar uma olhada, só para estar segura...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Wonderful! Oh...and while we’re at it, why don’t I just give
you a full-body checkup?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>I can examine you from the top of your precious head to
tips of your little toesies!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Que maravilha! Ah... já que estamos aqui, que tal eu fazer
uma avaliação médica completa em você?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Posso examinar você da sua cabecinha preciosa
até as pontinhas dos seus dedinhos!

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,17)><$motion(2,807)>Ulp... Y-you really don’t need to do all THAT...
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,17)><$motion(2,807)>Ulp... você realmente não precisa fazer tudo isso...

source: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(231)></color>. Question—<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>how do I get strong like you?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>The secret is havin’ a fire inside ya! A figurative one in
addition to the literal one, y’know?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Then you just gotta stoke that fire real good!

<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>I...see. To be honest, getting fired up’s not really my style.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you have any, I dunno, practical training tips that you
can share?

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, hey, hey! Don’t you go badmouthin’ my methods
like that!
<$voicel(2,6)>You absolutely gotta have that fire in ya if you wanna get
really strong!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>The fire’s what keeps ya goin’ through your toughest
training when ya just wanna give up!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm. If you say so, I guess that must be true...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>All right! I’ll work on building up that fire inside me!

<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Rock on, bud! I’m glad you’re startin’ to get it!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>When I stoke that figurative fire, I get it burnin’ so hot that
it’ll spill outta my beak as REAL fire!
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>So sometimes I end up roasting berries before I eat ’em!
Good thing roasted Leppa Berries are tasty!

<$facial(2,2)><$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Not sure I’d want to let the fire spill outta me...but roasted
Leppa Berries sure do sound good.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>You know, I’ve always really looked up to you, <$cdef(27)>Wingull</color>.
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Você sabe, eu sempre olhei para você, <$cdef(27)>Wingull</color>.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)>You look so amazing when you fly! And it seems like
you have so much fun up there in the sky.
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,666)>I really wish I could fly like that...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)>Você parece tão incrível quando voa, e parece
que você se diverte tanto lá no céu.
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,666)>Eu realmente gostaria de poder voar assim...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Yeah, flying IS really fun... Nothing beats slowly soaring
above the ocean!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Sim, voar é muito divertido... nada bate lentamente subindo
acima do oceano!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>I knew it! I’m so jealous...
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Underground, I’ve had <$cdef(27)>Diglett run into me while I was
napping in a hole, and one time a <$cdef(27)>Hoothoot even came
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)>and dug me out for no reason!
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>I feel so uncool...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Eu sabia, estou com ciúmes...
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Subterrâneo, eu tive <$cdef(27)>Diglett me encontrar enquanto eu
estava cochilando em um buraco, e <$cdef(27)>uma vez um Hoothoot
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)>chegou e me cavou sem motivo!
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>Eu me sinto tão descolado...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Hee hee, it must be nice having so many friends around.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Deve ser bom ter tantos amigos por perto.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>I just wish I could take a niiice long nap as I fly across
the sky...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Eu só queria poder tirar uma longa soneca enquanto viajo
pelo céu...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, I wouldn’t recommend dozing off mid-flight. That’s
kinda, uh—dangerous.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>You might get blown away by one of <$cdef(27)>Pidgeot’s gusts, or
run into an unsuspecting <$cdef(27)>Rookidee...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, eu não recomendaria cochilar no
meio do vôo.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Você pode se surpreender com uma das rajadas de <$cdef(27)>Pidgeot, ou
se deparar com um desavisado <$cdef(27)>Rookidee...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Wait, really? I guess it’s not as safe up there as
I thought...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Acho que não é tão seguro lá em cima como
pensei...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)>Yeah... I guess every place has its perks and its, uh—pains?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)>Acho que cada lugar tem suas vantagens e suas dores?

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Yo, you really like touchin’ your cheeks, don’t you, <$cdef(27)>Pawmo</color>.
translation: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Você realmente gosta de tocar suas bochechas, não é, <$cdef(27)>Pawmo</color>.

source:
<$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, yeah... My cheeks are full of electricity, so, um...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>It feels nice and tingly when I touch them. ♪
translation:
<$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, sim... minhas bochechas estão cheias de eletricidade
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>, então... sinto-me bem quando toco nelas.

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Uh-huh, go ahead!
<$voicel(2,7)>Just be careful. Sometimes folks who touch them get
shocked so bad they can’t move after...
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Aham, vá em frente!
Às<$voicel(2,7)> vezes as pessoas que os tocam ficam tão chocadas
que não podem se mover depois...

source:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Oh, uh... Y’know what, I haven’t washed my hands in a bit,
so maybe I’ll pass this time.
<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,5)>You don’t paralyze yourself, though? You’re totally fine?
translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Sabe, eu não lavei as mãos um pouco, então
talvez eu passe desta vez.
<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,5)>Você não paralisa a si mesmo, está totalmente bem?

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Yup! Sometimes some of the...um...tingliness stays in my
paw pads, but that’s actually pretty useful.
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Às vezes, um pouco da... beleza fica nas minhas
almofadas, mas isso é realmente muito útil.

source:
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)>Here, I’ll show you.<$motion(2,815)>
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>See? If I punch with the electricity, I can knock out weak
opponents with just one hit. ♪
translation:
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)>Aqui, eu vou te mostrar.<$motion(2,815)>
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Se eu bater com a eletricidade, posso nocautear oponentes
fracos com apenas um golpe.

source:
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,9)>You got some surprisingly scary stuff goin’ on in your head,
yo. I don’t wanna get on your bad side.
translation:
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,9)>Você tem umas ideias surpreendentemente assustadoras,
hein. Não quero arranjar encrenca com você.

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, <$cdef(27)>Prinplup? Do you finally understand how awesome
my mane is?

<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>No, <$cdef(27)>Zoroark... I think it’s time for you to acknowledge the
superiority of crests.

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Grrrrrr... But manes are fluffy and feel so nice to touch!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>A hard, bulky crest can’t compete with that!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,7)>But when it rains, your mane gets flat and matted, no?
On the other hand, crests <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>stand tall and proud no matter
the weather. They’re better. End of discussion.

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Ughhh... We’re not gettin’ anywhere. Guess we’ll just have
to ask <$cdef(27)>!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Hey, bud! Which do YOU think is better?! Manes, right?
I bet you prefer manes!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s simple if you stop to think about it. Which is more
appealing? The answer is clearly crests. <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Yes?

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Heck yeah, bud! I knew you’d be on my side! I’ll let ya
touch my mane sometime! <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>Just once, though! I don’t let
anyone touch my mane!
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>No way... Seriously? But...but...manes are the BEST...

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I knew you’d understand, <$cdef(27)>.
We should get together sometime to discuss the many
charms of crests in greater detail.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Tell me, Clodsire—what food do you think is the tastiest?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)>It is, isn’t it? I could never choose between crisp, crunchy
carrots <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(2,15)>and irresistibly juicy tomatoes.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, so you like <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,666)>I’m with you there. That tantalizing flavor... It never gets
old, no matter how many I eat.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>You know, earlier I spotted a tree with <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>
growing on it. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>If you really like them so much, want me to
go grab some for you?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,663)>Oh no... I can’t eat another bite...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh? I’m surprised to hear that coming from you.

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>The rest...? Well, I’m sure there’ll be plenty of berries left
tomorrow. <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>I can always bring you some another time.

<$voicel(2,3)>Mmm... Y’know what, one more wouldn’t hurt... <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Huh?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Whuhhh? Where’d all my <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> go?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, hi, <$cdef(27)>Empoleon</color>! You look super cool, just like always!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh heh, thank you. That’s very kind.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, but your horns!
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>They’re just a little bit dirty!
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, mas seus chifres!
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>Eles são um pouco sujos!

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Errr... Really? I suppose if it’s only a little bit, that’s
probably all ri—
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Acho que se for só um pouquinho, provavelmente
é tudo ri

source:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,9)>No! It’s not OK! Your super cool horns <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>need to be pretty
and shiny all the time!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Here, I’ll clean them for you!
translation:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,9)>Seus chifres super legais precisam <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>ser bonitos e
brilhantes o tempo todo!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Aqui, vou limpá-los para você!

source: <$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>But...you just recently cleaned them for me.
translation: <$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas... você acabou de limpá-los para mim.

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Here I go!
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,6)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>YAAAH!!!<$motion(1,841)><$se2d(370)>
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>OK! Now they’re all clean and shiny! <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>I gave you a FULL
POWER cleaning today, just like always!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Aqui vou eu!
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,6)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>Yaaah!<$motion(1,841)><$se2d(370)>
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Agora estão todos limpos e brilhantes, <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>eu te dei uma limpeza
de energia completa hoje, como sempre!

source:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Yes, thank you. And as always, it’s appreciated...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,1)>But next time, perhaps—if you would be so kind—you
could give me a half-power cleaning?
translation:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Sim, obrigado, e como sempre, é apreciado...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,1)>Mas da próxima vez, talvez, se você fosse tão gentil, você
poderia me dar uma limpeza de meia potência?

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Hey, how come you and me are different colors?
translation: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Ei, por que você e eu somos de cores diferentes?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Hmmm... Yeah, I wonder?
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh! I think I know! Maybe it’s ’cause <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I nap a whole
bunch more?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Sim, eu me pergunto?
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Acho que sei, talvez seja porque<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)> eu cochilo
mais?

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? But I sleep just as much as you!
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh! I know! We like different berries!
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas eu durmo tanto quanto você!
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu sei, nós gostamos de frutas diferentes!

source:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>You’re right, we do!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>D’ya think our colors change based on the berries we eat?
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Você tem razão, nós temos!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Você acha que nossas cores mudam com base nas frutas que comemos?

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Yeah, that’s gotta be it!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, but wait... I’m pretty sure <$voicel(1,6)>I’ve always been this color,
ever since I was born...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>What about you? How long have you been that color?
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, tem que ser isso!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas espere... tenho certeza <$voicel(1,6)>que sempre fui dessa cor
, desde que nasci...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Há quanto tempo você tem essa cor?

source: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? Oh, I’ve been this color ever since I was born too!
translation: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu tenho essa cor desde que nasci também!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... Then maybe the berries we eat actually don’t
make any difference?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmm... Então talvez as frutas que comemos realmente não
façam diferença?

source:
<$voicel(2,6)>*rumble*
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Gosh... Just THINKING about berries has got me
hungry now...
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)>*rumble*
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Pensar em frutas me deixou com fome
agora...

source: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m hungry too! Let’s eat some berries!
translation: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Também estou com fome, vamos comer algumas frutas!

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nooo...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>I’m so hungryyy.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey...<$motion(1,803)> Uh—that egg you’re always carrying looks tasty.
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nããão...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>Estou com fome.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Aquele <$motion(1,803)>ovo que você está sempre carregando parece saboroso.

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)>You can’t have it! This is my special egg!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>And aren’t you always carrying food around in your fur
anyway, <$cdef(27)>Munchlax? <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>Did you look reeeaaally carefully?
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)>Este é o meu ovo especial!
E<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)> você não está sempre carregando comida
em sua <$cdef(27)>pele de <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>qualquer maneira, Munchlax?

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)>In my fur? Uh, hmmm. Let’s see...<$motion(1,817)> Ooh, here?
