<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Wow, you were right!<$motion(1,17)> It’s food tiiime! ♪
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,19)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)>Aah, that was super yummy!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)>Na minha pele, vamos ver.<$motion(1,817)>.. aqui?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Uau, você <$motion(1,17)>estava certo!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,19)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)>Aah, isso foi super gostoso!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,31)>If you eat it up that fast, you’re just gonna get hungry
again really soon!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,31)>Se você comê-lo tão rápido, você só vai ficar com fome de
novo muito em breve!

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nooo...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)>Now I want dessert.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>That egg you’re always carrying looks tasty...
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nããão...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)>Agora eu quero sobremesa.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>Aquele ovo que você está sempre carregando parece saboroso...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,4)>É tão redondo... e suave... e, ahn... comida em forma.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>OK, look. I’m gonna tell you a secret. <$comeff(2,3)>This is actually just
a rock. <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,3)>It’s not an egg at all!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Vou te contar um segredo, na<$comeff(2,3)> verdade é só
uma pedra<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,3)>, não é um ovo.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>No waaay!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,18)>I had no idea. So does that mean rocks are, uh<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>...actually
kinda tasty?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>Nããão acredito!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,18)>Eu não fazia ideia. Então as pedras são, ahn...<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>na verdade,
meio gostosas?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, it’s just some trash. It was super shiny, <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>so I thought it
was treasure, but...guess not.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Are you kiddin’ me?! This is totally treasure! What an
amazing find!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Just the right amount of filth... Not too dirty, not too clean.
And it smells awesome! It’s got my mouth waterin’, yo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I wanna dig in and scarf it all down right now!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Now you mention it, I guess it DOES look kinda special...

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>So, uh... You don’t need this for anything, right, <$cdef(27)>Meowth?
Can I have it? Pleeeaaase?

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? N-No way! <$comeff(1,11)>It’s mine! I’m the one who found it!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>This treasure belongs to ME!
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Awww... No way... I’m so jealous, yo!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>You know, every time I see you, your fur is so glossy and
beautiful.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,23)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>I get nervous just being close to you...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Sabe, toda vez que te vejo, sua pele é tão brilhante
e bonita.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,23)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Eu fico nervosa só de estar perto de você...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Well, as you can see, my whole body is made up of
garbage.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,18)>I’d never forgive myself if I dirtied your beautiful fur...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Bem, como você pode ver, todo o meu corpo é feito
de lixo.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,18)>Eu nunca me perdoaria se sujasse sua bela pele...

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>No need to worry about that, dear. I’ll be fine.
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Não precisa se preocupar com isso, eu vou ficar bem.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, how very kind of you. You don’t mind getting dirty?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, quão gentil de sua parte, você não se importa em ficar sujo?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>I wouldn’t say that! I just don’t think it’s likely.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>In fact, I have every confidence my fur will stay clean.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)>Go ahead—touch it to your heart’s content.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Eu não diria isso, só não acho que seja provável. Na
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>verdade, tenho toda a confiança que meu pelo vai ficar limpo.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)>Vá em frente, toque no conteúdo do seu coração.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)>Bem, se você tem certeza... aqui vou eu!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>Como é isso?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>My goodness! You don’t have so much as a speck of dust
on you! That really is impressive.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>Meu Deus, você não tem nem uma partícula de poeira em
você, isso é realmente impressionante.

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Hopefully your concerns are put to rest!
My fur repels dust. ♪
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Espero que suas preocupações estejam paralisadas,
minha pele repele a poeira.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>As long as it doesn’t repel every last bit of me...</textsize>
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>Contanto que não repele cada pedacinho de mim...</textsize>

source:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>ZORUA! Hey, you haven’t seen my captain around,
have ya?!
translation:
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Ei, você não viu meu capitão por aí
, não é?

source: <$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? Your captain? Uh-uh, I haven’t seen them.
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Dang, really? Grrr... I can’t find them anywhere.
translation: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Grrr... não consigo encontrá-los em lugar nenhum.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK! If I see them, I’ll tell you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Se eu vê-los, eu vou te dizer!

source: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, Captain! I was looking EVERYWHERE for you!
translation: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Capitão, eu estava procurando por você em todos os lugares!

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh? Uhhh... You seem a little OFF today, Cap...
translation: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Você parece um pouco fora hoje, Cap...

source: <$comeff(3,4)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,5)>N-no, I’m totally fine! I’m definitely your captain!
translation: <$comeff(3,4)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,5)>Não, estou totalmente bem, definitivamente sou seu capitão.

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>I knew it—something IS off about you! You AREN’T my
captain! Um, I’m right... Right?
translation:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu sabia, algo está errado com você, você não é
meu capitão, estou certo, certo?

source:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Darn it! I thought I did a really good job, too! How could
you tell?
translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Também achei que tinha feito um bom trabalho, como
pôde saber?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Cap calls me something totally different! And the way you
were talking was totally off too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Besides, if ANYONE is good at imitating the captain,
it’s me!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Cap me chama de algo totalmente diferente, e o jeito
que você estava falando também.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Além disso, se alguém é bom em imitar o capitão,
sou eu!

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh yeah? Then go ahead and show me!
translation: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Então vá em frente e me mostre!

source:
<$motion(2,634)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>!!!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! I’m playing dead! Well, whatcha think?
translation:
<$motion(2,634)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>!!!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Estou brincando de morto, o que acha?

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,635)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe—naw, this is way harder than it looks! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>You got at
least a million years to go before you’re ready to be
imitating my captain, kid!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,635)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso é muito mais difícil do que parece, você<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)> tem pelo
menos um milhão de anos antes de estar pronto para
imitar meu capitão, garoto!

source:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Nnngh... I swear I’m gonna look EXACTLY like your
captain one day <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>and totally surprise you!
translation:
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Juro que vou parecer exatamente como seu capitão
um dia e <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>totalmente surpreendê-lo!

source:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Um e-excuse me... Do...do you have a minute? I was...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>I was wondering... Can you teach me how to camouflage
the way you do?

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>? Sure, but...nobody’ll be able to see
your camouflage under that cloth.

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, um...I was gonna take the cloth off once I learned
how to camouflage myself properly...

<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh. Well, if that’s what you want, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu, I can teach
you...but it’s not super easy!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>R-right. Yeah, OK... I guess that figures...

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Why do you wanna learn how to camouflage yourself,
anyway?

<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, since I don’t have any friends...<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I thought...maybe if I
looked less scary, then other Pokémon would wanna be
friends with me.
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? What do you mean? You and me are friends!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? Wait, what? Really? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Wow, I’m friends with <$cdef(27)>Zorua...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>That’s so cool! Heh heh heh...

translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>* fwsh fwsh fwsh *
<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww... não é bom, hein?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>No! Don’t give up! Next time, give it more PASSION!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Really DIG DEEP and get in there!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>Não! Não desista! Da próxima vez, coloque mais GARRA!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Tire forças lá do fundo e vá com tudo!

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,12)>Um, OK!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>*fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww. Yeah... See what I mean? Generating electricity is
pretty tough.
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,12)>Está bem!
*<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)> fwsh fwsh fwsh *
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>Gerar eletricidade é muito
difícil.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>You can DO THIS, Pawmi! Try it gently this time! Almost
like...like you’re warming up an egg!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Você pode fazer isso, Pawmi, tente gentilmente desta vez,
quase como se estivesse aquecendo um ovo.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Um, would you mind showing me what you mean,
<$cdef(27)>Dedenne?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Importa-se de me mostrar o que quer dizer,
<$cdef(27)>Dedenne?

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Hmmm? No chance, sorry! I can’t MAKE electricity at all!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Sem chance, desculpe, não posso fazer eletricidade!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,5)>Wha—? Then why are you giving me that
know-it-all advice?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,5)>Então por que está me dando
esse conselho?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Because once you CAN make electricity, I want you to
share it with me sometimes!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>It’s totally fine! YOU! HAVE! THE! TALENT!
...Probably!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Porque uma vez que você pode fazer eletricidade, eu quero que
você compartilhe comigo às vezes!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Está tudo bem, você tem o talento!
...Provavelmente!

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Oh. I’m just...shocked. I’ve been practicing so hard with
you, but still...
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Eu só estou... chocada, tenho praticado tanto com você,
mas ainda assim...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Shocked, huh? OK, great! Now take that shock and
SLAM it into your cheeks!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Ok, ótimo, agora pegue esse choque e bata
nas suas bochechas!

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>My battery’s totally drained today. I can’t fly another inch!
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>Minha bateria está totalmente esgotada hoje, não posso voar mais um centímetro!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Hey, bud. Think you could spare a little electricity to help
charge me up?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Acha que pode poupar um pouco de eletricidade para me ajudar
a me cobrar?

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,59)>Sorry, dude. I’m totally out of battery today too.
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,59)>Desculpe, cara, estou sem bateria hoje também.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Aw man! All right. Guess we’re both outta luck, huh...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>I found a spot with tons of tasty-lookin’ berries, and I
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>reeeaaally wanted to take you there, but oh well...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Acho que estamos ambos sem sorte, Hum...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Encontrei um lugar com toneladas de frutas
saborosas<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>, e eu queria te levar lá, mas bem...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,51)>Yeah, but I guess there’s nothin’ we can do about it now,
is there. Real shame, though...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,51)>Sim, mas acho que não há nada que possamos fazer
sobre isso agora, está lá.

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,4)>Hey, y’know what—uhhh... Hold up.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Looks like I DO have a little electricity left, yo! <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I bet it’s
enough to get us to those berries! Let’s go!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,4)>Ei, você sabe o que...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Parece que ainda tenho um pouco de eletricidade, aposto<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)> que é
o suficiente para nos levar para essas frutas!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I was lying, ya dummy! And you fell for it!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Eu estava mentindo, seu idiota, e você se apaixonou por isso!

source: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,56)>Whaaat?! It’s not cool to lie, yo...
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,48)>Hey, you lied first! Ugh, now I’m hungry.
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,48)>Você mentiu primeiro, agora estou com fome.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Things sure are peaceful around here, huh, Captain? Even
tiny weaklings like us don’t have much to worry about.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>As coisas são pacíficas por aqui, Capitão, até pequenos
fracos como nós não têm muito com que se preocupar.

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>Don’t drop your guard just ’cause all’s well and good right
now, you blockhead!
<$voicel(1,5)>We use our smarts to make up for our size, got it? If you’ve
got time to relax, you’ve got time to run scenarios!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Long as we do that, we’ve got nothing to fear—not even
gettin’ attacked by some massive Pokémon!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>Não largue a guarda só porque está tudo bem
agora, seu idiota!
<$voicel(1,5)>Nós usamos nossa inteligência para compensar nosso tamanho, entendeu? Se
você tem tempo para relaxar, você tem tempo para executar cenários!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Contanto que façamos isso, não temos nada a temer - nem mesmo
sermos atacados por alguns Pokémon maciços!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, hey, is that <$cdef(27)>Pelipper flying this way? Check out that
gaping maw...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)> It looks hungry.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Ei, aquele é <$cdef(27)>Pelipper vindo para cá? Olha só aquele
bocão aberto...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)> Parece que está com fome.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>I’m playin’ dead, you blockbrain! Don’t talk to me!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>Quick, go hide somewhere! Now!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>Estou brincando de morto, seu blockbrain!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>Rápido, vá se esconder em algum lugar!

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,803)>There’s no <$cdef(27)>Pelipper</color>. I made it up. Sorry.

<$motion(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>What?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,7)>You sneaky so-and-so! <$voicel(1,10)>Thought you’d play a little trick on
me, huh?!
translation:
<$motion(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>O que?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,7)>Achei que você <$voicel(1,10)>jogaria um pequeno truque em mim
, hein?

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>I just thought it’d be a good scenario to run...
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu só pensei que seria um bom cenário para correr...

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,4)>Oh, er, right. Well... Good job. Keep it up!
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,4)>Oh, er, certo, bom trabalho, continue assim!

source: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey! Don’t just chomp me out of nowhere!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>O-oh! Sorry! You’re just the perfect size, yo. I couldn’t
help myself...
translation:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Desculpe, você é do tamanho perfeito, não pude
me ajudar.

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Er, perfect size? What’s that supposed to mean?!

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,1)>Uh, y’know, like...I usually gulp up Arrokuda and use ’em
as projectiles, right? <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>But I’ve kinda been wonderin’ if
something bigger might be more effective...
translation:
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,1)>Ah, sabe... eu costumo engolir Arrokuda e usá-los
como projéteis, certo? <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Mas ando pensando
se algo maior não seria mais eficaz...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Wha—?! More effective?! I think I’d just get STUCK!
Wouldn’t that be a BAD thing?!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Acho que eu pegaria PRESO, não
seria uma coisa ruim?

source:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Y-yeah, I guess you’re right.
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>It’s just, like, I can’t help myself, y’know? I gotta go for
what’s challenging.
translation:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Sim, acho que você está certa.
É<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)> só que, tipo, eu não posso me ajudar, sabe, eu tenho que ir para
o que é desafiador.

source:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,3)>Uh... OK. Respectfully, I have no clue what you’re going
on about—but cut it out, would ya?!
<$facial(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Because next time, you’re gonna end up getting my
bzzt-bzzt-electro-shock counterattack!
translation:
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,3)>Respeitosamente, não faço ideia do que está acontecendo
, mas pare com isso, não é?
<$facial(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Porque da próxima vez, você vai acabar recebendo meu
contra-ataque bzzt-bzzt-eletrochoque!

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>A-ah...OK...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>So, like, a battle or somethin’? That seems like a kinda fun
challenge too...
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh, I like this song... <wait(0.8)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Hum hum dee dum. ♪
translation: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Oooh, eu gosto dessa música.<wait(0.8)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>.. hum hum dee dum.

source: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum hummm... ♪ I can’t stop using Metronome... ♪
translation: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum hum hummm... Não consigo parar de usar Metronome...

source: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum dee dum... ♪ Hm hm hmmm... ♪
translation: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum hum dee dum... Hm hm hmm...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum dee dee... ♪ Hum dee dum... ♪ Ta-daaa!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Thank you for listening to my performance!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum dee dee... Hum dee dum... Tcharam!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Obrigado por ouvir minha performance!

source: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Whaaa? But I, um... I was singing first...

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Feast yer eyes on these wings o’ mine! Big and
strong-lookin’, wouldn’t ya say?
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Festeje seus olhos nessas minhas asas,
grandes e fortes, você não diria?

source:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Yeah, they’re really cool! Hey, um—check out my
wings too! <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>Pretty cute, yeah? ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, eles são muito legais! Ei, hum - confira minhas
asas também<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>! Muito bonito, sim?

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Wings? What wings? What’re you on about?
translation: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Asas, que asas, sobre o que você está falando?

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Um... The wings on my back, silly!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>I see you’ve got li’l ribbons on yer back, yeah.
translation: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Vejo que você tem fitas de volta, sim.

source: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><turn(1,180)><$voicel(1,7)>Hee hee, those aren’t ribbons—they’re wings! <wait(0.8)>Cute, right?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, yeah, they’re cute... But they’re a bit small and
funny-shaped. <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>You can really fly with those wings?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, sim, eles são fofos... mas eles são um pouco pequenos
e engraçados. <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Você pode realmente voar com essas asas?

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Uh, yeah? I can fly no problem! Here, lemme just get
ready... OK!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Faaa! ♪ Riii! ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu não posso voar, não há problema, deixe-me só
se preparar.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Faaa! Riii!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I can only fly when I’m feeling really good, so first I gotta
dance so I feel, uh—more good! ♪
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Cleee faaaiii reee! ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu só posso voar quando estou me sentindo muito bem, então primeiro eu tenho
que dançar, então eu me sinto, uhmais bem!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Cleee faaaiii reee!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>You sure are a strange one...
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>... ... ...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Hey, um... How long’s this dance o’ yours gonna last?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Você com certeza é um estranho...
.<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>..............
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Quanto tempo essa dança vai durar?

source:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Um, until I feel good enough to fly! Last time I danced all
night... Hee hee. ♪
translation:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Até me sentir bem o suficiente para voar, da última vez que
dancei a noite toda...

source: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>All...night? Maybe I don’t need to see ya fly after all...
translation: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Talvez eu não precise vê-la voar depois de tudo...

source:
<$comeff(1,5)>Wha—?!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, it’s you, <$cdef(27)>Wigglytuff! I’m so sorry I didn’t notice you
for a second!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>The moon’s just so gorgeous, I was totally enchanted by it.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Clefable</color>. You certainly love the moon, don’t you?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes, of course! After all, the moon looks different every
single day, so I never get tired of gazing at it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>And I also feel some sort of mysterious power from it!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>That’s certainly true... When I bathe in the light of the
moon, I too can feel power well up within me.

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, exactly! Oh, I’m so glad you understand, <$cdef(27)>Wigglytuff!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Why, whenever there’s a full moon, I get so excited I jump
up in the air!

<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, goodness! You can certainly jump high! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>It almost
seems as if you could float right away!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>If you kept floating higher and higher...and I grabbed
onto you...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>do you think we could reach the moon?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>That...may prove difficult, I’m afraid. I’m sorry.

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>*sigh* That’s what I thought. Oh, but I DO wish I could
go someday! <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>If only it weren’t so far...
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Tot tot tot totot! ♪ Tot totot tot! ♪

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>That’s such a pretty sound you make! I can hear it all the
way underground, you know?
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I have to stop and listen whenever I hear you... I just can’t
help it. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I bet it’d be a lot of fun if I could make sounds
like that too...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Isso é um som tão bonito que você faz, eu posso ouvi-lo todo
o caminho subterrâneo, sabe?
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu tenho que parar e ouvir sempre que te ouço... eu simplesmente não
posso evitar.<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)> Eu aposto que seria muito divertido se eu pudesse fazer
sons assim também...

source:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Thanks, yo! That means a lot to me!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>Y’know what, I bet you could make some good
sounds yourself, <$cdef(27)>Diglett.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Humor me for a second, yo! Try diggin’ a hole and poppin’
out real fast!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Isso significa muito para mim!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>Você sabe o que, eu aposto que você poderia fazer alguns
bons sons você mesmo, <$cdef(27)>Diglett.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Tente cavar um buraco e sair muito
rápido!

source:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Yoooooo! Yeah! That’s the one!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>That “po-pop!” sound has a really cool ring to it!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know what, <$cdef(27)>Diglett—why don’t we have a li’l jam sesh?!
translation:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Eiii! Isso! É esse aí!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Esse som de “po-pop!” ficou muito legal!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Sabe de uma coisa, <$cdef(27)>Diglett? Que tal improvisarmos um som juntos?!

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Uh, sure... But...do you really think I can keep up?
translation: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Claro, mas... acha mesmo que posso acompanhar?

source:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>You got this!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>You just gotta time your po-poppin’ with my to-tottin’.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>It’ll be super easy, yo!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Você consegue!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>É só sincronizar seus pulos com o meu ritmo.
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Vai ser super fácil, cara!

source: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Well, if you say so... OK! I’ll give it a shot!
translation: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, se você diz isso... OK, eu vou dar uma chance!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>To-tot! Heck yeah! Let’s do it!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>OK, here we go...
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Claro que sim, vamos lá!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Ok, aqui vamos nós...

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeah! That was some awesome music we just made! And
your timing was perfect, yo!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso! A música que acabamos de fazer ficou incrível! E
a sua sincronia foi perfeita, cara!

source:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Kricketot! You called that a “sesh,” right? Seshes are
lots of fun!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It must be nice for the three of you to always be together
like that...<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> It gets a bit lonely being by myself all the time...
translation:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Deve ser bom para vocês estarem sempre juntos assim
... fica um<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)> pouco solitário estar sozinho o tempo todo...

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>I dunno. That actually sounds kinda nice.
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Honestly, I’m gettin’ a little tired of these two always
taggin’ along, no matter what I do.
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Não sei, na verdade parece um pouco legal.
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Honestamente, eu estou ficando um pouco cansado desses dois sempre
taggin' junto, não importa o que eu faça.

source:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>But see, that’s exactly what I mean! You all joke around
like that and it seems like so much fun!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>I wish I had brothers too... One would be courageous like
you, Dugmiddle...
translation:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas veja, isso é exatamente o que quero dizer! Vocês todos
brincam assim e parece muito divertido!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu gostaria de ter irmãos também... um seria corajoso como
você, Dugmiddle...

source: <$voicel(1,5)>And one would be smart like you, Duglefto...

<$voicel(1,7)>And maybe I’d even have a brother that was nice like
you, Dugrighto!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)>E talvez eu até tivesse um irmão que fosse legal como
você, Dugrighto!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I really, really wish I had brothers like that! <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Then I could
talk to them and joke around with them like you do!
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu realmente gostaria de ter irmãos assim, então<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)> eu poderia
falar com eles e brincar com eles como você faz!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Diglett</color>, amigão, chegue um pouco mais perto...

source: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah! Get as close as you can!

translation: <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Então você não vai se sentir sozinho.

source: <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Really? Oh, Dugs... Thank you! You’re all the best!
translation: <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, Dugs, obrigado, vocês são os melhores!

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Are you sure? Well, OK...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, isn’t it a bit warm around here? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>A little TOO warm?
translation:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>- Tem certeza?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Ei, não está um pouco quente<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)> por aqui?

source:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>The heat... It’s my fault... <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>Sometimes I let my flames get
real strong without noticing, and... <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>I think it makes other
Pokémon uncomfortable...
translation:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>O calor... é minha culpa... <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>às vezes deixo minhas chamas
ficarem fortes sem perceber, e... acho <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,2)>que isso deixa outros
Pokémon desconfortáveis...

source: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, really? Well, I don’t mind it at all!
translation: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, eu não me importo com isso!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,4)>But...where I used to live...<$voicel(2,5)>I accidentally set fire to all the
trees on the mountain, and...they all burned down...
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>I don’t want that to happen here... Not when
<$cdef(27)>’s
working
so hard...
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,4)>Mas... onde eu morava... <$voicel(2,5)>acidentalmente atendi fogo a todas
as árvores da montanha, e... todas queimaram...
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Eu não quero que isso aconteça aqui... não quando
<$cdef(27)> está
trabalhando
tão duro...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Wow... That must’ve been a lot. But you’re safe now! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I can
hang out with you and keep an eye on things!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>You probably wouldn’t guess it, but I actually can’t stand
the cold—so this is great for me too!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Deve ter sido muito, mas você está segura agora, <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>posso
sair com você e ficar de olho nas coisas.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Você provavelmente não adivinharia, mas eu realmente não aguento o
frio, então isso é ótimo para mim também!

source:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>R-really? You...would? Th-thank you! That really means a
lot to me...
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Arcanine</color>! I challenge you to a race!
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Arcanine</color>, eu te desafio a uma corrida!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re really pumped up about racing me, huh? Sure, I can
play with ya for a li’l bit!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Você está realmente animado por me correr, não é? Claro, eu
posso jogar com você por um pouco!

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Yesss! I’ll do my best! So... How do you think I could win?
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Sim, farei o meu melhor, então... como acha que posso ganhar?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hahaha! You’re askin’ ME how to beat me?
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)>I’ll just say this—make sure you warm up well so you don’t
hurt yourself.
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Você está me perguntando como me vencer?
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)>Eu só vou dizer isso, certifique-se de se aquecer bem para que você
não se machuque.

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Wow, you’re really takin’ this seriously, huh?
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Uau, você está realmente falando sério, hein?

source:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>You might wanna stop there... <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>You’re gonna wear yourself
out before we even start!
translation:
<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Você pode querer parar por aí.<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>.. você vai se desgastar
antes mesmo de começarmos!

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>*pant pant* *gasp* I...think I’m done...warming up...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Hey...I’m exhausted. Is it OK if we race another time?
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>* Pant Pant * * Gasp * Eu... acho que eu terminei... aquecendo...............
..<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,14)>................
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Ei, estou exausta, está tudo bem se corrermos outra hora?

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Wow, uh... Maybe next time don’t warm up so much?
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Talvez da próxima vez não aqueça tanto?

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey <$cdef(27)>Graveler, I’ve got a question. <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>You know if there are
any good boulders around here?
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>Graveler, tenho uma pergunta<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>, sabe se há
pedras boas por aqui?

source: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)>It’s gotta be heavy enough that I can just baaarely lift it...
translation: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)>Tem que ser pesado o suficiente para que eu possa simplesmente levantá-lo...

source: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Ohhh, I see. So about as heavy as me?

<$voicel(1,8)>Yeah, <$cdef(27)>Graveler, and about your size. And it should also
be round...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)>Sim, <$cdef(27)>Graveler, e sobre o seu tamanho, e também deve ser
redondo...

source:
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa! You’re right!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I guess the best boulder around is you, <$cdef(27)>Graveler!
translation:
<$emotion(1,15)><$voicel(1,10)>Você está certo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Acho que o melhor pedregulho é você, <$cdef(27)>Graveler!

source: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Hee hee. I don’t really get it, but that makes me happy. ♪
translation: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu realmente não entendo, mas isso me faz feliz.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>I was doing reps a bit ago with a boulder about your size.
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>But I had to give up at 9,999...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Next time, I wanna see if I can hit 10,000! You in?
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu estava fazendo representantes um pouco atrás com um pedregulho sobre o seu tamanho.
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas eu tive que desistir em 9.999...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Da próxima vez, quero ver se consigo acertar 10 mil!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Dang, bro! Check you out! Your muscles are so huge I can
barely see around ’em!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Seus músculos são tão grandes que mal
consigo vê-los!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)>Niiice! ♪ Lookin’ real cut, bud! Your biceps look like a
couple of <$cdef(27)>Geodude!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Whoa, thanks! But I’m not done yet! <$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>HAH! YAH!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Gotta say, I love flexin’ with you, <$cdef(27)>Machamp! It gets me
even more pumped than usual!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Obrigado, mas ainda não <$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>terminei.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Tenho que dizer, eu amo flexin 'com você, <$cdef(27)>Machamp, isso me deixa ainda
mais bombeado do que o habitual!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>I feel ya on that! It’s like your muscles are more excited to
show off if they’ve got an audience!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>How ’bout the two of us aim to become the muscliest
duo out there?!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)>É como se seus músculos estivessem mais animados para
mostrar se eles têm uma audiência!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>Que tal nós dois nos tornarmos a dupla mais
musculosa lá fora?

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Aw yeah, count me in! With our muscles combined,
nothing can stop us! HAH! YAH! MUSCLE!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Com nossos músculos combinados
, nada pode nos parar.

source: <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,1)>Umm... My berries. Now I’m down one.
<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? Your berries? I don’t see any berries...

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, I’ve got six berries stored in my cheeks right now...
<$motion(2,19)><$voicel(2,6)>*GULP*
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Aaack! Now I’m down to five!
translation:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, eu tenho seis frutas armazenadas em minhas bochechas
<$motion(2,19)><$voicel(2,6)>agora...
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Aaack, agora eu estou abaixo de cinco!

source: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Wha—? You’ve still got five whole berries in your cheeks?!
translation: <$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Você ainda tem cinco frutas inteiras em suas bochechas?

source:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Now I’ve ONLY got five berries left! Gosh, what am I
gonna do now?!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm... Y’know, you’re starting to look awfully berry-like.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>I wonder if I could fit YOU in my cheeks.
translation:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Agora SÓ me restam cinco frutas! Ai, o que vou
fazer agora?!
<$emotion(2,55)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmm... Sabe, você está começando a parecer uma fruta.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Será que eu conseguiria colocar VOCÊ nas minhas bochechas?

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, uh...I-I tell you what—how about I go and find some
berries for you?
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, ahn... eu te digo o que... Que tal eu ir e encontrar algumas
frutas para você?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>You’re looking tough and sturdy as always, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>.<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)> One
day I’d like to battle to see who has a tougher body.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, that’s so sweet of you to say!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>To be honest, though, these days I’m rather jealous of
<$voicel(1,5)>softer bodies—like <$cdef(27)>’s!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, <$cdef(27)> works so hard to make all
sorts
of
nice
things
for
us,
right?
<$voicel(1,4)>If I accidentally bump into things with this hard body of
mine, <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,1)>I’m bound to break something sooner or later!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>I’d feel so much more at ease if I were softer.

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)><$facial(1,2)>You’re so mature, <$cdef(27)><$cname(64)>...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>I still get the urge to just launch myself <$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>right into stuff
sometimes... <$voicel(2,1)>What should I do?

<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, whenever that happens, dear, don’t hesitate to crash
right into ME as hard as you can!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll stop you right in your tracks!
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Th-thank you! I can always rely on you...
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Wow, sounds like you were up pretty late...
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... I think I mighta caught a cold... <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,10)>Achoo!<wait(1.2)> <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,9)>ACHOO!

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You should warm up and get a good night’s sleep today.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Gotta get rid of that cold quickly. <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>If you set fire to a house
<$cdef(27)> built, that would be really bad...
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>I’m already warm all the time...but I’ll be extra careful!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, sorry about that... I must’ve given you chills...
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, desculpe por isso... devo ter lhe dado calafrios...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>I’m t-t-totally fine! Y’know, despite how I look, I actually
prefer the cold!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Sabe, apesar da minha aparência, prefiro
o frio!

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Anyways, it looks to me like you’ve got a cold, <$cdef(27)>Glaceon!
Totally a cold, right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,801)>Hang around with me and you’ll get super nice ’n’ warm
and be back on your feet in no time...probably!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>De qualquer forma, parece que você <$cdef(27)>está
com frio, Glaceon!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,801)>Fique por aí comigo e você vai ficar super legal 'n' quente e estar
de volta em seus pés em nenhum momento... provavelmente!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,16)>Huh...? I just got a little dust up my nose.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,806)>Besides, I prefer the cold too...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,16)>Eu só tenho um pouco de poeira no meu nariz.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,806)>Além disso, eu prefiro o frio também...

source:
<$emotion(1,5)>OHMYGOSH!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motionoff(1,802)>C-could it be that it’s a total pain to be around me?!
translation:
<$emotion(1,5)>Ohmygosh!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motionoff(1,802)>Poderia ser que é uma dor total estar perto de mim?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, um... I think I’m feeling a bit too chilly today. Maybe
we could talk just a bit more?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Acho que estou me sentindo um pouco frio demais hoje, talvez
possamos conversar um pouco mais?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>YEAHHH! So—what do you wanna talk about?!

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Ehehehe! Yesss! I knew it! Just look how tall these bad
boys stand up!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Yess, eu sabia o quão altos esses bandidos
se levantam.

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Really? Hmmm. Ah well, doesn’t really matter.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Clearly. Heh, good to know you’re paying attention.
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>É bom saber que está prestando atenção.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)>Nooo! Ugh, maybe if I massage my ears, it’ll make ’em
longer somehow.
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)>Talvez, se eu massagear meus ouvidos, vai fazê-los mais tempo
de alguma forma.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hmm? You wanna know why we’re even talking about this?
’Cause whoever has longer ears is obviously cooler, DUH!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Quer saber por que estamos falando sobre isso? Porque
quem tem orelhas mais longas é obviamente mais legal, DUH!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,7)>Well, I was playing along since I can kinda see what you
mean, <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>but then you started talking about how yours are
longer, and <$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>wouldn’t listen to reason...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,7)>Bem, eu estava tocando junto já que eu posso meio que ver o que
você <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>quer dizer, mas então você começou a falar sobre como o
seu é mais longo<$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>, e não iria ouvir a razão...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Wha—?! You were saying the exact same thing earlier! I
couldn’t help hearing it with these PERFECT EARS!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Você estava dizendo a mesma coisa antes, eu não pude
deixar de ouvir isso com esses piolhos perfeitos!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,7)>Grrr! Your jabs come up short, just like your EARS!
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$facial(1,7)>Seus jabs são curtos, assim como o seu ORELHAS!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Nuh-uh! We aren’t friends at ALL! Are we, <$cdef(27)>Raboot</color>?!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Huh? We’re not fighting. <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> and I are friends.
translation: <$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Hein? Não estamos brigando. <$cdef(27)>Flareon</color> e eu somos amigos.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Oh yeah?! Well I think of you as my BEST friend, so how
about THAT?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Bem, eu penso em você como meu melhor amigo, então
que tal isso?

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hahaaa! Ya snooze, ya lose! Looks like this berry is mine!
translation: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Você soneca, perde, parece que esta fruta é minha!

source:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Nonsense!
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>I got to the berry first and you know it!
translation:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Tolice!
<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,7)>Eu cheguei na fruta primeiro e você sabe disso!

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Not backin’ down, I see...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I wager ya haven’t heard tell of my strength, have ya?
I’ll have you know that all Pokémon in the sky fear me!
translation:
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>Não para baixo, eu vejo...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que você não ouviu falar da minha força
, sabe que todos os Pokémon no céu me temem!

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, do they now? Well, perhaps YOU haven’t heard that
I’m feared by all Pokémon on the ground!
Feast yer eyes on my power! <$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,9)>GRRRAAAR!
translation:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, talvez você não tenha ouvido falar que sou
temido por todos os Pokémon no chão!
Festeje seus olhos no meu<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,9)> poder!

source:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, bless yer heart. Is that what you think passes fer power
these days? Check THIS out!
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRRAHHH!
translation:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Abençoe o seu coração, é isso que você acha que passa
pelo poder hoje em dia?
<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRRAHHH!

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, well! Looks like we’re evenly matched. But what
about speed? <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m clearly the faster runner!
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, bem, parece que somos iguais, mas e a velocidade
? Eu sou <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>claramente o corredor mais rápido!

source:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Now, why would I ever face you in a footrace when we
both know I’m faster flyin’?!
<$voicel(1,7)>Besides, this berry is—<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>huh?!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Ora, por que eu disputaria uma corrida a pé contra você, se nós dois sabemos
que sou mais rápido voando?!
<$voicel(1,7)>Além disso, esta fruta é—<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Hein?!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Ele, ahn... foi esmagado até uma polpa.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Whoops. Guess I got a li’l carried away...
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>I s’pose we’ll jus’ hafta put our li’l competition on hold fer
the time bein’.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Opa. Acho que me empolguei um pouquinho...
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,5)>É melhor deixar nossa competição de lado
por enquanto.

source:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>OK!
<$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Let’s decide what we’re gonna practice by counting down
and saying our choice at the same time!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Phew! That was so fun! What should we do tomorrow?
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Tomorrow we should REALLY get around to practicing.

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Definitely! Let’s decide what move we’ll practice tomorrow
by saying our choice at the same time!
<$voicel(1,8)>One, two...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,10)>Then let’s forget practice tomorrow and PLAY AGAIN!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Oops, I’m so sorry! I guess I let out some electricity when
I sneezed...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Acho que libertei um pouco de eletricidade quando
espirrei...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>D-don’t worry about it—I’m fine... But your electricity is
pretty powerful, isn’t it? <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>It gave me quite a shock...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Não se preocupe, estou bem, mas sua
eletricidade é muito<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)> poderosa, não é?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh... Well, thank you for saying so...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>I just have a hard time controlling it... Electricity is so
difficult to manage...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Bem, obrigado por dizer isso...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Eu só tenho dificuldade em controlá-lo... a eletricidade é tão
difícil de gerenciar...

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>I know what you mean... <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)>Me, I wish I could shoot out some
REALLY powerful bolts, <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>but I still need lots of practice...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Eu gostaria de poder <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)>atirar em alguns parafusos
realmente poderosos, mas <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>ainda preciso de muita prática...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey... Why don’t you show me what you can do? <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Maybe I
can give you some pointers!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei... Que tal me mostrar o que sabe fazer? <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Talvez eu
possa dar algumas dicas!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>R-really? That’s awfully nice of you, thanks! Watch this, OK?
<$motion(2,859)><$voicel(2,8)>Hyaaaaaa!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Isso é muito bom da sua parte, obrigado, veja
<$motion(2,859)><$voicel(2,8)>isso, ok?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>I-it’s n-n-not the m-most powerful b-b-blast f-for sure,
but <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>it’s m-m-made me g-g-go all n-n-n-numb...
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>I’ve n-n-n-n-never f-f-f-felt electricity l-l-like th-th-this!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>N-não é a d-descarga mais forte, c-com certeza,
mas <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>me deixou t-todo dormente...
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,842)><$comeff(1,23)><$facial(1,9)>N-nunca senti uma eletricidade a-assim!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Really? Aw, thank you...
Also, um, sorry—I think I forgot to mention...<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,9)> My
electricity might have just a liiittle poison mixed in...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Aw, obrigado...
Além disso, desculpe, acho que esqueci de mencionar<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,9)>..
. minha eletricidade pode ter apenas um veneno misturado em...

source:
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Th-th-th-that’s a b-b-b-big p-p-piece of info t-t-to
l-l-l-l-leave out...
translation:
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Isso é um g-g-grande d-d-detalhe t-t-
to d-d-deixar de fora...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Cleffa. I’ve noticed I often catch you gazing up at the
sky at night.
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,806)>What about auroras? You ever seen one?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>Yeah, they’re waves of light that sway and dance all over
the night sky.<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,8)> They’re really pretty.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>Wow! That sounds amaaazing! But I’ve never seen one!

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh. Well, I guess that makes sense.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,806)>Back where I was born, you could see auroras pretty often.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,803)><$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)>In a very cold, very beautiful place.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh, I get it! So when winter comes, we might be able to
see an oh-roh-rah!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Your dance is as entrancing as ever. Just watching you
warms my heart.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Sua dança é tão fascinante como sempre, só de vê-lo aquecer
meu coração.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Why, thank you! Would you care to join me sometime?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Gostaria de se juntar a mim algum dia?

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>Me? Oh, no, I’m completely incapable of dancing.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Don’t be silly! I’m sure you can do it. Dancing is simply
using your body to express the joy in your heart.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Has anything fun happened to you recently? Something
that brought you joy?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>A dança é simplesmente usar seu corpo para
expressar a alegria em seu coração.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Algo divertido aconteceu com você recentemente, algo
que lhe trouxe alegria?

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Hmmm... It was certainly fun to watch you dance just now.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,21)>Well then, try and visualize the joy you felt when you
watched me dance.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Can you feel your body start to move on its own?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,21)>Bem, então, tente visualizar a alegria que sentiu
quando me viu dançar.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Você pode sentir seu corpo começar a se mover sozinho?

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>That’s it! You’re a natural!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,25)>I look forward to sharing a dance with you someday.
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>É isso aí, você é natural!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,25)>Estou ansioso para compartilhar uma dança com você um dia.

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)>Thank you. Now I have more things to look forward to
as well.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Um...hi. I need to ask you a favor...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Huh? Oh, um, OK! Just let me know how I can help.
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,59)>Well, you see, my face is really itchy right now...
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,59)>Bem, você vê, meu rosto está realmente com coceira agora...

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Oh, OK... Here, I’ll scratch it for you!
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Oh, OK... aqui, eu vou coçar para você!

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh! Um, that’s not— I just...I just need you to stay still...
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Isso não é... eu só... eu só preciso que você fique quieta...

source:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)>To be honest what I really want to rub my face against is
a nice, hard tree, but...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,46)>There’s no good trees around here...
translation:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)>Para ser honesto, o que eu realmente quero esfregar meu rosto é uma
árvore bonita e dura, mas...
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,46)>Não há árvores boas por aqui...

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,17)>Uhhh, so basically... You wanna rub your face against me?
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,17)>Uhhh, então basicamente... você quer esfregar sua cara contra mim?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Thank you! In that case, let me get started...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,5)>*scratch scratch* I knew it... *scratch scratch* You’re
perfect for this... *scratch scratch* Whew!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Obrigado! Nesse caso, vou começar...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,5)>*coça, coça* Eu sabia... *coça, coça* Você é
perfeito para isso... *coça, coça* Ufa!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Thank you so much... D-do you think you could help me
out again if I ever get itchy?
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Você acha que pode me ajudar de novo se
eu ficar com comichão?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
... ... ...
... ... ...<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>Well? How was that?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>That’s what it should look like... Any questions?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,14)>...........
.............
............ <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>bem, como foi isso?
É<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)> assim que deve parecer... Alguma pergunta?

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>That was AMAZING! You looked JUST like a tree!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>I wanna be like you someday, <$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo!
translation:
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Você parecia uma árvore!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Eu quero ser como você um dia, <$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Hee hee... I know you can do it, <$cdef(27)>Bonsly! ♪ Here, why don’t
you try practicing now?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Hehe... sei que você consegue, <$cdef(27)>Bonsly! ♪ Que tal
praticar agora?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Well, I mean, it’s just... Your demonstration was SO COOL,
<$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>I got so excited I couldn’t keep still!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Bem, quero dizer, é que... sua demonstração foi tão legal,
<$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Fiquei tão animada que não conseguia ficar parada!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Was I really that cool? Hee hee...hee hee hee...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Wait, uh—that’s not the point! Just try to really focus now.
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Eu estava tão legal assim?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Espere, esse não é o ponto, apenas tente realmente se concentrar agora.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Uh... What happened this time? You started off so strong...

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)>Well, you know... You were watching me the whole time,
<$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo, so...hee hee! I got kinda embarrassed!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)>Você estava me vigiando o tempo todo,
<$cdef(27)>Sudowoodo, então fiquei meio envergonhada!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Oh, geez. Teaching is harder than I thought...
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Ensinar é mais difícil do que eu pensava...

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Ahhh, I’ve got nothing to do today...
...Oli...olitoh... ♪
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>Olioliolitoooooohhh... ♪
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Ahhh, eu não tenho nada para fazer
hoje... Oli... olitoh
.<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>.. Oliolitoooooooohh...

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Hold up! What’s that beautiful melody?! <wait(0.8)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Kriii tututu...
translation: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>O que é essa linda melodia? Kriii<wait(0.8)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)> tututu...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Aw yeah, we sure made one sweet song together!
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>You make such interesting melodies!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Ah, sim, nós com certeza fizemos
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)> uma doce canção juntos!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,8)>Oh, I’m so glad you think so! It felt lovely to just go all out
singing like that!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,8)>Oh, estou tão feliz que você pensa assim! Foi lindo sair
cantando assim!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)>That low bass sounded like it was rumbling up from the
bottom of your belly—talk about inspiration overload!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Aw yeah, I feel like I could come up with a whole bunch of
new songs! You gotta let me hear you sing more!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)>Aquele baixo soou como se estivesse roncando do fundo
da barriga. Fale sobre a sobrecarga de inspiração!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ah, sim, eu sinto que eu poderia vir com um monte de músicas
novas, você tem que me deixar ouvir você cantar mais!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>I’d love nothing more! Here goes! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)>Ohhh olitoh
TOOOHHH!!! ♪

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Gliiimmm. ♪ Look. <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>My physical body shines and is
beautiful, do you not think?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Meu corpo <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>físico brilha e é
lindo, não acha?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>That sure is a shiny body ya got there, I tell ya what!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>It’s no match fer my sparkly, shiny, beautiful body, though!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Isso é um corpo brilhante que você tem lá, eu te digo o quê!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>Não é páreo para o meu corpo brilhante e bonito!

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>You said what? Who is no match for who?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Well. I am sparkly and shiny and also glimmering! I am
the winner!
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>Quem não é páreo para quem?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Bem, eu sou brilhante e brilhante e também
brilhando!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Oh yeah? Well, I do declare that I am sparkly! And shiny!
And glimmerin’ and GLISTENIN’ and, uh...um...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Hey, hold up just a sec...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Bem, eu declaro que sou brilhante e brilhante
e brilhando e brilhando e...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Ei, espere um segundo...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>BEHOLD! That there shine o’ yers is reflectin’ offa my
body, makin’ me...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>EVEN SHINIER!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Que o brilho está refletindo meu corpo, me
fazendo... até mesmo<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)> Mais brilhante!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You are correct! And that enhanced shine further reflects
off of my body—<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>making me look even more shiny as well!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>E esse brilho aumentado reflete ainda mais fora do meu
corpo, fazendo-<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>me parecer ainda mais brilhante também!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Y’know...if we become friends, you ’n’ me, I wager the two
of us together could become downright bee-yoo-tiful!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Você sabe... se nos tornarmos amigos, você não me, eu aposto que
nós dois juntos poderia se tornar francamente bee-yoo-tiful!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Yes! We could be sparkly and shiny and glimmering and
glistening and dazzling and—
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>How beautiful could we become? It is scary to think of.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Poderíamos ser brilhantes, brilhantes, cintilantes
, deslumbrantes e...
É<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)> assustador pensar em como poderíamos nos tornar bonitos.
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>Bleh! Esta terra está tão amarga. Que nojo!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Now you listen here, <$cdef(27)>Larvitar! You ain’t gonna grow
big ’n’ strong bein’ all picky like that!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Agora ouça aqui, <$cdef(27)>Larvitar, você não vai ficar
grande e forte sendo tão exigente assim!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,662)>Whatever! I don’t care—I don’t wanna get bigger anyway!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,662)>Eu não me importo, eu não quero ficar maior de qualquer maneira!

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>That right? Are ya SUUURE?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>It’d be real easy to eat more o’ them berries ya love if you
were bigger, y’know. Guess ya don’t love berries after all...
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>- Você tem certeza?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Seria muito fácil comer mais as frutas que você ama se
fosse maior, sabe. Acho que você não ama frutas afinal...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>You bet yer britches! Size is power! Why, if you were big,
all you’d need is a li’l shake of a tree and BAM! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Tons o’
berries would fall right out! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>You could eat, eat, EAT as
much as ya like!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Pode apostar! Tamanho é poder! Se você fosse grande,
bastaria dar uma sacudidinha numa árvore e PÁ! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Um monte de
frutas cairia! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Daria para comer, comer e COMER
à vontade!

source:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Wh-Whoa, that’s super awesome!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Does that mean you could eat up a whole MOUNTAIN
of berries, <$cdef(27)>Tyranitar?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>N-nossa, isso é super incrível!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Isso significa que você poderia comer uma montanha
inteira de frutas<$cdef(27)>, Tyranitar?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,4)>Hm?! M-me?! A-ain’t no doubt about it! I could eat ALL
them berries. Mm-hmm. Yep...
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,4)>Eu não tenho dúvidas sobre isso, eu poderia
comer todas as frutas.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>That rules! You’re the coolest, <$cdef(27)>Tyranitar. I’m gonna work
hard to get big like you! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>And I’ll stop being so picky.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Você é o mais legal, Tyranitar, <$cdef(27)>vou trabalhar duro para
ficar grande como você, e <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>vou parar de ser tão exigente.

source: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)>Gwahaha! That’s the spirit! I believe in ya!
translation: <$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)>Gwahaha, esse é o espírito, eu acredito em você.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>What about all this yummy food right here? Dig in!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>E quanto a toda essa comida deliciosa aqui?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Everywhere! The soil! Doesn’t it look tasty?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Em todos os lugares, o solo, não parece saboroso?
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Sabe, normalmente não se considera terra uma “comida”.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>What?! But it’s so tasty! Even though sometimes rocks get
mixed in there, <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>so it kinda hurts when you bite down...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>O que?! Mas é tão saboroso! Mesmo que às vezes as
rochas se misturam<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)> lá, então dói quando você morde...

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)>Rocks? I woulda thought you could crunch those to bits,
no problem.
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)>Eu pensei que você poderia esmagá-los em pedaços, não
há problema.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>Of COURSE I can’t crunch ’em up! I’ll tell you what—
next time I find a rock while I’m eating, I’ll give it to you!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>É claro que não consigo esmagá-los, vou te dizer uma coisa, da
próxima vez que eu encontrar uma pedra enquanto estou comendo, eu vou dar para você!

source: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>No thanks. Rocks, uh, aren’t really my thing.
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Pedras, na verdade, não é minha coisa.

source:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>I had a berry I was really looking forward to eating, but
then I went and dropped it...
translation:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,18)>Eu tinha uma fruta que eu realmente estava ansioso para comer,
mas então eu fui e deixei cair...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>Oh no, that’s too bad... Well, try distracting yourself with
something else.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)>How about...some exercise? You could go for a run, feel
the breeze on your face...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,17)>Oh, não, isso é muito ruim... bem, tente se distrair
com outra coisa.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)>Você poderia correr, sentir a brisa
em seu rosto...

source:
