<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Uuuh... Nah, I’m OK... I’m not very good at running anyway.
My head’s too heavy...
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Não, estou bem, não sou muito bom em correr de
qualquer maneira.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Oh, er, I see... Well, how about taking a nap?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Maybe doing something you usually do will help.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Oh, er, eu vejo... bem, que tal tirar uma soneca?
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Talvez fazer algo que você costuma fazer ajude.

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Yeah... Just floating along in the water, <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>relaxing and
listening to the sounds... That might help me forget...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Why don’t you join me, <$cdef(27)>Raboot?
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Sim, flutuando na água, relaxando <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>e ouvindo
os sons... isso pode me ajudar a esquecer...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Por que não se junta a mim,<$cdef(27)> Raboot?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>Don’t worry, you can ride the leaf on my head! <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>That should
make it OK, right?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>Não se preocupe, você pode montar a<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)> folha na
minha cabeça!

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>Yay! Oh boy, this is going to be SO much fun!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,5)>Hey, why don’t we go look for some new berries while
we’re at it?
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>Oba! Nossa, isso vai ser MUITO divertido!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,5)>Ei, que tal irmos procurar frutas novas enquanto
isso?

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh, sure. Nice to see you feeling better.
translation: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>É bom ver você se sentindo melhor.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>W-well? What do you think? Did I get the dance right?
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>O que você acha que eu fiz a dança certa?

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>You gotta go with the rhythm mooore. Gotta flow with
the flooow.
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Você tem que ir com o ritmo do mooore, tem que fluir
com o flooow.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmmmmm. <$cdef(27)>Lotad... <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Could it be that dancing maaaybe
makes you feel embaaarrassed?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(27)>Lotad... será <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>que dançar maaaybe faz você
se sentir embaaarrassed?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>I feel yooouuu. It takes courage to do something you’re
not uuused to.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)>But I wanna know more about you and what you’re
feeliiing. <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>You gotta let your passion run freeeeee.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>É preciso coragem para fazer algo que você não está
acostumado.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)>Mas quero saber mais sobre
você <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>e o que está sentindo.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeahhh. Take a good look at me...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>I don’t look embaaarrassed at all, riiight?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Sim, dê uma boa olhada em mim...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Eu não pareço envergonhada, Riiight?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Yeah, you look...really cool. And like you’re having fun.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Sim, você parece... muito legal. E como se estivesse se divertindo.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Riiight? You’ll stop caring what others think when you
just go aaall in on something...
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,6)>And that’s not my ooonly secret. I also just really like
myself when I’m daaancing!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Você vai parar de se importar com o que os outros
pensam quando você entrar em algo...
E<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,6)> esse não é o meu único segredo. Eu também gosto de mim
mesmo quando estou dançando!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>OK... I think I understand! I gotta show my passion.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>...How’s this?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Acho que entendo, tenho que mostrar minha paixão.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Como é isso?

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$textsize(2)>Niiice! That’s passion!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>I could reeeaaally tell how you felt when you danced just
now.
You were having so much fun! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Just keep up the paaassion!
translation:
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$textsize(2)>Legaaal, isso é paixão!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Eu poderia dizer como você se sentiu quando
dançou
agora, você estava <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>se divertindo tanto.

source:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>! You’re always so cool and composed.
I wanna be like you!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh... Is that so?
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>If you ask me, everyone else is just too excitable.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? Uh... <$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>, is that <$cdef(27)><$cname(69)> behind you? <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>They’re
just sittin’ there starin’ at us, and it’s kinda creepy...

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Whoa. Uh...sorry, yo. Didn’t expect ya to get so scared...
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I was thinkin’ you’d just stay cool and composed no matter
what, but I guess I got to see a new side of you just now!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Sableye. Your eyes sparkle greatly. Why? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>It makes me a
small amount of jealous.
translation:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Seus olhos brilham muito, me deixa com<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)> uma pequena
quantidade de ciúmes.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I do not know. Maybe because I eat many sparkling gems.
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Glimmora. Your petals are very nice as well.
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu não sei, talvez porque eu como muitas gemas cintilantes.
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Suas pétalas também são muito boas.

source: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh. Is it true? What do you find very nice?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Their gradient color is nice. And their smoothness. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>But.
Mostly, I like the hunger they cause in my stomach.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Sua cor de gradiente é agradável, e sua suavidade, mas, <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>
principalmente, eu gosto da fome que causam no meu estômago.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)>The hunger. Yes. <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, no. Drool. I cannot help it.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,2)><$textsize(0)>I must munch them.
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)>Não, Baba<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>, não posso evitar.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,2)><$textsize(0)>Eu tenho que mastigar eles.

source:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>There is no problem. Poison does not affect me a
large amount.
translation:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Não há problema, o veneno não me
afeta muito.

source:
<$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>I have just remembered. I must do a thing. It is a very
important thing. It is for <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,7)>So, I must say goodbye for today. I must. Yes. Goodbye.
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)>...............
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Acabei de me lembrar, devo fazer uma coisa, é uma
coisa muito importante, é para <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,7)>Então, devo dizer adeus por hoje.

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,23)>*sniffle* You bumped into me! It really hurt! Waaah!
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,23)>Você esbarrou em mim, doeu muito, Waaah!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, I’m sorry, but um...<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)> You’re faking crying, aren’t you?
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Sinto muito, mas... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>você está fingindo chorar, não é?
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Sim, quero dizer... é uma coisa de vibe...

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>Awww... Was it THAT easy to tell they weren’t real tears?
<$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,17)>I gotta get better at faking.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>Foi tão fácil dizer que não eram
<$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,17)>lágrimas de verdade?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Well... I don’t know if it’s a good idea to try and trick
someone. If you get too carried away, you never know...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>That “someone” might just gobble you up one of these days.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Bem... não sei se é uma boa
ideia tentar enganar alguém.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Aquele "alguém" pode te devorar um dia desses.

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,17)>Come on, I just told you that fake crying isn’t a good ide—
translation: <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,17)>Vamos lá, eu só disse que o choro falso não é uma boa ideia.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Uagh! Th-this is fake crying too, right? Right?!
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Isso também é um choro falso, certo?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Todaaay I’m going to tell you a stooory about a heated
battle I once had...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Yay! I wanna hear it! Tell me, tell me!

<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>All riiiiight. Here I go...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Maaany moons ago, when I was still young, my home fell
under attack...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>So I jumped out all on my own and fought off muuultiple
opponents all by myself...

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,39)>Hahaaa. I see you are warming up to my stooory...
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>What was I talking about agaaaiiin? Oh yeah, my battle...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Just as I was about to breathe ooone final breath of fire to
end it, it suddenly started to raaaiiin...
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Uh-oh, sounds like a setback! What’d you do, then?!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Hmm... You’ve warmed up so muuuch that now you’re
starting to get heated. Let’s take a quick breeeaaak...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>That cooled you down faaast, huh? Hahaha. Your emotions
are so obvious... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>We can finish the story laaater...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)>But what happens next?! I gotta know!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Whoooaaa there... You’re getting really heated again. It’s
so difficult to control your fiiire...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yooo, you have such a good sound, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune. It really,
like, pulls at my heartstrings ’n’ stuff.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>What’s the secret to makin’ such a pretty sound?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yooo, você tem <$cdef(27)>um som tão
bom, Kricketune.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Qual é o segredo para fazer um som tão bonito?

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm, good question. First, lemme hear your sound.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Y-yeah, sure! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Tot... Tot... Tot...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... I dunno, yo. It just sounds like it lacks a bit of a
punch or somethin’.
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Sim, claro, <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>tot... tot... tot...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Não sei, parece que falta um soco ou
algo assim.

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! What’s wrong with that? Sounds cute to me!
translation: <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>O que há de errado com isso?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Heyyy! Don’t make fun of my sound... This is a super
serious issue for me, yo!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Ei! Não tire sarro do meu som... Esse problema é muito
sério para mim, cara!

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Whoa, sorry, pal! I didn’t mean it like that.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>See, I can’t make that sound anymore, so I’m kinda jealous
of ya.
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Desculpe, amigo, não quis dizer isso.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Veja, não posso mais fazer esse som, então estou com ciúmes
de você.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! Guess the grass is always greener, huh?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>But it’s pretty fun tinkerin’ around to make your own tune.
If you can’t make a certain sound, try to work around it
and keep striving <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>to produce one you DO want.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>By the time you’re done, you’ll have your very own, unique
sound!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Acho que a grama é sempre mais verde, não é?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>Mas é muito divertido mexer para fazer sua própria música. Se
você não pode fazer um certo som, tente contornar isso e continue
se esforçando para<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)> produzir um que você quer.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Quando terminar, você terá seu próprio som
único!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yooo! Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune! I think I understand! <$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m gonna
work hard to find my own ideal sound, just like you!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>Kricketuno, acho que entendo, vou <$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>trabalhar
duro para encontrar meu som ideal, assim como você!

source:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Dartrix! You’re always so cool and composed and...
y’know, cool!
translation:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Você<$cdef(27)> é sempre tão legal e composto e...
sabe, legal!

source: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Are you even like that in battle?!

<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,5)>Of course. I start off by closely observing my opponents’
movements...
translation:
<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,5)>Eu começo observando de perto os movimentos dos meus
oponentes...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)>Then I instantly intuit where my opponent will be and what
they will do in the very next second. And then...
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>I strike them down with a single blow!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)>Então eu intuo instantaneamente onde meu oponente estará
e o que eles farão no próximo segundo, e então
.<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>.. eu os derrubo com um único golpe!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>That’s the secret to winning a battle without breaking a
sweat—it all comes down to using your head.
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Esse é o segredo para vencer uma batalha sem
suar, tudo se resume a usar sua cabeça.

source:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>My head?! I’m SO good at using my head, yo! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I once
knocked out 30 opponents in a row with just Headbutt!
translation:
<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>Minha cabeça?! Sei usar minha cabeça muito bem, viu! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Uma vez,
nocauteei 30 adversários seguidos só com Headbutt!

source: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Well... I guess there are lots of ways to use your head, huh.
translation: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Bem... acho que há muitas maneiras de usar a cabeça, né?

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Hey, bud. That’s a sturdy-lookin’ head ya got there.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Ei, amigo, essa é uma cabeça forte que você tem aí.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Wh-whoa... What’s with the sudden cooompliment? I think
I’m blushiiing...

<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>We gotta have a battle! Let’s see if your head is any match
against my pulverizing headbutt!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Vamos batalhar! Quero ver se a sua cabeça é páreo
para meu Headbutt devastador!

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Whaaat? H-hey... You’re making a scaaary face...
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Você está fazendo uma cara de scaaary...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>Uuugh, that really surpriiised me... And it kinda hurt?
It’s been a whiiile since something hurt me.
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>Uuugh, isso realmente me surpreendeu... e meio que doeu...
tem sido um gemido desde que algo me machucou.

source:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Oof...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,18)>Can’t remember the last time I’ve felt this much pain...
translation:
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Oof...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,18)>Não me lembro da última vez que senti tanta dor...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Ummm... Are we comparing who’s strooonger?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>’Cause if so, I guess it’s myyy turn next? OK, I won’t
hold baaack...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Estamos comparando quem é o strooonger?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Porque, se sim, acho que é a próxima
vez de Myyy?

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)>W-wait, no! Ummm...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Y-ya know what? I just remembered—it’s about time for
some grub... Guess we’ll have to stop here for today!
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)>Espere, não!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Acabei de me lembrar que está na hora de um grub
... acho que vamos ter que parar aqui por hoje!

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Not bad... Not bad at all! A most excellent jam session.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe! Don’t underestimate me, yo! And you were pretty
awesome yourself!

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,814)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You’re doing well, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. I see definite improvement.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Next, let’s work on refining your aura. Quietly now... Feel
the power inside you...
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,814)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Você está indo bem, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Dá para ver seu progresso.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Agora vamos trabalhar no controle da sua aura. Silêncio... Sinta
a força dentro de você...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$emotion(2,14)>... ... ...Ah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Heh heh, why don’t we get you something to eat, <$cdef(27)>Riolu.
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$emotion(2,14)>.........Ah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Por que não lhe damos algo para comer, <$cdef(27)>Riolu?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh! It appears you’ve been concentrating so hard, you
didn’t even notice you were hungry.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Parece que você tem se concentrado tanto, que
nem percebeu que estava com fome.

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>I can’t believe you had to notice for me, Sensei... I’m
so embarrassed! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>I’m really sorry!
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Não acredito que tenha notado por mim, Sensei
... estou tão<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)> envergonhada!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>There’s no need to be embarrassed, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Let’s get you
fed so you can start afresh on a full stomach!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Ah—one moment. We have nothing here to eat. So that
will be the next step in your training! Find some berries!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Do you think you can handle that, <$cdef(27)>Riolu?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Não há necessidade de se envergonhar, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Vamos te alimentar
para que você possa começar de novo com o estômago cheio!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Não temos nada para comer, então
será o próximo passo no seu treinamento.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Acha que consegue lidar com isso, <$cdef(27)>Riolu?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yes, Sensei! I’ll do my best so I can be like you someday!
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Sim, Sensei, farei o meu melhor para que eu possa ser como você um dia!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Reading the mind of one’s opponent and then outwitting
them—that is the true essence of battle.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Lendo a mente do oponente e, em seguida, enganando-os,
essa é a verdadeira essência da batalha.

source:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,46)>Yeah, you seem like you’d be pretty good at that sorta
thing. I’d love to figure out how to do that myself.
translation:
<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,46)>Sim, parece que você seria muito bom nesse tipo de
coisa. Eu adoraria descobrir como fazer isso eu mesmo.

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Heh heh. Well then, how about a bit of training?
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Então, que tal um pouco de treinamento?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>In that case... In a moment, I will throw either a punch or
a kick. <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Try to predict which it will be.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>Nesse caso, em um momento, vou dar um soco ou
um chute<$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>, tentar prever qual será.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Gotcha! OK, let’s see...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,815)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Got it! You’re gonna kick!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)>Nooo! Thought I had it for sure...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Well then, what do you predict I’ll unleash next?
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Bem, então, o que você prevê que eu vou liberar a seguir?

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,806)>I’ll definitely nail it this time!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)>You’re gonna...punch! Yeah, that’s gotta be it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,806)>Eu definitivamente vou pregar desta vez!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)>Sim, tem que ser isso!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>Unfortunately, the correct answer was Aura Sphere.
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>Infelizmente, a resposta correta foi Aura Sphere.

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,43)>Whoa, hey! No fair! That’s not a punch OR a kick!
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,43)>Não é justo, isso não é um soco ou um chute!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh heh. As I said, the true essence of battle is to outwit
one’s opponent.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Como eu disse, a verdadeira essência da batalha é enganar
o oponente.

source: <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Grgh... Guess I’m just not cut out for this!
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Grgh... acho que não estou preparado para isso!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)><$facial(2,5)>Despite its magnificent size and appearance, you managed
to keep that fire from burning too hot...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motionoff(2,666)>To produce—let alone control—a flame like that must
require a lot of skill.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)><$facial(2,5)>Apesar de seu magnífico tamanho e aparência, você conseguiu
evitar que o fogo queimasse muito quente...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motionoff(2,666)>Para produzir - e muito menos controlar - uma chama como essa
deve exigir muita habilidade.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>You’re an expert in the art of flame manipulation, aren’t
you? Please, share your secrets with me!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Você é um especialista na arte da manipulação de chamas, não é?
Por favor, compartilhe seus segredos comigo!

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,15)>A berry! I see, that never occurred to me.
<$motionoff(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Start by eating your favorite berry, relax both mind and
body—then concentrate. That’s it, yes?
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,15)>Entendo, isso nunca me ocorreu.
<$motionoff(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Comece comendo sua fruta favorita, relaxe tanto a mente
quanto o corpo e depois se concentre.

source:
<$motionoff(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>Nooo... Uhhh...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>I wanted to kinda char a berry a bit befooore I ate it...<$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>but I
accidentally burned it up insteeeaaad.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>If you bring me a berryyy I can teach you, though.
translation:
<$motionoff(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>Não, Uhhh...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu queria um pouco de amor um pouco befooore eu comi-lo... <$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>mas
eu acidentalmente queimou-lo insteeeaaad.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Se você me trouxer um berryyy eu posso te ensinar, no entanto.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>I...I see. Of course, whenever you have the time, I would
love to learn from you!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>Claro, sempre que tiver tempo, adoraria
aprender com você!

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>Raaawr! Why’re you bigger than me?! It’s not fair!
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>Raaawr, por que você é maior que eu?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>You heard me! This means we gotta battle!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,22)>I’ll show you that I’m stronger, even if you’re bigger!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Isso significa que temos que lutar!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,22)>Vou te mostrar que sou mais forte, mesmo que você seja maior!

source: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Hmmm... I’ll pass. I don’t really like fighting.
translation: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Eu vou passar, não gosto de brigar.

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Fine by me. That means YOU lose, and I’M the strongest!
translation: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Isso significa que você perde, e eu sou o mais forte!

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>*sigh* Fine. If you’re going to be like that, I’ll battle you.
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Se você vai ser assim, eu vou lutar com você.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe, I knew you’d come around. No matter what kind of
battle you choose, I’m gonna win!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe, eu sabia que você viria, não importa que tipo de
batalha você escolher, eu vou ganhar!

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,6)>OK then, how about this? Whoever speaks next loses.

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Huh? ...HUH?
... ... ...<$comeff(1,11)><$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>NOOOOOOOOO!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Dang it, you got me... Let’s have a rematch! <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>I’ll win next
time for sure!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>hein?...né
?......<$comeff(1,11)><$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>NOOOOOOOO!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Droga, você me pegou... vamos ter uma revanche! Eu vou <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>ganhar da próxima
vez, com certeza!

source: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)>I’ll let you know when I feel like it.

<$facial(1,2)><$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa! That’s a pretty awesome singin’ voice ya got there.
Sure wish I could sing like that!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Why, thank you, dear! I’m sure you could do it too if you
put your mind to it.
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Why not give it a try? Come on—let’s hear those pipes!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Ya really think so? OK, I’ll give it a go! Ahem...
Noyyy-VERRRNNNNNN!
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Ngh! That’s...quite a distinctive sound you’ve got.

<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Hey, thanks! I bet everyone <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>would enjoy hearin’ my sweet
singin’ voice, too! Now, who should I sing to first...

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Your singing voice is really quite impressive, but...well,
m-maybe it’s TOO impressive!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>I think you might want to consider singing somewhere far,
FAR away from everyone else.
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)>But then no one’ll be able to hear me sing!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Don’t worry about that, hon! The charm of your singing
voice is sure to reach them regardless!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ya think so? Well, cool! Thanks for the advice!

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, sorry. I was just sending out some ultrasonic waves.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>It’s a little hard to control where they go, so I—
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Desculpe, só estava enviando algumas ondas ultrassônicas, é um
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>pouco difícil controlar para onde elas vão, então eu...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>That...was...AWESOME! Will you do it once more? Pretty
pretty please?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Isso... foi... maravilhoso, você vai fazer isso
mais uma vez?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)>I mean, it made me feel all tingly...but in a way that
was like, again, do it again!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)>Quero dizer, isso me fez sentir formigamento... mas de uma forma que
foi como, de novo, fazê-lo de novo!

source: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>I, er...don’t think that’s a good idea. It could be dangerous.
translation: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Eu não acho que seja uma boa ideia, pode ser perigoso.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>When I use ultrasonic waves to see what’s around me, I
sometimes have a hard time moderating their strength
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>and wind up confusing those nearby...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Quando uso ondas ultrassônicas para ver o que está ao meu
redor, às vezes tenho dificuldade em moderar sua força e
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>acabar confundindo as pessoas próximas...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>That’s amazing! I wonder if I could do it too.<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,664)> OK, I wanna
try! Watch me, watch!
<$se2d(1045)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>HoowOOOOOOOOO!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>How’d I do? Are ya super tingly now?
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>Isso é incrível! Eu me pergunto se eu poderia fazer<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,664)> isso também
. Ok, eu quero tentar!
<$se2d(1045)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>HoowOOOOOOOOOO!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Você está super tingido agora?

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>You might need a little more practice...
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Você pode precisar de um pouco mais de prática...

source:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Why, hello, <$cdef(27)><$cname(106)>. How nice to see you looking as
cheerful as ever... Heh.
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Did you just say “heh” to imitate me? Heh.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yup! I wanna be super cool when I grow up—just like you,
<$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>! <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>So I’ll start copying you sometimes. Heh.

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Heh... I’m flattered, truly.
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>By the way, I happened upon some rather tasty-looking
berries earlier. <$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>May I offer you some?

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Yayyy! I wanna eat ’em! Can I, pretty please?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>Wait, no! What I MEANT to say was...yes, I’d like some.
...Heh.

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,17)><$comeff(1,10)>*munch munch*... *CRUNCH*<$motion(1,19)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)>Ouch ouch ooouuuch! I bit down on a rock...
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,17)><$comeff(1,10)>*nhac, nhac*... *CRAC*<$motion(1,19)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)>Ai, ai, aaai! Mordi uma pedra...

source: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Why’d you put somethin’ like THAT in your mouth, yo?
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>Por que você colocou algo assim na sua boca?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>’Cause I ate all the berries I had saved up.<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)> My poor
cheeks just felt super empty, so...
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Porque comi todas as frutas que salvei. Minhas <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)>pobres
bochechas pareciam super vazias, então...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Oh darn. Maybe you should just train real hard <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,6)>so you can
keep more berries in there in the future?
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Try openin’ your mouth REAL wide! Like this!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Talvez devesse treinar duro <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,6)>para manter
mais frutas lá no futuro?
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>Tente abrir sua boca de verdade!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Yeah! Like that, yo! Now you just gotta stuff a bunch of
things in there.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>You gotta be willing to take on any challenge! Even if that
means chompin’ down on something bigger than you are!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Agora você só tem que colocar um monte de
coisas lá dentro.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Você tem que estar disposto a aceitar qualquer desafio,
mesmo que isso signifique comer algo maior do que você!

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmm, OK! I’m gonna try it!
<$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>So I just open my mouth reeeaaally wide? OK, here goes...
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,816)>*blang-blang-twang!* *blaaaang twang-TWANG!!!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Aw yeah! Another day, another tasty riff from yours truly!
translation:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,816)>"Blang-blang-twang!" "Blaaaang twang-TWANG!"
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)>Outro dia, outro riff gostoso do seu, de verdade!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>I mean... It’s not bad, I guess...
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>Quer dizer... não é ruim, eu acho...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I just think you can do better...
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu só acho que você pode fazer melhor...

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>That’s big talk from a li’l pipsqueak!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,33)>Lay it on me, then. What can I do to make my riffs
even tastier?
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Você fala grosso para um tampinha desses!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,33)>Então diga: o que posso fazer para deixar meus riffs
ainda melhores?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>You don’t need so much strength in your fingers...
Make them go all relaxed, just like a <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Also I think you need to work on your wrist movements...
They should be sharper, like when you use Poison Jab...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Você não precisa de tanta força em seus dedos
... fazê-los relaxar, como um <$cdef(27)>slowpoke...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,824)><$comeff(1,14)>Também acho que você precisa trabalhar em seus movimentos de pulso..
. eles devem ser mais nítidos, como quando você usa o Poison Jab...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$motionoff(1,661)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(1,661)><$emotion(2,48)>So...completely change my style? Easier said than done...
But sure, why not? I’ll give it a shot. <$voicel(2,6)>Let’s see...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,816)><$comeff(2,13)><$se2d(1043)>*bleowww wah wah-wah WAHHH!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Hey, heyyy! Now THAT’s a new sound!

<$comcan(1)><$motionoff(1,661)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(1,661)><$emotion(2,48)>Então... mude completamente meu estilo? Mais fácil dizer do que fazer
... mas claro, por que não? Vou dar uma chance<$voicel(2,6)>. Vamos ver...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,816)><$comeff(2,13)><$se2d(1043)>*bleowww wah wah-wah WAHHH!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Ei, ei, ei, agora é um novo som!

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh heh... I knew you could do it...
translation: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu sabia que você poderia fazer isso...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,5)>Say, bud! Uh...maybe you could swing by every now and
then to listen to me jam? <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,10)>Y’know, if ya feel like it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,5)>Diga, amigo, talvez você possa passar por
aqui de vez em quando<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,10)> para me ouvir jam?

source: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>Heh... Sure. Every now and then, anyway...
translation: <$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,666)>De vez em quando, de qualquer maneira...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>You and I are quite similar in appearance, but...the
flames that burn within us seem fairly different.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Você e eu somos bastante parecidos na aparência, mas... as
chamas que queimam dentro de nós parecem bastante diferentes.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Yeah... Your flames are so bright and strong... Just looking
at them makes my heart grow hot!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Suas chamas são tão brilhantes e fortes... só de olhar para
elas faz meu coração ficar quente!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,4)>Really? Well, I think your flames possess a wonderful,
soothing quality.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,4)>Bem, acho que suas chamas têm uma qualidade maravilhosa
e calmante.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>You...think so? Well, thank you. It makes me happy to hear
you say that!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Bem, obrigado, fico feliz em ouvir você
dizer isso!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>O que você acha, <$cdef(27)>, de quem
você mais

gosta
de chamas?

source:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Yeah, I agree! I feel like it shows a fiery, passionate soul...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>It’s so cool!
translation:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Sinto que mostra uma alma ardente e apaixonada... é
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>tão legal!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)>That seems a bit exaggerated, but...thank you.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)>Isso parece um pouco exagerado, mas... obrigado.

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Heh. I knew you’d be able to appreciate their beauty. You
must desire peace of mind.
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu sabia que você seria capaz de apreciar a beleza deles, você
deve desejar paz de espírito.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>You and I may have our differences, but it seems we share
a desire for strength.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Você e eu podemos ter nossas diferenças, mas parece que compartilhamos
um desejo de força.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,9)>I agree! We can do our best together, <$cdef(27)>Armarouge!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)>I want you to witness us too, <$cdef(27)>...
I
promise
I’ll
become
stronger
than ever!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,9)>Nós podemos fazer o nosso melhor juntos,<$cdef(27)> Armarouge!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)>Quero que nos testemunhe também, <$cdef(27)>...

prometo que
ficarei
mais
forte do
que nunca!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Hey! Ever seen me swim?! I’m, like, super fast, yo! <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>I dunno
if ANYONE’S faster than me in the water!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,49)>Ei, já me vi nadando, tipo, super rápido, não sei<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)> se
alguém é mais rápido do que eu na água!

source:

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>One-handed? Two-handed? No-handed? No problem!
I can do it all!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Bem, eu conheço uma tonelada de diferentes cursos de natação,
com<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)> uma mão, com duas mãos, sem mão, sem problema, eu
posso fazer tudo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh yeah?! Well, uh... I can <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>swim with ease even when the
water’s crazy rough!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Bem, eu posso nadar com <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)>facilidade, mesmo quando
a água está louca!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)>What?! Well, I’m a fearsome fighter! Feast your eyes on
these fierce fists!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Which one of us is cooler?
