<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)>Bem, eu sou um lutador temível, ponha seus olhos
nesses punhos ferozes!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Ei, <$cdef(27)>, qual de nós é mais legal?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... I guess we should listen to
<$cdef(27)>
here, yo.

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,663)>Hmph! Well, I’m still not convinced.<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)>
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,48)>Besides, I’m not the one who started this bragfest—that
was all you, pal!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,663)>Bem, ainda não estou convencido.<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)>
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,48)>Além disso, não fui eu que comecei essa festa de pirralho. Era
tudo você, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>W-well, y’know, I thought it’d be fine to talk myself up a
bit, yo!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re so cool when you swim, <$cdef(27)>Poliwrath... I just wanted a
li’l friendly competition...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>Bem, você sabe, eu pensei que seria bom falar um
pouco, cara!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Você é tão legal quando nada, <$cdef(27)>Poliwrath... eu só queria
uma competição amigável...

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>That so? I didn’t know you felt that way...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>Well, I gotta admit, you are pretty speedy.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Eu não sabia que você se sentia assim...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>Bem, eu tenho que admitir, você é muito rápido.

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,666)>Say, <$cdef(27)>Wartortle...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>We should go swimmin’ together sometime. I’ll teach ya
some of my tricks.
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,666)>Diga, <$cdef(27)>Wartortle...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Devíamos ir nadar juntos um dia desses, vou te ensinar alguns
dos meus truques.

source: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Y-yeah! That sounds awesome, yo! I’m lookin’ forward to it!
translation: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Isso parece incrível, estou ansioso por isso!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yoooooo! Your tails are SO beautiful! Like...overflowing
with beautifulness!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Suas caudas são tão lindas, como... transbordando
de beleza!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>No matter what angle I look at ’em from! Beautiful! Just
beautiful! Thanks so much for showin’ ’em off to me!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>Não importa de que ângulo eu olhe para eles, lindo
, lindo, muito obrigado por mostrá-los para mim.

source: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>You certainly know how to deliver praise, <$cdef(27)>Wartortle</color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>My pleasure, yo! I’m just super thankful that I get to see
your <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>beautiful tails, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Estou super agradecida por poder ver suas
lindas<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)> caudas, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>Think nothing of it. After all, I also got to see something
<$voicel(2,6)>quite lovely.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>Afinal de contas, eu também tenho que ver algo
<$voicel(2,6)>muito bonito.

source: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huh? Somethin’ lovely? What do you mean?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Every time you got enthusiastic, your tail wagged.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>That fluff, those curly tufts... It was absolutely adorable!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Toda vez que você ficava entusiasmado, sua cauda se molhava,
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>aquele babaca, aqueles tufos encaracolados... era absolutamente adorável!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Awww, <$cdef(27)>Ninetales! Thanks, yo! I think I’m gonna take a page
out of your book <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>and try to get my tail all beautiful too!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Obrigado<$cdef(27)>, acho que vou tirar uma página do seu
livro e tentar <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>pegar minha cauda toda linda também!

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Hahaha! That sure was a good competition we had there,
<$cdef(27)>Greninja! You’re pretty good at this, if I do say so myself!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Essa foi uma boa competição que tivemos lá, Greninja
<$cdef(27)>, você é muito bom nisso, se eu disser isso eu mesmo!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,1)>Indeed. I feel very fortunate to have met a worthy rival
with whom I can hone my skills.
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,9)>I look forward to more of this in the future with you.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,1)>Sinto-me muito feliz por ter encontrado um rival digno com quem
posso aprimorar minhas habilidades.
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,9)>Estou ansioso para mais disso no futuro com você.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Heck yeah! Let’s do it! Of course, it goes without sayin’
that I won today’s water-blastin’ competition...
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,815)>But I’mma have to step up my game next time! Yes sirree!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Claro que não é preciso dizer que
ganhei a competição de hoje...
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,815)>Mas vou ter que intensificar meu jogo da próxima vez!

source:
<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,6)>...Excuse me? I believe you’ll find that I was the
victor today.
translation:
<$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,6)>Eu acredito que você vai achar que eu fui o
vencedor hoje.

source:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,10)><$comeff(1,22)>What?! Were you even watchin’, buddy? <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)>I clearly blasted
water farther’n you!
translation:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,10)><$comeff(1,22)>Você estava mesmo assistindo, amigo, eu <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)>claramente explodi água
mais longe do que você!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,7)>Preposterous! My record was a full leaf’s length farther
than yours!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Perhaps your eyes have grown weak, <$cdef(27)>Blastoise?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,7)>Meu registro era de uma folha cheia mais longe do
que o seu!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Talvez seus olhos tenham ficado fracos, <$cdef(27)>Blastoise?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)>Heh heh... You young’uns sure know how to twist things to
make yourselves look better than you are.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,9)>What you need, my friend, is to look at things with a li’l
more objectivity!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Put any sheet of iron in front of me, and my Hydro Pump’ll
blast clean through it! Losin’ just ain’t an option for me!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,807)>Vocês jovens não sabem como torcer as coisas
para parecerem melhores do que são.
O<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,9)> que você precisa, meu amigo, é olhar para as coisas com
mais objetividade!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,814)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Coloque qualquer folha de ferro na minha frente, e
minha Hydro Pump vai explodir limpa através dele!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Hahaha! If your aim is to send water flying a great
distance, there’s no need for brute strength like yours.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,10)>What’s truly important is skill and technique.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Se seu objetivo é enviar água voando uma grande
distância, não há necessidade de força bruta como a sua.
O<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,10)> que é realmente importante é habilidade e técnica.

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(2,653)>Grrr... You really know how to run yer mouth! We’ll settle
this once ’n’ fer all next time!
translation: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)><$motion(2,653)>Grrr... Você fala demais! Vamos acertar as contas de uma vez por todas na próxima vez!

source: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,817)>I would have it no other way!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Servine, you collect berries with your vines, right?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,666)>That’s so awesome! I’m jealous.

<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Huh... Is it really that cool? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,815)>All I do is aim at a target and
hit it with <$cdef(27)>Vine Whip...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>I can do that with my tail, but it can’t stretch out like your
vines. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,663)>I wish I could reach faraway stuff like you...

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh... Well, thanks.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>But you’re better at hide-and-seek than me, <$cdef(27)>Ekans. I can
never seem to find you!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>You got that right—no one has a sneakier slither than me!
Plus I’m super good at staying still and silent!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>Yup, I’m pretty much a hide-and-seek pro!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>So you’re using that thin, long body of yours to sneak
around, huh? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Maybe I should try slithering like you...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,666)>Huh?! You wanna copy ME? Wow, you’re gonna make
me blush!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Guess I gotta keep practicing if I wanna stay the
supreme sneak!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Yeah! I’ll do my best to keep up, too!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>If we play hide-and-seek together a bunch, <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>do you think
your body’ll get long like mine?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Hehe... That’d be amazing if it did!
Uh...<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> How come you’re not scared? <wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Ain’t you afraid of me?
translation: Por<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> que não está com<wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)> medo de mim?

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Huh? Why would I be scared? You just wanna be friends,
don’tcha?
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Por que eu estaria com medo, você só quer ser amigo,
não quer?

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Wh-WHAT?! Where’d ya get that idea from?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Wha—?! Am I wrong? I was CERTAIN you were scarin’
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>everyone ’cause you just wanted to talk to them...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Estava certo de que estava assustando todo
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)> mundo porque só queria falar com eles...

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Er, no way, that’s not... I’m, uh... You got it all wrong, pal!
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>De jeito nenhum, isso não é... eu estou, ahn... você entendeu tudo errado, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Awww... Really?
<$voicel(2,5)>’Cause I really wanted a friend too, so when you came and
went “Ssshaaa!” at me, <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)>I was so happy...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,18)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)>Ahhh... sério?
<$voicel(2,5)>Porque eu também queria um amigo, então quando você veio e disse
"Ssshaaa!" para mim, eu <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,805)>estava tão feliz...

source:
<$emotion(1,27)>For real?!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>...Psh, well, if that’s how ya feel, guess I got no choice—
starting today, you and me are pals, pal!
translation:
<$emotion(1,27)>De verdade?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Bem, se é assim que você se sente, acho que não tenho escolha - a
partir de hoje, você e eu somos amigos, amigo!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Really? REALLY really?! Yayyy! OK, you ’n’ me are
officially friends now, <$cdef(27)>Arbok!

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Hi, <$cdef(27)>Raichu. Get a load of this!
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Earlier, someone left a huge burn mark on my home!
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>- <$cdef(27)>Oi, Raichu.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Mais cedo, alguém deixou uma enorme marca de queimadura na minha casa!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh no! That’s a terrible thing to do!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>I’ll be sure to give whoever did that to you a real earful!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Isso é uma coisa terrível de se fazer!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Eu vou ter certeza de dar a quem fez isso com você um verdadeiro ouvido!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Thanks, but the thing is...I’ve got no clue who did it.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,47)>By the time I noticed, they were already gone.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,805)>Obrigado, mas é o seguinte... não faço ideia de quem fez isso.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,47)>Quando percebi, já tinham ido embora.

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,15)>Oh dear, the culprit must be a sneaky one!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Did you notice anything else at the time, <$cdef(27)>Trapinch?
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,15)>Meu Deus, o culpado deve ser sorrateiro!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Você notou mais alguma coisa na época, <$cdef(27)>Trapinch?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh yeah! I heard this loud noise, like KZZZAP! It sounded
kinda like electricity.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Who coulda done something like this? And why? I don’t
get it at all...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Ouvi um barulho alto, como o KZZAP, parecia
eletricidade.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Quem poderia ter feito algo assim?
E por quê?

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
... ... ...
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$textsize(0)>That...sounds like when I discharged electricity into the ground earlier.
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)>.................
...................
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$textsize(0)>Parece que quando eu descarreguei eletricidade no chão mais cedo.

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>Huh? Did you say something?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Wait, do you know who did this?!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>Você disse alguma coisa?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Espere, você sabe quem fez isso?

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Oh, er... Y-yes, dear! Exactly...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>I’ll tell that scoundrel <$voicel(1,4)>not to do that again near your home...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Oh, er... sim, querida!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Vou dizer àquele canalha para <$voicel(1,4)>não fazer isso de novo perto de sua casa...

source: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Wow, thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>Raichu</color>! I’ll leave that to you!
translation: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Uau, obrigado, Raichu<$cdef(27)>, vou</color> deixar isso para você!

source:
<$emotion(1,27)>Whoa...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Ahem! ...Yi-yip!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Awww... I just can’t roar as elegantly as you do, <$cdef(27)>Persian!
translation:
<$emotion(1,27)>Uau...
-<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)> Yi-yip!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Não posso rugir tão elegantemente quanto você,<$cdef(27)> Persa!

source: <$lookat(2,1,1)><waitactor(2)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>What’s this? A little copycat? How darling!
translation: <$lookat(2,1,1)><waitactor(2)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>O que é isso? Um pequeno imitador?

source:
<$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Well, yeah... Your fur’s all glossy and beautiful and...
I wanna be like you...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>I’m trying to copy what you do, but it’s so hard!
I just wanna become a lovely Pokémon already...
translation:
<$lookat(1,1,2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Bem, sim... sua pele é toda brilhante e bonita e... eu
quero ser como você...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>Estou tentando copiar o que você faz, mas é tão difícil
! Eu só quero me tornar um Pokémon adorável já...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, I see. But there’s no need to rush that, little one.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>From what I can tell, you already possess the makings <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>of
a lovely, refined adult.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Ah, entendo. Mas não precisa ter tanta pressa, meu bem.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Pelo que vejo, você já tem tudo para se tornar <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>um
adulto encantador e elegante.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Your constant desire to improve yourself, <$cdef(27)>Vulpix. Never
forget the determination I see burning within you.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Seu desejo constante de melhorar a si mesmo, <$cdef(27)>Vulpix, nunca se
esqueça da determinação que vejo queimando dentro de você.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Yeah!
<$voicel(1,5)>I’m gonna keep trying hard to be <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>a lovely Pokémon just
like you, <$cdef(27)>Persian!
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Sim!
<$voicel(1,5)>Vou continuar me esforçando para <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>ser um Pokémon adorável
como você<$cdef(27)>, Persa!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Why, if it isn’t <$cdef(27)>Flygon</color>. How nice to see you.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Se não é <$cdef(27)>Flygon</color>, que bom te ver.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>I must say, the sound your wings make when they flap is
quite lovely. Like listening to a beautiful serenade.
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>Though it can be a bit noisy...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Devo dizer que o som que suas asas fazem quando batem
é adorável, como ouvir uma bela serenata, embora
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>possa ser um pouco barulhento.

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,1)>Why, thank you. How very kind.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Those tails of yours are quite marvelous as well. They have
a sort of elegant mystique that’s utterly captivating.
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)>Despite looking unwieldy and uncomfortable.
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,1)>Obrigado, muito gentil.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Aquelas suas caudas também são maravilhosas. Eles têm uma
espécie de mística elegante que é totalmente cativante.
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)>Apesar de parecer difícil e desconfortável.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)>Thank you—it takes a great deal of effort to maintain their
beauty. I find that daily grooming is an absolute must.
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>How nice it must be to exist without regard for one’s
appearance, especially covered in desert sand.
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)>Obrigado, é preciso muito esforço para manter a beleza deles
, acho que a higiene diária é uma obrigação absoluta.
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$cdef(9)>Como deve ser bom existir sem levar em conta a aparência
, especialmente coberta de areia do deserto.

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>That must be quite burdensome. Despite how they look,
my wings are sturdy <$motionoff(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>and allow me to fly about freely.
<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)>Which I doubt would be possible if I had to drag a bulky,
hairy tail around...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Apesar da aparência, minhas asas são
robustas e me <$motionoff(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>permitem voar livremente.
O<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(9)> que eu duvido que seria possível se eu tivesse que arrastar uma cauda
volumosa e peluda ao redor...

source: <$comcan(2)>...<wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>You know, I feel like we have a lot in common. ♪
translation: <$comcan(2)>Eu<wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)> sinto que temos muito em comum.

source:
...<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>I think you may be right. This feels like the start of
a wonderful friendship! ♪
translation:
Eu <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>acho que você pode estar certo, isso parece o começo
de uma amizade maravilhosa!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Gosh, your legs are awesome, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag! You can use them
to walk on land, right?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Puxa, suas pernas são incríveis, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag, você pode usá-las
para andar em terra, certo?

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Well...yeah! <$voicel(1,6)>I can only walk real slowly, though.
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Bem... sim,<$voicel(1,6)> eu só posso andar bem devagar.

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Ugh... Even that makes me super jealous...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>I wanna have legs too! I wanna try WALKING!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>Até isso me deixa super ciumento.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)>Eu quero ter pernas também!

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oooh, OK. I understand.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Me, I’m jealous of those things called hands! I bet carrying
berries and stuff is a lot easier with those things!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oooh, ok, eu entendo.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Eu, eu estou com ciúmes dessas coisas chamadas mãos, eu aposto que
carregar frutas e coisas assim é muito mais fácil com essas coisas!

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,27)>Yeah, for sure!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Like, <$cdef(27)> has hands and uses them
to
make
all
SORTS
of stuff!
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,27)>Sim, com certeza!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>Tipo, <$cdef(27)>tem mãos e as usa
para
fazer

todas as
coisas!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Yeah! They also mess around with those human tools, too.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I wish I could do that...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eles também brincam com essas ferramentas humanas, eu
gostaria<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)> de poder fazer isso...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>I wonder if I’ll ever grow hands ’n’ feet... <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>And it’d be sooo
cool if YOU grew hands right along with me, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag!
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Eu me pergunto se eu crescerei as mãos e <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>os pés... e seria
legal se você crescesse as mãos comigo, <$cdef(27)>Poliwag!

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>No kidding. I hope that happens some day...

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Oh cool, you ARE awake!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>You always look like you’re asleep, so I’ve never been sure
if I could talk to you or not...
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Oh legal, você está acordado!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Você sempre parece que está dormindo, então nunca tive certeza
se poderia falar com você ou não...

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Oh, you can talk to me anytime...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,50)>By the way, your tummy makes this cool-looking
swirly pattern...
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Pode falar comigo a qualquer hora...
A<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,50)> propósito, sua barriga faz esse padrão
giratório...

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Yeah, pretty neat, isn’t it?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>I really love this swirly pattern I’ve got! It’s all swirly!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Sim, muito legal, não é?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Eu realmente amo esse padrão de redemoinho que eu tenho!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Swirly-whirly... Swirly-whirly... S-swirlyyy...whirlyyyyyy...
<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,16)>Gosh, I’m getting sleepier ’n’ sleepier looking at that...
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Swirly-whirly... Swirly-whirly... S-swirlyyy... whirlyyyyyy.
.<$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,16)>. Deus, estou ficando mais sonolento olhando para isso...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Oh, uh, don’t fall asleep on me! Maybe you shouldn’t look
at my belly...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Oh, ahn, não adormeça em mim, talvez você não deva olhar para a
minha barriga...

source:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, it’s just... Sometimes I glitch out and kinda...lose
control, I guess.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)>I wish I could do something to stop it from happening.
Don’t suppose you have any ideas?

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Why not try bending a spoon with your mind? It requires
you to center your focus and mental energy.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Mastering the art should give you better control of your
mental state, leading to fewer outbursts.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>Huh, interesting idea! But...how do I do that?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Take a look at this spoon, and try to telepathically transmit
your thoughts to it.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,14)>Calm your mind, center your energy, and with enough
focus...<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>the spoon should bend on its own.

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,27)>Got it. All right, I’ll give it a try!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,14)><$motionoff(2,804)>Hmmm... Nggghhh... <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,663)>This is harder than I thought. <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,661)>Could
you give me a quick demonstration?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Sure thing. Look closely at my hand, and... <wait(0.4)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,816)>Hrngh... HAAA!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,14)>Incredible! I can feel your telekinetic power growing much
stronger... It’s practically overflowing!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,827)>Huh?! O-O-Oh no, I fe-fe-feel a gli-gli-glitch coming on...
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)>C-C-Can you c-c-cut it out?

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)>Phew... Anyway, that’s all there is to it. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Whoa! Are you
all right?! <$voicel(1,6)>Looks like you’re having an outburst!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Quick, focus on bending the spoon!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Heh heh. It’s just as I foresaw.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, nothing significant. I was merely reflecting on my
weather prediction—which turned out to be correct.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,666)>That makes ten days in a row.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Estava apenas refletindo sobre minha previsão
do tempo, que acabou sendo correta.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motionoff(1,666)>Isso faz dez dias seguidos.

source: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Ah. Weather forecasting. What method do you use?
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Previsão do tempo, que método você usa?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh heh. Through training my psychic powers, I’ve
gained the ability to foresee things.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>What could be better than being able to see the future
with perfect clarity? Sometimes I amaze even myself.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Através do treinamento de meus poderes psíquicos, eu
ganhei a capacidade de prever as coisas.
O<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)> que poderia ser melhor do que ser capaz
de ver o futuro com perfeita clareza?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,8)>Understood. That is amazing. If it is OK, I can help you.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>I can reference past records. Calculate. Provide more
accurate data. It is easy for me.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,8)>Entendido, isso é incrível, se estiver tudo bem, posso ajudá-lo.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,805)>Posso fazer referência a registros passados, calcular, fornecer
dados mais precisos, é fácil para mim.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Forecasting is simple statistics. I am good at statistics. <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>Shall
I analyze one or two or three hundred days to start.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Previsões são estatísticas simples. Sou bom em estatísticas<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>. Devo
analisar um ou dois ou trezentos dias para começar.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>What?! What tremendous power... Or rather, I mean
to say—
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>Ahem! Not knowing what lies ahead is precisely what
makes the future fascinating! Wouldn’t you be bored by
a future you could easily calculate?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Que poder tremendo... ou melhor, quero
dizer...
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)>Não saber o que está por vir é exatamente o que torna o
futuro fascinante! Você não ficaria entediado com um futuro
que você poderia facilmente calcular?

source: <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)>The things you are saying. They are different from before.
translation: <$voicel(2,2)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)>As coisas que você está dizendo são diferentes de antes.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>Heh...heh heh! It’s our flights of fancy and fickle changes
of mind that make the future so unpredictable.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>And that’s why the future is worth looking forward to!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>São nossos vôos de fantasia e mudanças inconstantes de
mente que tornam o futuro tão imprevisível.
E<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)> é por isso que vale a pena esperar pelo futuro!

source:
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,27)>Goodness! So you’re only making it look as though a wall
is there? <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>What a meow-velous trick.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Aw, thanks! But I dunno if it’s really that amazin’, yo.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>I mean, I heard you can make stuff disappear,
<$cdef(27)>Meowscarada!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,38)>THAT’S pretty cool! Y’know...if the rumors are true,
that is.

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>Why not see for yourself?
<$voicel(2,5)>Take a good look at this flower. <$motion(2,806)>Get ready... Ta-da<$comeff(2,5)>!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,11)><$motionoff(1,804)>YOOO! It’s gone! Where’d it go? How’d you do that?!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)>You’re AMAZING!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)>A berry?! YOOO! Where’d that come from?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>So, like...you can make stuff disappear and appear at will,
or somethin’ like that?

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Whoooaaa. Awesooome. You’re so cool!
<$voicel(1,5)>But I bet you can’t make another completely different
berry appear, <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>can ya?!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Yooo! You did it! You really did it! That’s awesome! Well
hey, now that we both have a berry, let’s eat ’em together!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)>It’s chow time, yo!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,5)>So that’s what you were getting at! Seems I’m not the only
one with tricks up my sleeve. Well, time for a treat! ♪
<$voicel(2,10)><$facial(1,5)>Here’s a little treat for being such a good audience.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,663)>I’m ’bout ready to blast somethin’ to smithereens with a
<$cdef(27)>Hyper Beam...
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,663)>Estou pronto para explodir alguma coisa com um
<$cdef(27)>Hyper Beam...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Come now, <$cdef(27)>Gyarados, surely there’s no need to get so
worked up. <$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>Why not take a few deep breaths, hm?
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>Venha agora, <$cdef(27)>Gyarados, certamente não
há necessidade<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)> de ficar tão agitado.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>Deep breaths, huh? Breathe in, breathe out... Breathe in...
breathe out...
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$textsize(2)>AAAHHH! It’s no use! I’m the angriest
I’ve ever been!!!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)>Respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire, respire,
respire, respire, respire, respire.
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,807)><$textsize(2)>Não adianta, sou a mais irritada
que já fui!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Oh dear, that didn’t work. Well then, how about you tell
me what happened? <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Perhaps talking about it will help.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Bem, que tal você me contar o que
aconteceu? Talvez<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)> falar sobre isso ajude.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Hmph! Ya think so? Then listen here—do ya remember that
real blustery day we just had?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Então escute aqui, você se lembra daquele dia de
bobagem que acabamos de ter?

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Well, y’see, I’d stashed a berry at my home and gone out
for a li’l stroll...
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>But when I came back, the berry was missin’! That was
gonna be my post-walk snack!
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Bem, eu tinha guardado uma fruta em casa e saído
para dar um passeinho...
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>Mas, quando voltei, a fruta tinha sumido! Era para ser
meu lanche depois do passeio!

source:
<$voicel(2,7)>Is that really all that... <$emotion(2,14)>Wait a moment.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Now you mention it, I recall eating a berry that rolled my
way on that windy day. And if I remember correctly...
<$voicel(2,4)>It came from the direction of your home, <$cdef(27)>Gyarados...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)>Isso é realmente tudo isso... <$emotion(2,14)>espere um momento.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Agora você menciona, eu me lembro de comer uma fruta que rolou
meu caminho naquele dia ventoso e se eu me lembro
<$voicel(2,4)>corretamente... veio da direção de sua casa, <$cdef(27)>Gyarados...

source:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>Why, I oughta... I oughta...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Aw, shucks! I can’t stay mad at cute li’l you! I’ll let ya off
the hook this time—but ONLY this time, y’hear?!
translation:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>Por que, eu deveria... eu deveria...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Não posso ficar brava com você, vou deixá-lo fora
dessa vez, mas só desta vez, você ouviu?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Mmm. Those berries were mighty juicy. Ab-so-lute-ly
deeeee-licious, I tell ya what!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>And now I’m all full ’n’ happy!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Aquelas frutas eram muito
suculentas.
E<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)> agora estou cheio e feliz!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Whoa, seriously? That’s all it takes to fill ya up? Thought
you’d be a bigger eater!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>I’m smaller than you, but I ate way more!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>Isso é tudo que é preciso para te encher, pensei que você
seria um comedor maior.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Sou menor que você, mas comi muito mais!

source:

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Com certeza não estava contando, mas ainda estou apostando
que comi mais de você!

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(2,6)>Hey! <$cdef(27)>! Who do you think ate
the
most berries?

que<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(2,6)> você... Ei, <$cdef(27)>, quem você acha que
comeu
mais frutas?

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)>Gwahaha! Well, o’ course! <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$cdef(27)>
wasn’t
sittin’
there
watchin’
us eat!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)>There’s no way they’d know which of us ate more’n

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$cdef(27)> não estava sentado

lá nos

comer!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)>De jeito nenhum saberiam qual de nós comeu mais

Didn’t
mean
to
get
ya
caught
up
in
our
argument, bud!<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)>

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>Desculpe, <$cdef(27)>, não queria que

fosse

pego

em nossa


discussão
, amigo!<$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)>
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Então não há como saber com certeza, acho que teremos

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>We sure will! And don’tcha worry—<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)>I’ll surely be countin’
how many berries I eat from now on!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>E não se preocupe, eu certamente<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,38)> vou contar quantas
frutas eu como a partir de agora!

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Angular? I do not understand. Other Pokémon are not?

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Many spirit shapes exist. But so many angles. It is strange.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,38)>I have not before seen so many angles.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hm. I do not know why. I am strange?

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,661)>I do not think you are strange. I feel a warmth. Like a
human spirit. It is nice. <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,5)>You should treat it nicely.

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Pori-piii. ♪ Understood. I will treat it nicely.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I will upload the data to my home for safekeeping. Then—
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>No. Wait. That treatment is maybe too nice.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>You know, I’ve always been taken by your grace and charm.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)>Th-thank you... You look graceful and cool yourself! <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,6)>Plus
you always smell really nice...

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Why, thank you. I imagine that scent comes from all the
sunbathing I do.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>There’s a field of fragrant wildflowers nearby that I love to
use as a sunbathing spot.

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>What I find lovely is how the light reflects off your body.
What do you do to maintain that glossy sheen?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>You’re too kind... I guess it’s because I swim a lot.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>The sky looks so magical from below a lake’s surface that
I always end up staying underwater for a while.

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>I quite enjoy a dip, but I’ve never swum anywhere so deep.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,6)>What a beautiful sight that must be.
<$voicel(2,5)>How curious that we look so similar, <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>yet we spend our time
in such different places!
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite</color>. You must battle me now. With honor.
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite</color>, você deve lutar comigo agora, com honra.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Huhhh? What’s up with yooouuu all of a sudden?
translation: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>O que há com yoouuu de repente?

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Ha. Ha. You cannot bluff me. You are always calm with a
stare that is blank. But I know. <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>You are actually very strong.
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Você não pode me blefar, você está sempre calmo com
um olhar vazio, mas eu sei, <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>você é realmente muito forte.

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>I dunnooo about that... Anyway, I just don’t wanna
baaattle anyone right now.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Eu não sei sobre isso... de qualquer forma, eu só não
quero baaattle ninguém agora.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Becaaauuuse...I always end up blowing away a
mooouuuntain or a whole forest when I battle...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I don’t wanna mess up this area... That wouldn’t be nice
when <$cdef(27)>’s working so hard to
make
things
so preeetty...
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Becaaauuse... eu sempre acabo explodindo um
mooouuuntain ou uma floresta inteira quando eu luto...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Não quero estragar essa área... não seria bom quando está
trabalhando<$cdef(27)> tão duro para tornar
as
coisas tão
preeminentes...

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>Y-yes. Certainly. Definitely. Doing that would be bad.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>You have convinced me. Peace is the way. We do not need
to battle. It is true.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)>Sim, com certeza, fazer isso seria ruim.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Você me convenceu, a paz é o caminho, não precisamos
lutar, é verdade.

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Yeahhh... I like that. Let’s just have a niiice, friendly time.
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Sim, eu gosto disso, vamos ter um momento divertido e amigável.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Once. Upon a time. There was a Pokémon. The Pokémon
loved berries. One time, while searching for delicious
berries, the <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Pokémon found themselves in a dark cave.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Era uma vez, havia um Pokémon, os Pokémon adoravam
frutas, uma vez, enquanto procuravam por frutas deliciosas
, os Pokémon<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,806)> se encontravam em uma caverna escura.

source: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Whoa, my heart’s pounding! Scary stories rule!
translation: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Uau, meu coração está disparado! Histórias de terror são demais!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)>At last. The Pokémon found a berry. It was deep in the
cave. But then, the Pokémon realized. <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>The Pokémon did
not know the way out.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)>Finalmente. O Pokémon encontrou uma fruta. Estava no
fundo da caverna. Mas então, o Pokémon <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,666)>percebeu. O Pokémon
não sabia a saída.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Lost. Confused. The Pokémon felt behind them a chill.
The Pokémon turned around. And there was...
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Perdidos, confusos, os Pokémon sentiram um arrepio por
trás deles, os Pokémon viraram-se, e havia...

source: <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,3)>A voice only. It said, “You have taken my berry.”<$motion(2,807)><wait(0.6)>
translation: <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,3)>Apenas uma voz que dizia: "Você pegou minha fruta."<$motion(2,807)><wait(0.6)>

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,46)>Phew, that surprised me. <$facial(1,1)>So? Then what happened?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,803)>Hm. Your surprise has made me forget the rest.
translation: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,803)>Sua surpresa me fez esquecer o resto.

source:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$pkcry;1(1,2)>!
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,9)>Ugh, what’s up with me lately? I can’t make any flames.

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>You havin’ some trouble, pal? I wouldn’t know what
that’s like—I’m always in rare form!
<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,9)>Check this out: BAM! FLAMES! Anytime, anywhere, I can
just BWOOSH! You see that? <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,8)>BWOOOSH!

<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hmph... It’s not THAT impressive...<$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)> CYNDAAA!!!
<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>It’s no use. I’m never gonna make fire on my own... *sniffle*

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe you’re just tryin’ too hard, y’know? Here, take a
deep breath and try lettin’ go of that frustration. Relaaax.
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>OK, now try again.
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, that’s the stuff! Now try to do one big BWOOOSH!<wait(0.4)><$motion(1,850)><wait(1.2)>
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>It worked! IT WORKED! Wow, thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>Quilava</color>!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! Don’t mention it.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,5)>Your flames still look pretty puny, though. Better keep
practicin’ if you wanna spit fire like me!

<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRR! Just you wait—soon I’m gonna make WAY bigger
flames than you ever could!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>...But then this HUGE tree came crashing down! I was
stuck, so I decided to use a move that—
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? *sniff sniff*

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I just caught a whiff of a real good smell. Is someone
bakin’ bread nearby?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Bread? I don’t smell anything like that...

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>No, I’m definitely picking up on a bready smell!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s gettin’ stronger! *sniff sniff* Wait, it’s coming from...

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Is it? Oh, silly me! I should have realized.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, I’m glad we sorted that out. Please continue your
story... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Quilava?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’know, ya look a lot like bread, too, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun... And
maybe you’d taste like bread if I took a bite outta ya...

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Quilava, you must be hungry. Why don’t I go and find
a nice berry for you, hm?

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Has my little flower caught your eye? Well, this little one
is quite shy. <$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Stare at it too long and...see?
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh dear. I told you it was shy. Seems it hid itself away!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Me? Why, I didn’t do a thing.

<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah right! There’s gotta be some kinda trick to it. You got
psychic powers? Maybe ya teleported it or somethin’?

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Perhaps...but then again, perhaps not. Who can say? Good
luck trying to figure it out. <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>Hee hee... ♪
<$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, c’mon! This is gonna drive me CRAZY!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I wish I could fly way, WAY higher than I can right now...
But how can I do that?
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, that’s an EASY fix! Just leave it to me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Really?! But uh... What are you gonna do?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Hehe, aaall will become clear! Just hold on a second!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>HYUP! <$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>HRAH! HYAAAA!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, WOW! You’re REALLY strong! But why are you doing
that all of a sudden?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>This is my tried-and-true warm-up for just about anything!
I gotta get all PUMPED UP if I’m gonna send you FLYIN’!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Er, you don’t mean you’re gonna... I mean... With that
hammer...?
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Yup! I’m gonna launch ya WAAAY up into the sky!

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Uhhhhhh, you know what, I, um—I’m suddenly feeling
scared of heights! Really, REALLY scared!
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>So sorry, but maybe next time!

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,7)>Awww... For real?! Well, OK, but you know who to call if
you ever change your mind!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Espeon, whenever I see your tail...my whole body gets all
itchy and twitchy!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Espeon, sempre que vejo sua cauda... meu corpo todo fica com
comichão e espasmos!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,58)>Um, I’m sorry! I just can’t help it! Your tail <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>makes me
wanna grab it SO BAD...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr-rowrrr!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh dear, you almost had it that time!
translation: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh, meu Deus, você quase teve esse tempo!

source: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Awww... You knew JUST where I was gonna pounce!
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Você sabia exatamente onde eu ia atacar!

source:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>The full moon the other night was truly stunning to behold.
It reminded me of the jewel on your forehead.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Is that so? How lovely... I would have liked to see it myself.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>The night breeze is cool and comforting. Would you like to
stay up late with me tonight to feel it?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes, that could be nice every once in a while.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>While we’re on the subject, why don’t you try waking up
early? I have so much I’d like to show you, too.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Like how the flowers glisten as the sun begins to rise...
The way the light bounces off their petals is a thing of
exquisite splendor.

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah yes, I would imagine their beauty is quite unlike that of
the swaying flowers beneath the moon’s light.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Why hello, <$cdef(27)>. The two of us were
just
discussing
some
beautiful
scenery
we’ve seen.
<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,5)>Have you spotted any spectacular sights recently?

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>A sea of sparkling stars... How splendid! That sounds like
an ideal setting for an all-night soiree.

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>The night has many wondrous offerings.
<$cdef(27)><$cdef(27)>
and
I
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>would be
happy to
guide
you
through
the
nocturnal world.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>A blue sky... Why does that make me feel nostalgic?
Still, an adventure under the sun doesn’t sound half bad.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope you’re excited. There are so many wonderful things
in this bright and beautiful world for me to show you!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>And after that, I found the most fascinating object while
I was out for a stroll—

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Umbreon. You speak to me so normally. Why do you do it?
<$emotion(2,64)><$voicel(2,4)>I do not scare you?

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>I am often told so—that I am scary.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I scare me too. In a recent time, I saw a bright red light on
the water at night. It scared me. But then I noticed...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>It was my eye reflection!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>You were frightened by your own reflection? Heh heh!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You always tell the most amusing stories, <$cdef(27)>Dusclops!

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh heh. Now then, shall I continue my story? Or if you
prefer, we could go for a stroll together.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Any activity is enjoyable when I’m with you, <$cdef(27)>Dusclops.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Thank...you. Heh. Heh. We are friends. It is happiness!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Well, I love giving folks a good scare.
<$emotion(1,49)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m kind of an expert at sneaking up on folks without
being noticed.
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Bem, eu amo dar às pessoas um bom susto.
<$emotion(1,49)><$voicel(1,7)>Sou uma espécie de especialista em esgueirar as pessoas
sem ser notado.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Bem, eu acho que isso é bastante impressionante!

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>But YOU always catch on before I can get close...
How come?
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Mas você sempre pega antes que eu possa chegar
perto.

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Dear me, why could that be? Maybe I just have a sense for
these things.
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Querida, por que isso poderia ser? Talvez eu só tenha um senso
para essas coisas.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Even when I’m super stealthy and approach from behind,
you always notice... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)>It’s like you’ve got eyes on your tail.

source:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s all that shouting about? Did you need me for
something?

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>No, not you! I’m trying to talk to <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>that li’l round Pokémon
behind you.

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>The little round Pokémon behind... Oh! You mean...?
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,7)>Right, yes—I’ll call them for you! HEEEY!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Nice! I didn’t think you heard me.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Anyway, let’s go play!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>“Oh, yes, let’s! What would you like to do, dear?”

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Um... Uhhh... I didn’t think this far ahead! Hmmm...
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, I got it! Let’s have a contest to see who has the more
jaw-some jaw! I found some nice-looking boulders earlier.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoever can crunch ’em up fastest wins!

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>What? A boulder?! Err, I mean...<$comeff(2,6)>
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,1)>“Umm, you see... Actually...I bit into a really hard berry
earlier <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,1)>and hurt my mouth.
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,2)>“So maybe we should do that another time...”
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, OK! We can save that for next time!

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Phew... <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>That was a narrow escape, but all’s well that
ends well!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>You know many things. How did you become <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>knowing of
so many things?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I’m not really sure. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Maybe it’s because I got
an update?

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Uhhh, to put it simply—it makes your brain work better!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>If you got one, you’d be able to remember all SORTS
of stuff!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Amazement! I want to do it! I want an up-date... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>But I do
not know how it is done.

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh yeah—I would always just ask the humans for ’em.
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>I’m actually not sure how it all works... Sorry!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh. Sadness. I wanted to become knowing of many things
like you.

<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>OH! I’ve got it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>When the humans get back, we’ll just ask THEM to update
you! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Easy-peasy!
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh! That is an idea that is very smart!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder... If I got ANOTHER update, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>do y’think I’d get
EVEN SMARTER?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Yes. I think you would become knowing of many
more things!
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh. I am filled with excitement of a sudden nature!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Let us hope, <$cdef(27)>Porygon2! We must hope that the humans will
return in a small amount of time!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>La di da di da... ♪ I’m on top of the world! ♪
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>La di da di da... ♪ I’m on top of the world! ♪
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Uh, hey, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>... Do you like to dance too?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Uh, hey, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>... Do you like to dance too?

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>...Ohhh, I see—you’re playing Copycat! In that case, how
about this?
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Twirl twiiirrrlll!

<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,5)>...Ohhh, I see—you’re playing Copycat! In that case, how
about this?
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>Twirl twiiirrrlll... Oops!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>Let’s not slow down now... How about this? <wait(0.6)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>And this?
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,9)>Let’s not slow down now... How about this? <wait(0.2)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Uagh!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>Next, let’s do some spinning! Spin and <wait(0.5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,8)>spin and <wait(0.6)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,8)>spin!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,4)>Next, let’s do some—gwah!
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,2)>Ugh, I can’t keep up!
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Maybe I don’t need to try to copy you, <$cdef(27)>Kirlia...
