source:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m in a bit of a funk... I need to get better at copying
other Pokémon...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Don’t give up! I’ll cheer you on!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>OK, I can do this... Don’t give up! I’ll cheer you on!
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>Whoa! Now I’M feelin’ energized for some reason!
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa! Now I’M feelin’ energized for some reason!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, here it comes. <wait(0.8)>Let’s go, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>, let’s go! Woo-hoo!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>OK, here it comes. Let’s go, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr....
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,4)>Wait, no! I did it wrong! <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Let’s go, <$cdef(27)>Plusle, let’s go! Woo-hoo!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>YEAH! Cheering is AWESOME! Get ready for another!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Mime Jr. is the best! They’re way better than the rest!
Gooo, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>YEAH! Cheering is AWESOME! Get...ready...for another...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Plusle... *pant* is the best... They’re...way better... <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,4)>*gasp*

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Why do ya look so tired? Need me to cheer you on
even harder? No problem—I gotcha, pal!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Mime Jr. can’t be beat! Everybody thinks they’re neat!
’Cause they always bring the heat! Gooo, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.!

<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Whew... How’d...how’d you end up getting more energized
than me, <$cdef(27)>Plusle?

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)>Ngh!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>I...really don’t wish to complain, but the sound of your
wings <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>is causing my head to throb a bit.
<$comeff(1,11)><$voicel(1,3)>Oh. Is that truth? <$motion(1,759)>I am sorry. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Has it become better now?
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah, thank you. The pain has subsided.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,1)>I must say an honest thing. My head also hurts a small
amount when it hears your loud words.

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>Is that so? I’m terribly sorry.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicev(2,6,40)><$textsize(0)>Does it help if I speak like this?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Your words when quiet do not seem to hurt my head.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$voicev(2,5,40)><$textsize(0)>Indeed? I’m relieved to hear it. But I wonder what caused the issue.</textsize>

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>It is possible that the sound of my wings and the sound of
your words are the same. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>They hurt the head when heard.

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicev(2,7,40)><$textsize(0)>Fascinating... In that case, I’ll take care to speak quietly when conversing
with you in the future.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,810)><$voicel(1,10)>It is good! We have solved the problem!
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,759)><$voicel(1,4)>Oh no! My head! It is also hurting!
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>I do not believe it. OK! You try, then!
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,3)>Huh?! No way... I’m not scary either?

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>We are not scary. Why? Maybe...we are just not scared of
each other?

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Yeah, maybe...<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh! <$cdef(27)>’s here!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Duskull, let’s try to scare ’em together! Ready? ...<$voicel(2,8)>GO!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>We did it! We couldn’t do it alone, but together, <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>we’re
totally unstoppable!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes! It is a truth! We must combine our power! We will
scare everyone!

<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,3)>No way! Guess we’ve got a long way to go before we’re
super scary.

<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Yes. It is a possibility. We must grow bigger and scarier.
Then...we will scare <$cdef(27)>!

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Metang! What kindsa foods do you like? I like, um,
really sweet berries!

<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,4)>Thinking... <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>I love very hard foods very much. The crunch.
The clang. It is a delight.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Um. Thinking again... For example... Rocks. Hard rocks.
And big rocks. And the things like that...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,9)>Ummm, <$cdef(27)>Metang... Were you looking at my HAMMER when
you said that?!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>I am not looking. Not looking...<wait(0.8)>at all... <wait(0.8)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>Or only a little bit...

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You may not worry—it is fine. By the way...magnetic things
are very tasty. I like them.
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>The hammer—it is magnetic?

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Mag...net-ic? Um, I dunno what that is, but I’m pretty sure
my hammer isn’t that!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>You are certain? You do not sound certain. I can verify.
Just one bite...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I wish I knew how to use my vines better...

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>First, you give it a ZA-WOOSH! Then you gotta hit ’em
with, like, a ZA-ZHWOOP!

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Pfft, explaining is for nerds. MUCH better if I just show
you. <$comcan(2)><$comcan(1)><$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>See?!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, WOWWW! You really did go like “zhwoop!”

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,816)><$voicel(2,8)>Hehehe... Moves like these are easy-peasy once you
know the trick to ’em!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Eee, that’s so, SO cool! I’m gonna try an’ do it just like
you, <$cdef(27)>Floragato...
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>YAHHH!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Wha—?! Look at those MOVES! And to think I, like, BARELY
taught you! You’re a genius! A master! A MONSTER of
talent! <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Looks like you had nothin’ to worry about after all!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee! Hee hee hee... That’s ’cause you taught me so
well, <$cdef(27)>Floragato!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Hehe, well, the master can’t just sit back and get shown up
by their pupil, right? <$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,10)>Check out my NEWEST MOVE!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! ♪ Thanks a bunch! Let’s keep workin’
hard
from
here
on
out
too, yeah?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>Serperior</color>! How’d you get so BIG?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Well now, let me think... Perhaps it’s because I make sure
to eat a variety of different foods.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Ohhh, OK! Then I’m gonna eat lotsa different foods, too!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>You know, if you really want to grow big, exercise and rest
are important as well.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Um, OK, so, um... I gotta eat healthy food and do regular
exercise <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>and...and sleep a whole lot...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>It’s not just about sleeping a lot—it helps to go to sleep
and wake up early. As for exercise, I stretch before I
work out my vines and—

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Whoa! Ahhhhhh... That’s so much stuff. Where do I
even START?!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh dear, was that too complicated? Forgive me, little one.
Let’s see... <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)>How about regularly basking in the sun?

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,6)>In other words, relaxing in the sunlight. It’s needed for
photosynthesis, after all.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>Ohhh! I get it! Yeah, that’s definitely something
I can do! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Thanks so much, <$cdef(27)>Serperior!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr! You’re always carryin’ around that
concrete, right? <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Doesn’t it get heavy?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Nawww. Ya jus’ gotta train fer it! Become one with the
concrete ’n’ use it to get stronger!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)>Every mornin’, I wake up ’n’ do about 500 or so concrete
swings, and every night before I hit the hay, I do about
1,000 concrete lifts!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>And when I’m sleepin’, I’m dreamin’ of concrete! At this
point, it’s basically an extension of these ol’ arms of mine!

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Uh... Wow. That’s pretty cool, but, uh...I dunno if it’s
somethin’ I’m interested in doing myself!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Them muscles o’ yers are kinda puny-lookin’, <$cdef(27)>Frogadier!
Do they give ya the power ya need in a battle?

<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,827)><$comeff(2,14)>It’s true that my muscles aren’t super strong like yours...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,5)>But that’s OK ’cause I’m super fast!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,20)>Aha! So what you’re sayin’ is, you’ve still got room to get
super strong ’n’ become a double threat!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>I, uh...huh? I dunno if I like where this is goin’, yo...

<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Yes indeed! I do believe it is time fer a li’l trainin’!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Here, I’ll lend ya my concrete! Doin’ a hundred swings or
so oughta start ya off right, I reckon!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Froakie! I heard you played with my <$cdef(27)>Dreepy today!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Thanks for that, yo!
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>No biggie! I had tons of fun chasing <$cdef(27)>Dreepy</color> around!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Yo, I was super surprised to hear <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>that you caught <$cdef(27)>Dreepy</color>!
I thought <$cdef(27)>Froakie</color> was spacing out, so I dropped my guard!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Shucks, I just got lucky! <$cdef(27)>Dreepy was zipping around so fast
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>I couldn’t keep up with them at all!

<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Awww snap. I bet you’re just pretendin’ to be humble right
now <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>to get us to let our guards down for next time!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Ohhhh, you’re a tricky one for sure, yo!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ve been meaning to ask for a while now, dear, but that
long thing you’ve got there... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Is that your tongue?

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>So, you’ve got your tongue wrapped around your neck?
Why would you do that?

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>My tongue is extremely sensitive. With it, I can sense any
presence in my vicinity.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>For example, I can tell whether someone is hiding behind
a wall.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, my! How very useful! I think I’ll give it a whirl myself.
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh? Do you have abilities similar to mine?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>I couldn’t tell you, but who knows—maybe I’ll sense
something!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>All right, here I go!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,7)>*bleeeh*
...Hmm... I’ll give it another go.
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,6)>*bleeeh*
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Well? Do you sense an unseen presence?
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Your sensation of thirst is not an unseen presence...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Corvisquire! Your timing is TOTALLY perfect!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>The back of my neck is itching like crazy, and there’s not
a thing I can do about it on my own!
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>You want me to scratch it, yeah? Fine, I guess... <wait(0.5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hup!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Ack, no, not there! You gotta scratch a little more to the
right! TO THE RIGHT!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>You’re SO close! Just a little more to the left!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeah, that’s the spot! Just give it a big ol’ scratch!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,6)>What’ve I gotten myself into?
<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,4)>Hm, maybe if I crank up the speed... <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,6)>Hyah! <$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hyah! <$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>HYAH!
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>*pant* *wheeze*

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>PHEEEW! What a RELIEF! You are a total lifesaver! Here!
Take this for your trouble!
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>A single berry? After all that scratching?
<$comcan(2)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(2,0,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Oh hello, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink</color>. Are you searching for something?

<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>I’m looking for stuff to make my hammer with...
... ... ...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,40)>Oh!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,38)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Corviknight, didja know you are SO COOL-looking?!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Hm? Oh, err, yes. I see you have an eye for quality,
<$cdef(27)>Tinkatink.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>With that really neat color and hard body... SUPER cool!

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Heh heh. Why yes, I do have a rather beautiful glossy
finish, and these feathers are quite sturdy indeed.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>They provide excellent protection.

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeah, exactly! Super sturdy and perfect for smashing
stuff with!

<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Indeed, even if I were to be smashed by— <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)>Wait, did you
say perfect FOR smashing?

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Yayyy, I’m so glad I finally found what I was looking for!
I’m gonna make the coolest, bestest hammer!
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Now how many feathers should I take? Hmm...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Errr... You know, I just remembered an urgent matter that
requires my attention, so...I’ll be going now.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hiya! Didja fire any of your head missiles today?
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Você disparou algum de seus mísseis hoje?

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Naw. It’s jus’ so peaceful round these parts, y’know?
Not much reason to fire off these young’uns.
translation: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Não. Por aqui é tão tranquilo, sabe? Nem há motivo para soltar esses ataques.

source: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>Awww... Then it’s NEVER gonna be my turn...
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>You wanna get launched that badly, huh?
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Você quer ser lançado assim tão mal, hein?

source: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Yeah! I wanna shoot through the air and go WHEEE!
translation: <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Eu quero atirar pelo ar e ir UHUUU!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Ya never know whatcha might find when ya touch down,
though. Could be a battle with a dangerous opponent!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Você nunca sabe o que você pode encontrar
quando você tocar para baixo, no entanto.

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>But if I don’t get into those fights, how am I ever gonna
get as strong as you?
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Mas se eu não entrar nessas brigas, como vou ficar tão
forte quanto você?

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Hmmm. Yep, that’s a good point there.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>I always figured lastin’ peace was a good thing...
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>But now I reckon that might rob us of opportunities to
get stronger!
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Sim, esse é um bom ponto.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Sempre achei que a paz era uma coisa boa...
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Mas agora acho que isso pode nos roubar oportunidades de ficarmos
mais fortes!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,1)><$motion(2,803)>Hi there, <$cdef(27)>Drakloak! You look like you’re working hard
like always!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Hey! You’re a pretty hard worker yourself, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink! It’s
super cool to see from someone who’s <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>still so little!
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)>Kinda jealous to be honest, yo. My li’l one doesn’t do
much of anything!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Aw, thanks! But I’ve only just begun to learn and ma-chure!

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,7)><$textsize(2)>That’s...so...CUTE!!!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)>Yooo, you’re makin’ me feel parenty feelings, and I’m not
even your parent?! Wanna join the fam? It’ll be great! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>I bet
my li’l one would love it too!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,5)>No way, I wanna be an independent grown-up real soon!
But thanks for asking!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Wooow. You really are a mature li’l Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>I just can’t help but worry about ya goin’ through life all
alone, though! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Maybe if you had a teacher or somethin’?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Don’t worry! I’ll be OK ’cause I’ve got this hammer!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)>Graaahhh!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>WHOA! That’s a pretty cool hammer! It’s kinda little but
seems to be really well-made!
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>Hee hee! I made it all by myself!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Seriously?! Yooo! You can make stuff, and you’re strong
and... Huh... You might be more of a grown-up than me!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Guess I don’t need to worry about you after all! I’m sure
you’ll grow and mature just fine, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeah! And good luck with your li’l guy, too, <$cdef(27)>Drakloak</color>!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>Your fur looks so fluffy, <$cdef(27)>Sprigatito</color>! Mind if I touch it?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Yeah, that’s fine. Just don’t make it tickle, OK?

<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>OK, got it! I won’t make it ticklish.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Hah!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)>Wooow... It’s so curly and fluffy...and so super SOFT! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>It’s
amazing!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh, come on! If you’re gonna do that, then I guess I’ll
just... <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Yah!

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)>...Huh?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>You’re kinda moist and smooth...and doughy and soft...
So nice to the touch!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>Hehehe... Your paws are so squishy too, Sprigatito...
It’s neat how we’ve got all these different textures! ♪

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Yeah... There’s so many kinds, and I wanna feel them all!
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hi, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Since we’re already on a roll, let’s see what textures
<$cdef(27)>’s
got
going on!
<$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)>Hah!<$comeff(0,5)><$facial(0,13)><$motion(0,182)>

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! ♪ Fluffy, curly, soft, and squishy... ♪
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,8)>We got to experience so many different textures today!
How wonderful!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>*flop flop flop flop flop* Phew! Guess that’s enough
exercise for today!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,3)>What? That’s not even close to your highest potential.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? I dunno what you think you know about me, but this
is definitely all I got, yo.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>I bet you can flop much, MUCH higher than that.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>No wayyy! It’d be dangerous for me to flop up too high!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Come on, just think about all the grueling battles you’ve
endured up until now.

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>OK, forget that. The point is you’re the type of <$cdef(27)>Magikarp
who could always be striving for greater heights.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>You really think so? Well, I guess I can try to flop just a li’l
bit higher... <$motion(1,814)>*flop FLOP*
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,11)>Ow! Yooo...I think my abs are crampin’... <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)>Maybe changin’
things up isn’t really a good idea after all!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,859)><$facial(2,4)>Don’t worry. After a little Thunder Shock therapy, your
muscles will feel—

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>No, no, no! Nope! I’m totally fine! Everything’s gonna be
just fine! I think I’m already fine, actually!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>You’re so warm, <$cdef(27)>Torchic! I feel all toasty just hanging out
with you!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Você está tão quente, <$cdef(27)>Torchic, eu me sinto todo tostado só de sair
com você!

source:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,60)>I know, right?!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>A lotta the time in the winter, when I wake up in the
morning, tons of Pokémon are all around me!
translation:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,60)>Eu sei, certo?
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Muitas vezes no inverno, quando acordo de manhã,
toneladas de Pokémon estão ao meu redor!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Wow, other Pokémon must love you! I wish I was that
popular...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>If only I could become a warm Pokémon like you, <$cdef(27)>Torchic.
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Uau, outros Pokémon devem te amar! Eu gostaria de ser tão
popular...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Se eu pudesse me tornar um Pokémon quente como você, <$cdef(27)>Torchic.

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,817)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,2)>Oh, but in the summer, nobody wants to be close to me at
all. It’s super lonely!
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,817)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,2)>Mas no verão, ninguém quer estar
perto de mim.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, really? Then I guess I wanna be <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>a Pokémon who’s
warm in the winter but cool in the summer!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,33)>...But how do I do that?
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Então eu acho que quero ser<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)> um Pokémon
que está quente no inverno,
mas<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,33)> legal no verão!

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,13)>Umm... I dunno.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>But I think it’d probably be more awesome if you just
picked something and stuck with it!
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,13)>Eu não sei.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Mas acho que seria mais incrível se você
escolhesse algo e ficasse com ele!

source: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,5)>You think?! Oh, man—picking one thing is so hard...
translation: <$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,5)>Oh, cara, escolher uma coisa é tão difícil...

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Y’know, I’ve been thinking a lot these days... It’d be so
nice if I could stay like this forever!
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Becoming a grown-up seems kinda scary...

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Whatever do you mean? Aren’t you excited to see how
you’ll grow and change?

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$comeff(1,4)>B-but what if I’m having the most fun I’ll ever have right
now? I dunno what’s gonna happen in the future...

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,3)>Shall I let you in on a little secret?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>There was once a time when I dreamt of looking ”cooler.“
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>I wanted sharp, spiky fur, or a coat as black as night.
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Really? You mean you don’t like how you are now?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Oh, I don’t mean that at all! My feelings simply changed
after spending time with a human I care about deeply.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Now I love my adorable appearance, and I wouldn’t
change a thing about it!

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,7)>That’s good to hear!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I love you just the way you are too, <$cdef(27)>Sylveon!

<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Thank you, little one. ♪
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>As you experience more, I’m sure that you’ll develop a
clearer idea of who you want to be when you grow up.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,8)>Until then, enjoy being your current self to the fullest!

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Yeah... I’ll take your advice, <$cdef(27)>Sylveon. I’m gonna enjoy how
I am now as much as I can!
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, thanks. It’s still not good enough, though.
translation: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh, obrigado, ainda não é bom o suficiente, no entanto.

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Really?! Why not? I like it a lot...

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Other <$cdef(27)>Kricketune make WAY cooler sounds than me.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>But even after all this practice, I’m still not gettin’
any better.
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,827)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Am I missing something?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Os outros <$cdef(27)>Kricketune fazem sons muito mais legais que os meus.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>Mas, mesmo depois de praticar tanto, ainda não
estou melhorando.
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,827)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Será que está faltando alguma coisa?

source:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,13)>Hmmm. Well, music’s not really my forte, but...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>I think things like the sound of the wind and the
murmuring of water are really pretty!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,1)>Why don’tcha try slowing down a bit and listening to
the sounds of nature and stuff?
translation:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,13)>Bem, a música não é meu forte, mas...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Eu acho que coisas como o som do vento e o
murmúrio da água são realmente bonitas!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,1)>Por que você não tenta desacelerar um pouco e ouvir os
sons da natureza e outras coisas?

source:
...<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,40)>That’s a GREAT idea!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>When I focus, I can hear them... The rustling tree leaves...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,805)>The gentle flapping of Pokémon wings...
translation:
É <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,40)>uma ótima ideia!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Quando me concentro, posso ouvi-los... as folhas da árvore enferrujando
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,805)>... o suave bater das asas dos Pokémon...

source:
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,1)><$motionoff(2,804)>All right, here goes!
<$voicel(2,2)><$motionoff(2,817)><$comeff(2,10)>GREEE GIGIGIII GIGIGIGREEE!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,661)>Phew... How was that?

<$motion(2,800)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,20)>Hmmm. Sorry! Guess music really ISN’T my forte...
translation:
<$motion(2,800)>...............
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,20)>Acho que a música realmente não é o meu forte...

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>I sense powerful emotions from those blades of yours,
<$cdef(27)>Ceruledge... <$voicel(1,8)>And you seem quite skilled in their use.
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Sinto emoções poderosas dessas suas lâminas,
<$cdef(27)>Ceruledge... e<$voicel(1,8)> você parece muito hábil em seu uso.

source: <$comcan(1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe I am, maybe I’m not... Do you want to give it a try?
translation: <$comcan(1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Talvez eu seja, talvez eu não seja... você quer tentar?

source: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Give it a try? What do you mean?
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>If you battle me...you’ll see firsthand how skilled I am.
translation: <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Se você lutar comigo... você verá em primeira mão o quão habilidoso eu sou.

source:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>No, thanks. I prefer not to fight without a reason.
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>If it were to protect you or someone dear to me, however,
I’d fight anyone without fear.
translation:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Não, obrigado, prefiro não lutar sem uma razão.
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Se fosse para proteger você ou alguém querido para mim, no entanto, eu
lutaria contra qualquer um sem medo.

source:
<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>Is that so...? That’s noble of you...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, even then, I’d prefer you leave me to fight my own
battles. I could use a good battle or two...
translation:
<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,3)>Isso é...? Isso é nobre da sua parte...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, mesmo assim, eu preferiria que você me
deixasse lutar minhas próprias batalhas.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Starved for battle, are you? Even so, I’d prefer you didn’t
disrupt the peace around here...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>Mesmo assim, prefiro que não interrompa
a paz por aqui...

source:
<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, don’t worry... I know <$cdef(27)> is
working
hard
to
make
sure
things
stay peaceful.
I’m not going to cause any trouble... <$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>I’m just a bit bored,
that’s all...
translation:
<$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Não se preocupe, sei que <$cdef(27)> está trabalhando
duro
para
garantir
que
as

permaneçam pacíficas.
Não vou causar nenhum problema... estou<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)> um pouco entediado
, só isso...

source:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Glad to hear it. If it can be avoided, I’d really rather not
fight you.
translation:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Se puder ser evitado, prefiro não lutar
com você.

source: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Shame... I’d be up for a battle against you any time.
translation: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Vergonha... eu estaria pronto para uma batalha contra você a qualquer momento.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>How good it is to see this area grow more habitable by
the day. <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,10)>Not to mention all the Pokémon returning!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>And it’s all thanks to <$cdef(27)>. I just
hope
they
stick around...

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Are you worried they won’t? I find it hard to imagine that
<$cdef(27)>
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,9)>would
ever
abandon us.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>I’d like to believe that... But what about the humans? One
moment they were here, then suddenly they vanished.
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>And what if there’s an accident? <$cdef(27)>
could
get
hit
by a
boulder,
or
struck
by lightning...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)>That’s a bit dramatic, don’t you think?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,3)>To worry is to prepare oneself. I consider the danger that
may befall <$cdef(27)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>so
I
can
protect
them
from it.

<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,6)>I see. What a good friend you are.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,21)>But they’ll be fine. I’m sure of it. Call it a hunch.

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Good. And in the rare chance that
<$cdef(27)>
is
put
in
harm’s
way,
we’ll
protect
them together.

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>Gardevoir. When we work together, we can
achieve anything!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Your skin is just so lovely. Could you tell me your skincare
routine?
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Sua pele é tão linda, poderia me dizer sua rotina de cuidados
com a pele?

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>It’s all about keeping it moisturized! The humidity
does wonders for my slime and my skin!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>But your skin is beautiful too, dear! Do you do anything
special?
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>A umidade faz maravilhas para o
meu lodo e minha pele!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Mas sua pele também é linda,
querida!

source:
<$voicel(2,6)>Hmmm... <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)>I suppose, if anything, I just keep it cold! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>I always
try to keep my body freezing cold, you know.
translation:
<$voicel(2,6)>Eu acho <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)>que, se alguma coisa, eu só mantenho frio, <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>eu sempre
tento manter meu corpo gelado, você sabe.

source:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I suppose cold days do tend to tighten up the skin.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>If I get closer to you, do you think my skin will get nicely
chilled?
translation:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Acho que os dias frios tendem a apertar a pele.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Se eu me aproximar de você, acha que minha pele ficará bem
gelada?

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Hmmm... I’m really not sure the cold air I give off would
be good for your skin.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Não tenho certeza se o ar frio que emiti seria
bom para sua pele.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>We’ll never know if we don’t give it a try!
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,11)><$textsize(2)>That’s freezing!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,10)>Was that cold air really from you?! I almost got frostbite!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Nunca saberemos se não tentaremos!
.<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>..............
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,11)><$textsize(2)>Isso está congelando!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,10)>Isso foi um ar frio de você?

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Well, dear, I DID warn you!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>I think your moisturizing would feel too wet and sticky for
me, too.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)>I think it’s best that we stick to the skincare routines that
work for us!
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>Bem, querida, eu avisei você!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>Acho que sua hidratação se sentiria muito molhada e pegajosa para
mim também.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)>Acho que é melhor ficarmos com as rotinas de cuidados com a pele que
funcionam para nós!

source:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)>Agreed! Let’s each keep up our beauty in our own
unique way!
translation:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)>Vamos cada um manter nossa beleza em nossa própria
maneira única!

source:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Huh? You’re not scared at all? You’re...LAUGHING?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)>All right, pal, you asked for it! Next time, I’m gonna scare
the chuckles right outta ya!
translation:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Você não está com medo, você está... laughing?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,22)>Tudo bem, amigo, você pediu isso! Da próxima vez, eu vou
assustar as risadas logo de cara!

source:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>N-nooo, that’s not it...
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>You were making such a scaaary face, <$cdef(27)>Arbok. It really
made me juuump.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>So I had to try reeeaaally hard not to explode...
translation:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>N-noooo, não é isso...
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Você estava fazendo uma cara<$cdef(27)> tão escamosa
, Arbok.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)>Então eu tive que tentar reeeaaaaaally difícil não explodir...

source: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)>I... Um... I kinda explooode when I get staaartled...
translation: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)>Eu... meio que exploro quando fico de pé...

source:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,13)><$comeff(2,11)>No way!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)>Well, maybe next time I’ll scare you from a safe distance.
translation:
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,13)><$comeff(2,11)>De jeito nenhum!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,1)>Bem, talvez da próxima vez eu vou assustá-lo a uma distância segura.

source:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hmmm... But it might not be very scaaary if you’re
far away. <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>I don’t have very good eyesight, y’knooow...
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Mas pode não ser muito escamoso se você estiver
longe. Eu <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>não tenho uma visão muito boa, você sabe...

source: <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Dang it! You’re tougher to prank than I thought...
translation: <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Você é mais difícil de brincar do que eu pensava...

source: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Yeah! Your pattern looks like a big face—it’s SO COOL!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,817)>Oh, hey! How does it look when I do it? *whiiirl!*
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Whoa, nice! Your pattern looks like a face, too!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>No way! Really? What kind of face?
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Uh... I’d probably call it more “cute” than “cool?”
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,7)>Sounds like neither of us are hittin’ the vibe we want, huh?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,4)>Mrrrll, prrrrze! Rrrv grt brrrez strk rn mr chrrks!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>You have too much food in your mouth! I can’t understand
what you’re saying!

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Huh? Did you just say, “so sweet”?
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)>Are you complimenting me?

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>That was a “yes” just now, right?! Hee hee, oh, you’re
gonna make me blush!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, that’s good! So, can you tell me what you were saying
just now?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Um... I was saying “Help! Help me! I jammed way too many
berries in my cheeks!”
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Huh... Well, I was pretty much right!

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh! Ya still got a long way to go, <$cdef(27)>Mr. Mime! Might wanna
consider relearnin’ the fundamentals, I reckon!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh! Você ainda tem muito que aprender, <$cdef(27)>Mr. Mime! Acho que
seria bom praticar o básico de novo!

source: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Yooo... Seriously? I thought I was doin’ pretty good...
translation: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Eu pensei que estava indo muito bem...

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,43)>Ya won’t intimidate any opponents with slaps like those!
translation: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,43)>Você não vai intimidar nenhum oponente com tapas como essas!

source:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, uh, these aren’t slap attacks or whatever, yo. I was
pantomiming.
translation:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, ahn, isso não são ataques de tapas ou qualquer outra coisa, eu
estava pantomiming.

source:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,814)><$comeff(2,10)>Uh, y’know, like...if I move like this, it makes you think
there’s a wall here you can’t see.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>It’s pretty fun. You should give it a go, <$cdef(27)>Hariyama!
translation:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,814)><$comeff(2,10)>ahn, você sabe, tipo... se eu me mover assim, isso faz você pensar que
há uma parede aqui que você não pode ver.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Você deveria dar uma chance, <$cdef(27)>Hariyama!

source:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Well I’ll be... Them’s some fancy moves ya got there.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)>S’pose I can give it a try. Let’s see, now...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,629)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!!!<$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,5)>
translation:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Bem, eu vou ser... eles são alguns movimentos extravagantes que você tem lá.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)>Suponha que eu possa tentar, vamos ver, agora...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,629)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!!!<$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,5)>

source: <turn(1,270)><$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)><$motionoff(2,805)>Uhhh... You’re not s’posed to BREAK the wall, yo...
translation: <turn(1,270)><$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)><$motionoff(2,805)>Você não está destinado a quebrar a parede, você...

source:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Gahaha! That so? Well, it was good trainin’ for me anyhow,
I tell ya what!
translation:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Bem, foi bom treinar para mim de qualquer maneira, eu
te digo o quê!

source: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, next it’s my turn to hide!
translation: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, em seguida, é a minha vez de se esconder!

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Don’t worry, I’ll find you real quick. I’m good at
hide-and-seek! The seeking part in particular.
translation:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Não se preocupe, eu vou encontrá-lo muito rápido. Eu sou
bom em esconder-e-buscar a parte de busca em particular.

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmph! I’ll hide so good you’ll NEVER find me!
translation: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Vou me esconder tão bem que você nunca vai me encontrar!

source:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>But that’s what I mean!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>You’re thinking real hard about hiding, and thoughts like
that leak out.<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)> I pick up on things like that!
translation:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>Mas é isso que quero dizer!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Você está pensando muito em se esconder,
e pensamentos<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)> como esse vazam.

source: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? Really? OK, so what am I thinking now? Guess!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, no... I wasn’t gonna cheat! I was just gonna
camouflage myself as something to help me hide!
translation:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Não, eu não ia trair, só ia me camuflar
como algo para me ajudar a me esconder.

source:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Umm...well...uh... Oh, I know!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve got a quiz for you! What am I thinking NOW?!
translation:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hum... bem... ahn... Oh, eu sei!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu tenho um teste para você, o que eu estou pensando agora?

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Let me see...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>“I’m done with hide-and-seek, but maybe you could say
my camouflage skills are really cool”?
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Deixe-me ver...
"<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Estou farto de esconde-esconde, mas talvez você possa dizer que
minhas habilidades de camuflagem são muito legais"?

source: <$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey... Don’tcha think we kinda look alike?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Yeah, we really do! See, look at our ears—and the fur on
top of our heads!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Now that you mention it...I guess we do! Weird!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Oh wow! I should call you Big Sis <$cdef(27)>Zorua from now on!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Wait... It looks like we have a different number of tails.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,807)>Huh? Oh, you’re right... Everything else matches, so I
wonder how come that’s different...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)>Oh, I know!

<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>I bet I’m gonna have six tails, too! They just haven’t grown
in yet!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>If that happens, no one’ll be able to tell us apart anymore!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Oh, my! You’re back for another electricity contest? You’re
always bursting with energy, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Today’s the day I take you down! Here I go!
<$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUU!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Goodness, how impressive! You’ve powered up since last
time, dear!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ehehe! Sounds like this’ll be an easy win, then!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hee hee... Well, I suppose I’d better not hold back...
<$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUUUUU!

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)>Urk... Fine—you beat me THIS time!
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>See ya tomorrow, then!

<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>*wheeze*... *gasp* W-we’re doing this...tomorrow, too?
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Guess I’d better charge up somewhere... Oh, to be young
and full of energy!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>I hear you’ve been talkin’ big around these parts.
That true?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! Sure is! ’Cause there ain’t nobody who can
beat me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Wanna battle me ’n’ see fer yerself?

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Interestin’ proposition! I ain’t never lost a battle myself...
You’re on!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Never lost a battle, ya say? Gwahaha! Then I guess it’s up
to ME to send ya packin’ <$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>with one of my best moves!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oho! That’s a powerful move ya got there! I can see why
you’re so fulla bluster!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>But that powerful move ain’t worth much if it can’t hit me!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,4)>*fwoooooosh*
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! You pulled a disappearin’ act on me!
<$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,7)>Gwahaha! Well? Still think ya can beat me?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>You’re certainly makin’ it harder to aim, but I ain’t beat
yet! <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>GRAAAHR! <$cdef(27)>Rock Slide combo attack!

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Whoa! Careful now! I reckon ya’d feel real bad if ya hit
<$cdef(27)> with a stray rock!

<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Grrrah! Guess I got a li’l too fired up! Sorry ’bout
that, <$cdef(27)>...

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Phew. You’re a wild one, all right... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,2)>Ya may never have lost
a battle, but ya lose yer cool pretty often, don’t ya?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m the best at mimicry! Just watch!
<$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!
translation:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu sou o melhor em mimetismo!
É<$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)> você quando está voando!

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(2,8)>I’M the best at mimicry! Just watch, yo!
<$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>...............
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu sou o melhor em mimetismo!
É<$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(2,10)> você quando está voando!

source:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I was mimicking you! Sounded JUST like you, didn’t it?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Looks like I’m the best at mimicry for real, huh?
translation:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu estava imitando você! Ficou IGUALZINHO, né?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Parece que sou mesmo o melhor em imitação!

source:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I-I’m not gonna give up that easily! I’ve still got some
tricks up my sleeve...
translation:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Não vou desistir tão facilmente, ainda tenho alguns
truques na manga...

source:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>!
Come to think of it, <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>you’ve been mimicking a human
this whole time, haven’t you?
translation:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>!
Pensando bem, você<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)> tem imitado um humano
o tempo todo, não é?

source:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yooo... I hate to admit it, but I dunno if I’d stand a chance
against <$cdef(27)>...
translation:
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Odeio admitir, mas não sei se teria uma
chance contra <$cdef(27)>...

source:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Yeah... I’d get exhausted trying to mimic something for
so long...
translation:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Sim... eu ficaria exausta tentando imitar algo por tanto
tempo...

source:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, uh, then I guess the winner of the best mimicker
contest is...<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$cdef(27)>!
translation:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, ahn, então eu acho que o vencedor do concurso
melhor imitador é... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$cdef(27)>!

source: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,9)>Pahhh?! That scared me... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What was that all the sudden?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, I saw a tree branch flying on the wind this way, so I
merely sliced it away. <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>You’re not injured, are you?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh...I’m fine, thank you!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>I have to say, you looked so cool just now, <$cdef(27)>Empoleon! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>You
were all like “swish!”
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah, you’re referring to the move I used to cut the branch?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah! That’s what I meant! I couldn’t see it well because
it was so fast... <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Could you do it again, please?
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,5)>Yes, of course. A trivial task. Now watch closely... <wait(1.0)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>Yah!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow, amazing! How do you do that? <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>N-not that I want to
try to do it or anything...

<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,9)>Haha, you’re perfectly capable of it. Why not attempt it
and see for yourself?

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ll give you a slower demonstration. Try to do as I do.
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah! Like that.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, I can do this... <$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Yah!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>How was that? I thought it was pretty good...

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Heh heh. You have admirable form. I look forward to
seeing what the future holds for you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon</color>... Do you only eat one kind of berry?
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Well, your home’s filled with piles of the same berry.

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ohhh, you mean my snack stash! Funny story: I grabbed a
berry to eat later, <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>and next thing I knew, it was gone!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>But these things happen, right? So I went out to pick up
another one, but when I came back, I found the old one.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>And I always grab the same kind of berry to replace the
one I thought I lost!

<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Wait, this happened more than once? And that’s why you
have so many? Wow, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon... You’re something else.
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Say, why don’t I help you clear some of them away?

<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa, you serious? That’d be awesome!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>To be honest, it’s kinda annoying when I wake up to find
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>a bunch of berries stuck on my spiky bod.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>If you don’t mind helping me tidy, I’d really appreciate it!

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>No problem, just leave it to me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>First, I’ll flood your whole place with a gush of water...

<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, hey, hold up, pal! My home’ll get totally soaked if
you do that!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, yeah. The berries get washed away, plus your home
gets nice and damp. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s the problem?

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>The problem? Well, I don’t really wanna live in a wetland,
for starters...
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Y’know what, forget about it. I’ll get rid of ’em myself...
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! Could I have some of your wool?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I just thought that if I filled my home with your wool, it’d
be all fluffy and nice!

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>But my wool is so light, it could get blown away if
it’s ever windy, y’know.

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh, right... That’s not good...
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait! If we combined a bunch of wool with my string,
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>could that keep it from blowing away?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ohhh, yeah! You might be a genius... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>That sounds
fun, so lemme, y’know, help out!

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks! Now the question is, <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>HOW do we combine your
wool and my string...

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, the idea of combining wool and string kinda
reminds me of <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>those human tools
<$cdef(27)> makes.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>You’re right! Let’s start by getting something made by
<$cdef(27)>,
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>and
studying
it carefully!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! You don’t know any good hiding spots, do you?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Hiding spots?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... How about inside a cave or in the shade of a tree?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>No one will bother you there, so you can rest easy.

<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,7)>Nah, that’s no fun! I wanna find a spot where I can hide
then jump <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>out and scare folks! Hehe!

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh dear. Up to a little mischief, are you? I wonder what
I would do if you pulled that little prank on me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Perhaps I’d wrap you up tightly in a bundle of my thread...
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Then I’d hang you up and leave you there, alone, afraid...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Don’t worry, I’m only teasing! I would never do that.

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>But don’t you think troublemakers who thoughtlessly
frighten others deserve a taste of their own medicine?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I certainly do. That is why you mustn’t pull too many
pranks, little <$cdef(27)>Gastly. Otherwise, well...
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>I-I won’t! I promise! Please don’t tie me up!

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>*rumble*... I’m so hungry...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, do you have anything I could eat?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Really? Can I have some, then? I’m so hungry I feel like
I’m gonna collapse...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Suuure. They have a little sludge on them, though...

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,1)>Some Pokémon don’t liiike sludgy berries. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,18)><$voicel(1,8)>But here, you
can have one if you don’t mind...

<$emotion(2,63)><$voicel(2,8)>Fine with me! Thanks...
<$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,5)>*chomp*! *munch munch*...<$motion(2,19)>
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... The sludge makes it so creamy and tasty!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah... I like it a lot! It’s so good.
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ooh, I’ve got an idea. We should try putting sludge on
other foods, too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Like, on vegetables, and y’know, full meals...
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh? I dunno... That seems like a lot of wooork...
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>Hmmmmmm... I don’t know what to dooo...

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Yeeeaaah. You see, um...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>We look kinda similar, riiight? <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>We’re kinda shaped the
same, and we both like the sea, and...yeah...
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Now you mention it, yes. You might be right.

<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>But I can’t give others riiides on my back like you can.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m so jeeeaaalous that you can, <$cdef(27)>Lapras...

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Is that so? Well, I’m often told that the shell on my back <$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,4)>is
hard and uncomfortable to ride on.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>So I sometimes feel envious of your soft back.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee. You’re gonna make me bluuush. But my back’s
kind of sliiimy and slick, <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>you know? So it’s really difficult
for other Pokémon to stay on top and go for a riiide...

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>What’s wrong with that? I imagine all the little ones would
see your back <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>as a fun sort of slide!

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I never thought of it thaaat way... That makes me kind of
happy. Thaaanks, <$cdef(27)>Lapras.

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey heyyy! You just get back from a nice swim or
somethin’?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Isso é verdade, embora eu esteja flutuando por aí,<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)> o

não é?

source:

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I really like the evening wind myseeelf...

muito no vento de Saaame, hein?
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu realmente gosto do vento da noite myseeelf...

source:

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I try catching the wind so I can get a good view!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>But I like the wind during the day too, y’know.

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, eu sei o que você quer dizer, fica tão legal e legal à

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)> pegar o vento para que eu possa ter uma boa vista!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas eu gosto do vento durante o dia também, você sabe.

source:

translation:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, sim, é tão bom e quente e bom para cochilos, às vezes eu
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>flutuar reeeaaaaaally alto enquanto eu estou cochilando...

source:

source:

sooo cute!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu gosto de como gira quando você
salta!

source:

translation:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Essas folhas na sua cabeça também são boas, são
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>todas verdes e, sabe, folhosas.

source:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I know, right? The tips of my leaves are so cool

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>As pontas das minhas folhas são tão legais
e pontudas!
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Mas, ainda assim... eu realmente gostaria de ter uma flor como a sua...

source:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, grass doesn’t really catch the eye, y’know? It’s
just...sometimes I really wanna BLOOM!
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>It’d be fun to be in the spotlight a little...
translation:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, a grama realmente não
chama a atenção, sabe?
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>Seria divertido estar no centro das atenções um pouco...

source:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oooh! I gotcha. But I don’t think you need to worry
about that...
translation:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu te peguei, mas acho que não precisa se preocupar
com isso.

source:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I mean, it’s not like I always had a flower like this. <$voicel(1,6)>I used to
just have a couple of leaves sticking out.

someday too!
translation:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Quer dizer, não é como se eu sempre tivesse uma flor <$voicel(1,6)>assim. Eu
costumava ter apenas algumas folhas saindo.
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Então talvez você vai, você sabe, crescer uma grande flor
um dia também!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>medida que o dia começa, sinta suas penas

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>Sim, acho que isso <$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(1,1,2)><$lookat(2,0,1)><$lookat(2,1,1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>acaba bem!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Sua música me dá uma sensação tão boa e acolhedora... Quase como

of
